One way of resolving this is to simply tolerate such foreigners as if they were our own kinsmen, and not to attempt to subdue them to our culture.

name: Mapmaking
description: Accurately drawing the borders and landmarks of a country is much more than art — it helps us collect information about other nations for strategic purposes. By knowing where important places are exactly, we can not only better coordinate attacks, but also gain more knowledge about our own territory. As the elders often say, knowledge is power.

name: Colonies
description: Be it by sending our own people to settle in new lands, by imposing our rule over the natives in our overseas holdings, or through a mix of both, establishing a colony creates a foothold for our power that will let us further expand our control — and borders — in these unclaimed territories.

name: Codified Laws
description: Statutes and regulations are the backbone of any well-functioning society. If we are to hone our efficiency and internal capabilities, a set of robust codified laws is of vital importance.

name: $distribution_of_power_law$
description: $distribution_of_power_law_desc$

name: Subject Nations
description: Granting our subject nations some autonomy over local governance keeps them from revolting while ensuring they continue to provide tribute to the realm.

name: Taxation
description: Operating a civilized society implies the maintenance of a central authority, and that authority must be supported through some form of currency. By extracting taxes from our subjects and citizens, we will be more productive and better able to achieve great things for our people.

name: State Administration
description: Taxing our population is only feasible as long as we know who lives where and what local customs and laws apply to each person. We must establish a comprehensive administration to properly manage our realm.

name: Legalism
description: Laws and rules mean nothing if they are not compiled, standardized, and made understandable to every member of our society. By codifying clear legal standards and enforcing them uniformly, we will ensure that the principles of order and justice reach the furthest corners of our realm.

name: Medieval Administration
description: With a military elite in place to govern our society, the next stage of development is to build a literate class of administrators. Typically, these roles will be filled by drawing from the clergy.

name: $pest_house$
description: $pest_house_desc$

name: Banking Traditions
description: While many seek wealth in the opportunities of trade and commerce, our state fills its coffers by offering entirely fair and highly affordable loans.

name: Hospitals
description: Hospitals were first established during the Middle Ages to provide care for the sick, poor, and disabled. Typically run by religious orders, these hospitals offered a range of medical services, including basic nursing care, herbal remedies, and eventually, surgery. They were often located near churches or monasteries and had separate wards for men and women. Despite limited medical knowledge, these hospitals played a vital role in offering sanctuary, comfort, and some form of medical treatment to those in need during a challenging period in history.

name: Agriculture
description: The land is generous, and provides us with abundant crops and resources. But in order to advance our society and become a prosperous nation, we must learn how to shape and tame the land, and to extract the best possible treasures from it.

name: $windmill$
description: $windmill_desc$

name: Aqueduct System
description: Through carefully laid stone channels and gravity-fed conduits, this construct secures a steady supply of fresh water. While simple in construction, these works mark the first step toward organized urban water management.

name: Alchemy
description: The art of alchemy involves the creation of potions and elixirs using a combination of herbs, minerals, and other natural ingredients. While not always reliable, the use of alchemy can sometimes produce remarkable results in treating various ailments.

name: $apothecary$
description: $apothecary_desc$

name: City Building
description: Developing our urban centers has become central to national prosperity, and is a cornerstone of the urbanization movement. By systematically constructing infrastructure and specialized buildings within our cities, we will fuel our economic growth.

name: Ranching
description: Cattle breeding led to the ability to raise entire herds of horses, which in turn has made it possible to breed the best animals for travel, war, and many other tasks.

name: Horse-Riding
description: The domestication of horses has revolutionized the way people move and transport goods. Additionally, the use of horses in combat provides mounted warriors not only with a faster way of moving, but also a higher ground from which to attack their enemies — or even to crush them under the weight of their mounts.

name: Feudalism
description: Feudalism is a political system that is based on service or labor in exchange for holding and working land. It is a collection of rights and obligations to which each member of a structured societal model is bonded.

name: Trade Caravans
description: Lucrative trade routes have crossed our territories since ancient times. Our people are used to interacting with long caravan trains of merchants trading in goods from lands far away.

name: Quarrying
description: Quarrying has been a basic economic activity since the dawn of humanity. The widespread use of metalworking only increased the importance of prospecting and mining different types of minerals and metals for the development of complex societies.

name: Metallurgy
description: Metallurgy, the art of manipulating and working metal, stands as one of the defining capabilities of advanced civilization. Metal tools and weapons are far superior than their stone counterparts, enabling both workers and soldiers to operate with better efficiency.

name: $mining_law$
description: $mining_law_desc$

name: Bronze Working
description: Bronze is an alloy of $copper$ and $tin$, discovered and developed to make much more durable tools and weapons, as it also more ductile and easier to work with than $copper$.

name: $iron$ Working
description: $iron$ is a key material for the production of different types of tools and weapons, making it vital for village blacksmiths as well as large manufacturing chains.

name: $local_smelters$
description: $local_smelters_desc$

name: Advanced Mining
description: The development of more advanced and durable tools has made possible to further expand mining operations for new minerals and metals.

name: Fine-Metals Mining
description: The discovery and development of new metal alloys has made it possible to extract and exploit new fine metals on a larger scale, making the process highly profitable compared to other types of mining.

name: Mandatory Weapon Training
description: All male peasants are required to be proficient with a spear or bow and to train regularly, so as to be a competent soldier if ever they are called to arms.

name: Shipbuilding
description: The seas hold many adventures, much wealth, and commercial — as well as expansionist — opportunities.

name: Trade Fairs
description: As trade routes were revived and expanded during the Middle Ages, new mercantile practices began to appear. One such were trade fairs, large-scale events held annually in towns and cities where merchants and traders from different places could meet and broker deals.

name: Merchant Guilds
description: The formation of guilds has shaped our economy for a long time. While they are common organizations amongst our artisans, the same cannot be said for our merchants. We should encourage our traders to form similar guilds in order to streamline our mercantile ambitions.

name: Coastal Raiding
description: Our country has a long tradition of raiding the coastlines for slaves, money, and all the other necessary things in life.

name: Improved Religious Organization
description: Religion plays a major role in every society, yet not every faith has the same structure. An organized religion has its rituals and belief systems systematically arranged, and follows defined doctrines.

name: Classic Scholasticism
description: Based on Aristotelian logic and the writings of the early $christian_ADJ$ Fathers, scholasticism aims to spread knowledge by emphasizing religious dogmatic beliefs and traditions.

name: Guilds
description: A guild is an association of merchants or craftsmen who have come together for mutual protection, aid, and for the pursuit of their own interests. Guilds establish monopolies of their goods and trade, and set standards for the quality and price of trade goods.

name: Peasant Connections
description: Our merchants have established connections to the rural settlements within and beyond our borders. As a result, they are able to secure better prices for food than would otherwise be expected.

name: Master Masons
description: Our construction efforts should never rest and leave our villages and towns idle. Employing a master mason, who will oversee and plan our construction work, we can make significant improvements in expanding our country.

name: Expanded Archives
description: Regular diplomatic endeavors require paperwork and detailed documentation of our contacts.

name: Clearing Terrain
description: We must tame the far reaches of our country in order to expand our economic capabilities. Not only will we provide more space for our people, but we can optimize their contributions to our country.

name: Meritocracy
description: Merit is not exclusive to the upper echelons of our society. It can be found everywhere, even among the humblest individuals. By creating standardized exams that measure this merit, effort, and overall competency, we can find intellectual jewels hidden in plain sight, and properly appoint them for the betterment of our nation.

name: Educated Bureaucrats
description: The officials running our administration are not illiterate and lazy heirs to their parent's seats, but rather educated and talented individuals who have earned their positions through effort and merit. An administration like this will undoubtedly run more smoothly and efficiently than any other.

name: Efficient Bureaucracy
description: Bureaucracy is the oil that makes the wheels of our administration turn smoothly. With the appointment of efficient bureaucrats that have both talent and the will to properly fulfill their tasks, we will ensure the seamless operation of our government structures.

name: Right to Rule
description: Our administration is centered around the premise that the most talented people should be assigned to appropriate posts. As such, the ruler should be the most gifted member of the realm, as befits someone who leads an entire country. In the unfortunate case that the ruler might be lacking, we will need people skilled at 'embellishing' the truth to communicate the ruler's extraordinary competence, be it through imposing statues, astonishing paintings, or exalting verses.

name: Smooth Administration
description: Having an administration composed of the most talented and suitable individuals in our realm helps our country run smoothly and our authority to flow uninterrupted, regardless of any circumstances in which we may find ourselves.

name: Efficient Logistics
description: Logistics and communications are what allow us to properly administer our entire territory. To facilitate better communication between our provincial governors and the central rulership, we need a well-established network of roads for our messengers to travel upon.

name: Provincial Governors
description: Our provinces are not ruled autonomously, nor by any local nobles hungry for power. Instead, governors appointed by our central administration are the ones responsible for extending our authority into every settlement in our country.

name: Appointed Chain of Command
description: Having talented military experts leading our men into battle, rather than entrusting that duty to inept nobles who only were put in leadership roles because of their blue blood, make our armies work more efficiently. The result of that is that we can more easily command larger forces.

name: Temporary Appointments
description: Having our court members serve a position for life carries the inherent risk of them amassing undue power and influence. They also tend to dedicate less effort to their tasks, due to being given excessive responsibilities. To avoid this messiness, we can establish a system of temporary assignments. That way, officials are assigned to the positions they are best qualified for, but can be reassigned with ease should they grow too complacent in their roles.

name: Non-Hereditary Offices
description: Having our court officials pass their offices from father to son is a plague on our administrative system! It does nothing but cause apathy and rot to blight every branch of our authority. All offices should from now on be assigned to those best able to fulfill the required duties, regardless of their lineage.

name: Abacus
description: Abaci may be ancient technology, but it is precisely thanks to proper accounting tools and ledgers that we are able to keep accurate accounts of our wealth. Without these tools and the talented experts who know how to use them, we would be blind to the actual richness of our country.

name: Imperial Ambitions
description: As the countries grew and states consolidated during the High Middle Ages, their ambitions also grew, leading to attempts at creating and recreating empires in their regions.

name: Meticulous Accounting
description: A lack of rigor in accounting is what allows corruption to thrive, and rots countries from within! To avoid this threat to our administration, we must ensure that any changes in our treasury are fastidiously accounted for.

name: Talented Traders
description: Just as we staff our administration with talented officials, we need to ensure our commercial infrastructure is managed by skilled professionals. Having only the brightest minds overseeing our trade operations will keep products moving and revenues flowing without interruption.

name: Government-Sanctioned Celebrations
description: Our people are always eager to celebrate any good tidings, be they in honor of our country or to mark days on the calendar. Instead of letting them hold these joyful gatherings on their own, we should have our administration organize grand public celebrations, so that we can show our people we care about them while fostering a greater sense of unity between them at the same time.

name: Cathedral
description: A cathedral is one of the largest and most important types of $christian_ADJ$ temple, where the Bishop has a #italic cathedra#!, or seat. While a church can be beautiful and detailed, a cathedral is majestic, of enormous dimensions, and adorned with the finest and most intricate details.

name: Medical Schools
description: Specialized sites for medical training, these schools are where scholars go to learn about the human body, diseases, and how to treat and prevent them.

description: A chancery is a bureaucratic office that medieval rulers developed for governing their domains as societal changes made them more complex and increasingly difficult to manage. The main function of a chancery is to write, send, and receive documents related to the management of these domains.

name: Art Schools
description: Dedication to the aesthetic crafts, and the refinement of our artists, must be properly cultivated by the establishment of art schools. Each shall be an incubator for gifted individuals to commence their artistic careers and bring glory and splendor to our nation!

name: Lieutenancy
description: As the Crown's patrimony grows, the monarch's extended absences from the various kingdoms weaken the Crown and strain relations with subjects. To address this, the position of lieutenant emerges, acting as the monarch's temporary representative during their absences, which are not meant to be permanent. These lieutenants are not only from the royal bloodline but also from the domestic circle connected to the king's family.

name: Viceroyalty
description: A viceroyalty refers to a distinct and semi-autonomous territorial unit within a kingdom, characterized as a monarchical state governed by a designated viceroy. These administrative entities are entrusted to a viceroy, appointed by the monarch, with the crucial responsibility of managing and governing a specific country or province. Typically situated apart from the central core of the kingdom, the viceroyalty operates as a separate entity, exhibiting a degree of self-governance while ultimately being answerable to the reigning monarch. The viceroy's role encompasses a wide range of duties, including the implementation of policies, the maintenance of order, and the representation of the king's authority in the designated region.

name: Better Integration
description: Our administration is improving, and as such, we can afford the manpower to integrate larger sections of land into our country at once.

name: New Lands of Plenty
description: New lands mean new opportunities — and new resources to exploit. By encouraging our population to settle abroad and take advantage of these abundant resources, we will reap enormous benefits.

name: New Lands of Opportunity
description: A whole new world lies open before us, and that means our people are dreaming about what their lives could be in these distant lands. We should encourage these thoughts, embellishing stories of gold and glory to be found in the unexplored territories, so that our people will be eager to settle these new lands for us.

name: Shared Knowledge
description: It is not a shame that others know what we do not, but it is never to our benefit if we do nothing to remedy that ignorance. By actively studying and learning from the discoveries of others, we can better improve our own knowledge of the world.

name: Strict Monetary Control
description: Some may think that if we need more money, the only thing we need to do is mint more, but that is neither sustainable nor wise. By keeping strict control over our minting industry, we can keep our inflation in check, and possibly even reduce it.

name: Social Ladder
description: It is said that chaos is a ladder for those seeking higher status. For us, this ladder comes not from chaos but from order, as we have systematized pathways allowing our people to improve their social standing through merit. We not only permit such advancement; we actively encourage it.

name: Deflating Tensions
description: No country benefits from its neighbors being constantly vigilant of its movements. We must employ active diplomacy to immediately deflate any tensions that may arise, so that our neighbors have no reason to be concerned about us.

name: Nation State
description: Uniting as a single culture under a single flag is a powerful, moving idea. By fostering a sense of national identity, we will ensure the loyalty of our subjects and citizens to our cause.

name: Restricted Information Access
description: We cannot expect to perform well in either the diplomatic or military spheres if our secrets can easily be leaked to any foreign country. We must keep stronger control over how our information flows to quickly plug any possible leakage.

name: Keep Agitators in Check
description: At some point, people may be discontent with our leadership — it is practically unavoidable. However, these grumblings will not grow into anything major as long as we do not let them fester. If we actively seek out those who raise their voices against us, we can nip any agitation in the bud before they have the chance to rally others around them, and thus keep the general populace content. Or at least complacent.

name: Call of the Frontier
description: We are surrounded by weakly defended territories ripe for the taking! Let us send out some adventurous courtiers to enforce our authority in these unclaimed lands.

name: Castellany System
description: Official castellans are appointed to manage local strongholds and their garrisons, marking the first organized framework for the administration and maintenance of fortresses.

name: Border Wardens
description: Regional wardens coordinate multiple castles along frontier marches, establishing supply routes, reporting chains, and mutual defense between neighboring strongholds.

name: Defense Bureau
description: The $crown_estate$ centralizes oversight of fortifications under a formal bureau in the capital, consolidating records, funds, and maintenance orders into a single administrative authority.

name: Inspectors General
description: Professional inspectors travel the realm to evaluate garrisons, stores, and walls, enforcing consistent standards and ensuring the reliability of each fortified place.

name: Standardized Engineering
description: National standards for construction and repair are introduced, enabling efficient planning, shared designs, and predictable maintenance across our network of fortresses.

name: Ordnance Surveys
description: Comprehensive mapping and logistical integration link every fortress into a coherent defensive system; an achievement of bureaucracy, science, and state power working in unison.

name: $paper_guild_fiber_pulp_maintenance$
description: Utilizing fiber plants like hemp or paper mulberry, paper production will become widely available across the world. While cheap to produce, this paper is lacking in quality.

name: $paper_guild_cloth_maintenance$
description: $paper_guild_cloth_maintenance$, made from cotton unfit to be processed or otherwise used, set new standards for quality and durability.

name: $paper_guild_wood_pulp_maintenance$
description: Using widely available softwood, paper will be easier and cheaper to produce than ever before.

name: Monarchy Reform Traditions
description: Authority cannot be entrusted to just any individual. Concentrating power and influence in the hands of the ruler will help them create order and stability throughout the realm.

name: Republic Reform Traditions
description: Dissemination of power is a cornerstone belief of any healthy republic. Robust laws enforcing elections by lottery will ensure stability and reduce corruption.

name: Road Building
description: The transportation of goods, troops, and people is vital to our nation's survival. By developing a basic road network, we will be able to at least connect our people and assist them in their daily endeavors.

name: Supply Lines
description: Land warfare is becoming more dependent on supplying bigger and bigger armies. Therefore, better organization of our supply carts would lead to an increased operational capacity.

name: Standardized Pikes
description: A pike is a remarkably simple weapon to make, but to get the full benefit from their use, the entire formation must be wielding weapons of similar length and blade.

name: Caliber Standardization
description: With artillery's growing importance on the battlefield, the number of firearms kept increasing. But because each gun was made separately, it also required great effort to resupply. In 1544, in an effort to mitigate this, Emperor Charles V declared that there would be only five calibers of guns, while King Henry II of $FRA$ set the standard of calibers at six.

name: Army Logistics Planning
description: How far an army can march is a consequence of its logistics. With proper study and planning, armies can withstand longer and more distant campaigns.

name: Campaign Logistics Planning
description: Planning the logistics of warfare has become increasingly complex, as the growth in average army size has made it possible to field several armies at once for long-term campaigns, involving hundreds of thousands of soldiers for multiple years.

name: Thirst for Knowledge
description: Natural curiosity, and the desire to understand our world and how it functions, is what pushes us forward. Our people are eager to gain knowledge, and it is this spark in their minds that will ignite progress for our nation.

name: Empiricism
description: Things are what they are because we can feel them, see them, and overall experience them with our senses. It is by using this empirical evidence that we come up with newer ideas.

name: Court Accounting
description: The court is the symbol of our country, and its prosperity shall represent that of the nation. However, this does not mean that the court can spend more than the country can sustain; there should be proper accounting for what is spent at court.

name: Debt and Loans
description: Debt is sometimes simply unavoidable. However, an organized debt market will allow us to float loans at a lower interest rate.

name: Benefits for Mercenaries
description: Mercenaries will always look out for themselves first, so we need to ensure that any we hire remain with us. By properly looking after our mercenary companies, they will stay loyal for longer and require less direct monetary compensation.

name: Mercenary Recruitment
description: Money is not the only limiting factor when it comes to recruiting mercenaries. The other bottleneck is finding mercenary companies who actually wish to serve with us. Thus, we must ensure our system allows every company to join us.

name: Local Infrastructure
description: Despite our focus on country-wide affairs, we must not neglect our local state legislators and bailiffs.

name: Church Attendance Duty
description: Adopting a mandatory church attendance policy will emphasize the importance of our religious values and beliefs, and will minimize the costs of maintaining law and order.

name: Deus Vult
description: Join the battle cry of the Crusades — 'God wills it' — and crush the heretics!

name: Anti-Piracy Leagues
description: The proliferation of pirates, brigands, and robbers in the waters along our trade routes has forced our merchants to band together and form Merchant Leagues, which facilitate the protection of their boats during long journeys.

name: Dynamic Court
description: A truly innovative court is one where any person may rise to prominence. We must strive to make sure that old traditions, as well as prejudices around one's birth or level of wealth, do not hinder the development of our court or act as a barrier to talented people wishing to serve our state.

name: Missionary Schools
description: Although there is no shortage of people willing to spread the word of the true faith, most of them ultimately do more harm than good. However, establishing specialist schools to properly train missionaries will ensure we have more people who cannot only spread the faith, but do so successfully.

name: Preaching Missions
description: Establish missionary expeditions that will ensure that our population worships the one true faith.

name: Organized Construction
description: Upgrading our government's infrastructure is a costly business. However, if we structure the process correctly, we can do it for less expense.

name: Organized Mercenary Payments
description: Mercenary captains are a canny lot. They will try to coax two commanders in the same army into a bidding war over their services. We must streamline our mercenary recruitment process to prevent this sort of trickery, and to ensure we are always in the best position during negotiations.

name: A Seed Among Thorns
description: The world is huge, and we should not grow complacent with our position in it, for our neighbors will not necessarily do the same. We shall set our sights on expanding our borders and making ourselves stronger, lest we risk being swallowed up by growing neighbor states.

name: Faster Colonists
description: You cannot simply send colonists out to the New World and expect them to just build a colony. There is first a time-consuming process of preparing the expedition with everything they will need to survive in their new home. We can speed this process up, now that we have some prior experience.

name: Additional Merchants
description: Colonies are no good to us unless we can bring their riches home to the mother country. We must expand our merchant class to ensure that this happens.

name: Efficient Mining
description: We shall issue a decree to refine every aspect of metal mining within our domain, in an effort to regulate its presence in our markets.

name: Efficient Construction Plans
description: Our efficient building strategy allows us to complete complex work orders without taking any half measures.

name: Expanded Infrastructure Network
description: Our national road network is a vital part of our commercial and administrative success. As such, we should care to maintain and improve it.

name: Divine Supremacy
description: It is of the utmost importance that we rid our nation and its surrounding borders of the non-believers that plague our lands.

name: Devotion
description: Religion is one of the most important bulwarks of our rulership. By making grand displays of our religious devotion in public, we will inspire the people to follow suit, and this proliferation of piety amongst our people will strengthen our rule.

name: Religious Tradition
description: The strength of our faith, and the impressive public displays of piety and worship we stage, are admired by other countries both near and far. This is a clear reflection of the prestige and glory of our realm.

name: Advanced Bureaucracy
description: Allows us to increase our tax revenues by adopting a more bureaucratic administrative system governed by state officials.

name: National Bank
description: By establishing a central authority for financial matters, we will have better control over our nation's economy.

name: Competitive Merchants
description: To bring the focus of our trade home, we must be able to beat competition from other countries. We need to ensure that our legal system gives our merchants every possible advantage.

name: Humanist Tolerance
description: By striving to create a more tolerant society, and attempting to solve our social and religious problems in more rational ways, the risk of civil disorder will be diminished.

name: Cultural Ties
description: Different cultures have different customs, and for some reason, they tend to resist attempts from their rulers to change said customs. We can turn this weakness into a strength by incorporating local leaders into our system of government and having them carry out our will in a way that will be palatable to their people.

name: Ecumenism
description: Determining how to deal with the heretics in our realm is always tricky. Although the good, old-fashioned fire-and-sword approach will solve most problems eventually, diplomacy can also succeed. By encouraging dialogue between the various sects, we can reduce misunderstandings and promote peace in the realm.

name: Formalized Officer Corps
description: Traditionally, our military officers come from the nobility, but we do not have enough people in that estate to fill the necessary roles. However, there are many skilled members of the lower classes in our armies who would do nicely — we should consider promoting some of them as professional officers.

name: Religious Unification
description: There is only one religion that is true, and thus it is our duty to unite all the faithful under the sole guidance of God.

name: Centralized Government
description: If we centralize the state, then we will find it easier to advance the ideas and agenda of the center over the other regions.

name: Subservient Economy
description: The economy and wealth of a country should serve the government, not the opposite way around. As such, it is in the state's best interests to accumulate the lion's share of resources, both as a show of our power and in order to better carry out our will. Only with this system can our nation truly prosper.

name: Additional Colonists
description: The New World is many things, but the most important thing of all is that it is empty. Well, no one important lives there, at any rate. By letting people know of the boundless opportunities that await them in the New World, we will encourage more people to go forth and settle there.

name: Additional Diplomats
description: The drive to expand our country means we must also expand our diplomatic reach. We must ensure that our diplomatic service is properly staffed.

name: Bookkeeping
description: Sometimes money is short, and we need to borrow. Lenders always worry that they will not be paid back. By maintaining meticulous records, we will be able to ensure that everyone gets reimbursed, which will allow us to negotiate lower rates of interest.

name: Civil Service
description: Establishing a civil service of eager young bureaucrats will ensure that we can quickly adapt to new advances in administration and governance.

name: Local Traditions
description: Governing a large nation means ruling over diverse peoples, each with their own customs and traditions. By incorporating these traditions into our official code of laws, we will create a happier and more loyal populace.

name: Humanism
description: Mankind is the highest creation of our Lord, and thus it is natural to place it in the center of Creation. Every aspect of human nature has to be preserved and encouraged, from its well-being to its propensity for free will and exploration.

name: Formal Administration
description: Correct procedures and a well-oiled administrative apparatus result in a prosperous country, for without a proper administration, anything that the state attempts to accomplish will just remain fruitless. We will formalize and standardize our administration, so that the will of the state flows through it naturally to all corners of the nation.

name: Optimism
description: Victory is not just won on the battlefield, but also in the drawing rooms. Our advancement of reason helps our people shrug off the effects of temporary setbacks, and prepare instead for our inevitable victory.

name: Indirect Rule
description: Sometimes the best way to get people to do what you want is to let them believe that they have had a choice in the matter. A system of indirect rule like that will reduce the unrest in newly acquired provinces, giving them the impression that they have more self-determination than they truly do.

name: Smithian Economics
description: By opposing mercantilism and restricting the state's influence in economic matters, we shall support a free market that will increase our overall production efficiency.

name: Nationalistic Enthusiasm
description: Giving our troops adequate support is vital to national defense. With our excellent administration, we are able to secure generous discounts on our military supplies.

name: Improved Shipyards
description: To defend our interests around the globe, we will require a strong [navy|e]. We must ensure our shipyards can produce ships as quickly as possible to replace any losses we may suffer.

name: Efficiency in Administration
description: The most important factor in efficient government is getting the right advice. We must ensure that we are as inclusive as possible when it comes to advisors, so we can maximize the number of different viewpoints we are presented with.

name: Benevolence
description: Our nation is a bastion of tolerance and enlightenment. By ensuring that all other nations know this, we can foster better relations abroad.

name: Fortification Logistics
description: By ordering our system of fortifications in an organized manner, both construction-wise and logistically, we may save some coin on maintaining it in the long term.

name: Regulation Bureau
description: A legislative body whose jurisdiction involves the maintenance and promotion of inflation-related laws as well as the local administration of our provinces.

name: Integrated Elites
description: By bringing the ruling elite of our subject nations into our government, we can significantly streamline the process of integrating their provinces.

name: Marcher Lords
description: By granting considerable autonomy to vassals in border regions, these 'Marcher Lords' will be able to raise large military armies to support us in our wars.

name: Claim Fabrication
description: Claiming something as yours is easy; persuading everyone else that your claim is valid is much harder. By spreading our diplomatic net wide, we can ensure that the people who matter know that we have staked this claim.

name: Shrewd Commerce
description: Allows us to make use of more refined trading practices, giving our merchants the upper hand over our competitors.

name: Merchant Traditions
description: A steady flow of trade and commerce is a sure sign of a healthy economy. With our merchants focusing on keeping the trade flowing, we can establish a tradition of and reputation for lively commerce, making it easier to attract foreign trade to our nation.

name: Privateers
description: Waging war on enemy commerce is at the apex of naval warfare. We shall encourage the crustiest, saltiest seadogs we can hire to strike at the heart of the enemy's trade, which should help refill our own coffers quickly.

name: Experienced Diplomats
description: Sometimes it is simply enough for people to #italic believe#! that we are powerful. We have worked hard on our diplomatic service to ensure that our word carries extra weight.

name: Benign Diplomats
description: The art of diplomacy is an intricate one. Being good with words is not enough, as one's overall presence and demeanor are crucial to how the words themselves are interpreted. By having our diplomats focus on making a good impression, we will be seen more favorably by other countries.

name: Tribute System
description: Strengthen our income by establishing a formalized system of yearly tribute from our vassals.

name: Pressuring Diplomacy
description: Ending a war requires negotiations between the two opposing parties, and sometimes one party proves itself too stubborn to accept defeat. In such cases, the art of diplomatic pressure — and gently reminding them of their potential imminent annihilation — shall motivate them to accept our generous terms more easily.

name: Quest for the New World
description: Allows us to join the nations set to explore the world outside their borders, or strive to be the first nation to circumnavigate the globe, by commencing a quest for the New World.

name: Fortune-Seekers
description: Establishing colonies in distant lands is nearly always a one-way trip for those involved. Even if strange new diseases do not take you or unforgiving terrain does not starve you, the amount of time it takes to sail back means you will most likely never come home. While these realities are discouraging to some, if we remind people of the potential riches to be gained from colonial life, we can encourage them to settle lands further afield despite the dangers.

name: Overseas Trade
description: News of the discovery of distant lands has reached our nation, and our merchants are already preparing to expand their trading operations. These unexplored territories are filled with prosperous markets dripping with wealth, like so much ripe fruit waiting to be collected.

name: Colonial Ventures
description: Enables us to send more colonists to uncharted lands.

name: Exploration Ideas
description: Our naval superiority allows us to project power well past our own horizons, extending a natural claim to distant lands as our own by right of discovery.

name: Foreign Embassies
description: Diplomacy is a delicate balancing act that requires us to balance the needs and desires of multiple entities at the same time. Maintaining embassies in other countries that report to us on a regular basis will give us the information needed to better weigh our diplomatic options.

name: Efficient Spies
description: Most peasants would happily sell their own mother for gold, but there are some with skills and talents that we in the government might find very useful for...ah, #italic statecraft#!. Although finding these worthy commoners is difficult, through experience we are learning to separate the wheat from the chaff.

name: Vetting
description: Because so many of our government positions are held by those seeking to advance themselves, we sometimes find that those who run our administration are susceptible to bribes from foreign powers. Running some simple background checks will weed out the officials most prone to corruption.

name: Merchant Adventures
description: This allows us to make use of the numerous traders lusting for fame and fortune, eager to offer their services for a chance to search and explore new trade routes.

name: Ship's Penny
description: Ships are expensive to build and maintain. By imposing a ship's penny — a small tax levied on trade or port activities — we can ensure our fleet remains strong without draining our treasury.

name: Audit Checks
description: While we work to infiltrate other nations, we must be vigilant of poisonous ideas spreading around our own courts. Assembling an audit team to ensure our ministers are acting in the state's interest should help root out any rotten elements.

name: Cabinet
description: By establishing an executive council, we are able to assemble our most skilled diplomats.

name: Grand Banquets
description: No important matter can be discussed without an accompanying meal, and the more important the matter is, the more indulgent the meal should be. Having regular grand banquets allows us to constantly and properly discuss all matters that need consideration.

name: Fast Negotiations
description: Sometimes the key to closing a trade deal is to be the quickest one. We must ensure that our merchants can always successfully close their deals.

name: Trade Manipulation
description: At those key choke points where trade supremacy could go one way or another, edging out the regional competition is crucial to expanding our trade income.

name: Diplomatic Influence
description: By focusing on diplomacy, we can increase the power we wield on the world stage, and win many friends and potential allies.

name: Free Trade
description: Our leading merchant families wish to secure trade privileges as their exclusive preserve, but we are unwilling to do so, and will therefore allow the growth of the merchant class.

name: Land of Opportunity
description: By portraying our colonies and the surrounding unclaimed lands as places where anyone can make their fortune, we will rapidly increase emigration to our colonial holdings. This means the nation will spend less money encouraging people to go there.

name: Free Colonies
description: Only so many people are willing to move abroad to expand our great colonial empire. However, the promise of a plot of land to farm in freehold will encourage many more people to seek their fortunes abroad. The nice thing about this is that there is plenty of land for everyone!

name: Grand Navy
description: Allows us to create one of the largest and most powerful navies the world has ever seen.

name: Agent Training
description: We have many covert operations planned, but lack sufficient agents to carry them out. Establishing a training method for our spies will help bolster the ranks of operatives available for dangerous missions.

name: Subject Emissaries
description: Continued communication with our subject nations through dedicated emissaries will positively impact our relations, strengthening the core of our domain and ensuring the loyalty of all countries that stand under our banner.

name: State Propaganda
description: As with a man, a nation's reputation is everything, and the establishment of an official propaganda service will ensure our good name is not smeared by the lies of our enemies.

name: Formal Diplomacy
description: At a time where power is shifting from the hands of powerful individuals towards control by a centralized authority, it is wise to build bridges and open channels of communication between us and our neighbors. Diplomacy is key, and more so than ever in the face of these rising powers.

name: Diplomatic Corps
description: Through the establishment of a professional diplomatic corps, we will ensure that the hard-earned knowledge of senior diplomats is passed on to the younger generation.

name: National Trade
description: Cloth, wool, and other sought-after commodities have made their way across the world. At an age where a nation's commerce reaches faraway shores, we must make sure our merchants always have the advantage!

name: National Trade Policy
description: By adopting a national trade policy, we can strengthen our commercial presence and increase the effectiveness of our trade.

name: Viceroys
description: Makes it possible for us to establish Viceroys, therby improving the administration of our colonies and increase the amount of money they generate.

name: Sheltered Ports
description: It is an unfortunate fact that ships tend to be damaged during battle, and equally unfortunate that the damage can rarely be repaired at sea. To alleviate this problem, we will create a system of sheltered ports along our coastline where our ships can patch themselves up.

name: Naval Fighting Instruction
description: Allows our naval veterans to devise new methods to improve our navy's efficiency in blockades.

name: Merchant Marine
description: Let every merchant ship fly our emblem with pride and know that our navy will always be there to protect them, if needed.

name: Global Empire
description: Our commitment to our colonial empire has transformed attitudes towards working in the colonial administration. No longer seen as a haven for fortune-seeking freebooters, it is now regarded as a prestigious career for the brightest and best. This shift is reflected in more efficient tax collection.

name: Buffer States
description: There is nothing worse than arguing with one's neighbor. If we want to avoid border tensions, having other states act as a buffer between us and our potential enemies will allow us some breathing room.

name: Flexible Negotiation
description: You can never quite predict what could be gained during peace talks, so we should enter with all options open.

name: Overseas Merchants
description: To expand trade, we need to extend the rights of citizenship to people who live abroad, support our trade, and are of the right social class.

name: Postal Service
description: With communications being what they are, it is difficult to ensure that our diplomatic dispatches arrive in a timely fashion. Creating a network of post offices and courier rest stops will make it easier for our voice to be heard in distant lands.

name: Additional Loyalist Recruitment
description: Naturally, there are those within our subject nations who recognize our divine right to rule. By recruiting and aiding these enlightened individuals, we can strengthen our grasp on these territories.

name: Established Rest
description: No army can exist in a permanent state of action; all soldiers need time for rest and recovery. By establishing guidelines and procedures for them to rest, without permitting any laziness, we can keep our troops in prime condition.

name: Merchant Fleets
description: Merchant ships have become a common sight in our waters. Our traders have so many vessels going back and forth that they have effectively formed their own fleet.

name: Seahawks
description: Allows us to focus heavily on military advancements, and thereby increase our Naval Tradition.

name: Ideas of Tolerance
description: Every human was created equal to the Creator, and therefore we understand that their beliefs, even if wrong, can be accepted as a means to eventual conversion to the one true faith.

name: Glorious Arms
description: The sight of our glorious and prestigious army will make all adversaries tremble in fear.

name: Battlefield Commissions
description: Allows us to focus heavily on military advancements and thereby increase our Army Tradition.

name: Finest of Horses
description: How steadily those troops take the ground! How beautifully those cavalry form! Fine horses with well-trained riders are a hallmark of any modern fighting force, and ours are particularly impressive.

name: Designated Instruction
description: Levies are by definition not the best-trained troops, but that does not mean that we have to send a bunch of untrained rabble to war. Assigning them proper instructors from our most proficient units will allow them to learn from the best, and a mandatory training period with them will make them ready — and eager — to fight.

name: Open Levy Standards
description: What makes a man willing to fight and die for his country? Is it his faith? Loyalty to his nation? Or is it simply a desire to protect his family? In the end, the answer does not matter, as everyone has the duty of serving under our banner.

name: Enforced Service
description: The principle of volunteering underpins our whole army structure, but sometimes there are simply not enough willing conscripts. We should force — erm, #italic encourage#! people to volunteer.

name: Naval Glory
description: The awesome sight of our glorious navy will make all adversaries tremble in fear!

name: Boarding Parties
description: By teaching our naval officers to lead boarding actions against enemy ships, we can gain an edge in naval combat even when fighting superior enemy [navies|e].

name: Marine Regiments
description: Marines are military units that specialize in amphibious operations. They can be used in raiding shores and boarding enemy vessels, while still seeing action on land.

name: Military Drill
description: Allows us to invest in military training and thereby improve battle formations, weapon handling, and our army's morale.

name: Administrative Leadership
description: A military leader must not only know about military matters. Logistics, supply administration and allocation, monetary expenses, and similar topics are all also critical concerns for any successful military campaign.

name: Improved Maneuver
description: Tactical positioning is a vital skill for any commander. The ability to maneuver troops effectively around the battlefield will give us a significant edge.

name: Well-Trained Forces
description: The most crucial time for any army comes after battle. Win or lose, troops are most vulnerable when they are exhausted. We must ensure that our troops are highly trained and can recover easily from combat, lest our enemies take advantage of us in moments of weakness.

name: Naval Drill
description: The confusion of combat can leave a warship unfit for action for a long time. A well-drilled crew will recover much faster than an ordinary one.

name: The Old and Infirm
description: Our veteran sergeants are some of the most despicable and corrupt men imaginable, but that does not mean they are useless. Rather than leave them to be beggars on our streets when their service ends, we can put these old dogs to work. We shall make them into drill sergeants and quartermasters so that their unique skills can be put to use.

name: Improved Rams
description: The concept of outfitting warships with rams goes back thousands of years, but great advancements in metallurgy have been made since then, and we should take advantage of these to create sturdier rams.

name: Oak Forests for Ships
description: The more punishment our ships can take, the more they can dish out. Let us ensure that we have a ready supply of the finest seasoned oak for our warships.

name: Naval Cadets
description: By promoting the navy as the ideal career choice for second and third sons of the aristocracy, we can create a professional corps of naval officers to oversee our gunnery crews.

name: Adaptability
description: There is what is ours, and what is part of our ancestral domain that will never be surrendered. A bit of flexibility in defining these 'ancestral' borders will lead to more land being accepted as our rightful territory, and should the worst happen, the whole world will know our crusade to recover it will be just.

name: Defensive Mentality
description: There are those who think that attack is the best form of defense, but that is foolish. Let our enemies come to us instead; we shall counter with incredible zeal. Our troops will defend their homes tenaciously, and our fortresses will withstand sieges for longer.

name: Multicultural Ambitions
description: A country's expansion will inevitably result in it bringing other cultures into its fold. Thus, if we want to further expand our borders, we need to be prepared to become more multicultural.

name: Supply Trains
description: While on campaign, attrition is our most formidable foe, and the key to defending our men against it is a well-planned and efficiently run logistic network capable of providing ample support and supplies.

name: Expanded Supply Trains
description: Investing more resources into our supply trains will allow our army to operate for longer periods of time in hostile territory.

name: Camp Followers
description: Warriors obviously make up the bulk of our armies, but no army can consist of fighters alone. Without the extra entourage of people transporting food and equipment for the army, it would not be able to feasibly go anywhere. By organizing and structuring these camp followers, we can greatly increase their usefulness and efficiency.

name: Engineer Corps
description: Allows us to gather the greatest technological minds our nation has to offer, and make use of their unrivaled services.

name: Defensive Army
description: The rise of many powerful states around us has hastened our need for a robust defensive force, as we intend to maintain our territorial integrity. Knowledge of our homeland's native terrain, hidden paths, and regional tactics will see us through this turbulent period.

name: Conscripted Garrisons
description: By conscripting our able young citizens for our garrisons, we can ensure that we have enough guards to defend our borders.

name: Copper Bottoms
description: Wood may be the ideal material for shipbuilding, but it tends to deteriorate over time. By fitting our ships with copper sheathing below the waterline we can reduce this deterioration, allowing them to better withstand long journeys.

name: Improved Storehouses
description: Having proper storehouses to hold the products required by local businesses is a must if we want those enterprises — to say nothing of the entire economy — to function smoothly.

name: Coastal Careening
description: Ships are undertaking longer voyages than ever before, made possible by new technical advances. This means more complex repairs are needed, but ports with adequate equipment and skilled craftsmen are not always available. Our sailors must be trained in the art of careening — deliberately beaching vessels to expose the parts that need cleaning or repair. This is the only way our fleets can maintain seaworthiness far from their home ports.

name: Improved Foraging
description: Traditionally, we were unable to fight effectively in lands that did not supply enough food. However, our troops have become better at acquiring food in the wild, making it possible for larger armies to fight.

name: Disciplined Drills
description: During combat, only three things matter: firepower, manpower, and the discipline to combine the two. Regular military drills and exercises shall elevate our to a new standard.

name: Absolutist Administration
description: Absolutist rulers not only demonstrate their power in court, but also through an administrative apparatus that may spread throughout the country.

name: Offensive Army
description: The era of gunpowder and military innovations is upon us, and with it comes a renewed interest in and vitality to the conduct of warfare. To further our glory, we must diligently ensure high standards for our offensive armed forces.

name: Superior Firepower
description: The use of massed firepower to disrupt the enemy before delivering a coup de grâce is one of our army's strengths, and we will make sure that our leaders know this.

name: Grand Army
description: Allows us to create one of the largest and most powerful armies the world has ever seen.

name: Regimental System
description: By organizing our armies into regiments tied to distinct geographical areas, we allow them to put down roots in local communities. Then, we need to raise additional battalions for these regiments, recruitment will be faster thanks to these regional ties.

name: Private to Marshal
description: Every private has a marshal's baton in his back. Well, perhaps not exactly, but for those who distinguish themselves in battle, promotion and rewards will follow. The troops know this and are inspired by it.

name: Corvettes
description: Corvettes are a class of small warships that are designed to escort friendly vessels and harass the enemy, relying on speed and maneuverability rather than massed firepower.

name: Bayonet Leaders
description: Men who are well-led will follow, so we must ensure that our officers lead from the front.

name: National Conscripts
description: Increases our military numbers by making military service compulsory for those eligible.

name: Massed Battery
description: Let us mass our artillery in a single grand battery. Its destructive power will blast a hole in the enemy lines!

name: Mass Army
description: We have, up to now, been very selective about who can serve as an enlisted member of our military. We only took the poorest and most desperate — basically, the people no one else would miss. Now, though, we shall open up the ranks to everyone who wishes to serve and has no significant wealth to speak of.

name: The Young can Serve
description: How old does a boy have to be before he is a man? How old must he be before he can die for his country? Some rulers are squeamish; We, on the other hand, are an equal opportunity butcher.

name: Press Gangs
description: Life at sea is hard and unforgiving, and not everyone is keen on a naval career. By legalizing the impressment of sailors and other skilled seafarers, it will be easier to crew our ships, speeding up the process of commissioning ships as well.

name: Superior Seamanship
description: Enables us to transform our navy into a supreme naval force with top-class vessels and highly skilled captains and crew.

name: Improved Logistics
description: The modern art of war nowadays clearly differentiates between amateur officers who talk about tactics, and professional officers who actually study logistics.

name: Unrelenting Advance
description: Our armies on the march is a sight to behold. Their training and discipline shines when they march in unison into battle, unfazed by any previous long march.

name: Coastal Patrols
description: Maintaining regular patrols along all our coasts will ensure that our administrative authority is felt everywhere, even in the farthest regions.

name: Scions of Rûm
description: After surviving a turbulent period, and winning the struggle to dominate our neighboring Beyliks, the time has finally come for us to restore the borders of the once-great Sultanate of Rûm!

name: Seljuk Roots
description: We are surrounded by enemies on all sides, making a strong military an absolute necessity. Fortunately, we are not weak people. From the irregular Ġuzāt and the Akıncılar raiders to the Sipâhi of the $TUR$, the world has come to fear and respect our military might. Let us build an army worthy of an empire, inspired by our glorious traditions and history, honing our might through the ages.

name: $fratricide_succesion$
description: $fratricide_succesion_desc$

name: Splendor of $anatolia_region$
description: Our region is home to some of the most impressive madrasas and mosques in the entire $muslim_ADJ$ world. With their meticulous attention to detail and abundant talent, our artisans shine with unmatched prowess.

name: $IRA_ADJ$ in the Court
description: Persian has served as our administrative language for quite some time, a legacy stemming from our ancient roots. This has helped us transcend the social and cultural barriers that often arise in highly diverse nations like ours.

name: Akıncılar
description: Our light cavalry regiments often raid and sometimes even settle in neighboring territories. Known for their courage in battle, they lived and operated as raiders on the frontier, often the first line of response against incursions from our rivals and perfectly positioned to attack and rout enemy trade routes.

name: Crossroads of Commerce
description: Our $caravanserais$ support the flow of commerce, information, and people from $china$ to $europe$ across our lands. This proximity to important trade routes has unleashed a flood of affluence throughout our nation.

name: Colonial Traditions
description: Our state was formed and shaped by the ambitions of the 'founding fathers,' the first colonists to come over from the old country. Many of the customs and traditions they brought with them have influenced our own society in this new and strange world.

name: Colonial Heritage
description: As a colony, we bear the heritage of our mother country's imperial ambitions.

name: Founding Fathers
description: This refers to all the politicians, soldiers, diplomats, and others who played an influential role in establishing their nation by winning their country's independence and creating a new system of governance.

name: Colonial Militia
description: In the absence of regular garrisons, colonial militias played an important role in local conflicts and border raids against native tribes and other colonies. They were typically made up of adult male citizens who were usually expected to provide their own weapons and equipment.

name: New Frontiers
description: The movement to push the colonial frontier further and further inland in the New World, by establishing everything from small trade stations to full settlements with large areas of cultivated land.

name: Continental Trade
description: While the New World colonies had to import a lot of manufactured products, they also became a major supplier of raw materials for markets in $europe$.

name: Free Thinkers
description: The belief that every man is entitled to both freedom of thought and freedom of speech is widely held in our colonies. Without these rights in place, there could be no such thing as civil liberty.

name: Imperial Manufacturing Center
description: Our citizens are the power base of our overlord's trade empire. Foreign goods are delivered to us, which we then mold into finished products.

name: Colonial Assembly
description: Much of the legislative power over taxes and government spending has been moved into colonial administrations.

name: Sons of Liberty
description: Many leaders of the New World independence wars possessed not only the necessary military skills, but also the charisma needed to encourage morale, hold the army together, and be an inspiration to the people.

name: Colonial Ambition
description: Many of our people settled in the New World to start a new life; to discover the wonders beyond the sea and make an untamed continent their home. Their ambition is ours as we push further and further into the unknown.

name: A Maritime Realm
description: Our realm is firmly fixated on the vast expanse of the sea, its attention directed towards maritime pursuits. With a strategic outlook, it harnesses naval power and maritime trade to strengthen its position and expand its influence. Our maritime focus shapes our policies, fostering a seafaring culture that propels the nation's prosperity.

name: Desperta Ferro!
description: #italic Desperta Ferro!#! — Awake Iron! — is the fearsome battle cry of the $a_almogavars$, invoking the presence of iron in combat. It is accompanied by striking lances and darts against flints to create sparks. Among other war cries like #italic Aragó!#! and #italic Sant Jordi!#!, #italic Desperta Ferro!#! stands out as the most renowned and unique.

name: A Mediterranean Trade Power
description: The Mediterranean Sea's gentle embrace caresses our shores, beckoning our people to engage trade endeavors from generation to generation. Our bustling commercial centers and strategic trade posts scattered throughout the Mediterranean will play a crucial role in realizing our ambition to become a dominant force in trade.

name: Fleet Ordinances
description: In the bustling Mediterranean, fleets gather from around the world, prompting the need for a legal system to address crimes in the crowded land and sea. #italic Ordinacions sobre lo fet de la mar#!, or #italic Ordinances on What Happens in the Sea#!, is one of the earliest military codes of justice, created to govern fleets. This unique response to the post-Black Death era recruits crew members, including criminals, from outside $ARA$, resulting in a harmonized code formed from diverse traditions rather than a mere codification of existing naval customs.

name: $VAL_ADJ$ Golden Age
description: The realm we inhabit has ascended to literary heights as yet unattained by many neighboring nations, thanks to the remarkable contributions of esteemed authors such as Joanot Martorell, Ausiàs March, and Isabel de Villena. Their profound literary works have elevated our culture to unparalleled levels, instilling a sense of pride within our people. Undeniably, our nation stands as a radiant beacon of culture, shining brightly for all to behold.

name: Remença
description: The #italic Remença#! system, particular to $CAT$, has close equivalents in other territories of the Crown, fostering a collective drive towards greater raw goods production. Through this framework, our lands experience a surge in wealth, igniting the potential for substantial progress towards fulfilling our objectives. By harmonizing these systems, we will cultivate an environment where our endeavors are fortified by the abundance of resources, fueling a path of growth and prosperity for our realm.

name: Chartered Merchant Companies
description: Our traders are wasting resources competing with each other. This is silly; we should focus all our efforts on taking trade from others instead! Let us charter companies who will be given temporary monopolies on trade from certain regions and whose renewal will be dependent on giving the Crown its rightful due.

name: Stronger United
description: Since the merger of between us and the County of Barcelona in 1164, $ARA$ has functioned as a Confederation, comprising distinct realms under a central ruler. These differences have fostered prosperity and maintained individual identities, yet have also given rise to an illusion of disunity. This has led to the need for administrative reforms to strengthen our union while honoring the unique characteristics of each territory.

name: Constellation of Cities
description: Since its inception, our nation has consisted of diverse realms brought together under a single ruler. However, each realm retains its unique traditions and laws. Consequently, numerous major cities have emerged as regional metropolises, representing and governing their respective regions.

name: Protect the Smallfolk
description: Our soldiers would want their loved ones to be looked after in the event they perish in battle. $ARA$ will do its duty and ensure that this is done through establishing a system of workhouses for orphans of the fallen.

name: Gunpowder Souls
description: The #italic Fallas#! celebration has acted as a catalyst within the Crown of $ARA$, spurring advancements in artillery techniques through the practical expertise gained from handling gunpowder for firecrackers and fireworks. This festive tradition has fueled a spirit of innovation, resulting in the development of new strategies and knowledge about artillery.

name: Mossos d'Esquadra
description: The #italic Escuadras de Paisanos#!, known as #italic Esquadres de Catalunya#! or #italic Mossos d'Esquadra#!, are a local militia dedicated to safeguarding trade routes and fairs, making the most of their intimate familiarity with the terrain. Inspired by their success, we aim to establish similar militias in our other territories, composed of local inhabitants. This should foster a harmonious coexistence and ensure peace in these regions.

name: Network of Cities
description: Across lakes and valleys, our cities bind themselves through roads, markets, and shared purpose, strengthening our reach.

name: Status by Merit
description: Warriors and nobles rise through valor and service, ensuring authority belongs to those who have truly earned it.

name: Expansion of Merchant Guilds
description: Pochtēcah merchants extend their routes far beyond our lands, enriching every marketplace loyal to the Mexihcah.

name: Centralized City Governance
description: The refomation of our government, in an attempt to support the sprawl of our newly-attained urban territories, shall be united under firm oversight, creating a more orderly and dependable administration.

name: Wealth of Mesoamerica
description: The fertile soils, forests, and mines of Ānāhuac yield immense riches, sustaining our growth and imperial ambitions. Properly utilizing these resources will bolster our affluence.

name: Study the European Colonizers
description: Strangers have made contact with our people. Their unfamiliar ships and weapons instill awe and fear. Understanding their methods may be the key to survival.

name: New Fire Ceremonies
description: Once every fifty-two years, the world is renewed by flame, uniting the people in faith and cosmic balance.

name: The Sun Must Rise
description: Through devotion and ritual, we keep the sun's journey alive, easing the hearts and strengthening the spirit of our people. The preservation of equilibrium, and even the world, rests upon our shoulders.

name: Students of Foreign Courts
description: Members of our royal dynasties are accustomed to journeys abroad. They have spent much of their upbringing as students of illustrious courts far away from home, in the pursuit of a thorough education in matters of statesmanship.

name: Wagenburg
description: During the Hussite Wars, our armies relied on wagon forts called #italic Wagenburg#! to win battles against superior forces. While we may not always deploy wagons, the principle remains: infantry sharpshooters fighting from prepared defensive positions become our standard doctrine.

name: $BOH_ADJ$ $HRE_ADJ$ Standing
description: Our place within the $hre$ is one of prestige, grandeur, and authority. Few members wield as much soft power as us, due to our capable diplomats and alliance networks.

name: Urbanization Decrees
description: As part of our efforts to modernize $prague$, we will issue grants encouraging prominent figures to relocate their business to the capital while offering privileges to attract skilled and wealthy foreign immigrants. This influx of talent and capital will transform our $prague$ into a thriving, cosmopolitan metropolis.

name: $BOH_ADJ$ Crystal
description: There are very few workshops in the known world with the capacity to craft glass and crystal with the same quality and clarity as ours, let alone rival our superior production techniques.

name: Fortified Towns
description: Through the ravages of the $hussite_wars$, and in an effort to safeguard our faith and people, we funded many fortified towns. Since then, we have gained great expertise in erecting fortifications and engineering impenetrable defenses.

name: $hussite_ADJ$ Traditions
description: Through struggle and brotherhood, the adherents of our faith withstand all external conversion pressures. Our unshaken religious roots, stemming from ancient teachings, ring true to the hearts of all those who seek to protect their beliefs and live in peace alongside their fellow $christian_ADJ$ faithful.

name: The Kutnohorian Deal
description: The nobility will always be rather sensitive about protecting their privileges. It would go far towards winning their loyalty if said privileges were to be guaranteed forever.

name: $BOH_ADJ$ Thaler
description: For years, the standard currency in our country has been the #italic groschen#!, a coin made of silver and used all throughout the $hre$. The discovery of new sources of silver allows us to create another kind of bigger coin, the #italic thaler#!, also called 'toler' or 'daler', which will become strong and influential enough to dominate all trade and become a new standard.

name: $breton$ Peninsula
description: Ever since our ancestors came from $great_britain_region$, our extensive coastal holdings have been bustling with activity. Our people live by the sea and for the sea, and our ports are always full of trade and fishing boats.

name: Legacy of $breton$ Independence
description: $brittany_area$ has never truly been part of $FRA$ Though we have been ravaged by Franks, Vikings, and the $ENG_ADJ$ in the past, we have, thus far, maintained our unique identity as a people. Let all of our neighbors be aware that $BRI$ shall remain forever free, the last bastion of true Gallic traditions!

name: The Estates of $BRI$
description: First called in the 14th century, the Estates of $BRI$ allowed free men from all rungs of society, even the Third Estate, to share their grievances and petition the ruler for redress. By calling in the Estates, we can mitigate some of the tension felt throughout our domain.

name: $BUL_ADJ$ $orthodox_ADJ$ Patriarchate
description: The restoration of the Bulgarian Patriarchate in 1235, confirmed by the Council of Lampsacus, established Tarnovo as a sovereign spiritual rival to both Constantinople and Rome. By the 14th century, the Patriarchate functioned as the ideological spine of the Asen and Shishman dynasties, utilizing its autocephalous status to provide divine legitimacy that transcended the political fragmentation of the Bulgarian lands. From its seat on Tsarevets Hill, the Church managed an expansive administrative network of eparchies and monasteries, such as the Zograf Monastery on Mount Athos, which served as repositories for the Bulgarian recension of Church Slavonic.

name: Legacy of Ivan Asen II
description: The reign of Ivan Asen II marked a new height of $BUL_ADJ$ power, diplomacy, and economic expansion. His legacy endures as a foundation for a strong and centralized state.

name: The Bastion of Tsarevets
description: The capital of Tarnovo, perched upon the cliffs of Tsarevets and Trapezitsa, is arguably the most formidable fortress in the Balkans, symbolizing the power of the Asen dynasty. By continuously expanding the complex of palaces, patriarchal cathedrals, and triple-layered walls, we have created an administrative center that is immune to sudden coups or sieges. This architectural dominance projects an image of imperial stability that cowers the local Boyars and convinces the populace that the 'Third Rome' has truly moved to the banks of the Yantra.

name: Karvunan Maritime Heritage
description: Karvuna has built its power upon the sea rather than the fertile plains, drawing upon a mix of Bulgarian, Greek, and Italian sailors. By fortifying the limestone cliffs of the coast, we will create a series of naval bases that will allow us to dominate the Black Sea trade routes between the Danube delta and Constantinople. This maritime focus will provide us with a unique identity within the Bulgarian world, prioritizing naval superiority and trade over the traditional feudal concerns of the interior.

name: The Stronghold of Baba Vida
description: The fortress of Vidin, situated at a strategic bend in the Danube, serves as the ultimate gateway between the Bulgarian lands, the Hungarian plains, and the Serbian mountains. Under the Shishman dynasty, the castle of Baba Vida has been transformed into a sophisticated riverine citadel capable of withstand long sieges and housing a permanent garrison of elite troops. This focus on defensive architecture ensures that Vidin remains a sovereign bastion, even when the rest of the Bulgarian heartland is under threat, acting as a 'Western Shield' for the nation.

name: Reformation of the Patriarchate
description: The spiritual heart of the Bulgarian world will undergo a rigorous and profound transformation under the iron-willed guidance of our Patriarch. Recognizing that the survival of the nation depends upon the purity of its faith and the precision of its holy texts, the Patriarchate will initiate a sweeping linguistic and liturgical reform centered at the Holy Trinity Monastery of Tarnovo. By purging the Church Slavonic manuscripts of centuries of scribal errors and corrupt localisms, we will establish a new, standardized orthography that will become the gold standard for the entire Orthodox Slavic world, from the Danube to the Volga.

name: The Tarnovo Artistic Schools
description: Under the direct patronage of the Shishman Dynasty, the nation has undergone a spectacular cultural growth, positioning itself as a true #italic Third Rome#! and the primary guardian of Orthodox high culture. By funding the reconstruction of the Patriarchal Cathedral and the royal palaces of Tsarevets, the state has gathered a new generation of master iconographers, hagiographers, and architects who blend traditional Byzantine aesthetics with a unique, emotive Bulgarian realism. This school of thought does not merely produce religious icons; it serves as a powerful instrument of imperial propaganda, codifying the Bulgarian recension of Church Slavonic and producing the Manasses Chronicle to legitimize the Tsar's claim to the Byzantine heritage.

name: The Chancery of the Asens
description: At its peak, the chancellery in Tarnovo was the most sophisticated diplomatic hub in the Orthodox world, producing intricate Slavic charters that influenced the courts of Serbia and Russia. By professionalizing the class of #italic Logothetes#! and scribes, the Tsars will ensure that every land grant and international treaty is meticulously recorded and legally binding. This administrative rigor will allow the state to extract taxes more efficiently and manage its complex network of vassalage with a degree of central control that is rare in the late medieval period.

name: Looking for Friends
description: Given our small land area, our rulers understand the need for powerful friends and trade partners. By granting these allies exclusive trading rights in ports like Varna, the Despotate will gain access to modern Western naval technology and financial credit, as well as potentially powerful naval protection against our enemies. This alliance will transform Dobruja into a cosmopolitan trade hub, where the wealth of the Silk Road will be exchanged for the grain and furs of the north.

name: The Western Connection
description: Positioned at the crossroads of cultures, the Tsars of Vidin have maintained closer ties with the Catholic West than any other Bulgarian rulers, often marrying into Hungarian and Wallachian nobility. This diplomatic flexibility allows Vidin to survive as an independent state, utilizing Western military technology and courtly traditions to distinguish itself from the rest of $BUL$. By acting as a bridge between the Orthodox and Catholic worlds, Vidin becomes a center of trade and intellectual exchange that enriches the local treasury and the army.

name: The Danubian River Merchants
description: Leveraging their position as the gatekeepers of the Lower Danube, Bulgarian merchant families have established a sophisticated trade network connecting the Black Sea to Central Europe.
