By utilizing shallow-draft barges and fortified river ports, they have managed to bypass the expensive and dangerous overland routes, controlling the flow of salt, grain, and timber across the Balkans. This riverine expertise has turned the Danube into a Bulgarian artery of wealth, funding the rise of a new urban elite that we can tax so they keep their privileges.

name: The Boyar Council
description: To prevent the internal strife that plagued the 14th century, we will evolve into a 'Consultative Autocracy' where the most powerful Boyars are integrated into a permanent State Council. This body will serve as a high court and a military planning board, ensuring that the interests of the landed nobility are aligned with those of the crown. This political stability will allow us to maintain a large standing army and avoid the devastating civil wars that have historically left the empire vulnerable to its neighbors.

name: The Hesychast State Philosophy
description: The spiritual teachings of Grēgórios Sinaítēs have moved from the hermit's cell to the halls of power. By adopting Hesychasm — a philosophy of inner stillness and divine light — as the unofficial state ideology, we foster a populace that is deeply pious and resilient. This shared spiritual identity acts as a powerful deterrent against the influences from our enemies, making the Bulgarian subjects immune to foreign conversion or subversion.

name: The Condotta of Varna
description: As a maritime state with a relatively small land population, Karvuna has refined the art of 'contract warfare' by formalizing a permanent Condotta with the Italian maritime powers. Under this arrangement, we provide them with fortified warehouses and naval bases in the Black Sea, and in return, the Italians provide a professional corps of heavy crossbowmen and expert siege engineers for the Despotate's defense. This symbiotic relationship allows Karvuna to punch far above its weight in land battles, utilizing Western tactical innovations and professional discipline to defend its coastal strip while the native Bulgarian sailors dominate the waves, effectively outsourcing its land defense to the most skilled mercenaries in the Mediterranean.

name: The Order of the Danubian Dragon
description: To ensure the loyalty of the border nobility and create a professional officer corps, the Tsars of Vidin will establish a local knightly order modeled after the Western European #italic Societas Draconistrarum#!. Members of this order will be granted estates along the Timok and Danube rivers in exchange for maintaining a state of perpetual readiness and providing a heavy cavalry core for the Tsardom's defense. This institution will hopefully bridge the gap between the old Bulgarian Boyar traditions and the chivalric standards of the West, fostering a high level of military discipline and personal loyalty to the crown and prevent internal fragmentation.

name: Fortress of the Balkans
description: We have recognized that spiritual purity alone cannot halt the encroaching craze of the world. To survive, the state has pivoted toward a doctrine of total territorial fortification, transforming the Balkan Mountains into an impassable granite wall. By reinforcing our lands with tiered stone redoubts and permanent garrisons, the nation has created a strategic depth that forces any invader into a lethal war of attrition. This policy ensures that the Bulgarian heartland remains a sanctuary of Orthodox stability, where the flame of our people's heart is shielded behind a ring of iron and stone that no storm can easily douse.

name: The Silk and Rose Guilds
description: Utilizing the fertile Thracian plains and the unique climate of the Rose Valley, we have established state-protected guilds for the production of luxury oils and silk. These high-value, low-weight goods are perfect for overland export to the courts of Europe and Asia. The wealth generated by these guilds allows the state to build a massive gold reserve, making our economy one of the most stable and credit-worthy in the entire Mediterranean basin.

name: The Bulgarian Gunpowder Foundries
description: Drawing on the iron mines of the Balkan mountains and the expertise of Saxon miners, we will establish the first major domestic gunpowder industry in the region. These foundries will produce heavy siege cannons and early handguns, allowing the Bulgarian army to transition away from purely feudal cavalry toward a more modern, infantry-heavy force. By controlling the production of saltpeter and iron, we will ensure that our walls remain the most dangerous obstacle for any would-be conqueror in the Balkans.

name: The Cosmopolitan Code of Karvuna
description: To maintain its status as the premier trade hub of the Black Sea, we will promulgate a revolutionary legal framework known as the 'Code of Karvuna', which will grant extraterritorial rights and religious freedom to recognized merchant nations. Regardless of their faith or origin, any merchant operating within our ports will be judged by a commercial court of his peers rather than by local feudal lords. This atmosphere of legal predictability and tolerance will attract a massive influx of capital and expertise, turning Karvuna into a huge hub where the wealth of the silk and spice roads will be reinvested into the state's infrastructure and military-industrial complex.

name: The Mining Grants
description: Vidin needs to expand its influence into the mineral-rich Timok valley, granting charters to Saxon and Ragusan miners to extract silver, lead, and copper. This industrial base will provide the Tsardom with the metal needed for modern currency and the production of high-quality firearms, making Vidin a self-sufficient military power. The wealth from these mines will also allow the Tsars to maintain a professional army.

name: The Bulgarian Cloth Industry
description: The Bulgarian towns will be transformed into the industrial heartland of the peninsula through the specialized production of #italic Aba#! (a durable, thick woolen cloth) and #italic Gaitan#! (decorative braid). By organizing the local weavers and shepherds into powerful, self-governing guilds, the Bulgarian merchants will be able to secure massive state contracts for the outfitting of the regional armies and the growing urban middle classes of the Mediterranean. This economic surge creates a merchant aristocracy that will signal the transition of the Bulgarian people from a rural peasantry to a sophisticated, proto-industrial society with the financial power to dictate terms to their neighbors.

name: The Grand Academy of the Yantra
description: The intellectual legacy of the 14th-century Tarnovo Literary School is revived in the 17th century through the creation of a modern state university. This institution focuses on civil law, engineering, and the translation of Western scientific texts into the Bulgarian vernacular, creating a class of bureaucrats who are as capable as any in Paris or Vienna. This modernization of the elite will ensure that we can manage a complex, multi-ethnic empire while maintaining the cultural purity of its Bulgarian core.

name: The Standing Drilled Infantry
description: Moving away from seasonal levies, we have established the first permanent 'Regiments of the Lion'. These infantrymen are trained year-round in the use of firearms, following a rigorous drill based on the successes of neighbor models but adapted for Balkan terrain. This professional infantry core give us a reliable tool for offensive warfare, capable of out-marching and out-shooting the traditional armies of our neighbors.

name: The Black Sea Admiralty
description: Karvuna will establish a permanent, state-run Admiralty to oversee the construction of modern deep-water warships and the training of a professional officer corps. Shifting away from small galleys, we will begin building frigates and small ships-of-the-line capable of projecting power as far as the Aegean and the Sea of Azov. This naval modernization will ensure that we remain a major maritime player, capable of defending our trade interests against our enemies.

name: Vidin's Custom Houses
description: As the trade between the upper Danube and the Black Sea grows, Vidin has become one of the most important custom houses on the Lower Danube, regulating the flow of European luxury goods into the Balkans. By implementing a sophisticated system of tariffs and warehouse laws, the state will be able to fill its coffers without placing a heavy burden on its own agricultural population. This trade-heavy economy will allow Vidin to modernize its infrastructure, building paved roads and stone bridges that connect the Danube to the interior of the Balkan Peninsula.

name: The Bulgarian National Awakening
description: Driven by the writings of monks like Paisius of Hilendar, the Bulgarian people have rediscovered their imperial history and linguistic pride, sparking a massive educational and political rebirth. This movement has moved beyond local grievances to demand a centralized, modern state that can take its place among the great powers of Europe. The result is a highly motivated and literate populace, ready to serve in a modern bureaucracy or a national army, fueled by the conviction that the glory of the Tsars is not a memory, but a future.

name: The Imperial Restoration Doctrine
description: We have fully embraced our role as the natural leader of the Balkan peoples, articulating a formal doctrine for the reunification of all former Bulgarian lands. This fate is backed by a modern, professionalized army and a sophisticated diplomatic corps that seek to play the Great Powers against one another. The belief in a 'Greater Bulgaria' becomes the central pillar of the state, driving a policy of aggressive expansion and cultural assimilation that seeks to restore the empire of Simeon the Great.

name: The Bulgarian Census Bureau
description: Knowledge is power. We have instituted a decennial census that records every person, unit of livestock, and hearth in the empire. This precise data allows for the most efficient taxation and conscription system in the Balkans. By knowing exactly what the nation can provide, we can plan long-term campaigns with a level of logistical certainty that ensures our armies are always well-fed and our coffers never empty.

name: The Free Port of Varna
description: To cement our position as the premier commercial hub of the Balkans, we will declare Varna a free port, exempting international merchants from most traditional duties in exchange for a flat transit fee. This policy will attract a massive diaspora of merchants, bankers, and insurers, making Varna the 'Venice of the Black Sea' and the financial capital of the Bulgarian world. The resulting wealth will allow us to maintain a professional army and a world-class navy, ensuring that our coastal state remains a wealthy and independent power in an age of giants.

name: The Codex Shishman
description: To finalize the transition from a medieval feudal state to a modern, centralized monarchy, the Tsardom will promulgate the #italic Societas Codex Shishman#!, a comprehensive legal reform that unifies the disparate local customs of the Western Balkans. This code will establish a professional judiciary independent of the local landowners and standardize the weights, measures, and currencies used throughout Vidin's trade network. By providing a predictable and fair legal environment, we will ensure the growth of a loyal urban middle class and the stability of the state's tax revenue. This administrative modernization will make Vidin a beacon of 'Enlightened Despotism' in the East, where the rule of law is as ironclad as the walls of Baba Vida itself.

name: Between Two Realms
description: We can consider ourselves to be both members of the traditional lands of the $hre$, and of the realm of $FRA$. While this can complicate feudal relations, the situation has molded us into adept diplomats, able to skillfully play both sides to our own advantage.

name: Knightly Prowess
description: We occupy a prestigious position within the feudal system of $FRA$. Therefore, it is only right that our troops are seen as a reflection of the $BUR_ADJ$ spirit.

name: The Order of the Golden Fleece
description: One of $europe$'s foremost chivalric orders. Being a Knight of the Golden Fleece is a mark of great status, and reflects well upon us.

name: Promote the États Généraux
description: $BUR$ is a feudal creation with various parts conjoined under different conditions, which has created strong local identities. By promoting a central assembly, we give a forum for these interests, promoting a smooth and uncontested rule.

name: Reform the Feudal Army
description: The feudal levy system has proven slow and unreliable in this new age of professional warfare. Inspired by the $FRA_ADJ$ model, we will replace our scattered vassal hosts with salaried companies, skilled officers, and integrated armies. A disciplined core of professional soldiers will form the backbone of a modern and adaptable army.

name: Compagnies d'Ordonnance
description: Our reliance on feudal levies has proven inadequate for the demands of modern warfare. The creation of permanently contracted cavalry units, the #italic $compagnie_d_ordonnance$#!, provides us with a reliable and professional military force directly loyal to the Crown.

name: Influence of the $BUR_ADJ$ Towns
description: The traditional Estates General favors the clergy and nobility, but the rising wealth and political importance of towns can no longer be ignored. By refining its structure to reflect the growing strength of the merchant class, we ensure more balanced governance while preserving the privileges of the other estates. A stronger urban voice will also enhance our administrative capacities and speed up the rate of urbanization.

name: Create the Regimental System
description: To ensure consistent recruitment and sufficient supply of fighters, we must establish a formal regimental system. This reform will allow us to organize manpower more effectively, centralize command structures, and reduce dependence on local nobles and foreign mercenaries.

name: Foster Agriculture
description: The lands of $BUR$ are well-suited to growing plants and herding animals. Grapes are particularly apt for local growing conditions. With skilled cultivation, it should be easy to foster an agricultural industry.

name: Repoblaciones
description: The extensive conquests of our ancestors have created a country with more land than people available to inhabit and work it. That has resulted in a dire need to attract migrants from other regions.

name: The Reconquista
description: In the many years since the Visigothic Kingdom fell to invaders, we have waged war against the Moors. This has given us the sort of iron discipline that not many can boast of. Arise, warriors of $CAS$, and show the world your determination!

name: $CAS_ADJ$ Navy
description: Situated as we are on a peninsula, surrounded by sea on three out of four sides, and with the valuable $strait_of_gibraltar$ bitterly fought over by different powers, dominating the seas has become a matter of life and death. From our hundreds of kilometers of coastline, our ancestors started taming the waves, evolving our nation into a fearless naval power.

name: Crónicas Reales
description: By compiling the chronicles written by previous rulers, we are able to create a compendium that details every past event in our realm and the origins of all our rulers. This knowledge will help us not only to create better cultural foundations, but will also help present and future rulers to correctly assess present events through comparisons to past ones.

name: Masters of the Orders
description: As the Reconquista is no longer our main focus, we can no longer justify the independence of Holy Orders. By having our ruler assume the position of Master in every Order, they will not only gain significant power, but they will also have access to the military knowledge of these crusaders.

name: The New World
description: Newly-discovered lands can be claimed and settled by enterprising colonists, and will send valuable trade goods back to our realm. We will send a few loyal colonists to the New World, have them stake their claims and find ways to harness the treasures of nature, and thereby form the backbone of our colonial endeavors.

name: Reform of the Millions
description: With the approval of the Reform of the #italic Millones#!, we might be able to tax our populace more efficiently. This will be an indirect extraction of revenue, done through a levy on food products.

name: $CAS_ADJ$ Marine Infantry
description: With a strong navy comes the need for crew members adept at combat in any situation, including having to fight outside their vessels. In order to overcome this challenge, we will regulate our marine infantry so they become a powerful weapon no matter where they fight.

name: $CAS_ADJ$ Pasos
description: While the #italic Pasos#! of the Holy Week are an old tradition in $CAS$, the sculpted artworks that accompany them have recently reached a stunning new peak. Artists such as Juan de Juni and Gregorio Fernández have started down the path of making $CAS_ADJ$ #italic Pasos#! the most impressive on the Peninsula.

name: Real Academia Española
description: As our language evolves and spreads across the world, the need to regulate and preserve it becomes obvious. To preserve the essential character and defining traits of our mother tongue, the #italic Real Academia Española#! will be established to set standards for how to properly speak our language.

name: Canal de Castilla
description: Inspired by other water systems across $europe$, which are used for both commercial purposes and irrigation, the #italic Canal de Castilla#! will bring water from the mountains in the north of the #italic Meseta#! and irrigate the cereal fields of Old Castile. This feat of engineering will increase our yield, create a surplus with which we can trade, and be the way to transport it for export.

name: Royal Factories
description: To combat the export of raw materials instead of more valuable manufactured goods, we will develop a system of government-backed factories that will industrialize our nation. More robust domestic manufacturing will lead to a stronger national economy.

name: Gỗ Trầm Hương
description: The resinous heartwood of our native trees, known as agarwood or #italic Trầm Hương#!, is treasured not only for its enchanting aroma but also for its spiritual and medicinal properties. Across the seas, nobles and monks alike covet it for incense, perfumes, and offerings. By protecting our forests and refining our harvesting methods, we can turn this rare natural gift into one of our most prized exports.

name: Mỹ Sơn Sanctuary
description: Within the lush valleys of central $CHA$ lies the sacred temple complex of Mỹ Sơn, where for generations our kings and priests have performed solemn rites to $shiva_god$, protector of our realm. These towers are carved with devotion and adorned with sacred symbols, connecting us to our ancestors and the divine. As long as incense burns in their sanctuaries, the soul of $CHA$ shall endure.

name: Legacy of Chagatai
description: The legacy of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ is ours through his son Chagatai. All shall tremble before us as we reclaim his glory!

name: Chagatai Riders
description: The horses of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ trampled and conquered territories stretching from $europe$ to $china$. As his heirs and successors, our cavalry will instill fear of the same thing happening into our enemies.

name: The Mountain Khanate
description: We lie sheltered between $balkhash_lake$ and the Tiānshān Mountains. It is a harsh and unforgiving land, one which our people know how to use as a weapon against would-be invaders.

name: Ceaseless Border Wars
description: Surrounded by people that would oppose us, we face a constant struggle to maintain our borders. Our ever-vigilant soldiers have plentiful opportunities to hone their skills in battle, giving birth to a combat-hardened warrior people ready to reclaim the legacy of the Great $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$.

name: Sons of Chagatai $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$
description: We can trace our line back to Chagatai $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$, the second son of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$, who once ruled these lands and established a powerful Mongolian successor state. Although a long time has passed since then, we can still claim considerable legitimacy by appealing to the legacy of our fierce ancestor.

name: Tradition of Conquest
description: Conquering people can be a tricky business; not everyone is ready to accept our enlightened government. Still, we have discovered that there are easier ways to bring people into our empire than building a mountain of skulls — something that our ancestors never learned.

name: Scheming Court
description: The constant power struggles between the various princes, nobles, cities, and tribes in the Chagatai Khanate have produced a nation of highly adept schemers. If we can put aside our quarrels and channel this energy towards outsmarting our enemies, it would be a great boon to our people.

name: The Glory of Conquest
description: Let it be known that boy cannot be a man unless he has ridden first with our invincible host, that he can take no wife until he has taken another man's wife, that he is not worthy of a hut until he has burnt down someone else's. Let service in our armies be the only route to manhood.

name: Unrelenting Horde
description: Our armies shall march like the great hordes of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$. Our troops shall trample our enemies under our hooves like blades of grass of our native steppes. All shall fear the power of our armies!

name: Genghisid Legacy
description: Our forefathers rode with $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ as he ravaged the known world. We have kept our military traditions alive, and continued to be ruled by $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$s who claim descent from the Genghisid line.

name: Slavers of the Steppe
description: There is a fortune to be made from the $slaves_goods$ trade; unwitting $christian_ADJ$ believers who fall into our grasp fetch a high price in $turkish_culture$, $AIA_ADJ$, and $ITA_ADJ$ markets.

name: Steppe Commanders
description: $CRI_ADJ$ cavalry commanders have mastered the art of mobility in steppes warfare, using speed, flanking, and ambush to outmatch slower European armies.

name: Free Cattle Grazing
description: We place no restrictions on pastoral farmers for the grazing of their great herds of horses and cattle. Herders are free to go about their business as they wish, able to traverse the steppe safely and trade freely.

name: The Devshirme of the Steppes
description: $CRI_ADJ$ elites mimicked aspects of $TUR_ADJ$ military-administrative practices, blending $turkic_group$ and $muslim_ADJ$ systems to manage manpower and military efficiency.

name: Merchant Legacy
description: Phoenician trade fleets traveled through the Mediterranean for centuries. This economic legacy means that we are more efficient — and ruthless — when it comes to trade. We shall once again preside over the ebb and flow of goods!

name: Breadbasket of Rome
description: Centuries ago, our advances in irrigation and olive cultivation earned $CTH$ the nickname of 'the breadbasket of Rome.' We will now consult our ancient agricultural knowledge, and once again do battle with the desert to plant our olive groves, just like in antiquity.

name: Army of Mercenaries
description: Our ancestral empire did not have a massive population, so for centuries, we relied on mercenaries during war. Since the reformation of $CTH$ we have continued that tradition to save our population from dangers of the battlefield.

name: Cothon
description: The ancient Carthaginian #italic cothon#! was a technological marvel that helped facilitate efficient ship construction. Now, this great legacy will serve as a blueprint for our whole country. Studying ancient shipbuilding techniques allows us to excel in this area once again, and the $CTH_ADJ$ navy will soon dominate the Mediterranean.

name: Phoenician Sailors
description: After restoring our ancient kingdom, we started reaching out to our Phoenician brothers in Libya. As a result, we have a steady influx of volunteers that want to join the restoration of the ancient Phoenician kingdom of $CTH$. It seems we can maintain a much bigger navy now...

name: Legacy of Hannon
description: Hannon the Sailor was a legendary ancient explorer who ventured far into the south of the African coast. We shall follow his example, and mount exploration voyages in order to restore our lost trading empire. This time, we will push our expeditions even further, seeking out fresh trading opportunities across the entire world.

name: Beyond the Pillars
description: It is time for our trade factories to reach beyond the mythical pillars of Hercules. Combining ancient colonization knowledge with modern discoveries allows us to settle more efficiently than other younger nations, those who are fairly new to this experience. $CTH_ADJ$ colonies shall soon be found all around the world!

name: Punic $wine$ Trade
description: In ancient times, we created a $wine$ trading pipeline by producing large amounts of low-quality $wine$ to trade, and importing the good stuff for ourselves. Building on that tradition, we are looking into expanding our $wine$ production capabilities — we #italic will#! dominate the $wine$ trade in the Mediterranean!

name: Punic Global Trade
description: For centuries, our nation dominated the Mediterranean trade. Now, with all the new discoveries made in the centuries since, we stand poised to dominate the globe. Soon, there will be a $CTH_ADJ$ trading vessel in every port in this world!

name: Rule of Šūfeṭ
description: Our ancient kingdom was headed by an elected head of state called the #italic Šūfeṭ#!. In this new modern age, we shall reorganize our government, taking experience from antiquity and combining it with modern theories to create a powerful Republican system, one that will outshine every Republic created up to this date!

name: Children of the Panther
description: Our ancient legends state that our royal line is descended from the union of a princess and a panther. This ancient and mystical tale will enhance our prestige and fame.

name: Migan and Mehu
description: The Migan and the Mehu are the ruler's two chief ministers. One oversees the north, the other the south; one oversees justice, the other commerce. Together, they bring stability and prosperity.

name: Slave Hunts
description: While raiding the surrounding territories, we obtain slaves who cannot only be employed economically or bartered to our neighbors, but who can serve in our armies. In this way, we will increase the number of fighters that can be called to arms.

name: Lagredis
description: By secretly placing male courtiers disguised as royal wives in the harem, they will be able to act unseen as the king's eyes and ears, especially in matters of palace intrigue.

name: Dahomey Amazons
description: A corp of female warriors, recruited from among the king's wives. They have earned their reputation as mythological Amazons due to their ferocity in battle and the fear they strike in the ranks of their opponents. These $dahomey_amazons$ are entirely devoted to $DAH$ and its interests.

name: The Yovogan
description: As more and more foreigners are coming to our shores, we should establish a new office in our government to study and learn from their ways, so that we may benefit from this exchange of cultures.

name: Palaces of Abomey
description: Building a sprawling palace complex in our capital would be an elegant, yet imposing demonstration of our power. Any who may consider taking up arms against us will surely be deterred by the sight of our sumptuous palaces.

name: Viet Autonomous Villages
description: The Vietnamese countryside is built upon the enduring strength of the #italic làng#!, autonomous villages that embody the principle: 'customs of the village outweigh the laws of the king.' In a land of rugged mountains and winding rivers, these communities govern themselves, raise local militias, collect taxes efficiently, and uphold royal authority at the grassroots.

name: The Nghĩa Quân
description: Throughout our history, the #italic Nghĩa Quân#! — 'righteous militias' — have risen in defense of our land during times of great peril. Composed of farmers, scholars, and local patriots, they stood against foreign invaders and internal tyranny alike. Though irregular in nature, their valor and devotion to the country have made them a formidable force when mobilized.

name: Reliance on Levies
description: Our domain is protected by natural barriers, namely the Jutland Peninsula and the $DAN_ADJ$ archipelago. This defensive geography is extremely helpful when we are under attack, as it gives us time to raise levies before our enemies can reach our core territory.

name: $DAN_ADJ$ Sea Networks
description: Every part of our country is surrounded by the waters of the Baltic and North Seas. This gives us the unique advantage of being able to utilize waterways for both transport and communication, considerably shortening the time it takes to travel between regions.

name: True Rulers of the North
description: The rulers of $DAN$ have claimed overlordship over the Nordic regions for centuries. Embellishing the legacy of Kings like Canute 'the Great' will grant us the internal and external legitimacy needed to support our assertions.

name: Reliance on Mercenaries
description: $DAN$ cannot rely on a vast population to supply their armies. Therefore, we need to ensure that mercenary companies are willing to serve our state, while guaranteeing their loyalty with solid contracts.

name: Rentekammeret
description: By establishing a separate department for our Treasury, the #italic Rentekammeret#!, we will have better control over our finances and be able to run the government more efficiently. With the documentation of all our financial records, we will be able to estimate our future expenditures more easily, stabilizing our finances.

name: $DAN_ADJ$ State Navy
description: Our country is surrounded by water, and therefore vulnerable to domination by any power with a large enough fleet. To ensure this will never happen, we must fund a navy capable of protecting our coastline and projecting our power over the north of $europe$.

name: Religious Uniformity
description: In the tumultuous religious landscape of $europe$, we must set $DAN$ on the path to righteousness, and remain true to the doctrines of our church.

name: The $kobenhavn$ Dockyard
description: Our country has a long and proud history of shipbuilding. Our experienced shipwrights need a modern and spacious dock in which to construct a navy worthy of calling itself $DAN_ADJ$. The waters around $kobenhavn$ are the perfect place to construct such a dockyard.

name: $DAN_ADJ$ Legislation
description: The regional laws of Jutland, Zealand and Scania formed the basis of our legal code for centuries. For the benefit of our realm, we should compile and unify these laws into a single comprehensive legal system, which will be known as the #italic Danske Lov#!.

name: Agricultural Focus
description: While the $DAN_ADJ$ terrain is relatively poor in terms of rare materials available to exploit, they make up for it with agricultural abundance. We shall focus on optimizing our farming and food production, safeguarding our people against future periods of famine.

name: Royal Life Guards
description: The Royal Life Guards are an elite $DAN_ADJ$ regiment that also serve as the ruler's personal guard and perform ceremonial duties.

name: Scanian Regiment
description: The Scanian Regiment is a military unit composed of drafted peasants, established to reduce reliance on mercenary forces and build a more organized standing army under direct royal authority.

name: College of the Admiralty
description: With the establishment of a centralized college to train our naval commanders, we will be able to produce skilled leaders familiar with our coastal waters. This will improve our marine defense strategy, and ultimately better safeguard $DAN_ADJ$ sovereignty.

name: A Maritime Nation
description: We cannot produce everything we need to maintain economic stability on our own. We must instead rely on a stable trade network to export our goods and import everything that we ourselves are not able to produce.

name: Origin of $hindustani_language$
description: The $hindustani_language$ language developed from Apabhramsa — a Middle Indo-Aryan language — and emerged as the contact language of $DLH$. As $hindustani_language$ has influences from $persian_language$, $arabic_language$, and Turkic but also Old Hindi, diplomacy with the $muslim_ADJ$ world and the $hindu_ADJ$ world becomes an uncomplicated task.

name: Indo-Persian Culture
description: $persian_language$ has been the dominant language of the court ever since the first inception of the $DLH_ADJ$ Sultanate. As such, the influence of $persian_language$ has synthesized with local Indian cultures.

name: $turkic_group$ Conqueror Roots
description: Although we call $india$ our home, the ancestors of our state were of $turkic_group$ origins. Their early successes as conquerors and rulers from the days of the $mamluk$ dynasty, as well as the achievements of the following Khalji dynasty, inspire our military and diplomats alike to push the borders of $DLH$ into every corner of $india$.

name: Revert Ghiyath's Reforms
description: The foolish economic decisions of Ghiyath al-Din have brought nothing but financial ruin to the state of $DLH$. We must revert his madness and restore the usage of gold and silver for our coins.

name: Restore the Greatness of $DLH$
description: The $DLH_ADJ$ Sultanate once encompassed nearly all of $india$. It must rise again!

name: Re-integrate Former Provinces
description: The once vast $DLH_ADJ$ Sultanate has lost most of its former possessions, but we have not forgotten the means of administering them. As we work towards restoring our past glory, we will remind local rulers of their duties to the Sultan.

name: Innovative Textile Production
description: The thriving textile industry in $DLH$ makes our nation a hotspot for related technological innovations. As early adopters of the cotton gin and worm gear roller, we know the importance of staying ahead of the curve in these matters. We must now ensure that the spinning wheel is adopted as widely as possible.

name: $afghan_culture$ Nobility
description: Much of the $DLH_ADJ$ nobility is drawn from the ranks of the $afghan_culture$ community, a people with a long history of conquest and rule in northern $india$. Though at times a political hindrance, their martial skills are beyond question.

name: Protect the Grand Trunk Road
description: The Grand Trunk Road runs from $kabul$ in Afghanistan to the coast of $bengal_area$. Many of the most important trading cities along its route are part of our empire, and so it falls to us to ensure that the road is well maintained and free of banditry.

name: Cosmopolitan Religions
description: $india$ is a massive subcontinent with several religions present. In order to ensure stability within our realm, we should expand the rights of the different faiths, and secure the loyalty of their worshippers.

name: Tughlaq Architectural Revival
description: During the height of the $tughlaq$ dynasty and the most stable period of our state, great architects and artists of grand vision constructed mosques and tombs in the unique Tughlaq style. As the decades went on and our power was challenged by internal issues, the resources for maintaining this architecture faded. It is time to revive it, and re-establish $DLH$ as an empire of art and wonders.

name: Indian Throne
description: For centuries, every great Indian empire has been ruled from $delhi$. It is the seat of conquerors and our birthright. All must know that $delhi$ is once again home to the rightful ruler of all $india$!

name: $HIN_ADJ$ Identity
description: Foreign ideas of nationalism and cultural identity have reached $india$. While the cultural diversity of $india$ will remain high, it is clear that our geography, as well as the values of $muslim$, give us all a sense of unity in the form of a $HIN_ADJ$ identity.

name: Lionhearts
description: The bravery and discipline of $ENG_ADJ$ foot soldiers has been witnessed from the shieldwalls of $northumbria_area$ to the darkened skies of $FRA$. Inspired by the lion-hearted spirit of our kings and the stoicism of the common man, our infantry fights with the ferocity of the Anglo-Saxon warriors before them.

name: Our Island Home
description: Our island protects us from outside enemies, but that will not matter if we do not protect the surrounding waters. By being true masters of our surrounding seas, we will keep a firm control on those who threaten our land.

name: $magna_carta_reform$
description: $magna_carta_reform_desc$

name: $a_early_longbowmen$
description: $a_early_longbowmen_desc$

name: $a_longbowmen$
description: $a_longbowmen_desc$

name: $a_late_longbowmen$
description: $a_late_longbowmen_desc$

name: A Royal Navy
description: Beginning around 1495, the $tudor_dynasty$ monarchy invested heavily in not just ships, but extensive infrastructure to maintain and otherwise support them. This for many marked the official founding of the Royal Navy.

name: Secretaries of State
description: The monarch has always had a secretary responsible for their royal correspondence. This position eventually evolved into that of the Secretary of State, a powerful minister who not only transmits royal decrees, but also has a high level of administrative authority.

name: The Eltham Ordinance
description: The Eltham Ordinances represented $ENG$'s first attempt to streamline royal bureaucracy and make it more adaptable and cost-effective. The Ordinances attempted reform through reducing royal household expenditures and consolidating certain bureaucratic functions.

name: The Sick and Hurt Board
description: This institution looked after the welfare of ordinary enlisted seamen in the Navy. It brought about a series of reforms that greatly improved the health of sailors on duty.

name: $ENG_ADJ$ Bill of Rights
description: A sweeping series of reforms limiting royal power, particularly in judicial matters. Among other stipulations, they state that the monarch may not unilaterally raise armies, prescribe cruel and unusual punishment, or interfere with the free election of members of Parliament.

name: The Navigation Acts
description: These acts represent the apex of mercantilism. Trade must be conducted with our ships and pass through our ports first, where we will collect customs duties and any other applicable taxes.

name: Palladian Architecture
description: The architectural innovations made by Inigo Jones will undoubtedly have a significant impact on future generations of architects. His promotion of classical architecture and his priority on proportion and harmony are considered hallmarks of the neoclassical movement in $ENG$.

name: Blake's Sailing and Fighting Instructions
description: Robert Blake has written several sets of rules and regulations that resulted in sweeping naval reforms. These include new tactics for blockades and landings, as well as adoption of the single line ahead battle formation.

name: Coke Smelting
description: The invention of coke smelting, specifically its application in $iron$ and $steel$ production, is closely tied to the Industrial Revolution. $iron$ and $steel$ are currently produced using traditional methods like charcoal smelting, whereas this new method will result in improved output and reduced maintenance costs.

name: Redcoats
description: Life in the $ENG_ADJ$ army is grueling and strictly regimented, but it instills in one a certain character. The unflappable nature of our troops, as well as their expertise with firearms, strikes fear into the hearts of our enemies.

name: $a_experimental_riflemen$
description: $a_experimental_riflemen_desc$

name: Rulers of the Waves
description: A massive sea presence is required for any nation attempting to rule the waters. Our fleet will be so imposing that the shores of our enemies will always be surrounded by our vessels.

name: Water Frame
description: The water frame is a spinning frame used in the textile industry to produce cotton thread. This innovation will contribute to the establishment of large textile factories powered by water wheels.

name: The Ark of the Covenant
description: We are the only nation to house the sacred Ark of the Covenant after it was secretly taken by Menelik I with divine assistance thousands of years ago. It is hidden away from public view, lest someone attempt to steal our sacred national treasure. Replicas of the Ark are placed in every single one of our churches as a reminder that our rule is blessed by God.

name: The Roof of $africa$
description: Our people have inhabited the highlands for generations, enduring extreme conditions that have made us resilient and strong. This gives us a significant advantage over our enemies whenever we engage in conflict.

name: $solomonid_dynasty$ Dynastic Claim
description: Our rulers' forefathers are descended from the monarchs of Aksum; from the bloodlines of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. We have deposed the $zagwe_dynasty$ monarchs in order to legitimize our rule and firmly establish the kingdom being restored to its rightful dynasty.

name: Nəgusä Nägäst
description: Our ruler is the king of all kings; the heir to the pedigree of the kings of Aksum along with that of the first ruler, Menelik I, the son of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. All of our kings are descended from the $solomonid_dynasty$ dynasty, and the line of inheritance need not be from father to son.

name: A Permanent Capital
description: For centuries, our nation has lacked a permanent capital, with the court following the rulers wherever they desired. While this approach has its advantages, in order to effectively govern our vast nation we need to establish a strong central authority in a proper permanent location.

name: External Friends
description: Our envoys to $rome$ and $iberia_region$, looking for military support, were quite successful — in fact, they put us on the map. These endeavors to find allies should continue.

name: An Eternal Crusade
description: As a $christian_ADJ$ nation, we find ourselves surrounded by $muslim_ADJ$ adversaries who seize every opportunity to attack us. To ensure our survival, we must be prepared to fight back immediately.

name: Prester John
description: People from $europe$ have been looking for Prester John for centuries, and are convinced that our ruler has to be him, somehow, as we are fellow $christian_ADJ$ worshippers. There is no reason to point out that they are wrong, however, as they are now happy to share their ideas with us.

name: An Iron Fist
description: Our region is diverse in cultures and religions, and the only thing that keeps it united is not compassion, but a powerful ruler, capable of dealing swiftly and decisively with any attempt at revolt.

name: A True $ETH_ADJ$ Church
description: External influences have their uses, but exposure to them can alter the nature of our beliefs. In order to maintain our identity, we must secure the domestic primacy of our own Tewahedo Church.

name: Origin of $coffee$
description: It is from our lands that $coffee$ comes, as we have the perfect growing conditions. While it can be cultivated in other places, ours is revered for its quality and exported by the ton. We have to make this a way to channel wealth into our nation.

name: A Modern Nation
description: Despite our apparent isolation, we are well aware of the innovations happening around the world, and we waste no time in implementing these modernizations in order to maintain a competitive advantage over our rivals.

name: Ç̌äwa Regiments
description: The #italic Ç̌äwa#! serve as $ETH$'s noble feudal warriors, recruited and appointed for the Emperor's army service. They are a professional soldier class, renowned for their ferocity.

name: $a_renaissance_cawa$
description: $a_renaissance_cawa_desc$

name: $a_discovery_cawa$
description: $a_discovery_cawa_desc$

name: $a_reformation_cawa$
description: $a_reformation_cawa_desc$

name: $a_absolutism_cawa$
description: $a_absolutism_cawa_desc$

name: $a_revolutions_cawa$
description: $a_revolutions_cawa_desc$

name: La Cour de $FRA$
description: Our diplomatic maneuvers are renowned for their complexity and finesse, and our skilled envoys emulated across the continent. Yet only a fool would become complacent now — we could further refine our diplomacy through measures such as cultivating networks of informants and perfecting the art of negotiation. Let other nations muddle through yesterday's techniques while we pioneer tomorrow's.

name: A Knightly Nobility
description: The aristocrats of our nation have always provided the best soldiers for our armies. Their well-trained fighters will serve our nation and defeat our enemies in the name of righteous glory!

name: $french_language$ Language in All Courts
description: For a long time, $latin_language$ has been the language of cultural exchange in $europe$... but to be honest, that language is nearly as dead as the ancient Romans who spoke it. We need to find a new #italic lingua franca#!, and nothing says 'lingua franca' like $french_language$.

name: Élan!
description: Cultivating the doctrine of attack is the hallmark of our army. Our men must fight with #italic élan#! — spirit and vigor — giving us a clear edge on the battlefield.

name: Estates-General
description: According to some, the Estates-General have existed since 1303. Over time, its form has shifted from being a council of royalty appointees to one of elected representatives. This change in structure has given the Estates-General, and the taxes levied by them, greater legitimacy.

name: Gendarme Companies
description: Reliance on a levy system has exposed our government to great risks, and has proved to be severely limiting. We should recruit heavily armed cavalrymen and pay them a fixed salary in order to create a standing army.

name: Consolidation of the Country
description: Our influence over other states is undeniable. Why not use this persuasive power to incorporate them directly into our country?

name: Reliance on Privateers
description: Direct competition with other maritime powers could be detrimental to our finances. We should empower our mercantile fleet to plunder and seize the merchant ships of our enemies. This will not only ensure a healthy income for our state, but also disrupt the maritime economies of our rivals.

name: Establishment of Recettes Générales
description: The intendants responsible for collecting the taxes of the people shall not be appointed by the estates, but by our ruler directly. This way, we will ensure these officers will be loyal to the ruler alone, and gather all of the rightful tribute owed.

name: Northern Mannerism
description: As a nation much enriched by the $renaissance$, we should invest in the creation of a unique, distinctively $FRA_ADJ$ aesthetic. By inviting foreign artists to our realm and sponsoring a school for artist training directly, we will be able to brand any artistic works produced as identifiably $FRA_ADJ$.

name: Innovative Fortifications
description: Our genius in fortification does not represent a radical departure in their design; rather, the innovation comes from the placement of the fortresses. By taking maximum advantage of local terrain, even the most basic fort requires more effort and supplies to take.

name: The Philosophes
description: We are proud to be the home of so many of the most renowned philosophers of these enlightened times. These thinkers produce a constant stream of groundbreaking ideas, which are stimulating advances in all fields, from the most trifling to the most vital.

name: Historic Claims
description: We trace our nation's lineage back to the empire of Charlemagne, and can therefore claim all those lands to be part of our rightful territory. With the support of dedicated courts, we will be able to identify and re-claim all of this long territory.

name: Liberté, Egalité, Fraternité
description: With all men declared to be equal under our new laws, adherents of other beliefs are finally allowed full participation in our government, and may thus now contribute to our national progress.

name: Code Civil
description: We must replace the chaotic patchwork of laws governing our state with a single, unified legal code that applies to our entire population. This #italic Code Civil#! will serve as the foundation of our government and establish a just system for everyone in our realm.

name: Grande Armée
description: When measured against our adversaries, our need for military reform becomes painfully apparent. By introducing modern drilling techniques, we can transform our troops into a disciplined force capable of destroying any foe in combat.

name: Kipchak Khanate
description: Our great country is also called the Kipchak Khanate, ruling over all the territories of the Cuman-Kipchak Confederation. With such swathes of land under our command, the armies we can gather will be innumerable.

name: Legacy of Jochi
description: After $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ died, his son Jochi also passed not long after. However, his presence and legacy are still felt in our country, to the point that we are still known as the Ulus of Jochi. Warriors flock to our banners to uphold that legacy.

name: Legacy of the Golden Horde
description: We were one of the main constituent parts of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$'s empire, and we represent the main political force in $eastern_europe$ and the Steppes. The world shall tremble before us!

name: Perso-$MGE_ADJ$ Administration
description: Our ancestors refined our administrative system over the centuries, and they were not shy about incorporating the ideas and methods of the cultures they subdued. Our current system of administration is in part based on traditions dating back to the Great $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ himself, and in part on what we have adopted from $IRA_ADJ$ and $muslim_ADJ$ bureaucrats in the lands conquered.

name: Tatar Traditions
description: Our empire may no longer be ruled from horseback, but our armies remain masters of the mount. Over the centuries, we have stayed true to our origins, ensuring that few can match the skill of our riders. As we go forward and adopt new technology and tactics when needed, we build on the strong organization and martial traditions of the $MGE_ADJ$ Empire.

name: Secure the Trade Routes
description: Not all riches in this world originate in our territory. Trade is the source of all wealth, and the Golden Horde has always protected merchants. By ensuring the safety of anyone who wishes to move goods through our country, we can ensure a steady stream of furs, silk, spices, and other necessities to our cities. Whether they choose to sell their goods to us or not, their mere presence will generate wealth for our people.

name: Religious Pragmatism
description:
Constraining, inflexible doctrine has never won many admirers among the Tatar hordes. When the Great $Oz_Beg$ $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ adopted $muslim$, it was the faith of a Sufi Shaykh or a zealous Qāḍī that he invited into his lands.

Centuries of tradition and loyalty are what we would rather build our state upon. Religion has a part to play, but we would prefer to see our country thrive than to fall apart in the chaos of forced religious homogeneity.

name: Modernization of the Steppes
description: It was long ago that $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$'s armies first seized control of the steppes. Our country has since surpassed our ancestor's every expectation, and now we stand as a global power on our own merit. We shall now begin the process of modernizing our territories, so that one day we shall be the beacon of all the world.

name: Banū Naṣr
description: We descend from the Banū l-Ḫazraj tribe and come from the lineage of Saʿd ibn ʿUbāda, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The founder of our dynasty, Muhammad I, controlled a territory that included $granada$, $jaen$, $almeria$, and $malaga$, though some of those lands fell to the $christian_ADJ$ forces. Since then, we have been resisting their advances with tenacity, and we will continue doing so with the strength of our ancestors.

name: Nasrid Art
description: The artisans and architects of $GRA$ are the most skillful in the world. They create things that are not only useful, but pleasing to the eye, beautifully combining form and function.

name: Skillful Envoys
description: Our skillful use of diplomacy has been the deciding factor between life or death many times before. But we must not let ourselves be lulled into complacency; we must train our envoys even more to ensure their success.

name: Nasrid Razzias
description: The borders of our enemies are tantalizing opportunities for us. Should we boldly strike with lightning attacks, we can catch the enemy off-guard and inflict lasting damage.

name: Mutawwi'a Armies
description: $GRA$ has a limited number of people, and we cannot draft enough soldiers to defend our nation effectively. However, where we lack people, we do not lack gold, and that can be used to bring mercenary swords under our banners.

name: Expand the Qanāh
description: The lands of $GRA$ are fertile, but expanding our irrigation canals would allow us to make better use of our water supply, and grow better-quality crops as a result.

name: Adaptive Trade
description: Our privileged position as middlemen between $christian_ADJ$ and $muslim_ADJ$ nations is being challenged. This threat could be an opportunity to modernize our trade methods and recover our position as a link between more distant markets and $europe$.

name: Expand the Frontier
description: Since the foundation of our dynasty, our territorial holdings have been shrinking. However, we are now in a stronger position, capable of not only recovering every piece of lost land, but enlarging our realm even beyond those original borders.

name: A Strong Rule
description: For decades, generations of our ruling family have fought incessantly with each other, destabilizing our nation. It is about time a powerful ruler decisively asserted their authority, proving they are the only one who can keep the peace and bring prosperity to our nation.

name: Modernized Economy
description: Modern times demand a modern economy, capable of thriving in a highly competitive environment. By upgrading our infrastructure and making our production methods and processes more efficient, we will maximize production using the same amount of resources.

name: Nasrid Ghazawat
description: As the descendants of the warriors who fought under the Prophet, we must defend our realm with similar bravery. Every battle for $GRA$ is a #italic ghazawat#! — a holy struggle to preserve $muslim$ against the onslaught of $christian$.

name: A New Golden Era
description: Al-'Andalus was once a center for learning, home to exceptional scholars like 'Aḥmad Ibn Rušd, 'Abū al-Qāsim, and Muḥammad bin Ṭufayl. We should endeavor to continue this long-standing intellectual tradition.

name: A House of Glory
description: Our rise to power has made us the target of much envy, and the rival houses of the $hre$ vie for our position as the protectors of the south-eastern border. Despite these circumstances, we pride ourselves on executing diplomatic maneuvers unrivaled by any others.

name: Legacy of Rudolf I
description: The victory of Rudolf I over his rivals secured our place among the great houses of the $hre$ and is the subject of many tales and songs. The fervor displayed by him and his knights in the Battle on the Marchfeld will inspire our troops for centuries to come.

name: Land of Mountains and Rivers
description: Our people are highly adapted to traverse the obstacles of our country, from the high peaks and passes of our mountains to the wide rivers of our valleys.

name: 'Tu Felix Austria Nube'
description: 'Let others wage war; you, happy $HAB$, marry! For what Mars gives to others, Venus gives to you — kingdoms.'

name: $HAB_ADJ$ Diplomatic Expertise
description: Given our location at the center of all $europe$, we must adopt a highly flexible attitude towards external diplomacy. Alliances and rivals can shatter as easily as they are formed, and our diplomats must be trained to cover every possible position.

name: Landsknecht Tactics
description: Only well-rounded tactics of artillery shock, cavalry charges, and unyielding infantry recruited from the $landknechte$ can lead us to victory.

name: Edict of Restitution
description: A bit of bookkeeping will help us to weather any religious strife that could befall our realm. This harmless edict will surely not spark any further conflict.

name: $HAB_ADJ$ Court
description: Maintaining our diplomatic relations requires time and effort, and committing too many people to diplomatic missions could negatively affect our efficiency and damage our reputation. The $HAB_ADJ$ Court's streamlined approach ensures we deploy the right envoys at the right times and still gather the information we need without overextending our diplomatic resources.

name: Geheimer Rat
description: The #italic Geheimer Rat#! is an elite advisory body composed of high-ranking nobles and officials, serving as the central institution for guiding our political, military, and administrative decisions.

name: Hofkriegsrat
description: Our war council can only function with a proper bureaucratic structure. Only when we know every detail about our troops and logistics can we defend our realm from hostile intruders.

name: Military Frontier
description: Defending our frontiers is a serious issue, and puts significant financial pressure on the state. The solution we have hit upon is to make generous grants of frontier lands in order to build up a professional military class. This will ensure more discipline overall and facilitate migration to the underpopulated regions of our realm.

name: Enlightenment Through Education
description: Our rulers must receive the best education possible to live up to the ideal of the enlightened monarch.

name: State Industrialization
description: Industrial modernization must always be a priority for our administration. Only through modern manufacturing can we compete with our rivals on a global stage.

name: Wiener Klassik
description: Viennese Classicism is a transformative force in music. Our best composers' works shall revolutionize Western musical tradition through bold, trend-setting innovation of symphonic, operatic, and chamber arrangements.

name: Multicultural Empire
description: $HAB$ is a diverse and multicultural realm, committed to embracing and accommodating its numerous ethnic minorities to maintain unity and stability amidst growing nationalist tensions.

name: Imperial Artillery
description: The rapidly changing nature of warfare urges us to modernize our troops and tactics. In order to stay ahead of our foes, we shall make our artillery the pride of the Imperial army.

name: Sipâhi
description: Neglecting the importance of the infantry has been the downfall of many would-be conquerors. We must ensure that our troops are equipped with the most effective firearms and drilled in tactics that can adapt to any foe.

name: United $india$
description: The many people, cultures, languages, and nations that make up $india$ shall be finally united under a single banner. Only with common understanding and a carefully fostered unity among all our people can we strive towards greater ambitions.

name: Gaṅgā
description: Many $hindu_ADJ$ faithful worship the river Ganges as a goddess that brings purity and redemption to the faithful. We implore pilgrims to visit the river banks to bathe in the sacred waters. Through Gaṅgā, our nation is made pure.

name: Persianate Courtly Culture
description: Foreign languages and noble customs have richly influenced the courts of $india$ for a long time. We should utilize these connections to invite the most capable advisors to serve under our guidance.

name: Gunpowder Empire
description: Our mastery of gunpowder warfare has brought us glory and helped us found our great state. This dominance would be impossible without fostering firearms production for our troops.

name: Attract Sufi Missionaries
description: $muslim_ADJ$ princes across the world compete to attract the wisest Sufi teachers. As our renown has grown, more of these Sufis have joined us. Towns are founded wherever they settle, often in previously inhospitable regions, and the local people are inspired to convert through the wisdom of the Sufis.

name: Indian Administration
description: Governing a state as large as an entire subcontinent is no easy task. We will need to develop a robust system of administration in cooperation with local princes to get the most out of our production and to ensure widespread stability.

name: Imperial $india$
description: No ruler, be they $muslim_ADJ$, $hindu_ADJ$, $buddhist_ADJ$, or $jain_ADJ$, has ever succeeded in conquering the entirety of the subcontinent. We shall be the first universal rulers of $india$!

name: Develop Rocket Technology
description: Iron-cased rockets have yet to be widely adapted for military purposes, yet their explosive power surely has tactical applications. We should experiment with this technology and test it on the battlefield.

name: Industrialization of $india$
description: Conditions in our economy are ideal for rapid industrial growth. With new technology we can ensure better conditions for our local production, particularly in the textile industry. Our focus on new methods means that our state can ensure steady industrial expansion.

name: Composite Light Cavalry
description: Made up of horse archers as well as swift horsemen, our light cavalry is the backbone of our military force. Our mounted forces have shown their mettle time and time again, and will inevitably lead our forces to glory once more.

name: Castle Warriors
description: The Castle Warriors, one of the most select classes in our society, are duty-bound to provide military service to their local #italic ispáns#! in royal castle districts. Stalwarts from the earliest days of our nation, these privileged landholders hold a unique position, actively defending their realm while cherishing their hereditary rights.

name: Realm of Many Cultures
description: The Carpathian Basin is home to more than just $HUN_ADJ$ people. $slovak$, $ruthenian$,$cuman_culture$, and $german_carpathian$ people, among many other different minorities, call our realm their home. Given this diversity, it is only natural that our government proficiently absorbs and adopts these different cultures into our state.

name: A $renaissance$ Prince
description: The peasants consider their ruler a just one because they are officially protected from having excessive demands and other abuses heaped upon them by magnates. The ruler of $HUN$ is a true $renaissance$ prince — a successful military leader and administrator, an outstanding linguist, and an enlightened patron of the arts.

name: Reformed Coinage
description: To pay for our new professional army, we will need a steady stream of revenue. Reforming the coinage to standardize weights will make this much easier, because we shall know exactly how much people need to pay.

name: Found the Black Army
description: Inspired by the writings of Julius Caesar, $HUN$ shall maintain a corps of professional soldiers. These warriors will be so fierce that our enemies shall whisper terrified tales of 'The Black Army' to their children at night!

name: $a_hungarian_hussars$
description: $a_hungarian_hussars_desc$

name: $HUN_ADJ$ Reformation
description: $hun_hungarian_reformation_intro$ Our realm has been threatened by outside powers for long enough. By joining the Reformation and abandoning the duty of following the Pope like a lapdog, we can break at least one of the shackles oppressing us!

name: The $catholic_ADJ$ Shield
description: $hun_hungarian_reformation_intro$ Yet, the hearts of the faithful remain strong. God and His loyal servants will withstand this heretical madness.

name: Realm of Many Religions
description: $hun_hungarian_reformation_intro$ Alas, the Reformation has split families apart, made former friends into enemies, and threatened the very stability of many nations. However, our realm knows better than to fall victim to this theological quarreling. We are a people and a realm of many religions, after all.

name: Bulwark of $christian$
description: With $turkish_culture$ power rising in the south, it falls to the people of $HUN$ to defend faithful kingdoms from the $turkish_culture$ threat. Let it be known that we will not flinch from our sacred duty!

name: Revolutionary Military Tactics
description: As military technology advances, so do battlefield tactics. It is imperative to the survival of our state that we keep pace with the ever-evolving nature of land warfare.

name: Curtail Peasant Liberties
description: $HUN$ is not blessed with protective natural frontiers. The wild plains that first brought our ancestors here were perfect for launching raids into the West, not for defense. If $HUN$ is to defend itself, we will need resources. The best solution is to allow our magnates to bind the peasants more closely to the land, ensuring greater productivity.

name: Strengthen the Towns
description: Towns are key factors in producing the wealth $HUN$ needs to grow and prosper. If we ensure the operations of our townships are protected from the power-hungry machinations of the nobility, they will continue to bring in trade, which we can tax.

name: $HUN_ADJ$ Unity
description: Although our subjects have faced many external threats over the years, the spirit and will of the $HUN_ADJ$ people remains unbroken. Unifying $HUN_ADJ$ hearts is greatly inspiring to our patriotic soldiers, who will defend our homelands to the last man.

name: Restore the Yäm
description: The Yäm, our ancient system of relay stations and messengers, once connected the furthest corners of the $MGE_ADJ$ world. By restoring this vast network across $persia_region$ and beyond, we ensure that our orders are swift, our envoys safe, and our dominion responsive, just as it was in the golden days of the Khans.

name: $ILK$ Resurgent
description: What was once broken is now reborn. Our banners fly once more across $persia_region$, invoking awe and fear in equal measure. As word of our rising power spreads, the world will remember what it means to be ruled by a true $ILKHANATE_LEADER_MALE$.

name: Persian Arts and Architecture
description: Our ancestors ruled with the sword, but their greatness was measured in palaces, libraries, and minarets. Let us follow their example and fund not only walls and roads, but mosques, gardens, and schools as testaments to $ilkhanate$ grandeur.

name: Descendants of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$
description: The blood of the $rank_empire_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ runs through our veins. Let no man forget that our rule was ordained on the steppes and sealed by conquest. Our horsemen remain unmatched, and our banners bear not just a name, but a birthright.

name: New Roots
description: The days of pure steppe conquest lie behind us. We have sown ourselves into the soil of progress and reformation. From that soil, a more stable, sophisticated state shall grow. Though our hearts may still beat to the rhythm of the open fields, our future lies in lasting institutions, not fleeting raids.

name: Chasqui
description: The #italic chasquis#! are the messengers of our state. Chosen from the fittest and most durable runners of our country, these agile men carry $quipu$ strings, messages, gifts, and other kinds of information, and deliver them to the target recipient. The spread of ideas, as well as the bulk of our diplomacy, rests on their shoulders.

name: Mitma Obligations
description: In order to undertake great building projects in the past, our rulers had to fulfill ancient traditions by inviting every single petty chief in our empire to the capital, showering them with gifts, and holding lavish feasts. As our state grows, however, this is far from an ideal way to undertake these projects. Supplying labor and materials for construction should be the duty of each and every chief in our lands.

name: The Vertical Economy
description: No other empire is as well adapted to the heights of the Andes as we are. By maintaining settlements and storehouses at every altitude, from the lowest valleys to the highest plateaus, we have mastered the method of moving men and goods across the most difficult terrain, where other states would falter. Our llama caravans, our roads carved into sheer cliffsides, and our highland communities turn the Andes from a barrier into our own highway.

name: Military Mit'a
description: The #italic mit'a#! is a mandatory public service system fundamental to Incan society, and forms the backbone of the military service. Every #italic ayllu#! must contribute capable men, adapted to combat in the highlands, to provide labor for state projects and military service.

name: Warachikuy
description: The #italic warachikuy#! is a holy ceremony where young men are tested in their skills, valor, and wits, as well as their physical abilities like racing, marksmanship, combat, and durability for extended lengths of sleep deprivation. Those who pass these tests with excellence are promoted to the rank of officers for our ever-growing army.

name: $tambo$
description: $tambo_desc$

name: Improved Tambo Way Stations
description: Our road system is one of our empire's most valuable assets. To further benefit our military and administration, we will erect #italic tambo#! way stations along all the main roads. These stations will be built within a day's march of each other, and will provide shelter and carry supplies for travelers.

name: Quipu
description: A system which uses knots on a string to store information, do accounting, and perform other informational tasks. Each knot represents a number from zero to nine. The knots can also be used to refer to logograms on the same string. The knots show which syllable in the logogram to use, and by combining more strings, sentences can be formed.

name: Llama Michis
description: Llamas have many functions in our society. They act as beasts of burden, as sacrifices, provide meat and wool, and even give us fertilizer for our crops with their dung. Controlling the breeding and use of llamas through government #italic michis#!, or herders, we ensure that the llama population is strictly monitored. This will provide an opportunity for the llama population to increase

name: Drafted Hatun Runas
description: The #italic Hatun Runas#! are the peasant class of our empire. One in fifty men are chosen for military service on their twenty-fifth birthdays, and conscripted for the next seven years. This conscription system helps us maintain a substantial professional army with superior discipline than the troops of our adversaries.

name: Adaptable Incan Army
description: Invaders from strange lands have set foot in our territory, and threaten our very existence. But our armies are adaptive; they adjust to new enemy tactics, learn to wield their very own weapons against them, and fight with an unbreakable resolve inspired by their foes.

name: Sasanian Heritage
description: Before the Islamic Conquest of $persia_region$, the region was home to the Sasanian Empire, which once ruled from Caucasia in the West to the Kirthar Range in the East. Many of its great cultural accomplishments have shaped our cultural and artistic identity.

name: $IRA_ADJ$ $muslim$
description: The Islamization of $IRA$ has been a lengthy process. It is not yet completely finished, but our religion has still become one of the major pillars of our national identity. Many of our ancient traditions have been combined with the teachings of $muslim$, and now make up our current core culture.

name: $shahnameh$
description: The #italic $shahnameh$#! - the Book of Kings - is an epic poem, and a national treasure of the $farsi_culture$ people. Describing the historical and mythical past of the empires which once occupied Greater $persia_region$, its stories contribute to the $farsi_culture$ culture in uncountable dimensions.

name: The Iranian Plateau
description: The great plateau at the heart of our realm does not result in a weakness for us but instead turns into our strength. As the origin of great empires, our people have for countless generations crossed its great plains and the rugged mountain ranges surrounding it, like the Zagros or the Alborz. The same terrain that exhausts foreign armies is where our soldiers, our merchants, and our administrators thrive. We will use this familiarity to move across our lands and govern them with an ease that no outsider can match.

name: Restoration of Cities
description: The Mongol invasion of $IRA$ was catastrophic for the entire region. Population centers of magnificent size were reduced to mere rubble. But it is finally time to rebuild what was once destroyed, and restore the awe-inspiring empire of $IRA$.

name: Improve the Silk Road
description: A system of upgrades to roads and bridges, a system of guards to protect the roads — for a small fee — and a chain of $caravanserai$ for rest and refreshment. All these improvements will help the merchants as they traverse the Silk Road, and also provide revenue for the state.

name: Promotion of Irrigation
description: As a consequence of the Mongol invasion of the past, $IRA$ is somewhat depopulated compared to the earlier empires which claimed these lands as their own. Promoting the practice of irrigation should help our people develop the agriculture needed to boost the local population and help us recover from the death toll of past conflicts.

name: $IRA_ADJ$ Horses
description: Horses play a fundamental role in our society. Many of our people are raised alongside their steeds, which is reflected in both the care our horse breeders take and the durability of our cavalry.

name: $IRA_ADJ$ Influence
description: $persian_language$ is an ancient language with a history longer than the lifespan of many empires. Even the $muslim_ADJ$ conquest could not diminish the core of the $IRA_ADJ$ identity, and many other states try to imitate our culture.

name: $IRA_ADJ$ Rug Production
description: $IRA$ has long been famous for its beautiful carpets and rugs. However, when the Mongols devastated the empire, much of this cultural heritage was lost. For $IRA$ to fully recover its tumbled glory, we must regain our economic strength, and restoring this legendary ancient industry is the first step in that direction.

name: $safaviyya_order_hall$
description: $safaviyya_order_hall_desc$

name: The $qizilbash$
description: The #italic $qizilbash$#! - the Red Heads - are a Shia military movement founded by the Ṣafawiyya. Guided by their religious convictions and deep ties to Sufism, these warriors are primed to fight for our state and to form the core of our army.

name: The Qurchi
description: While the $qizilbash$ are the backbone of the $IRA_ADJ$ military, the #italic Qurchi#! are the royal bodyguards enlisted from their ranks. Instead of being given land, these soldiers are paid from the royal treasury.

name: Religious State
description: No matter what the official faith of our state is, $IRA$ will always be an inherently religious country. Every aspect of our life is guided by religious principles, and even the government itself acts with our core beliefs in mind when dealing with matters of morality and justice.

name: The $a_ghilman$
description: The $a_ghilman$ are a military unit made up of formerly $christian_ADJ$ slaves with Caucasian origins. The $a_ghilman$ undergo strict military training and are well-practiced in the usage of firearms, making them an essential part of the national army. They serve as a counterbalance to other influential branches of the military.

name: Encourage Art
description: $IRA_ADJ$ art is highly in demand. Collectors from near and far travel here in droves to purchase our exquisite creations. We should offer state support for our talented artists, as this trade in aesthetic goods is extremely lucrative.

name: Court Nāẓir
description: The #italic Nāẓir#!, or overseers, are territorial administrators, and represent the eyes and ears of the Šâhanšâh. All actions of the court are supervised by the Nāẓir, and courtiers are promoted on their command. Even the Grand Vizier must work in association with the Nāẓir.

name: The $a_tofangchi$
description: The $a_tofangchi$ are our musket corps. Although firearms have been in use for a while, their presence in our ranks is highly irregular, as many of our fighters prefer to use their traditional weapon of bow and arrow. The regiments of the $a_tofangchi$ aim to change this, as they are trained in the use of modern weaponry.

name: The $a_tupchi$
description: $a_tupchi_desc$

name: Religious Unity Policy
description: The time of great religious divides has come to its end. In these turbulent times, $muslim$ cannot afford any more in-fighting. We shall advocate for a policy of internal and external religious unity, and come to peace with what we used to consider heresy.

name: $persian_gulf$ Coastal Defense
description: Although our lands are located mostly in the highlands of the Zagros Mountains, $IRA$ does have coastal possessions. While past dynasties might have paid little attention to the maritime protection of the empire, our people are more aware of the sea, and our sailors are eager to defend our coasts.

name: The $a_jazayerchi$ Infantry Corps
description: $a_jazayerchi_desc$

name: Connect the Interior
description: While the terrain of our lands allows for swift transportation and travel along the coastline, the interior of the Italian peninsula is much harder to traverse in many places. Connecting not only interior locales, but also coast with coast, will ensure easier mercantile operations and improved maneuverability of our troops.

name: A Prized Possession
description: $italy_region$ is a desired possession for many foreign rulers. If we want to defend our country, we must expand recruitment for both our land and sea forces. Since $italy_region$ is vulnerable to invasions both from across the alpine passes and our vast coastline, we must ensure the army and navy are well-prepared to face any conqueror looking to disrupt the peace of the peninsula.

name: Flourishing Cities
description: Our lands are blessed with many highly urbanized areas. This not only offers us ample opportunity to manufacture goods, but their mercantile connections also enable us to ship them to foreign markets for our profit. Clearing any obstruction to expanding these industries will guarantee their continued success.

name: Influential Clergy
description: With its close proximity to the $papacy_reform$, $italy_region$ has a long tradition of powerful and talented clergy in the service of the faith. Regardless of where our religious matters will take us, we should maintain good relations with our clergy.
