name: Hardships of War
description: Foreign interest in $italy_region$ has many times turned our lands into the battlefield of stronger countries. Sustaining our people during these times of need is a difficult task. Establishing secure locations to shelter our population during conflict will ensure their support during even the most dire wars.

name: Appealing Landscape
description: The fertile, mild land of our peninsula is a popular place for people from bordering countries to seek their fortunes. While many of our cities already rely on labor from seasonal migrants, we should increase our efforts to settle these people into our lands permanently.

name: Sons of the Salur Tribe
description: The $KAR$ trace their ancestry to the Salur, one of the major Oghuz tribes. Known for both their leadership and valor, the Salur legacy shapes our state's identity and our claim to represent the $turkmen_culture$ of $anatolia_region$.

name: Meḥmed Bey's Firman
description: Meḥmed I issued a decree demanding that only Turkish be spoken in courts, dervish lodges, assemblies, and public squares. This act rejected $persian_language$ and $arabic_language$ dominance in elite circles and laid the groundwork for a uniquely $turkmen_culture$ cultural policy.

name: $KAR$ Cavalry
description: Cavalry has always been the cornerstone of $turkmen_culture$ warfare. Our riders, trained from a young age and mounted on hardy Anatolian horses, uphold the proud traditions of steppe warfare with discipline and striking force.

name: Home of the Whirling Dervishes
description: $konya$, our spiritual center, is home to the followers of Mevlânâ Jalāl al-Dīn Muḥammad Rūmī. Their sacred practice — the #italic sema#! — symbolizes the soul's journey toward divine truth. Their presence deepens the mystic traditions of our realm and reinforces our Sufi roots.

name: Fixed Military Camps
description: By establishing permanent military camps at strategic locations throughout our domain, we will ensure our army suffers fewer casualties from attrition and can be mobilized quickly when needed.

name: Kanem Siege Tactics
description: Our armies are experienced with siege machinery, but adopting mobile artillery that can maintain sustained fire would secure our victory whenever we attack an enemy's walls!

name: $a_iron_helmet_musketeers$
description: As warfare tactics advance, so must our strategy. By adapting foreign innovations and techniques like formations, lines of fire, and new gunpowder recipes, we will surely be victorious!

name: Council of Clan Heads
description: Delegating administrative duties to local clan heads may mean relinquishing some of our central authority, but our advisors insist that we shall reap great benefits in return.

name: Ribāṭ Fortifications
description: Used throughout the $muslim_ADJ$ world, these small fortifications have provided protections to caravans, commercial hubs, and isolated communities alike.

name: Defense of the Faith
description: We have been driven from $acre$ and $CYP$, but the Order of the Hospital of St. John will retreat no further. In pagan times, a Colossus stood sentinel over the harbor of Rhodes, but today, the greatest fortifications the world has ever known have taken up the guard!

name: Assistance to the Suffering
description: Our Order is named the Knights Hospitaller for a reason: we were originally the protective force of a pilgrims' hospital in $jerusalem$. Though $jerusalem$ is lost to the Saracens, we still provide medical aid to those in need, including our brave knights, who heartily return to the battlefield much faster than most armies.

name: Reconquista of the Sea
description: In our frequent clashes with fierce foreign corsairs, the thought has occurred to us that these scurvy dogs might have the right idea about looting and pillaging the coast, but they are preying on the wrong targets. Piracy may be a vile sin in peacetime, but in times of war, it is known as 'privateering,' and that is another thing altogether.

name: Friends in Need
description: Our Order was formed by faithful souls from every nation in Christendom. This fact, combined with our need for external support to fulfill our missions, have made us adept at recruiting helping hands for our cause. We will take advantage of our omnipresence in $europe$ to reach the ears of powerful $catholic_adj$ rulers, and sway them to our side.

name: Scourge of the Corsairs
description: The famed $turkish_culture$ privateer Hayreddin Barbarossa fought many legendary encounters against the Knights, but he was hardly the only corsair we have encountered. $turkish_culture$ raiding and looting of all of Southern $europe$, tolerated by the Barbary states and funded by the Turks, must end. The Knights will do their job protecting innocent sailors at any cost.

name: Crusader Tradition
description: Knights of our Order were present in the wars against Saladin and defended the last Outremer Crusader outpost, $acre$. If any among us needs inspiration to do heroic deeds, they need to look only at what the Knights of the Order of the Hospital of St. John have accomplished in the past. The name Knights Hospitaller is truly eternal, as is our famed courage in battle.

name: Ecumenical Defenders of Christendom
description: The Reformation has harmed our cause as knights from $GER$ and $scandinavian_region$ have started murmuring questions about the nature of the Communion Host, but the always-present $turkic_group$ threat has a way of making such disputes seem minor. Perhaps we should focus on defending the realm, and debate theology once the Saracen threat is safely at bay?

name: A Never-Ending Crusade
description: As long as any faithful $catholic_ADJ$ is in danger of religious persecution, our mission is not over! Be it during a pilgrimage to the Tomb of our Lord and Savior, or while crossing the seas and fending off corsairs, we will never stop training and never rest, ready to leap into combat at a moment's notice.

name: Inspired Builders
description: While our Order's principal duty is to fight, we serve our people in other ways as well. Over the centuries, we have developed the art of rapid construction, erecting buildings and fortifications with remarkable speed. We will use this expertise to make our capital into both an impregnable fortress, and a dynamic center of culture.

name: The Right Hand of the Pope
description: As time goes on, and the Crusades start to fade from the memory of our people, the importance of having the Pope's ear increases. We ingratiate ourselves until we are the closest confidantes to the Supreme Pontiff. Naturally, our devotion to his service will benefit us enormously — and why not enjoy our hard-won privileges?

name: A Brand New World
description: The world evolves, and those who fail to adapt are forgotten by history. Our Order has endured for over half a millennium, and we will not fade away now! Our mortal bodies will eventually join the Creator, but our Order must first become immortal. We will transform ourselves into the most modern nation of our age, strengthening ourselves from the very core.

name: An Order with a State
description: While some nations are often described as an #italic Army with a State#!, we, on the other hand, have always been an Order with a nation, ever since our acquisition of Rhodes from the Greeks. Nevertheless, we cannot help but admire how efficiently they have harnessed their resources to become a formidable nation. Inspired by their success, we will implement reforms to ensure our military can confront any adversary with confidence.

name: Symbol of $catholic$
description: $jerusalem$ is the holiest city in Christendom, the very place of Christ's Passion and Resurrection. By asserting $catholic_ADJ$ supremacy over these sacred grounds, we become the spiritual beacon of the Latin world and a pillar of the true faith.

name: Protectors of $KOJ$
description: We stand on the frontlines of Christendom, surrounded by unbelief. It is our sacred duty to shield the Holy City and strike fear into the hearts of heathens who would dare usurp it.

name: Rites of the Holy Sepulchre
description: In the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, the ancient Latin rites are once more performed in full splendor. These solemn rituals, honoring the death and resurrection of Christ, reinforce our divine mandate to rule this land and spread the teachings of our faith.

name: Latin Patriarch
description: $PAP$ has reinstated the Latin Patriarch of $KOJ$, once exiled and forgotten. Now restored, the Patriarch shall strengthen our influence in $rome$ and reinforce our role as guardian of the Church's interests in the East.

name: Latinate Integration
description: Our realm is a crucible of noble blood from around $europe$, zealous pilgrims, and old Levantine stock. Through careful governance, we shall weave together this diverse heritage into a Latin $christian_ADJ$ society, where faith and culture go hand in hand.

name: Bakongo Confederation
description: Before the rise of our realm, the people of this region governed themselves through clan councils and provincial alliances. What we now call $KON$ emerged from centuries of interwoven relationships, where loyalty to the land and kin outweighed loyalty to borders. Uniting this patchwork into a centralized realm was no small feat, but we did it and we will keep it together yet.

name: Lineage of Lukeni lua Nimi
description: All things must begin somewhere, and for our kingdom, that beginning lies with Lukeni lua Nimi. He was more than a conqueror. Indeed, he was a founder, the father of our realm. His bloodline commanded respect, not just for its ancestry, but because it reminds the people who first dared to dream of a unified $KON$.

name: Contact with $europe$
description: The strangers came from the sea with beards, books, and barrels of wine. They brought with them strange gods, stranger languages, and an entire ocean of opportunity. Our emissaries have learned their customs, their intentions, and — most importantly — how to turn their need for allies into our advantage.

name: Cultural Syncretism
description: The influx of foreigners and cultural exchanges have made an impact on our society. However, we have not abandoned our own ways. We call upon deities by Kikongo names, we proudly wear our religious insignia, and our ceremonies echo with both drums and hymns. This is a vibrant example of our clarity, and the gods seem to agree.

name: Study European Firearms
description: The musket may not make a man brave, but it certainly makes him fearsome. Let those in $europe$ boast of their superiority; we will buy their weapons, master their drills, and soon enough the only thing distinguishing our soldiers from theirs will be the color of their flags.

name: Transatlantic $slaves_goods$ Trade
description: Prisoners and laborers are needed overseas to operate our many worksites, plantations, and mines. While this is far from a noble endeavor, none can deny the profitable nature of these exploits.

name: Fortresses of Goguryeo
description: $korea_region$ was home to many kingdoms in the past. However, the influence of one kingdom in particular is still felt today: Goguryeo, the precursor to Goryeo. Goguryeo has left us many legacies, including its stone fortifications and castle-building techniques, which are still in use to this day.

name: $korean_culture$ Artisanry
description: $korea_region$ has always had artistic traditions, but art has truly blossomed since our national unification, thrusting us into a golden era of cultural achievement. Among our many accomplishments, the artisanry of our people shines as a beacon of skill and refinement.

name: $korean_barracks$
description: $korean_barracks_desc$

name: Metal Movable Type
description: Movable type is an ancient printing technology first used by the $CHI_ADJ$ people many centuries ago. But it is the Goryeo dynasty who developed the metal form of movable type, streamlining the printing process. We can now print books with unparalleled efficiency.

name: Court Poetry
description: Our aristocracy puts great emphasis on the cultural development of their spirit and mind. Literature, such as poetry in $classical_chinese_language$, is seen as greatly valuable by the court. The nobility and ruling class alike are enthusiastic about the cultural impact of the written word.

name: Gunpowder Engines
description: Our forces have been aware of gunpowder's tactical value for centuries. Through reverse-engineering $CHI_ADJ$ designs and the innovations of Choe Museon, we have mastered both gunpowder production and the construction of machines that employ it for military use.

name: $korean_gunnery$
description: As gunpowder technology advances, so does our ingenuity, and as a result we have devised a new defensive system. Although simple in concept and execution, installing cannons in our fortifications will increase their defensive capabilities tremendously.

name: $a_hwacha$
description: $a_hwacha_desc$

name: $n_early_turtle_ship$
description: $n_early_turtle_ship_desc$

name: Grand Code for State Administration
description: To ensure proper, stable governance, we must first codify exactly how the government will work. This will be the basis for our nation's first written constitution.

name: The Hangeul Alphabet
description: The $korean_language$ language is so fundamentally different from any form of $chinese_language_family$ that the use of $chinese_language_family$ characters renders all except the most highly educated people illiterate. Our new alphabet is more scientific, and will allow all our people to be able to read and write in their own language.

name: Hyangyak System
description: Agriculture is the bedrock of our economy, and therefore efficient village management is paramount. To this end, we will implement the #italic hyangyak#! system, which establishes self-governance for villages. These agreements establish behavioral standards, dispute resolution regulations, and other civil procedures aimed at creating stable, self-reliant communities.

name: Border Defense Council
description: Our borders are constantly threatened, both by barbarians from the north and pirates from beyond the seas. To ensure our armies are always ready to meet every threat with swiftness, we will establish a council of officers dedicated to controlling and securing our borders.

name: Geobukseon
description: Defending our coastlines is vital to our survival, and as a result of this vigilance, we have developed the ingenious 'turtle ship'. These heavily armored behemoths will ensure that no enemy ship penetrates our coastal holdings.

name: $n_panokseon$
description: $n_panokseon_desc$

name: The Hopae System
description: The #italic hopae#! is an identity tag system requiring all $korean_culture$ people to carry proof of their name, birthplace, status, and residence. This allows authorities to quickly verify identities, and to track a person's movement, if needed.

name: The $korean_culture$ Cannon
description: Although we are already quite experienced at using gunpowder and cannon, we should not stop making technological advancements. By developing smaller, but more durable cannons, as well as inventing more efficient methods of reloading, we will revolutionize our artillery and greatly benefit both our army and our navy.

name: Daedongbeop
description: A new set of reforms that will gradually introduce previously ignored improvements into the tax system. The tribute tax levied against households will be replaced with a unified tax on arable land, and the tax on goods will be limited to a quota which lets enterprising peasants and wholesalers make and sell surplus goods. This will result in lower taxes for the peasantry, increased revenues for the state, and an overall rise in commerce.

name: Tribal Loyalty
description: Having asserted our authority over all $kurdish_culture$ tribes, we will be able to call upon their experienced, hardened warriors to defend our country.

name: Legacy of the $kurdish_culture$ Dynasties
description: Our people have established several great dynasties, ruling territories from $egypt_region$ to Iran. Tying our own state to the glory of past rulers will allow us to be a unifying symbol for the $kurdish_culture$ people, and make our rule seem more legitimate in the eyes of our subjects.

name: Prospering $kurdish_culture$ Quarters
description: In the times of foreign rule, many of our people established predominantly $kurdish_culture$ quarters in cities. While these areas prospered even under distant rulers, we can now utilize their wealth directly, and better guarantee a prosperous future for our people.

name: Adaptable Cavalry
description: Our homelands are surrounded by many would-be conquerors, hungry to subjugate our people. While our native terrain can slow down hostile armies, it also makes it difficult for our own troops to respond to threats swiftly. A strong cavalry, however, will allow us to quickly react to any threats, no matter how many there might be.

name: Mercenary Experience
description: Our people have long served as hired swords for foreign lords, gaining valuable combat experience in their service. With our own country now established, it is time to call those experienced fighters under our banner.

name: Warrior Poets
description: Our rulers must not just be capable warriors; they must also be educated in the matters of fine art and effective administration. By writing texts and documenting their reigns, our leaders will pass the knowledge and history of our people down through generations, ensuring no valuable insight is lost.

name: Baltic Crusader Forts
description: The many fortifications in our territories owe their construction and funding to our numerous Crusader bands. Flanked by sturdy walls, these fortifications will serve and protect our people for years to come!

name: Knights of the Livonian Order
description: Our nation is founded on the strong backs of the brave $christian_ADJ$ men who have joined our order as knights. Their martial prowess will compensate for our low numbers, compared to those of the Pagans surrounding us, as will the light and strength of our faith.

name: Bannerets of the Livonian Order
description: The knights of our order have proven their valor and skill in battle time and time again. By promoting the most capable among them to bannerets, we ensure that our armies will always be led by the best.

name: Baltic Forestry
description: Our forests are a vital resource, providing timber for construction and fuel for our fires. We must manage them wisely to ensure their continued abundance.

name: Baltic Forts
description: Our network of forts and castles scattered across the landscape provides a first line of defense against invaders. These strongholds allow us to monitor and control key routes through the Baltic.

name: Bubu & Jala
description: $bubu_building_desc$

name: Home of the Sea Nomads
description: $n_kabang_desc$

name: $n_jong$
description: $n_jong_desc$

name: Foreign Architectural Influence
description: In our many conquests across $indonesia_region$, we have encountered many new and incredible forms of art, all of which could be adopted and refined by our people to further our legacy. By introducing new techniques and sponsoring artists, our culture will come to exemplify the artistic achievements of our region.

name: The $bajang_ratu$ Gate
description: $bajang_ratu_desc$

name: $a_late_karambit_warrior$
description: $a_late_karambit_warrior_desc$

name: Sumpah Palapa
description: The head of our military directly answers to our ruler, and holds enough influence and power to shape the future of our realm. To ensure they understand what an important role they have been given, they are required to swear a special oath, one that underlines our dreams of conquest and bolsters our spirits.

name: The Magic Arrow
description: $a_cetbang_cannon_desc$

name: Maritime Silk Road
description: Our geographical position, complemented by our growing influence, has led to us presiding over the extensive and profitable trade network that carries $silk$ and $spices$ from East to West.

name: Restore Candi Shrines
description: Scattered throughout Nusantara are a series of temples known as #italic candi#!. We should restore these temples wherever we find them to renew our people's faith.

name: $n_madurese_gali$
description: $n_madurese_gali_desc$

name: Island Colonies
description: Contact with our neighbors in the archipelago has shown us clearly that the raw resources and unclaimed lands are ripe for the taking, promising to become secure and prosperous under our control.

name: Preservation of $javanese_culture$ History
description: The history of the $javanese_culture$ people is an integral part of our cultural identity. To protect this identity, we must preserve the traditions upon which we built our great country.

name: Epic of Sundiata
description: The $epic_of_sundiata$ tells of the legendary campaign of Sundiata Keita, the founder of the $MAL_ADJ$ Empire and hero of our people. His story has passed from generation to generation, and has always been a great source of inspiration to our people.

name: Kouroukan Fouga
description: The $kouroukan_fouga_advance$ is the basic constitution of $MAL$. It covers every aspect of living, from simple family life in the villages all the way to the sovereignty of the Mansa.

name: Gold of Bure
description: The twin gold fields at Bambuk and Bure are renowned as the largest gold deposits anyone has ever heard of, and they belong to us! Bure's gold mines in particular produced fantastic wealth that famously destabilized the entire Egyptian economy through inflation when Mansa Mūsā visited there. Our economy, though, is used to a constant influx of gold, and is more difficult to inflate.

name: Reclamation of Land
description: The Sahara is not static. It can wax and wane depending on rainfall, and the habitable belt known as the $sahel_region$, where we reside, can grow or shrink accordingly. A major drought could render much of our kingdom useless desert, an addition to the Sahara where no one reigns but death. However, in good years, we might reclaim some of the marginal lands from the Sahara and make it productive again.

name: Accounts of the Atlantic Voyage
description: According to the legendary Mansa Mūsā, his predecessor started a journey across the $atlantic_ocean_continent$ in hopes of discovering the furthest limits of the ocean. While some among the ruling class consider this endeavor a shameful abdication of duty, others see this as inspiration to explore corners of the world previously unknown to man.

name: Mandinka Warrior Spirit
description: Whether pagan or $muslim_ADJ$, Mandinka men have been the greatest fighters the $sahel_region$ has ever seen. The courage of our troops is admirable, as is their pride. When the Mansa raises an army, not only is it the largest in all the $sahel_region$, it is the best!

name: Markets for $salt$
description: In our kingdom, $salt$ is worth its cost in gold. But south of us, in the great forests of the Ashanti and the Yoruba, salt is worth considerably #italic more#! than gold. Luckily for us, we have our own supply of $salt$, and enough gold to obtain as much as we could ever want. Perhaps we could find yet more markets of people for whom $salt$ is more valuable than gold?

name: West African Slave Trade
description: Even before our Empire existed, the great Wagadou, the Ghana Empire that preceded us, sold $slaves_goods$ across the desert to the Arabs. We have followed suit all these years, supplying the Arab world with a vast number of $slaves_goods$. Now the Europeans clamor for even more $slaves_goods$ to work their holdings in the so-called New World. We have had little report, but the amount of $slaves_goods$ they demand is truly stunning, and they keep coming back, sometimes even raiding our shores and abducting our subjects. The time has come to impose order on this trade and restrict the Europeans to select commercial ports where they will purchase, not steal, $slaves_goods$.

name: The Kèlè-Koun
description: The Kèlè-Koun, or 'war-head', are the commanders of infantry fighting for Empire, called the Kèlè-Bolo, or 'war-arm'. Unlike the Ton-Tigi, the feudal lords of $MAL$, the Kèlè-Koun are not necessarily part of the $nobles_estate$. The Kèlè-Koun have #italic jonow#!, 'slaves', serving as carriers of the weapons and equipment until their inclusion in the Sofa battalions.

name: Mandekalu Levies
description: The $mandekalu_levies$ are the backbone of the $MAL_ADJ$ military. Freemen of the Empire are called to arms in times of war, and it is a great honor for them to participate in these battles with their own weapons.

name: Sofa Levies
description: Originally, all soldiers in the Kèlè-Bolo levies are #italic horon#!, or 'freemen', but the latest developments in $MAL$ have forced the inclusion of #italic jonow#!, 'slaves', to serve in the army as fighters instead of weapon-bearers. These slave warriors would thereafter be known as 'Sofa', protecting fortifications as part of garrison forces.

name: Farari Corps
description: The $farari_corps_advance$ are the elite of the $MAL_ADJ$ military. Commanders in their own right, they are highly respected for their experience and bravery.

name: Mohe Ancestry
description: Our people descend from the Mohe tribes of the Amur forests. Their traditions of hunting, herding, and hardy frontier life shape our society.

name: Warka Ties
description: Our ties with the Warka have given us great knowledge in hunting and gathering food. Through these practices, we ensure our people stay fed, even during long winters.

name: Shadow of Ambition
description: The unification of the Jurchen tribes is but the first step in our ambitious rise to power. Soon, our name will strike fear and awe across the entire continent.

name: Niyamniyan
description: The tradition of the Five Noble Talents involves riding, archery, military command, loyalty, and discipline. These aspects of our martial society form the backbone of our proud culture.

name: Southern Campaigns
description: $CHI$ is home to immeasurable wealth, prestige, and knowledge. Under the rule of a weak dynasty, it falls upon our shoulders to seize power and return the prosperity and splendor of these lands.

name: Foreign Learning
description: From foreign scholars and texts, we shall adopt new administrative, military, and scholarly practices, accelerating the pace of our technological development.

name: Pax Mongolica
description: Having unified all $mongolian_culture$ territories under our banner, the stability and prosperity our people will be able to enjoy has not been seen since the times of the great $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$.

name: All Under a $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$
description: $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ unified great swathes of territory under his banner. Having unified those territories again under the authority of a single $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$, all people in our empire shall swear allegiance to us.

name: Ghostly Horses of the Plain
description: The prowess of $mongolian_culture$ horsemen is renowned across the entire world. Our enemies shake in terror at the sight of a dust cloud in the distance, fearing that it might signify our cavalry's approach!

name: Yeke Mongol Ulus
description: As the original Mongols, we restored the #italic Yeke Mongol Ulus#!, the Great Mongolian State, resurrecting the glory of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$'s great empire. Given the slightest chance, our people will emulate the exploits of the Great $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ and reclaim his legacy, reuniting the once-vast territories of the $MGE_ADJ$ Khanate.

name: The Life of a Steppe Warrior
description: The steppe is a foreboding and unforgiving place for the unprepared. We are accustomed to living in this harsh environment, and as such our people are sturdy and have a knack for survival. We will ensure that all of our soldiers share these skills, and are thus able to more easily survive extreme situations.

name: Multicultural Empire
description: The territories of the great $MGE_ADJ$ Empire are home to many different peoples, all unified under the glory of the mighty $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$.

name: Improved Yam System
description: The system of #italic yam#! posts all over our empire have facilitated communication and logistics since the times of the great $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$. After re-establishing and improving this system, our messengers can cross the massive expanse of our empire at speeds that were not even thought possible before.

name: Mongolian Mobility
description: Each of our soldiers typically maintains three or four horses, allowing them to change each time their mount becomes tired, and thereby travel at high speed for days without stopping. Furthermore, their extra mounts provide them with food reserves through mare's milk as well as horse meat, making our armies far less vulnerable to starvation than other, so-called civilized nations' armies. This allows us to outmaneuver our enemies with ease, covering a staggering amount of territory in shorter periods than they had believed to be possible.

name: The Kheshig
description: The #italic Kheshig#! once formed the formidable bodyguard of the Great $MGE_ADJ$ $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$. Their descendants will continue to protect the $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ of $MGE$ as they ride into battle.

name: Glory of the $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$
description: The extraordinary $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ amassed a huge army like never before seen. We are heirs to his glory, and therefore our army will outstrip even the greatest $MGE_ADJ$ hordes of the past.

name: The Melaka Tree
description: As legend goes, the timid mouse deer sought refuge in what would later become our domain. Our beggining is humble, as little more than a fishing village clustered beneath the shade of the Melaka tree. From these roots shall grow a people that will one day shape the entire region.

name: Orang Laut
description: Long before our rise, the Orang Laut roamed the straits as masters of wind and tide. Now, by learning their ways and employing a select few, we guide traders through the narrow waters and shield our coast from pirates. Such vigilance ensures that all who sail to $malacca$ arrive safely.

name: Congregation of Merchants
description: From $arabia_region$ to China and the coasts of $south_asia$, merchants of every shore converge upon $malacca$. Drawn by fair laws, secure waters, and bustling markets, they will form a great congregation that enriches our ports and carries our name across the seas.

name: Connections with China
description: Our envoys have secured recognition from China's most prestigious sovereigns. Tribute and goodwill flow between us, granting us prestige, protection, and a privileged place in the vast network of their trade.

name: Control the Malacca Strait
description: The narrow $inner_strait_malacca$ is the backbone of our maritime commerce. By controlling this vital strait, we channel the wealth of nations into our harbors and establish ourselves as the unrivaled gatekeepers of the east-west trade.

name: The Shāhbandar System
description: To manage the vast tide of merchants arriving at our ports, we appoint a Shāhbandar as the authority to oversee customs, resolve disputes, and organize the foreign quarters. This office brings order to our bustling entrepôt and will strengthen our role as the crossroads of the seas.

name: Gatherers of Tribute
description: Our position as the collector of tribute for the $GLH_horde$ has given us many years of experience in gathering tribute... and in retaining some of the profits for ourselves.

name: Rule through Dynastic Ties
description: The lands of $russian_region$ have been ruled by one dynasty since time immemorial. We should utilize our position among our peers and our blood ties to take a leading role.

name: Seat of the Metropolitan Bishop
description: The $RUS_ADJ$ people need firm religious guidance. We have historically cooperated well with the Church, and expanding this relationship would benefit us all. If we can move the seat of the Metropolitan Bishop to $moscow$, we will be able to strengthen the bonds between our faith and our state.

name: Pomestnoe Voisko
description: By redistributing plots of confiscated lands to noble cavalrymen, we can build a new class of soldiers to defend our principality.

name: Strength of the Boyars
description: The Boyar class is in many ways the foundation of $RUS$, but just as we need to strengthen the Boyars, we also need to control them. We must protect seats for the Boyars in the Duma, but also to make sure that they are dependent on us to further their influence.

name: Zasechnaya Cherta
description: In order to withstand the constant threat of Tatar raids, our ancestors have built a line of tightly positioned and well-defended forts. As our state grows larger, we should keep expanding this 'Abatis Line' to ensure our people are always protected from foreign attacks.

name: Hurricane Hardy
description: The designs of Feodor Apraksin are robust and resilient, enabling ships to weather most storms that Mother Nature is able to conjure. The innovative construction greatly contributes to any burgeoning maritime ambitions.

name: Preobrazhensky Semyonovsky Imperial Guard
description: The 'Toy Army' is organized into elite companies, forming the Imperial Guard which protects the interests of the monarchy. They are frequently involved in court ceremonies, parades, and other significant events, showcasing their importance beyond their military duties.

name: Organized Levies
description: Governing the vast expanse of $russian_region$ is no easy task. We should establish local recruitment centers to make drafting levies into our armies easier.

name: Imperatorskiy Moskovskiy Universitet
description: The Imperial University is dedicated to the study of philosophy, medicine, and law, and plays a significant role in $RUS_ADJ$ education and research. It is established as part of educational reforms conceived by polymath Mikhail Lomonosov, emphasizing the importance of scientific inquiry and innovation.

name: Settle the Islands
description: Across the scattered isles of our homeland lie countless shores awaiting our touch. By strengthening our presence among these islands, we secure the wealth of our people: new trade posts, new harvests, and new communities bound by the waves that unite us.

name: People of the Sea
description: We are a people shaped by wind and tide. From childhood, we learn the ways of the monsoon, the pulse of the straits, and the call of the open ocean. Our sailors carry this knowledge into every voyage, earning renown across the archipelago for their courage and mastery.

name: Malay Merchants in Every Port
description: From the bazaars of $arabia_region$ to the harbors of $east_asia$, our merchants are a familiar sight. Their presence forms a vast network of cooperation, easing the establishment of our enclaves abroad and extending our reach into every great entrepôt of the world.

name: Expert Hagglers
description: Wherever our traders land, be it the coasts of $south_asia$ or the markets of distant China, they are respected for their sharp tongues and keen judgement. Navigating both seas and bargains with equal finesse, they ensure that our trades are never at a disadvantage.

name: Agreements with the Sea Nomads
description: The $sama_culture$ and other sea-wandering peoples have long lived upon the water itself, drifting between islands with unmatched skill. Through knowledge-sharing or agreements of mutual respect and shared opportunity, we shall ensure safe passage and swift repairs.

name: Masters of Spice
description: Trading in cloves holds much wealth for us and our people. By securing the lands and seas from which these spices flow, we stand at the center of a trade that spans the world, and no merchant can ignore the allure of these goods.

name: Zamindar System
description: The Zamindar are feudal rulers who govern our territories autonomously or semi-autonomously. While they are owners of the land they administrate and part of our nobility, in the end, they serve as internal vassals to the Crown itself.

name: $ibadat_khana$
description: $ibadat_khana_desc$

name: $MUG_ADJ$ Architecture
description: A great empire demands equally monumental buildings. In our cosmopolitan realm, architects are already creating marvelous edifices that will awe generations to come. Our dynasty should be at the forefront of this movement, creating great architectural works such as the world has never seen.

name: Fatawa-i-Alamgiri
description: The $mug_fatawa_e_alamgiri$ is a sharia-based compilation, serving as the primary legal code regulating various aspects of life in our empire. It is one of the most comprehensive collections of $muslim_ADJ$ laws, ethics, military strategies, economic policies, justice, and principles.

name: Indian Padishah
description: Though we came to $india$ as foreigners, we now rule as Indian Padishah, embracing local traditions while transcending divisions of caste and creed. As our realm is one of many faiths and cultures, our administration will draw talent from all communities, giving everyone — regardless of caste, religion, or culture — an equal opportunity to serve our great house and glorious realm.

name: Transatlantic Whaling
description: $basque$ whaling traditions represent centuries of experience, and our specialists are often consulted by other nations looking to expand and improve their own whaling industries. We should capitalize on this expertise by establishing whaling enterprises throughout the $atlantic_ocean_continent$.

name: Expert Shipbuilders
description: The sea kissing our shores teems with resources waiting for those brave enough to grab them. For centuries, our coast has been full of ports and shipyards, tirelessly building vessels with which to slake our thirst for adventure and profit on the open seas.

name: Memories of the Reconquista
description: Our people were active participants in the Reconquista, contributing to the $christian_ADJ$ efforts to reclaim $iberia_region$ from $muslim_ADJ$ rule. Despite reaching a stage where further territorial expansion became unattainable, $NAV$ still played a significant role in this Crusade, through military campaigns and alliances with neighboring $christian_ADJ$ kingdoms

name: A $renaissance$ Realm
description: Though our realm originates in the mountain valleys of the Pyrenees, our people have been heavily influenced by humanistic ideas coming from both north and south. By embracing this new way of thinking, the people of $NAV$ are not abandoning their traditions, but merging them into their overall identity.

name: Fearless Seafarers
description: Our people have always looked to the sea with awe and fear, well aware of both the rewards and dangers to be found in its briny embrace. Our brave forefathers founded communities that would live not only by the sea but from it, developing impressive skills on the water. Sailors from our shores are well known all across the Atlantic Coast.

name: Always Ready
description: We were born as a small realm, encircled by formidable adversaries from every direction. This has profoundly influenced the development of our national character and our approach to engaging with the world. Consequently, we remain ever-watchful, poised to respond to the slightest indication of a threat.

name: Chartered Councils
description: Each historical territory will form a council, dependent on the ruler and elected by the locals, which will guarantee the respect of their traditional laws or #italic Fueros#!. This intermediate step will give us better and more efficient administrative power over our lands, without meddling in local interests.

name: People of the Sea
description: Our people are expert mariners, and all the world knows it. Our expertise will be an obvious advantage in maritime battles to come.

name: $basque$ Ferocity
description: Even before the Battle of $roncesvalles$, for which the $FRA_ADJ$ still weep, or the campaigns of the $NAV_ADJ$ Company, our people have always been considered ferocious fighters. We should never let our enemies forget it.

name: An Industrious Folk
description: The land we live in might not be the richest, but the $basque$ people are industrious individuals, working hard to obtain what they need. Be it by smelting $iron$ in our ironworks, converting wood from our forests into charcoal, or building the finest ships, our realm is bountiful thanks to the efforts and expertise of our community.

name: Mercantile Expansion
description: For centuries, our society has traded not only with our neighbors, but with faraway lands. This has had the effect not only of making our merchants particularly skilled in the art of trade, but has disseminated innovations from many nations farther and wider than they would have been able to otherwise.

name: $NAV_ADJ$ Defense Force
description: Over time, our neighbors have gained significant strength, posing an increasing threat to our nation's survival. To address this, we will establish a military department aimed at bolstering our forces with a higher number of soldiers without compromising on the quality of recruits.

name: Shipyards and Ironworks
description: The traditions of shipbuilding, steelmaking, and ironworking have been common activities in our lands for centuries. But as new techniques develop, we must obviously update our processes correspondingly. Even the most ancient traditions must embrace modernity in order to remain valuable in the modern world.

name: Adept Traders
description: The quality of our ships, the proficiency of our merchants, and the efficacy of our production processes have made our trade incredibly lucrative. The influx of wealth into our nation will make us stronger than ever before.

name: The National Military Academy
description: With the professionalization of our army, the necessity of a training center for our recruits becomes apparent. We will form a corps of experienced soldiers to teach the fundamentals of war and to forge our recruits into the spearhead of our army.

name: Royal $basque$ Society
description: #italic Euskalerriaren Adiskideen Elkartea#!, the Royal $basque$ Society of Friends of the Country, has been founded to encourage the development of $basque$ economy, culture, and science. It will benefit the country greatly in the coming years.

name: Efficient Bureaucracy
description: Our nation has maintained bureaucratic traditions since the realm's establishment, but changing times demand new approaches. $NAV$ has drawn particular admiration for pioneering certain administrative innovations.

name: Riflemen March
description: The introduction of rifles to our armies has required new approaches to military training and discipline. Our commanders have developed innovative marching formations that have become famous as proof of our military competence and focus.

name: $NED_ADJ$ Verlagssystem
description: For a long time, our land has been home to bustling towns and cities with a higher concentration of craftsmen than our neighbors. This focus has made us a highly productive nation.

name: The Four Quartiers
description: The Four Quartiers are the four provinces into which the core of $BRB$ is divided. Each quartier is formed by a satellite of large and smaller towns, some walled and others not. They all work in perfect synergy like a well-greased engine, filling our coffers with great riches.

name: $FLA_ADJ$ $cloth$
description: The $FLA_ADJ$ $cloth$ industry is the envy of the world. Merchants come from far away to sell their $wool$ in $FLA$, where we manufacture the best quality $cloth$.

name: Trading Traditions
description: Long before the counties south of us developed their own routes, our ancestors dominated coastal trade in $europe$, from the Baltic to Biscay. We must revive this ancient maritime expertise to reclaim our rightful position.

name: A Warring Spirit
description: Some may call us bellicose, but that is only because they fear our might. A well-trained standing army is essential for survival in this chaotic age. Our adversaries will soon learn to respect our hardened spirit.

name: Expert Ambassadors
description: Our rulers have always been skillful with their words, and their diplomatic acumen has established their influence far beyond our national borders. As time goes on and geopolitical pressures intensify, we must start cultivating friendship with other nations for protection while expanding our sphere of influence.

name: Hollander Sailors
description: A land of sands and flooded terrain, the people of $HOL$ have always looked at the sea as their natural second home, where bountiful resources and glorious adventures await those brave enough to pursue them.

name: Athens of the North
description: $liege$ has been a cultural center for centuries, the home of the most celebrated scholars in the region and the envy of our rivals. But we shall not allow ourselves to become complacent; we shall never stop improving our institutions.

name: Destined to Rule
description: The great Luxembourg dynasty, whose very name is derived from that of our nation, is now the most important family in $europe$. This has to be a sign from Heaven, and we will use this divine benediction to further extend our influence.

name: The City of Churches
description: $utrecht$, often called the #italic City of Churches#!, is home to the iconic Dom Tower. The spiritual center of $common_string_prefix_article$ $NED$ and the seat of the Bishopric of Utrecht, it has been a beacon of faith since antiquity.

name: A Dynamic Society
description: Our lands are a haven for the bold. Those looking to better their lives will find opportunity here, and we will in turn capitalize on the talents of these ambitious individuals to strengthen our nation.

name: $BRB_ADJ$ Rights
description: As other nations have, it is time to codify the liberties of our subjects, in order to identify and safeguard their rights and motivate them to continue working towards a better future for our country.

name: $FLA_ADJ$ $renaissance$
description: As one of the most prosperous regions on the continents, much of the wealth we have created naturally flows toward artistic patronage. $FLA_ADJ$ merchants commission master painters to create art that, while perhaps not practical, casts light over even the cloudiest of days. With dozens of our merchants actively hiring artists and commissioning new pieces, we are creating a distinctive $renaissance$ of our own.

name: Resisting the Invader
description: Surrounded as we are by enemies, our people are accustomed to aggressively defending their lands, fighting so fiercely that many would-be invaders turn tail and never return. Those who cannot escape us can take comfort in the thought that their blood shall nurture the $FRI$ soil.

name: A Healthy Economy
description: We have expanded our borders not only by the sword, but through careful financial planning, which allowed us to purchase influence over desirable territories — or to buy them outright. With continued wise budget management, this economic trend should be sustainable.

name: A Frontier March
description: As a border province of the $hre$, $HAI$ has developed a rough-and-ready spirit, born from centuries of frontier conflict. This spirit makes our people naturally inclined towards taking defensive action, which we can exploit to our benefit.

name: Maritime Warfare
description: As a maritime nation, our sailors are accustomed to naval combat, whether against members of rival nations or pirates attempting to plunder our trading vessels. In any case, our navy must be prepared to face any enemy at any time.

name: A Devoted Land
description: As part of one of the biggest dioceses in the area, there is no doubt as to the depth of devotion our people hold. We will show the world that our faith in God is as strong as our faith in our nation.

name: The Fortress of $europe$
description: The impregnable position of $LUX$, with the formation of the Bock acting as a natural fortress, is incredibly strong. Our enemies would perish in any attempt to usurp our holdings. We shall learn from nature, and construct all our fortresses so as to use the local terrain to their advantage.

name: A Blessed Land
description: The Pope himself influences the election of our Prince-Bishop, challenging the traditional five-chapter election format that we had before. This is clear proof that our land has been divinely blessed!

name: Early Urbanization
description: The Low Countries have traditionally had a high rate of urbanization, which has allowed us to achieve power beyond what most might expect. We should accelerate this trend by creating a robust network of prosperous settlements that can help us create a wealthier future.

name: A Land of Culture
description: With the foundation of the University of $leuven$, $BRB$ has placed itself firmly at the center of culture in $common_string_prefix_article$ $NED$. Students from all over $europe$ come to our lands to study and share their knowledge.

name: Prospering Agriculture
description: As our cloth, luxury goods, and financial industries face growing competition, it is becoming obvious that we need to manage our land use better. By creating regional granaries, we further diversify our economy, and bolster our food stores against famine or poor harvests.

name: The Legend of Grutte Pier
description: There are stories in our lands about a pirate who was seven feet tall and strong as an ox. These tales inspire many to take to the seas and do what our ancestors did best: loot unguarded coasts.

name: Expand the Kwarteers
description: As in the case of $BRB$, $GEL$ has traditionally been divided into four quarters. This system of provinces arranged around a strong central city has proven to be an efficient way to govern our nation, and we should apply this system to new regions that join our realm in the future.

name: Bustling Towns
description: Our lively urban settlements are full of potential. With just a little effort, we can make them and their hinterlands incredibly wealthy, allowing us to thoroughly tax them.

name: Trading Spirit
description: Our country is surrounded by the sea, so it is only natural that we would brave the roiling waves in search of trading ports and enriching goods to bring back.

name: An Inspiring Maecenas
description: Our nation inspires artists from across $europe$, who come here to create their masterworks. We will spare no expense to support these artists and attract new talent, establishing ourselves as a hub of arts and culture.

name: Heirs of John the Blind
description: John the Blind, the heroic King of $BOH$ and Count of $LUX$, was born in our humble realm. He died in the Battle of Crécy at fifty, having charged headlong into combat despite his blindness. His brave, honorable death will inspire our soldiers for centuries.

name: Skilled Diplomats
description: Given the growing influence of our neighbors, our nation's survival depends on our ability to find loyal, powerful allies who will support us in our times of need.

name: Dutch Education
description: While our people always enjoyed superior literacy rates at all levels of society, this advantage is becoming more apparent in the world taking shape before us. Only those with a limited understanding would not take advantage of and increase this edge.

name: Platoon Fire
description: Standard volley fire involved each rank delivering its volley in one go to maximize firepower. But we have developed a different system of firing by platoon, with the idea being that one part of the regiment would always be firing at the enemy while others reloaded and got ready for the next volley. This removed time between attacks that the enemy could use to recover or otherwise gain an advantage.

name: Dutch Art
description: The $NED$ have historically been at the forefront of technological and cultural advancements. We must continue to patronize inventors, artists, and writers to maintain our edge over other nations.

name: A Trading Hub
description: Our nation is blessed with a well-established hub of cities focused on trade, and adventurous sailors willing to bring riches from all over the world back home. These seafarers will be an excellent way for us to trade with other nations and make significant profits.

name: Concentration of Power
description: For too long, our nation has been unevenly governed by multiple #italic Stadtholders#! across different provinces, with the most powerful acting as #italic Primus inter Pares#! among their peers. It is time to make the position hereditary and concentrate authority in a single ruler.

name: A Fortified Border
description: Our borders are not well-defended by natural features, as is the case in some other nations. However, we have wit and wisdom in abundance, enough to construct the mightiest fortifications possible to deter our enemies and protect our families.

name: Seaborn Country
description: The $NOR_ADJ$ people have always chosen to traverse the country by boat, whenever it is convenient. This makes our people adept sailors, ready to man our navy whenever necessary.

name: Bountiful Seas
description: The $NOR_ADJ$ land cannot provide our people with enough food to sustain themselves. We will look to the sea to feed our people instead. Fortunately, the waters of the North Sea provide us with plenty of fishing grounds.

name: Natural Seamanship
description: With the growth of our fishing industry, we have also seen a corresponding expansion in the number of sailors in our realm. We should take advantage of this and recruit some of them to our navy, as seamanship is just as important as the ship itself.

name: The Call of our Forefathers
description: Long ago, our illustrious forefathers sailed forth and established colonies in the North. Our sagas even tell us that they reached a new world and established Vinland. We must follow in their footsteps.

name: Pioneer Spirit
description: In days gone by, our people would brave the high seas to establish colonies on distant shores. Let us rekindle this adventurous spirit in our people so that they sail forth again!

name: Military Shipbuilding
description: The expansion of our fishing industry has also led to an expansion in shipbuilding. We have a ready pool of trained shipwrights at hand to expand our own production process.

name: Write New Sagas
description:
Keen minds preserve knowledge
Known from ages past
Sung in the sundown
Sagas are our inheritance
Encouraged by the establishment
Each country will have its own

name: $NOR_ADJ$ Merchants
description: The ports of $NOR$ have long been a desirable destination for merchants from all around $europe$. It is time that we not only host foreign merchants in our ports, but benefit from the trades of northern $europe$ ourselves.

name: Birchbark Manuscripts
description: Writing and reading are fundamental pillars of our society. Religious texts, as well the details of our history, need to be written down so that future generations can learn of our cultural achievements. We have an abundant supply of birch trees in this nation, and their papery white bark will become our parchment.

name: $NOV$ First Chronicle
description: The #italic Novgorod First Chronicle#! details the history of our country, from the days of the legendary Varangian chieftain Rurik up to the present. It is a cultural heirloom that is proudly handed down from one generation to another.

name: The Ushkuyniks
description: The Viking-like #italic Ushkuynik#! pirates were once a useful tool to suppress our competitors. Unfortunately, we were forced to stop using them due to foreign intervention, mainly from Moscow. We should begin funding them again, and send these pirates to plunder farther shores — that will show everyone who the true masters of the North are!

name: Northern Center of Arts
description: $novgorod$ is an important cultural center in $europe$. Epic tales are told of our's literate and intellectual population, intricate religious art, and grand architecture, increasing the prestige of our flourishing city and indeed the whole nation.

name: City of Churches
description: There are over eighty $orthodox_ADJ$ churches in $novgorod$, and some are the largest landholders in the principality. Their wealth and religious prestige allows the Church to significantly influence the population in many areas, and our citizens are more pious as a result — in a good way.

name: Reforms of the Posadnichestvo
description: The #italic Posadnik#! is the highest administrative position in our towns and cities, and is a more significant role than that of a mayor. As their city grows, so do the responsibilities, influence, and number of Posadniks in the administration.

name: Novgorodian Fur Trade
description: $fur$, the silken gold of $RUS$! While other states gain their wealth from trading in $goods_gold$ and other rare metals, our source of income comes from the high-quality $fur$ the motherland provides us with.

name: Grand Duke's Army
description: Leading troops is the most important duty for the Grand Duke, who is appointed to rule over the Veche Republic. Under such strong and experienced leadership, our armies will become far more deadly in battle.

name: Baltic Shipyard
description: We shall build a grand shipyard on the eastern coast of the Baltic Sea, and dominate overseas trade!

name: Defenses of $NOV$
description: The Republic of $NOV$ is the target of many external threats. But be it the western heretics from $scandinavian_region$, the rampaging Germans to our southwest, or even other $RUS_ADJ$ powers to our south; they all shall all crumble at the feet of our unbreakable fortifications.

name: Heirs of Rollo
description: The legacy of Rollo, the Viking founder of $NRM$, continues to define our ruling house. Such a prestigious line has led to strengthened legitimacy and respect from our peers.

name: $NRM_ADJ$ Law
description: Our state is governed by its own customary legal code, the $couteume_de_normaundie$. By enshrining noble privilege, decentralized power, and property rights, this legal tradition ensures local stability while asserting our distinct identity.

name: Channel Trade Ports
description: Our position along the English Channel allows us to flourish as a commercial gateway. By investing in our port towns and merchant infrastructure, we can dominate regional trade while minimizing the cost of overseas operations.

name: The Exchequer
description: Our legislative body must remain distinct from any outside influences, in an effort to preserve our cultural identity and independence. Inspired by Anglo-Norman fiscal institutions, our parliamentary procedures will surely bolster crown revenue and improve administrative oversight.

name: Frontline of the Caroline War
description: During the long conflicts between $FRA$ and $ENG$, we stood as a strategic battleground. The pressures of war forged a hardened officer corps and traditions of battlefield excellence that endure to this day.

name: Gulf of $OMA$
description: Our nation is at the back of the ample and hostile deserts of $arabia_region$, but the sea to our east allows us to circumvent them. It is by sea, not by land, that we will need to perform our diplomacy, trade, and expansion.

name: Control of the Gulf
description: Our sailors are used to navigating far and wide upon the seas, but control of the gulf surrounding us is what allows such travels. We must always stand ready to defend our waters against any foreign threat.

name: Local Merchant Preference
description: Theoretically a merchant can be a citizen of the world, sailing to and from whichever port he pleases. We are going to give advantages to home merchants, for example, priority for loading and unloading of cargo, to ensure that our merchants have every incentive to bring their products home.

name: Association With Unbelievers
description: There are those who feel that we should not associate with unbelievers at all. We have done much to quash this, as only through association with heathen nations will we be able to trade with them.

name: Port Security Improvements
description: To reap the full financial potential from trade, we need ships and any cargo they carry to be safe when docked in our ports. We must ensure that any areas that merchants consort in are free from petty crime.

name: End of the Shipbuilding Guilds
description: As long as ships have been built in $arabia_region$, there have been guilds who control the production. Although they may have performed a valuable service in keeping shipbuilding traditions alive, they now stand in the way of progress. We must open up the shipbuilding industry to all with talent.

name: Skilled Captains
description: We must ensure that our captains meet the highest standards of seamanship and nautical knowledge, ensuring that they will be able to use every advantage in all situations.

name: Expansion of Trade Contacts
description: We must ensure that our merchants are always welcome wherever they go. Thus, we will use any means possible to make sure that all rulers we know about welcome our merchants.

name: Land Isolation
description: Despite not being an island, our land is factually isolated from the rest of $arabia_region$ due to the surrounding deserts. As such, we have learned how crucial it is to have access to the sea, and how useful it will be for us if we take that option away from our enemies.

name: A Vast Emporium
description: It has been said that $ORM$ is 'a vast emporium where there were peoples and goods of every description from all parts of the world' or that 'If all the world were a golden ring, $ORM$ would be the jewel in it'. Our realm's identity is inseparable from commerce. Indeed, ships from $gujarat_area$, $arabia_region$, and even $CHI$ anchor in our ports, exchanging spices, $gems$, $silk$, and stories.

name: $ORM$ Toll
description: At the narrowest point of the $persian_gulf$ stands $ORM$, the gatekeeper of east-west maritime trade. No vessel passes without our knowledge — or without paying our fee. For centuries, this toll has not just made us richer, but shaped our diplomacy and how we project power across the vast seas.

name: Gate of the $persian_gulf$
description: $ORM$ controls the strait that links the $indian_ocean_continent$ to the interior of $asia$. Whoever holds this vital passage dictates the rhythm of maritime traffic. Our command of these waters must be absolute, lest our influence be diminished.

name: Institutionalize the Moqarrariya
description: For generations, our realm maintained peace with the mainland through the ancient tribute system known as #italic Moqarrariya#!. Rather than depending on custom and negotiation, let us codify these tributes into formal pacts — securing fresh water, overland safety, and long-term stability through reliable diplomacy.

name: Invest in Qeshm and $ORM$
description: Though dry and rocky, the islands of Qeshm and $ORM$ have sustained urban life thanks to careful provisioning and rich trade. With proper investment, their ports and workshops can flourish further, turning them from logistical hubs into centers of innovation and productivity.

name: The $ORM_ADJ$ Navy
description: The $persian_gulf$ is crossed daily by our fleets — be they traders, patrols, or armed escorts. But to match the ambitions of those who envy our position, we must expand and modernize. Let $ORM$ become more than just a trading post: a maritime arsenal.

name: Mint of the Gulf
description: Ormuzi coinage circulates from $basra_al_hamra$ to $bengal_area$, trusted for its purity and weight. By institutionalizing our mint and expanding our issuance, we reinforce our financial sovereignty — and claim fiscal supremacy over the $indian_ocean_region$.

name: Kasztelanowie
description: Castellans represent the voice of the monarch across our domain. They are in charge of gathering taxes and enforcing the rule of law, and may even execute justice in the name of the Crown.

name: Land of Promise
description: The fertile lands of our domain are a coveted destination for many migrants, primarily those of lower status, seeking a better and more prosperous life.

name: Statute of Kalisz
description: Known as the General Charter of $judaism_ADJ$ Liberties, this legislation contains articles that allow all Jews in our realm the freedom to worship, trade, and travel. The statute also attempts to reduce the number of blood libel accusations against Jews propagated by the $catholic_ADJ$ Church.

name: Corona Regni Poloniae
description: This legislation establishes the kingdom as an indivisible, collective entity, owned not by any single dynasty or monarch but by the entire noble class. Rulers serve the realm, they do not #italic own#! it. This concept of collectivity is deeply entrenched in our society.

name: Grosz Krakowski
description: In an attempt to reform our monetary system, we will introduce a new currency, the #italic Kraków Grosz#!. Minted from silver, these coins are destined to challenge the power of the $BOH_ADJ$ #italic Prague Groschen#! and help establish our realm as pioneers of centralized taxation.

name: Stone and Brick
description: For centuries, we have used wood to build our towns and defenses, but we will now  systematically upgrade our infrastructure by replacing more vulnerable wooden structures with stronger ones. We have inherited wooden towns, but we shall leave them fortified with stone and brick.

name: Folwark System
description: The Folwark System was a system of production that emphasized creating agricultural surpluses. Peasants were encouraged to work through either the use of rents or through compulsion. This system formed the bedrock of our economy.

name: Council of Three Lands
description: Our country has a long-standing history of accepting destitute, persecuted $judaism_ADJ$ people. To that end, a council that will look after their needs and advocate for their rights will benefit the stability and spiritual strength of this realm.

name: $polish_group$ $renaissance$
description: Inspired by the ideals of the $ITA_ADJ$ $renaissance$, we are experiencing a cultural golden age. Our literary achievements, architectural splendors, and cultivated atmosphere of religious tolerance have all led to a blossoming of culture across our land.

name: Granary of $europe$
description: The fertile fields of our domain are home to $europe$'s richest grain crops, in part thanks to the $folwark_system$. Through our grace, we supply the markets beyond our borders, ensuring our people continue to prosper and never go hungry.

name: Winged Hussars
description: The hussars were originally light cavalry troops used for scouting, but with the decline of the old feudal army, we have switched over to professional regiments, the core of which shall be made up of these heavier, armored hussars. The fear of these winged warriors shall make our enemies tremble in the night like children!

name: Wojsko Komputowe
description: The 'Compute Army' was based around an annual budget calculated and approved by the Sejm. The idea behind this was to provide the Commonwealth with a stable standing army for defense.

name: Late Winged Hussars
description: The evolution of $POL_ADJ$ hussars entailed the adoption of heavier armor with red and white colors. They used a longer lance of around six meters, which made their charge incredibly devastating, often breaking the morale of their foes and causing them to rout.

name: Komisja Edukacji Narodowej
description: Our government's need for capable administrators has led to systematic education reform. We will establish the first education ministry in $europe$, devoted to spreading literacy throughout our population, which will hopefully lead to an increase in qualified candidates to staff our expanding administration.

name: Szkoła Rycerska
description: By establishing the 'Knight's School' to train noble youth in military science and their patriotic duty, we will forge generations of capable, dedicated military and civil personnel.

name: Great Sejm Reforms
description: If we are to survive and continue to prosper, our governmental mechanism must run efficiently and be based on robust foundations. The parliament shall adopt modernized procedures and strengthen its authority. The goals of this evolution are to curtail the power of the nobility and mitigate the escalating abuses of serfdom.

name: The Battle of $ourique$
description: In 1139, our brave troops defeated five Moorish kings in battle. This feat shall live on eternally in the memories of our soldiers, and they can use it as inspiration to defeat any enemy, no matter how powerful or well-armed they are.

name: Establishment of the $POR_ADJ$ Navy
description: King Dinis laid the foundations for the $POR_ADJ$ Navy when he appointed $GEN_ADJ$ merchant Manuel Pessanha, originally Pessagno, as admiral of the national fleet. Pessanha's missions were to defend $POR_ADJ$ shores from $muslim_ADJ$ pirate raids, and to create a powerful trade fleet.

name: Stimulate Rural Areas
description: Many places across our country, mainly in rural and remote regions, are becoming depopulated, with fields, forests, and mines falling into disuse. By reforming relevant aspects of our legal system, we will encourage people to remain in the countryside and restore its productivity.

name: Pursuing the Waves
description: It seems the land is not enough for part of our populace. Some people look at the sea and feel #italic saudade#!, as if it was a long-lost lover. The ports and docks bustle with eager sailors, all enrolling in expeditions as if they were drunk with a desire to explore the world. We will make great use of these eager seafarers.

name: Bombardeiros
description: Technological advancements have helped us develop much more powerful cannon, but most ships' decks cannot support their weight. By reinforcing our ships, we will be able to carry more munitions, and our navies will be feared for their awesome firepower.

name: Feitorias
description: Let us send forth our #italic feitors#! to all corners of the East, and establish our country as the dominant trading force in the $indian_ocean_region$. By creating a network of strong fortified trading posts along the coasts of $africa$ and $india$, we can dominate local trade without expending too many resources.

name: Ordenanças
description: Our nation needs a professional army to guard the sacred borders of our glorious nation. We will reform the conscription system and train our young recruits to fulfill that duty with honor.

name: Encourage the Bandeirantes
description: Sometimes, members of slave-raiding expeditions stumble across gold and other precious metals or stones. Spreading word of these valuable discoveries should pique the interest of hardy souls who might be willing to emigrate to our colonies in search of their fortunes.

name: Colonial Governors
description: By sending our most capable administrators to govern our colonies and outposts, we will ensure that these settlements remain peaceful and loyal to their mother nation, while we sit back and watch the profits roll in.

name: Royal Absolutism
description: For too long, our royal authority has been hindered by hapless meddling from the nobility, whose narrow local interests threaten the greater good of the realm. We will ignore the Cortes entirely, and rule without their interference.

name: Royal Academy of Fortification, Artillery, and Drawing
description: Our artillery corps and fortifications have long been the key to defending our land, making our small country a tougher nut to crack for enemy armies. We shall establish a military academy — the #italic Academia Real de Fortificação, Artilharia e Desenho#! — to train our officers in these fields, so that they, in turn, may fashion our forts and our artillery corps into the finest in the world!

name: Vinho do $porto$
description: On the banks of the Douro river, in the north of the country, grapes are cultivated to create a unique $wine$ fortified with spirits, which is famously known as #italic Port Wine#!. As we are the only nation producing this delightful intoxicant, we must not miss our chance to make scads of money from its export.

name: Capetian House of $ANJ$
description: A potent mix of Capetian dignity and Angevin ambition courses through our blood. Though we no longer wear the crown of Jerusalem, we remain heirs to a legacy of kingship that once stretched from $ANJ$ to $ALB$. With careful diplomacy and planning, we may yet revive the grandeur of our forefathers and claim what was unjustly taken from us.

name: Lords of the Rhône Corridor
description: The Rhône Valley has always been our artery of power, and our castles stand watch over it like sentinels of stone. These fortifications are some of the sturdiest in all of $europe$, a steadfast sign of our military and engineering prowess, forever watching over our domain.

name: Angevin Heraldry
description: The golden lilies and double-headed eagles of our banners speak to ancient rights and royal ambitions. Claims that stretch across $italy_region$, reaching as far as $ALB$ and $jerusalem$, still echo in our hearts. Let the House of Valois-Anjou rise higher than ever before!

name: Le Livre des Tournois
description: Penned by royalty, the 'Book of Tournaments' is more than a manual — it is a statement of courtly pride and chivalric identity. Our nobility trains not only for war but for spectacle, and in doing so preserves martial discipline and prestige across the realm.

name: Statutes of Aix
description: A series of loosely consolidated laws and statutes form the legal backbone of our governance. These statutes blend Roman jurisprudence with local customs and Angevin tradition, allowing us to manage a patchwork of regions as one cohesive domain: a true composite monarchy, where the parts are diverse, but the crown is indivisible.

name: Rade of $toulon$
description: $toulon$'s natural harbor offers the ideal staging ground for our naval ambitions. While $marseille$ thrives as our commercial jewel, $toulon$ shall be the armory of $PRO$, and the launching point of a future maritime power.

name: Piqûre de $marseille$
description: Across the workshops of $marseille$, artisans stitch delicate #italic boutis#! quilts in the $PRO_ADJ$ style — treasured across $europe$ for their quality and charm. Much like our duchy, works of art created in our realm are composed of many parts stitched into a unified whole: a quilted land, rich in texture and culture.

name: S.P.Q.R.
description: The Senate and the people of Rome are the eternal foundations of our state. By invoking this ancient authority, we remind all that Rome rules not merely by force of arms, but by the will of its citizens and its institutions.

name: Pax Romana
description: Peace under Rome does not mean the absence of war, but the triumph of order. Through enforcing our laws and building extensive road systems, as well as the might of our armies, we will bring stability and prosperity to every corner of the Empire.

name: Restore the Legions
description: The Legions were once the pride of Rome, feared and respected across the world. To restore them is to also revive the discipline, organization, and indomitable spirit that our great empire is built upon.

name: Revival of Arts and Culture
description: Rome was as much a center of culture as it was an Empire of conquest. By sponsoring poets, scholars, and architects, we will rekindle the creative flame that once illuminated the ancient world.

name: Novus Corpus Juris Civilis
description: Our jurists shall compile and refine our laws into a comprehensive body, drawing on the wisdom of Justinian and the Republic alike. In doing so, we will assure justice for all Roman citizens.

name: Panem et Circenses
description: The people must be kept happy and sated, for discontent breeds revolt. By putting grain on their tables and providing diverting activities such as games and public festivals, we shall win their loyalty and strengthen the state through their patriotism.

name: Roman Citizenship
description: Citizenship is the lifeblood of Rome, binding peoples of every province into a single political body. Extending these rights ensures integration and the promise of advancement for all who serve the empire.

name: All Roads Lead to Rome
description: The Roman road system is the envy of the world. It binds our empire together, speeding merchants, messengers, and soldiers alike, with all paths converging in the Eternal City.

name: Provincial Governors
description: Our more remote provinces cannot effectively be ruled from Rome only. By placing competent governors in the outlying regions, we will guarantee that our laws are followed and taxes paid promptly in even the most distant lands of the empire.

name: Imperium Sine Fine
description: Rome's destiny knows no bounds. From the Pillars of Hercules to the edges of the earth, we will expand our dominion without end, bringing civilization wherever the Imperial Eagle soars.

name: Roman Triumphs
description: A triumph is more than a mere procession. Indeed, it is the living memory of conquest, paraded through the streets of our greatest cities. Such ceremonies inspire loyalty, awe, fear, and ambition in equal measure.

name: Roman Architecture
description: From aqueducts to amphitheaters, Roman engineering leaves behind monuments that endure for centuries. Our mastery of stone and arch will show the entire world that Rome's greatness is eternal.

name: Unified $SCA$
description: The union of $DAN$, $NOR$, $SWE$, and $FIN$ under one crown has turned the North from a battleground of competing kings into a centralized power. With unified administration and increased cooperation among the estates, we can assert stronger control over the realm.

name: Legacy of the Kalmar Union
description: Though the Kalmar Union dissolved in conflict, it established a precedent for shared Nordic sovereignty. Drawing upon this legacy, we reaffirm our authority and remind our subjects that unity brings strength, not subjugation.

name: The Sound Toll
description: Control over the Øresund grants us the right to impose the Sound Toll on all foreign ships passing through the $DAN_ADJ$ straits. This ancient privilege turns geographic advantage into tangible wealth, strengthening our dominance over northern trade.

name: $NOR_ADJ$ Maritime Heritage
description: $NOR$'s rugged coastlines and maritime traditions have shaped a people skilled in seafaring, fishing, and navigation. The legacy of $NOR_ADJ$ fishermen and shipbuilders fuels our naval endeavors and bolsters the lifeblood of our coastal communities.

name: $DAN_ADJ$ Dockyard Legacy
description: $DAN$'s long naval traditions and its mastery of maritime logistics culminated in major dockyards like those in $kobenhavn$. As $SCA$, we inherit these powerful infrastructures and traditions, boosting our diplomatic standing and naval readiness.

name: $FIN_ADJ$ Frontier Cavalry
description: The $FIN_ADJ$ cavalry — #italic Hakkapeliitta#! — gained a fearsome reputation in wars in $europe$ These riders, raised in the wild forests and plains of $finland_area$, bring experience, adaptability, and toughness to our ranks.
