By formalizing their role, we will create a permanent elite force within our armies.

name: $SWE_ADJ$ Military Roots
description: From the disciplined Carolean ranks to the strong freeholding peasantry, $SWE$'s military prowess is an essential pillar of Scandinavia. By integrating $SWE_ADJ$ institutions and recruitment systems, we reinforce the manpower and strength of our empire.

name: $a_gallowglass$
description: $a_gallowglass_desc$

name: $a_reformed_gallowglass$
description: $a_reformed_gallowglass_desc$

name: $a_late_gallowglass$
description: $a_late_gallowglass_desc$

name: $SCO_ADJ$ Salmon Conservation
description: Our rivers and coastlines are rich in salmon. With careful attention and strict legislation, we will be able to harness this resource and shape our local economy towards export of this highly sought-after fish.

name: $SCO_ADJ$ Courage
description: Since the start of our war against $ENG_ADJ$ tyranny, we have preserved our independence through the valiant efforts of the courageous $SCO_ADJ$ people. The memory of brave men like William Wallace will motivate our armies to defend and protect $SCO_ADJ$ independence for all time!

name: $ENG_ADJ$-$SCO_ADJ$ Longbowmen
description: Now that our ties to $ENG$ have been strengthened, we shall incorporate some of their military tactics, refining our units into fearsome forces.

name: Peel Towers
description: Peel Towers were developed to mitigate the dangers of life in our borderlands. They serve as protection against incursions of hostile raiding parties, sheltering both people and valuable livestock, and are a fast way to alert neighboring towns of approaching hostile armies by being a high place to light signal fires.

name: Highland Tradition
description: The clans of the Highlands have always moved and fought differently from lowland armies. Raised among the glens, lochs, and steep braes of the north, our clansmen are naturally comfortable engaging in terrain that would exhaust and disorient outsiders. This intimate knowledge of the local landscape is passed down from father to son, and no foreign conqueror has ever truly mastered it.

name: Tenacious Land
description: War can be a long and tiring affair. If we are to defend our independence, we need to be prepared to endure hard times. Luckily, our people are as tenacious as the land they call their home, and resist foreign invaders to their last breaths.

name: $ENG_ADJ$ Administrators
description: Securing peace with our southern neighbor has led to a steady influx of $ENG_ADJ$ aristocrats entering our administration. This makes it possible to exert our control over our country more effectively.

name: $north_sea_area$ Trade Connections
description: Our country is situated at the far edge of $western_europe$ and is sparse in resources. If we are to thrive economically, we need to invest and expand our trade connections to further regions. The $north_sea_area$ can connect us to rich markets and business opportunities, provided we learn to harness its potential.

name: Comets?
description: We have recently received a rather curious new tome. It is called #italic On the True Significance of Comets against the Vanity of Astrologers#!, and it is positively filled with vital information on these highly suspicious entities. We have decreed that all in the realm should be aware of its contents.

name: Royal Scots Navy
description: Since the Wars of Independence, we have been looking at reinforcing and updating our navy. Previously, we had used feudal obligations to bulk out our fleets with crew and ships, but we will now create a modern fleet, owned by the King and based in our port of Newhaven.

name: Assert the Royal Revenue
description: If $SCO$ is to continue its independent existence, we must secure stable sources of income. By tightening our control over the obligations owed to us by royal estates and feudal properties, we can increase our rightfully received taxes. Through these methods, we can ensure the Crown has sufficient funds to enact their will without relying on other sources of money.

name: $SCO_ADJ$ Universities
description: Having sent our brightest scholars to be educated in foreign universities for many years, it is time to improve our domestic education, and provide a place here in $SCO$ where the greatest minds of our nation can learn and grow. Our people should strive to acquire valuable knowledge and skills in their home country rather than wasting their money on expensive travel and their time on foreign institutions.

name: Act of Revocation
description: It has long been the custom to gift parts of the Royal Domain to our nobility as a reward for their services, but this system cannot be sustained if we want to ensure the integrity of our domain. From now on, we will insist on renting these lands instead of outright giving them away.

name: Reliable Alliance
description: For centuries, we relied on diplomacy and contact with foreign powers on the continent to ensure our independence. It is time to formalize this practice, and secure the endurance of our bonds for centuries to come.

name: Establish Highlander Regiments
description: Recruiting regiments from the people who live in the $SCO_ADJ$ Highlands can be a crucial measure for our military efforts.

name: Scotch Whisky
description: While distilleries have existed in $SCO$ for a long time, we should ensure these industries are finally put under the purview of the state. This supervision will allow us to establish ourselves at the forefront of liquor production, and expand our exports industry.

name: $SCO_ADJ$ Enlightenment
description: Rapid advancements in philosophy, political economy, and medicine have led to a plethora of accomplishments by our fellow countrymen that will propel $SCO$ to the forefront of global innovation. This period of $SCO_ADJ$ Enlightenment can be a very powerful tool for us on the world stage.

name: Zadužbina
description: The Serbian elite and commoners alike are bound by the tradition of the #italic Zadužbina#! — the 'endowment for the soul'. This cultural drive to build stone churches and monasteries creates a permanent, physical landscape of Serbian presence across the Balkans. These buildings serve as more than religious centers; they are repositories of history, art, and literacy that define the Serbian 'living space'. This architectural obsession ensures that the Serbian culture is physically anchored to the land, providing a sense of permanence and historical continuity that inspires the people to defend their 'holy ground' at any cost.

name: A Sheep Surrounded by Wolves
description: We exist geographically wedged between the soaring ambitions of more powerful enemies. To survive this predatory encirclement, our lords have mastered the art of pitting our neighbors against each other, wherein we perpetually offer vassalage to the distant wolf to deter the one at our doorstep. By playing the Catholic West against the Orthodox East and the Bosnian Krstjani against both, we ensure that no single hegemon can fully digest our lands without triggering a massive intervention from their rivals. This culture of sophisticated political duplicity transforms our perceived weakness into a survival mechanism, as we grant trade concessions and military access to whichever power currently guarantees our internal autonomy, effectively keeping the greater wolves at each other's throats while we remain the undisturbed masters of the Neretva.

name: The $saxon$ Mining Privileges
description: The deliberate invitation of #italic Sasi#! miners from $upper_saxony_area$ and the Harz Mountains has fundamentally transformed our primitive surface pits into sophisticated industrial engines. By granting these Germanic experts their own autonomous courts, the right to follow their own mining codes, and religious freedom, we have successfully unlocked the vast, deep-seated silver and gold veins of $brskovo$ and $novo_brdo$. This influx of technical expertise provide us with the immense quantities of hard bullion necessary to hire the finest Western mercenaries, build monumental stone endowments, and mint the high-quality silver #italic Matapan#! imitations that have come to dominate Balkan trade and Mediterranean commerce.

name: Mimicking the Phoenix
description: We eagerly embrace the ways of $BYZ$, aiming to mirror their laws and overall style. Drawing from the rich tapestry of Roman influences, we strive to infuse our governance and legal system with their essence, in a conscious effort to emulate the grace and sophistication of $BYZ$ within our realm.

name: Župa Administrative Reform
description: Under previous rulers, the traditional Slavic #italic Župa#! (district) of Travunja was reorganized to better collect the #italic Soj#! (land tax). The ruler appointed #italic Kephale#! (heads) to oversee the Trebišnjica Valley, ensuring that the wealth from the fertile plains reached the central treasury. This proto-bureaucracy allowed our past rulers to fund their wars by squeezing wealth from the productive agricultural output of the hinterlands. We shall continue with this tradition.

name: Maritime Fiefdoms of the Adriatic
description: Our identity is forged at the violent meeting point of the high limestone mountain and the salt of the sea. By maintaining firm control over the strategic coastal towns of the coast, the lords of Zeta act as the indispensable maritime gateway for the entire Serbian interior, controlling the flow of salt, silk, and silver. We utilize the considerable wealth generated from Mediterranean trade and customs duties to fund our independent-minded mountain clans and build massive stone fortifications that guard the shoreline. This ensures that Zeta remains a maritime power in its own right, projecting influence far beyond the rugged cliffs of the hinterland.

name: Home of the Hussars
description: Although light cavalry formations are an old concept, the first Balkan hussars — or #italic gusars#! — appeared as auxiliary units of $BYZ$, recruited mainly from $BYZ_ADJ$-held $serbia_area$ in the 10th and 11th centuries. Even after $BYZ_ADJ$ power dwindled, this tradition remained, and was further refined over the following centuries.

name: The Kosača Iron Fist
description: Inspired by the Kosača dynasty, the Principality has started centralizing the military under a single dynastic banner, the state has moved away from fragmented feudal levies toward a professionalized core of heavy infantry and mercenary crossbowmen. This military consolidation allows us to defy our enemies, turning the rugged landscape of our lands into a power-broker in the southern Dinaric Alps.

name: Viteštvo
description: We will encourage #italic Viteštvo#!, a unique Serbian chivalric code, that will blend the heavy-armored traditions of the West with the stoic warrior-ethos of the East. This culture of knighthood will not be restricted to the highest nobility but trickle down into the lower classes of free soldiers. It will emphasize personal bravery, loyalty to the True Faith, and a specialized mastery of both the lance and the saber. This military culture will produce a population that is naturally predisposed to warfare, viewing military service as the highest form of social and spiritual achievement.

name: Rallying the Troops
description: Our realm has developed various methods for swiftly amassing troops, so no enemy can catch us unprepared. This edge has helped us stand tall, despite all odds being against us, and we are prepared for battle. United, we march forward, resolute in purpose and ready to defend our honor and homeland!

name: The Defensive Network of Klobuk
description: To counter the expansion of our enemies, the state will rebuild the fortress of Klobuk into a modern citadel. We will introduce a system of 'Signal Fires' across the #italic Popovo Polje#!, allowing the garrison at Trebinje to alert the entire hinterland of an invasion within hours. This will create a zone of control that will make the region impossible to bypass.

name: The Italian Condottieri
description: We have mastered the lucrative and dangerous art of the international mercenary contract. By providing elite Zetan mountain infantry and veteran sailors to the italians for their various overseas wars, we secure access to modern Western armaments, gunpowder, and a powerful naval ally in the Adriatic. This connection ensures that our realm's independence is protected by powerful friends, while we simultaneously maintain and sharpen our ancient warrior traditions at home. It provides us with a professional military edge that few other Balkan states can hope to match.

name: Serbian Epic Poetry
description: Serbian people have developed a 'living history' through epic poetry. The #italic Guslar#! — a wandering bard — is the primary guardian of the national soul. The #italic Guslar#! recites thousands of verses accompanied by the #italic gusle#!. These songs preserve genealogies, legal precedents, and moral imperatives. Serbian culture ensures that even the most illiterate shepherd has an understanding of ancestral rights and a shared identity. Every village gathering becomes a session of historical indoctrination.

name: The Viticulture of the Sunny Scree
description: The limestone-rich, sun-drenched slopes of the Herzegovinian valleys produce a distinct, high-sugar grape that is the envy of the Adriatic. By establishing a royal monopoly on the export of Žilavka and Blatina wines, we can create a luxury trade that bypasses the volatility of the grain markets. This 'Liquid Diplomacy' allows our court to maintain a lifestyle that rivals the Italian city-states, using high-end wine exports as a diplomatic lubricant to secure favorable treaties with the Republic of Venice and the Kingdom of Naples.

name: The Transcribers of Resava
description: In an era of conflict, the Serbian people turns to the pen to preserve what the sword can not. The #italic Resava School#! of orthography will standardize the Serbian-Slavonic language, creating a cultural 'republic of letters'. This obsession with linguistic purity and the preservation of chronicles will ensure that Serbian history is never lost to the fog of war. It creates a highly literate elite who acts as the memory of the nation, keeping the records of our dynasties alive in every monastery scriptorium from the Danube to the Adriatic.

name: Keepers of the Gate
description: $SER$'s rugged terrain has birthed a formidable network of defenses, epitomized by the imposing Smederevo Fortress. These enduring fortifications safeguard our nation, making invasion a daunting prospect. From the sprawling mountain ranges to the strategic river valleys, $SER$'s defenses stand as a testament to our resilience and indomitable spirit.

name: The Trebišnjica Bridges
description: Following the model of Roman engineering, the local lords will invest in massive stone bridges to ensure that the 'Silver Road' from the interior never closes during winter floods. This investment in infrastructure will allow for the year-round movement of heavy trade caravans between the mountains and the coastal towns.

name: The Retreat to the Karst
description: The coast may be temporarily lost to the shifting sands of imperial power, but the karst mountains remain our eternal and impregnable fortress. Our monastery-stronghold of Cetinje, nestled high in the Lovćen mountains where the air is thin and the slopes are steep, is the core of our nation. This city embodies a long-term national strategy of 'Mountain Isolation', where we deliberately trade the wealth and vulnerability of the ports for the absolute security of the high peaks. By entrenching ourselves in the rock, we effectively make the Zetan state impossible for any imperial power to fully annex or govern.

name: The Icon of Saint Sava
description: The cultural foundation of the Serbian people is defined by Saint Sava. By blending Byzantine spirituality with local Slavic customs and a fierce commitment to the Serbian language in liturgy, Sava created a national church that is inseparable from the people's identity. This cultural anchor resurfaces again among our people and ensures that all Serbians, whether nobles or peasants, view themselves as part of a distinct, sacred community that remains unified even when political borders shift or collapse, providing an internal stability that resists foreign cultural assimilation.

name: The Humite Chancery Records
description: To manage our state, we have centralized our administration into a mobile but highly organized Chancery. By maintaining precise records of land ownership, clan lineages, and tax obligations even during wartime, we prevent the social disintegration that often follows foreign occupation. This bureaucratic resilience ensures that the state can resume full operations the moment an invader is repelled, maintaining a clear and unbroken chain of command that stretches from the ruler's palace to the smallest mountain hamlet in the high karsts.

name: The Rebirth of the Patriarchate
description: Through incredible savvy and political maneuvering within the complex imperial administrative systems of our neighbors, we have successfully negotiated the restoration of our national Patriarchate. This diplomatic victory grants us spiritual and legal jurisdiction over all Serbian populations stretching from the Adriatic coast to the middle Danube, effectively allowing the Church to act as a 'Guardian of all Serbs'. It enables the maintenance of a shadow administration that collects tithes, manages local education, and keeps the flame of our traditions alive among a population that remains unified by a single, powerful faith.

name: The Morava Trade Guilds
description: We will issue royal charters to the guilds of the Morava Valley, and encourage the development of large-scale leather-working, weaving, and metal-finishing workshops along the river's transit points. By exempting these guilds from certain internal tolls in exchange for providing standardized equipment to the royal armies — such as saddlery for the cavalry and uniforms for the infantry — the state will create a self-sustaining domestic industry. This move will reduce the realm's dependence on expensive foreign imports from outside and create a prosperous, urban middle class that serves as a loyal counter-weight to the rural power of the nobility, significantly broadening the state's taxable economic base.

name: The Aqueducts of Popovo Polje
description: Utilizing the unique hydrology of the Trebišnjica river (the world's longest sinking river), the state will build a series of stone aqueducts and mills. This will allow for intensive agriculture even in the dry summer months, making the state self-sufficient in grain and able to withstand long maritime blockades.

name: The Vladika Sovereignty
description: As the secular noble dynasties fade under the pressure of continuous war, the Prince-Bishops (Vladikas) of Cetinje have taken up the heavy mantle of national leadership. This unique #italic Theocratic Monarchy#! unites spiritual authority and temporal power in a single, celibate office, effectively preventing the dangerous fragmentation of our lands among rival feudal heirs. It turns the struggle for mountain independence into a perpetual holy war that every clan member is religiously bound to fight. The #italic Vladika#! is not just a ruler; he is the living symbol of our resistance, ensuring that the cross and the sword are never separated in the defense of the #italic Black Mountain#!.

name: Seobe
description: The Serbian people have mastered the art of 'mobile identity'. This is characterized by the ability to move entire communities to new lands without losing cultural cohesion. This cultural mobility ensures that the 'Serbian Hearth' is not a fixed geographic point, but a portable and indestructible social contract; wherever the Serbian community strikes its staff, the old laws and the traditions of the #italic Slava#! are immediately re-established. This resilience makes the Serbian culture functionally impossible to decapitate, as the nation can abandon scorched valleys only to reappear as a fully formed, military society on a new frontier, waiting for the opportune moment to strike back at the heart of their ancestral lands.

name: The Ponor Storage System
description: We have mastered the climate-controlled secrets of the Trebišnjica river system, the world's longest losing stream. By utilizing the stable temperatures and dry upper galleries of the #italic ponors#! (sinkholes) during the summer, we have established a national network of subterranean granaries. This 'Hidden Reserve' ensures that our grain supplies are immune to the scorching Herzegovinian heat and, more importantly, invisible to the foraging parties of invading armies. While our enemies starve in a scorched valley, our forces remain well-fed by tapping into the earth's own cool depths, allowing us to maintain a high-morale standing army even during multi-year blockades.

name: Serbian National Militia
description: Drawing from the hard-won experience of our veteran units of the previous decades, we have established a permanent, professional standing National Militia. This force represents a decisive move away from the disorganized peasant levy, utilizing rigorous Western drill, uniform equipment, and a modernized chain of command while retaining the fierce, high-morale fighting style of our Balkan predecessors. This ensures that our independence is not a fragile diplomatic gift, but is instead backed by a credible, modern military machine that can defend our borders against any encroaching imperial power.

name: Foreign Relations Bureau
description: Our realm has recognized the importance of fostering friendly relations and alliances with neighboring countries. To facilitate this, we will establish a specialized bureau dedicated to foreign affairs. By maintaining a dedicated focus on diplomacy, we are better positioned to navigate the complex web of international relations and secure our nation's prosperity.

name: The Zudiosca Network
description: As the great Mediterranean wars intensify, the Travunjan state will leverage its unique relationship with the Jewish and Ragusan merchant families (the #italic Zudiosca#!) to build a sophisticated espionage ring. Because these traders move freely between the mountain interior and the Adriatic ports, they provide the Travunjan commanders with real-time troop movements of foreign armies. This 'Invisible Guard' will allow the local army to always strike at the enemy's weakest point, effectively nullifying the numbers of any invading power.

name: Guerillas of the Scrub
description: The #italic Gola Brda#! (Naked Hills) of the karst offer absolutely no cover for a traditional invading army, but they provide infinite hideouts and ambush points for our nimble warriors. We have developed a sophisticated tactical doctrine of 'Night-Raiding', where our clansmen descend silently from the peaks under the total cover of darkness to butcher enemy camps, spike their cannons, and vanish back into the mist before the first light of dawn. This psychological warfare ensures that any occupying force in the lowlands is driven to the brink of madness by constant fear and physical exhaustion, making our territory a nightmare they eventually choose to abandon, while adapting our armies to any hostile territory.

name: $SER_ADJ$ Enlightenment
description: Inspired by other nations of the Enlightenment, our national heroes, such as Dositej Obradović, have sought to elevate our vernacular language and literature. Touched by the dearth of secular works accessible to the common folk, Dositej Obradović has taken the lead in bridging the gap between written and spoken $serbian_dialect$. By diligently crafting grammar books and dictionaries, authoring new tomes, and translating foreign works, our nation is fostering a literary revival thanks to the work of these visionaries.

name: Modernized National Redoubt
description: Refining centuries of mountain warfare, we have implemented the 'National Redoubt' doctrine, where every major city and pass is integrated into a single, cohesive defensive plan. Using modern Western ballistics and cartography, we have pre-positioned batteries and supplies in hidden mountain caches. This doctrine ensures that even if the valleys are lost, the state can continue to function as a sovereign military entity from the high peaks, mocking any occupier with a permanent, active resistance that makes the cost of holding Hum prohibitively expensive for any empire.

name: Military Modernization
description: Our people remember the birth of our nation: surrounded by formidable powers that pose permanent, looming threats to our security. This enduring vigilance has forged a culture of unwavering readiness, ensuring our armed forces stand as a shield against adversity. Fearless and respected, our soldiers have transformed us from potential prey to a mighty adversary, deterring any who dare encroach upon our sovereignty.

name: The Šumadija Agrarian Revolution
description: The Serbian peasantry has led its own cultural-economic revolution by adopting agrarian techniques learned from the West. This has turned the dense forests of $sumadija_province$ into a highly productive agricultural heartland. This surplus of food does not just feed the people; it fuels a demographic explosion. A well-fed Serbian population is a growing and ambitious one, providing a massive pool of young, healthy recruits for the army and a robust internal market that makes Serbia the dominant economic engine of the Central Balkans.

name: The Constitution of Trebinje
description: The state will introduce a written constitution that will limit the power of the ruler and grant rights to the 'Assembly of Lords and Citizens'. This will be one of the first liberal documents in the Balkans, intended to prevent internal revolution and present Travunja as a 'Civilized State' to the great powers of Europe, ensuring our continued sovereignty.

name: The Code of the Black Mountain
description: To finally transition from a loose tribal federation to a modern, centralized state, we have introduced a rigorous and uncompromising new legal code that strictly suppresses the destructive tradition of blood feuds and centralizes the power of the #italic Vladika#!. By replacing ancient tribal law with a uniform system of state justice and taxation, we unify the competing clans into a single, cohesive national body. This reform turns the disparate and often chaotic energy of the mountains into a focused, disciplined national force capable of reclaiming our ancestral coastlines and expanding our borders with the efficiency of a modern European power.

name: Expansion of Sokoto
description: For too long the people of $west_africa$ have labored under rulers that, while professing to be righteous, indulged in syncretism. No more! Our flag shall always fly above that of worldly kingdoms!

name: Recruit the Faithful
description: Everyone who is ready to serve under our righteous leaders must be welcome, regardless of their heritage.

name: Learned Scholars
description: By encouraging the spread of literacy and scholarship among men and women alike, we can advance our society and further our hold over our lands. The family of our rulers must have a special place in these efforts, serving as an ideal to emulate.

name: Most Religious Court
description: Instead of displaying the worldly pomp of our rule, our court should focus on spiritual matters. By inviting learned religious figures to teach in our capital, we can show our true commitment to our faith.

name: Recruit $fulbe$ Commanders
description: The $fulbe$ people are distinguished warriors, serving as leaders in all corners of $west_africa$. We should establish ourselves as a permanent employer for their most capable commanders.

name: Unification in Faith
description: Our lands are home to many people of different cultures and languages. We must emphasize our faith as the unifying force, joining all people under one banner.

name: Diocese of $SMO$
description: Once a spiritual stronghold of $orthodox_ADJ$ $christian$ and home to one of the oldest bishoprics in the region, the Diocese of $SMO$ embodies our people's unshakable faith.

name: $SMO_ADJ$ Resolve
description: For centuries, $SMO$ has been a land carved up by outsiders — $LIT_ADJ$ dukes, $POL_ADJ$ kings, and $MOS_ADJ$ princes. To survive, we clung to what united us: our faith and our fortitude. If we are ever to rise again, we must cast off divisions and rally around the sacred idea that, above all, there is only $SMO$.

name: Link the Steppes Trade
description: Positioned between forest and steppe, $SMO$ has long been a crossroads of war and commerce. By improving overland infrastructure and securing the arteries of caravan travel, we can reforge our role as the vital hinge between northern Rus', the Baltic, and the southern trade routes of the steppes.

name: Hub of Militarism
description: Long has war defined our fate, but now it shall define our strength. From the ruinous embrace of warfare and siege, $SMO$ rises as a center of military production — cannons, firearms, powder and doctrine flow outward from our armories. Let the world see us not as a prize to be taken, but as a hammer to be feared, ready to strike the anvil of foreign conquerors.

name: The Armories of $SMO$
description: After decades of warfare on every border, we learned to fight with weapons of both east and west. Blending $MOS_ADJ$ grit with western precision, our armories now produce elite artillery and tactics unmatched by our rivals. From our forges comes firepower — and from firepower, domination and perseverance.

name: Stories of the $gao$ Empire
description: Before the $MAL_ADJ$ Empire came to dominate $west_africa$, the city of $gao$ was the capital of an empire in its own right. Although there are barely any written records of the $gao$ Empire, its legacy lives on in our oral traditions, inspiring all who want to achieve greatness one day.

name: $MAL_ADJ$ Military Tactics
description: During our time as subjects of $MAL$, our people learned much from their military command and combat tactics. This knowledge shall help our own infantry in battles to come.

name: $goods_gold$ to $salt$ Trade
description: Some say that $salt$ is worth its weight in $goods_gold$... perhaps it would be more accurate to say that $goods_gold$ is worth its weight in $salt$. Either way, by exchanging these two commodities, we have established thriving trade networks.

name: Independence from $MAL$
description: For many years, we were a subject of $MAL$. As $MAL$'s power has weakened, ours has grown, and we can now claim to be fully independent of $MAL_ADJ$ overlordship. Let us take steps to make sure we remain so.

name: $jihad$ Against the Pagans
description: Despite the best efforts of centuries of Sunni sultanates, $west_africa$ is still plagued by the menace of Animistic pagans. By lifting the banner of $jihad$, we can cleanse our lands of the unbelievers and expand our frontiers at the same time.

name: Sankoré Madrasah
description: We have been told that the Sankoré Mosque's school is the greatest center for learning in the entirety of $africa$. Who could be surprised if this were true, given how many wise men from distant $arabia_region$ and the $maghreb_region$ are here right now, arguing the finer points of philosophy and religion?

name: The Ḥajj
description: Like Mansa Mūsā of $MAL$ once did, our rulers can travel to $mecca$ on pilgrimage, fulfilling the fifth pillar of $muslim$ and bearing gold as a symbol of our wealth and power. Like the $MAL_ADJ$ pilgrims of old, the world will gasp in wonder at the wealth and grandeur of $SON$.

name: Sharī'ah
description: The Holy Law that the Prophet followed when ruling $medina$ should be the unshakable foundation of the laws we use to run our society. By reforming our criminal code to reflect the teachings of the Prophet, we will bring harmony and justice to our people.

name: Trans-Sahara Trade
description: Our traders frequently bring back fascinating things from the courts of $north_africa$. Perhaps they could find and bring back yet more fascinating trinkets?

name: Modernization of the Military
description: Our state lives and dies by the capabilities of our army. Our military not only ensures our survival, but is also what has set us on the path to greatness. We cannot allow ourselves to fall behind in progress!

name: School of $salamanca$
description: Based in the University of $salamanca$, the School's interests lie in fields as diverse as theology, economics, and political philosophy. As one of the leading schools of thought in the $catholic_ADJ$ world, its entrenched presence in $SPA$ ensures that our nation always remains at the forefront of intellectual affairs.

name: $SPA_ADJ$ Viceroyalties
description: New lands across the ocean are waiting for us to claim them. We will divide this territory and have each section ruled by representatives of our government, who will establish orderly settlements. The aim there is for our people to find these new lands an attractive destination, and will settle there and secure our presence.

name: Siglo de Oro
description: Our realm bustles with cultural and artistic achievements of all kinds. Should we channel that creativity to the proper places, feeding it when needed through wealthy benefactors, we will start a truly Golden Century of $SPA_ADJ$ art.

name: Revival of Ecclesiastical Discipline
description: Religious laxity has become widespread among our people, turning us away from God. We will sign treaties with our religious leaders to encourage a stronger bond between them and our government, and return to being a devout nation.

name: $SPA_ADJ$ Naval Reforms
description: We have not made our navy a priority, and as a result, we have fallen behind our competitors in terms of naval quality and performance. A reform is in order, which will re-elevate us to our rightful position of maritime supremacy.

name: $SPA_ADJ$ Enlightenment
description: Radical new ideas have permeated the minds of $SPA$'s leading figures, inspiring them to develop ambitious plans that will make us stand out among all the other nations of the world.

name: Sérén Taun
description: Held after the harvest, the #italic Sérén Taun#! festival is an annual thanksgiving ceremony celebrating agricultural abundance. Marked by rituals, offerings, and music, it strengthens the communal bonds of our #italic kampung-kampung#! and reminds all of the sacred balance between people, rice, and nature.

name: Pepper of the Parahyangan
description: The fertile volcanic soil of the Sundanese highlands is perfect for growing the prized spice, black pepper. Traders from across the world seek our peppercorns for their potency and aroma. We must capitalize on this natural treasure to expand our influence through spice.

name: Pan-Asian Trade
description: Sunda lies at the crossroads of great empires: $india$, $CHI$, and the Islamic world. By positioning ourselves as an indispensable node in this network, we secure access to goods, ideas, and partners across $asia$ turning our harbors into gateways of prosperity.

name: Extend the Kampung-Kampung
description: The foundation of $SUN_ADJ$ society lies in every #italic kampung#!, rural communities that dot the landscape. Investing in the infrastructure of these villages ensures sustainable growth, strong local leadership, and resilience against both famine and invasion.

name: Always Attack
description: Forming our marching troops into a #italic Svinfylking#! and charging is enough force to shatter any opponent! Mounted troops are not superior; other than being ridden to the battle itself, horses have no place on the battlefield.

name: Free Farmers
description: $SWE_ADJ$ peasants have always made significant contributions to our country; the differences between a noble and a free farmer have never been big.

name: Kung och Riksdag
description: $SWE_ADJ$ rulers often depended on cooperation with the estates, especially with such a large peasant class compared to that of the nobility. During the reign of Gustavus Adolphus, however, a historic compromise was made with the aristocrats, who loyally pledged their resources to the disposal of the nation in return for new privileges.

name: $SWE_ADJ$ Steel
description: While other armies may be content to wildly fire inaccurate volleys at their enemies, we shall march at them in disciplined ranks, deliver a single volley at close range, and then feed them cold steel.

name: Mulltimmer Masugn
description: $SWE_ADJ$ $iron$, prized for its purity and strength, supplies not only our domestic needs but also the foundries and armories of nations across the continent. The #italic Mulltimmer Masugn#! was not built just with stone, but also with wood isolated with sand, gravel and dirt.

name: Kungliga Postverket
description: The #italic Kungliga Postverket#!, or Royal Postal Agency, was created to improve state administration and communication across the expanse of $SWE$. It establishes a reliable network of couriers and waystations, and has become crucial for our military coordination, diplomacy, and governance.

name: Swedish Copper Coins
description: The abundance of copper in $SWE$, primarily from the Stora Kopparberget mine in Falun, has prompted the country to use it as the main metal for minting a new national currency, the #italic daler#!. This is issued as a large money plate, called #italic plåtmynt#!, which can weigh up to 20 kilograms. Some argue that this might not be very practical and that the volume of money in circulation could exceed copper reserves, but they seem narrow-minded.

name: Indelningsverket
description: The $SWE_ADJ$ allotment system divides the peasantry into groups of ten for recruitment purposes. This system made it easier to find people to serve in the army and organize them into units.

name: Hakkapeliitta
description: $FIN$ is considered a rather poor and backwards region, but service in the $SWE_ADJ$ cavalry offers skilled $FIN_ADJ$ horsemen ample opportunities for glory and plunder. Superior horsemanship and high-quality mounts allow us to raise the feared #italic Hakkapeliitta#! — cavalry so effective in battle that our enemies whisper they must be protected by witchcraft.

name: $a_caroleans$
description: $a_caroleans_desc$

name: $SWE_ADJ$ Absolutism
description: Absolutism is the theory that one person should be in charge, that this person is the monarch, and that said monarch shall run the government unfettered by the Privy Council.

name: Machina Nova
description: Christopher Polhem, dubbed the 'father of $SWE_ADJ$ engineering, has transformed $SWE_ADJ$ industry with his #italic Machina Nova#!, an innovative array of mechanical systems designed to streamline and boost production. Using intricate systems of gears, cams, and water power, Polhem has developed several machines capable of performing tasks previously done by hand, from ore-crushing in mines to textile weaving and sawmilling.

name: Produktplakatet
description: The decree forbids foreign ships arriving in $SWE$ to bring goods from countries other than their own or their colonies.

name: Crusader Discipline
description: Our grand order was forged in the flames and blood of the Third Crusade during the siege of $acre$ in 1191. While we originally nursed the sick and feeble, the order has transformed into a militarized group of knights of unbreakable devotion and discipline.

name: Teutonic Heavy Cavalry
description: There is no greater symbol of power and military prowess than the heavy cavalry. While for many states the cavalry is made of nobles, every Teutonic Knight is also a member of our heavy cavalry, and undergoes the strict training of a crusader.

name: Reformed Order Army
description: The $GER_ADJ$ knights, and veterans of the Crusades and other wars are simply not numerous enough to remain the base of our armies. We must reorganize the army to incorporate domestic levies, regiments capable of replacing the knights on the battlefield.

name: Peasant Recruitment
description: It has become clear to us that we can no longer rely on foreign volunteers to fill up our army ranks, no matter how experienced and valuable they might be. Instead, we will develop a system that would allow us to levy our subjects, both $GER_ADJ$ and non-$GER_ADJ$ folk alike.

name: Infantry Tactics
description: Contemporary battles in $europe$ have proven that the age of infantry is about to begin. It is now time to develop new tactics, adopt use of the pike, and reform our medieval concept of auxiliary infantry into the main fighting force of our future armies.

name: Teutonic Religious Authority
description: We will put an end to the loose religious autonomy local bishops hold within our realm. All religious matters, from taxation to converting the populace, will be state matters from now on.

name: Expanded Marches
description: Grant autonomy to the local governors of our border regions, and reform their holdings into marches. These special zones will pay fewer taxes to the state in return for an obligation to maintain the highest combat readiness during times of war as well as peace. This should provide us with substantial military flexibility at little cost.

name: $prussian$ Bishops
description: We shall grant further rights and privileges to our $prussian$ bishops, ensuring their loyalty in all matters.

name: One State, One Religion
description: Reserve all state offices only for those who follow our religion. Heretics and heathens are no longer welcome in our realm.

name: Absolute Order
description: All powers of the state are consolidated in our order. Every action taken and every decision made goes through the hierarchy of the Teutonic Order first before it gets executed. Of course, this bureaucracy is not in everyone's favor, but it ensures the absolute power of the #italic Hochmeister#!.

name: Sakya Hegemony
description: For the last century, the Sakya school has held temporal authority over $TIB$, acting as spiritual and political stewards under $MGE_ADJ$ patronage. Their dominance ushered in an age of centralized governance and scholastic consolidation. Though their rule has waned, their legacy continues to shape our approach to authority and order.

name: Monastic Dominance
description: A fusion of spiritual and temporal rule defines our political landscape. From the smallest village to the halls of power in Sakya, monastic institutions are central to every sphere of life. Their moral authority and organizational prowess ensure loyalty, unity, and cultural resilience.

name: The Yak
description: Domesticated for centuries, the yak is the backbone of $TIB_ADJ$ pastoral life. It provides meat, milk, wool, transport, and fuel — even its dried dung is a vital source of fuel on the treeless plateau. In times of need or celebration, yak butter fills our lamps and cups.

name: Drokpa
description: The Drokpa nomads often operate as herders and traders, porters that connect distant settlements. Through their traditions and unparalleled knowledge of the terrain, they traverse the high-altitude routes between $TIB$, Bhutan, Ladakh, and $NPL$. Their seasonal caravans carry $salt$, $wool$, and dried meat in exchange for grain and manufactured goods. These networks knit our mountains into a vibrant lattice of commerce and diplomacy.

name: Monastic Education System
description: Our monastic institutions have long served as centers of learning, debate, and spiritual discipline. Through rigorous training and a structured approach to education, our clerics maintain a high standard of intellectual and moral integrity. These foundations will support wise governance and cultural flourishing across our enlightened realm.

name: Tányuè Guānxì
description: For centuries, our spiritual influence in $CHI$ has formed the bedrock of our diplomatic relations. Imperial patronage, tribute exchanges, and sacred rituals like #italic Tányuè#! secure both respect and material gain.

name: The Three Great Seats
description: Sera, Ganden, and Drepung, these towering monastic universities form the intellectual heart of $TIB$. Their scholars train one generation after another of monks, diplomats, and rulers. With their rise, our realm became not only a bastion of faith but a cradle of rigorous thought and institutional progress.

name: $TIM_ADJ$ Cavalry
description: As the great $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ dominated the steppes with the power of his cavalry, so will we triumph through our incomparable horses. Bred for the most rigorous combat, and mounted by the best-trained soldiers in the world, our cavalry will instill fear in the hearts of our enemies.

name: $TIM_ADJ$ Architecture
description: The architecture of $persia_region$ has been the envy of the known world for centuries. We must promote a new form of architecture, one that surpasses anything seen before, so that we may claim our birthright as the master of this art.

name: The Mantle of the Great $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$
description: The death of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ created a power vacuum that led to people who should have known better vying to replace him. However, through strategic marriages, we have consolidated our claim to descent from the Great $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ himself, and the warriors of the steppes will declare their loyalty to us accordingly.

name: Turco-Persian Tradition
description: $IRA$ has always been the undeniable center of culture and language in the region, influencing the different $turkic_group$ peoples that have been around for centuries. We will embrace this blend of cultures to create our own unique tradition.

name: Tamerlane Chess
description: This new variety of chess, invented by our great eponymous founder, improves upon previous versions. Using it will help our generals to improve their strategic and tactical skills.

name: $karluk_language$ Literature
description: The $karluk_language$ language of the eastern steppes is far more worthy to carry the thoughts and ideas of our great lineage than $persian_language$ or $arabic_language$ ever could be. We must promote the use of our ancestral language, and create a new literary tradition.

name: Nambardar Levy
description: The $nambardar_levy$, or #italic čerig-i nambardar#!, refers to our troops that do not come from $mongolian_culture$ or $turkic_group$ origins, but instead come from the native $iranian_group$ population. Thanks to them, we can build larger armies than would have been possible before.

name: $TIM_ADJ$ $renaissance$
description: Ever since the initial $TIM_ADJ$ expansion, our realm has attracted the greatest artisans and wise men of the age. Through our continued patronage of art, science, and literature, we have made the cities of $herat$ and $samarkand$ the brightest jewels in the world.

name: Control of the Silk Road
description: As long as our merchants control the trade through the lands of $transoxiana_area$ and $samarkand$, the trade of the Silk Road shall flow unhindered and the wealth of our dynasty will continue to grow.

name: Reform the Dīwān
description: We are fortunate to be served by loyal and well-educated $farsi_culture$ administrators, who have perfected the art of governance for generations. Sadly, however, a hereditary office is one that over time might stagnate and lack innovation. By reducing the number of inherited offices with each generation, we can make sure that we reward not only loyalty, but also ability. Able administrators must rise to high positions regardless of which family they come from.

name: Conqueror's Legacy
description: Our glorious empire emerged from the legacy of great conquerors. It was the ferocity of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$'s troops that allowed him to conquer from $europe$ to $china$. As his successors, our troops will be as fearsome as the ones in his army.

name: Beacon of Maghrebi Trade
description: $TLE$ lies at the crossroads of Saharan caravans, Mediterranean commerce, and Andalusian eminence. As trade flourishes through its markets and ports, we must strive to continue expanding our merchant networks, asserting our influence over regional commerce.

name: $qalat_al_mashwar$
description: The fortified complex of $qalat_al_mashwar$ stands as both a military bastion and a symbol of dynastic authority. Having invested in its expansion, the defense of $TLE$ is strengthened while ensuring administrative control over the surrounding lands.

name: Hispano-Moresque Style
description: Our cities reflect a unique blend of Andalusian elegance and Maghrebi architecture. The Hispano-Moresque style, passed down from foreign artisans and nobles, inspires a new cultural flowering and elevates the prestige of our court.

name: City of Scholars
description: $TLE$ has long been a center of Islamic learning and intellectual exchange. Our madrasas attract scholars from across the $maghreb_region$ and Al-'Andalus, fostering scientific and theological progress for generations to come.

name: Entrepôt Connections
description: To thrive as a trade hub, our cities must be connected by solid infrastructure. By empowering the noble class to build and maintain strategic roads, we improve internal trade and strengthen the arteries of our realm.

name: Pōchtēcayōtl
description: Traders travel far afield, to provinces well beyond the reach of our authority, and even to the territories of our rivals. If these traders were to, perhaps, also serve as our eyes and ears, what secrets might we learn?

name: Warrior Societies
description: Our society is remarkably dynamic, offering commoners, also known as #italic mācēhualtin#!, the path to become #italic pīpiltin#!, or noble, by exceptional military service through the #italic tlahuiztli#! honor dress rank system. This unique opportunity for upward mobility grants our people a distinct advantage over those in neighboring societies.

name: Chinampas
description: Proficient in terracing hills for cultivation and skilled in crafting arable land on shallow lake portions through ingenious #italic chinampas#!, our populace's remarkable agricultural abilities will significantly benefit our society.

name: People of War
description: Whether we take up arms on a search for prestige, to instill fear in our foes, to take captives for sacrifice,  or simply to acquire wealth, our people are accustomed to a continuous state of warfare, enduring its hardships with more resilience than members of other nations.

name: Tlahtohcāyōtl
description: We will create a system of provinces for the city-states that are integrated into our realm in an effort to centralize our power.

name: Calpixcāyōtl
description: Our tributary regions will receive appointed tribute collectors, called #italic calpixqueh#!, who will be in charge of ensuring the flow of tribute never stops. There will be a #italic calpixqui#! in the region, and another in the capital of our nation, for each tributary state.

name: Reformed Tēlpōchcalli
description: As we face new enemies, new military tactics have to be developed or learned. This invaluable knowledge will be taught in our #italic Tēlpōchcalli#!.

name: $nahua_culture$ Domination
description: The superiority of $nahua_culture$ culture is very clear, as neighboring peoples increasingly adopt it as their own. This cultural diffusion and spread of influence creates opportunities for us to extend our political control well beyond our borders.

name: The Return of Quetzalcōātl
description: Contact with foreigners from other continents has given us interesting new ideas about our gods. The #italic Quetzalcōātl#! prophecy unveils a reality beyond myth — a glimpse of truth. #italic Quetzalcōātl#!, 'the Feathered Serpent', will soon return and herald a transformative era, vanquishing darkness for enlightenment. Symbolizing cosmic fusion, he will bridge matter and spirit, restoring balance and elevating human consciousness.

name: Brave as a Hummingbird
description: The hummingbird holds a crucial role in our mythology. Linked to the god of war, Huītzilōpōchtli, it embodies fallen warriors' reincarnation and is honored for its bravery. The hummingbird will be made a new symbol for our banners, one that will inspire our soldiers to fight unto their deaths!

name: New Trade Opportunities
description: The needs of our people have been adapting to the new markets that have opened to our traders, and we have been training our merchants in methods to maximize our earnings.

name: $AZT_ADJ$ Chargers
description: The aggressive nature of our warriors is known — and feared — beyond our borders. When battle starts, our enemies shiver in fear at the sight of our combatants charging at them with frenzy, as if they were about to be run down by the heralds of Death itself.

name: $TUN_ADJ$ Corsairs
description: From their strongholds in $TUN$ and La Goulette, our corsairs dominate the Mediterranean. With swift galleys and the power of state sponsorship behind them, they strike fear into foreign merchants and bolster our naval strength with ruthless efficiency.

name: Tamazight
description: The Berber-speaking people of the interior are a vital part of our society. By recognizing their cultural identity and fostering literacy, we expand our ability to govern diverse regions without losing cohesion or a firm hold on power.

name: Guardians of Ifrīqya
description: As successors to the ancient cities of Carthage and Kairouan, we bear the mantle of guardianship over the heart of the $maghreb_region$. Our rule brings stability, and shall be welcomed by all in a once-contested region.

name: Saharan Trade
description: From the oases of $ghadames$ to the caravans of the $sahel_region$, our merchants secure and collect revenue from the trans-Saharan routes that connect us to the riches of the interior. $goods_gold$, $salt$, and $slaves_goods$ flow northward under our protection and oversight.

name: Al-Qā'id
description: By appointing a loyal #italic Qā'id#! to oversee provinces and regulate trade on behalf of the state, we empower urban merchants while ensuring provincial governance. Ensuring fair dealings and regulated markets will greatly strengthen our economic base.

name: Connections with the $christian_ADJ$ World
description: Treaties and trade agreements with $christian_ADJ$ states ensure that diplomacy and pragmatism serve our long-term interests. Though our faith differs from theirs, we should not close the door to opportunity.

name: Attract Foreign Pirates
description: Our ports have long been a haven for those who seek fortune on the high seas. By welcoming these skilled seamen regardless of their faith or origins, we may further strengthen our corsair fleets and expand our maritime manpower.

name: Ra'īs of the Navy
description: Our corsair captains, the #italic Ra'īs#!, are more than just pirates. Truly, they are seasoned naval commanders, and their experience at sea feeds a deep well of maritime tradition that strengthens our navy's proud heritage.

name: Export Monopolies
description: By controlling key exports such as olive oil, textiles, and $dyes$, we ensure both domestic prosperity and leverage abroad. Such protectionist practices allow us to project power through commerce as much as conquest, ensuring our own merchants maintain dominance over foreigners in our markets.

name: Seljuk Heritage
description: To embrace the future, we must remember what we learned from $IRA$ and the Great Seljuks, and build a state that can unite disparate peoples and beliefs into a greater whole.

name: Turkic Traditions
description: We hail from the steppes. The wind, the hardships, and the thrill of battle will always be in our blood, and we must never forget them.

name: Ghazi
description: In keeping with steppe traditions, our nobles are warriors of the frontier, and we shall be fearless in the fight to expand the Abode of $muslim$.

name: Azeb Irregulars
description: Unmarried youths drafted from the poorest segments of society, the Azebs will not only function as soldiers and sailors, but also builders, sappers and armorers. Through a system of fortress garrisons, we will ensure that they always get paid.

name: Kanunnames
description: By establishing unique codes of law in each of our empire's provinces, we can ensure that our rule will be viewed as equitable and just. These law books, known as #italic Kanunname#!, will take into consideration the local circumstances and traditions of each of our diverse and far-flung provinces.

name: Timariots
description: By offering Timar land grants to Sipâhi cavalrymen, they can use this new state-sponsored wealth to supply themselves and their retinue. This allows us to field more formidable cavalry forces.

name: Bashi-bazouks
description: Unruly irregulars recruited from disenfranchised segments of the population, and sometimes outright vagabonds, the #italic bashi-bazouks#! provide an affordable way of garrisoning forts and outposts. With their proclivity for brigandage and wanton killing, they can always be relied upon to disturb the enemy's frontier.

name: Birûn
description: The #italic Birûn#!, or the Exterior Service, comprises the group of administrators, military officers and religious scholars just outside the ruler's personal inner circle. Together, they make up an efficient bureaucracy inherited from $IRA$ and the Great Seljuks, but adapted further by elements from $BYZ$, making it uniquely $TUR_ADJ$ indeed.

name: Autonomous Pashas
description: Balancing local needs versus national interests is one of the most difficult aspects of government. Given the slow pace of communications, it can take a long time for the most basic directives to reach even relatively close provinces. We must encourage local governors towards more autonomy to ensure that local interests are served in a timely manner.

name: Dragomans
description: Interpreters, translators, and guides in one, the $dragomans$ are skilled officials who work to enhance our diplomatic and commercial efforts with different communities and countries. Most dragomans are of $greek_culture$ ancestry, though some hail from $judaism_ADJ$, $armenian_culture$, or other multilingual backgrounds.

name: The Legal Code of Suleiman
description: Suleiman is remembered as one of the great rulers of history, a soldier, a lawmaker, and a reformer. In fact, while the West knows him as Suleiman the Magnificent, in his homeland, he is called 'The Lawgiver'. Central to his reforms was the re-examination of $TUR_ADJ$ dynastic law, #italic Kanun#!, in order to bring it in line with $sharia$.

name: Ahidnâme
description: Also called capitulations, the $ahdnames$ are contractual agreements with other nations, drawing upon both $muslim_ADJ$ and secular law. $ahdnames$ are most often used for guaranteeing the protection and rights of foreign merchants and clergy within our lands, ensuring that justice is upheld and trade can flow unhampered.

name: Kafes
description: By keeping our unruly princes confined to a special part of the harem, the $kafes$, we can prevent wanton rebellions and the rivalry between brothers that used to plague our regime.

name: Menzil
description: A complex system of supply depots and lodgings for use by soldiers and officials, #italic menzil#! waystations allow our armies to rely less on plunder, and remain well-supplied on every frontier.

name: Mālīye
description: A vast, diverse, and highly organized bureaucracy staffed by the most skilled of scribes, the $late_ottoman_bureaucracy$ aspires to be a fundamental and incorruptible institution of the state.

name: Muqāta'ah
description: A system of tax farming where nobles purchase the right to collect revenue from parcels of land owned by the state. $ottoman_tax_farming$ balances the distribution of wealth across the empire, and turns the nobility away from corruption, giving them a vested interest in supporting the state.

name: Tulip Period
description: We will reform old and stagnant traditions, plant tulips in all gardens, and usher in a new golden age of commerce and connection.

name: Imperial School of Naval Engineering
description: This new school, #italic Mühendishane-i Bahr-i Hümâyûn#!, will help us train shipwrights, naval officers, and sailors for both the navy and the merchant fleet.

name: Khedivates
description: Large empires are usually formed around a core territory, and otherwise surrounded by subject nations of somewhat dubious loyalty. We should take the necessary measures to keep these nations under our surveillance.

name: Âyan
description: $ayans$ are provincial magnates of diverse backgrounds that wield significant local autonomy, but still provide a ready source of tax farming income and military forces for the state.

name: Janissaries
description: Janissaries are the elite units of our armies, trained since childhood and forged through discipline.

name: $a_renaissance_janissaries$
description: $a_renaissance_janissaries_desc$

name: $a_discovery_janissaries$
description: $a_discovery_janissaries_desc$

name: $a_reformation_janissaries$
description: $a_reformation_janissaries_desc$

name: $a_absolutism_janissaries$
description: $a_absolutism_janissaries_desc$

name: $a_revolutions_janissaries$
description: $a_revolutions_janissaries_desc$

name: Il Contado
description: The #italic Contado#! — the ring of rural territory surrounding each of our cities — has long been the foundation of Tuscan wealth and power, its villages, castles, and farmlands bound by law and custom to answer to the urban lord within the walls. By formalizing our jurisdiction over the countryside, we transform scattered feudal obligations into a coherent system of agricultural surplus, military manpower, and direct revenue. This mastery of the contado anchors our legitimacy among the landed classes and extends our reach into every corner of the land we claim to rule.

name: Il Catasto Fiorentino
description: We shall commission the #italic Catasto#! — the most comprehensive survey of wealth and property undertaken by any government in medieval Europe, mapping the taxable assets of every citizen and household from the wealthiest merchant to the humblest artisan. By laying bare the full extent of our fiscal base, the Catasto allows us to distribute the burden of taxation with unprecedented fairness, replacing the factional manipulation of the old system with transparent and enforceable assessments. This reform earns the trust of our subjects, eases the cost of governing, and establishes a standard of administrative precision that future rulers of Tuscany will build upon.

name: Porto Franco
description: In declaring Livorno a #italic Porto Franco#!, we open our harbor to merchants of every faith and nation — Armenians, Jews, Greeks, and Flemings all welcomed without the religious conditions that other Mediterranean ports impose. This freedom draws skilled traders and financiers whose settlement enriches our city and swells our trade routes with goods that more closed ports cannot handle. This cosmopolitan harbor transforms Livorno from a modest fishing village into one of the most dynamic commercial ports in the western Mediterranean, drawing population and capital to our shores.

name: Uffizi
description: Our commissioning of the #italic Uffizi#! as the administrative heart of our new Grand Duchy creates not merely a seat of government, but a stage for our power — its long corridor soon to be lined with antiquities, sculptures, and canvases that announce our ruler's dynasty's mastery of both statecraft and beauty. Across the city, we are establishing a secret workshop in the Palazzo Vecchio, where alchemists and craftsmen perfect a soft-paste porcelain — the first produced in Europe, rivalling the precious wares imported at great expense from China. These twin achievements of administration and artisanal ambition mark the apex of our patronage, announcing to every court in Christendom that Tuscany under the Grand Dukes is as much a center of refinement as of power.

name: Accademia del Cimento
description: Our Grand Duke has established the #italic Accademia del Cimento#! — the Academy of Experiment — gathering the finest scientific minds of the age under a single roof devoted to empirical inquiry, its members bound by the motto #italic Provando e Riprovando#! — testing and retesting — that sets a new standard for the pursuit of knowledge. At the same time, the Grand Duchy is reshaping the municipalities of Tuscany, replacing the patchwork of local privileges with uniform administrative procedures that make the state's authority felt in every town and valley. This combination of scientific ambition and administrative rigor defines our duchy as a state where both ideas and governance are held to the same exacting standard of proof.

name: $TUS_ADJ$ Physiocratic Reforms
description: Our ruler governs Tuscany by the principles of the #italic Physiocrates#!, which state that land and agriculture are the true sources of all wealth. We will abolish serfdom and guild monopolies, work to free the grain trade from state controls, and will be reorganizing taxation around soil productivity rather than the privileges of merchants and nobles. This same spirit of rational governance is restructuring our commercial culture, dismantling the internal barriers that previously restricted the movement of goods and opening our markets to trade that guild charters had long excluded. This comprehensive reform of land and commerce is transforming Tuscany into a model of Enlightened administration, an experiment in rational governance that observers across Europe come to study and imitate.

name: Unified Legal Code
description: The territories which constitute our land have suffered revolts due to unjust applications of laws. In order to prevent these occurrences in the future, we should standardize our legal code and ensure our laws are applied fairly. This will surely prevent any uprising from spiraling into chaos.

name: Loyalty of the Noble Families
description: The Noble Families of both Sicilies exert much power in our stead. By granting them prestigious yet meaningless roles at court, we will ensure their loyalty and guarantee stable rule over our countryside.

name: Attract new People
description: Previous rulers put too much focus on particular areas of our country. If we want to retain control of both Sicilies, we will have to invest equally and fairly in both parts. One step towards this goal is attracting people to settle in previously neglected areas.

name: Overseas Ambitions
description: Expanding our territories within Italy is a difficult task, navigating a treacherous web of alliances and risking the anger of the Pope himself. Therefore, we should look overseas, where potential riches await us in the lands of northern Africa and Greece.

name: Capable Vicars
description: A particular struggle of our unified country is governing both sides of the Strait of Messina. Since our ruler can only be present on one side at a time, the other will have to be given to a vicar, ruling in our name. We must be sure to appoint only the most capable and trustworthy people to this vital role to prevent corruption.

name: Increase Maritime Patrols
description: Our coastline is vast, and vulnerable to raids by pirates hunting for slaves. We need to establish a navy to patrol, protect, and eventually defeat this vile threat to our people.

name: Mayflower Compact
description: Bound together by shared peril and purpose, the early settlers drafted a pact of self-governance. Even in the wilderness, the seeds of society and compromise found soil.

name: Empowered Assemblies
description: Elected assemblies emerged throughout the colonies, empowering landowners to govern themselves. The humble origins of liberty lie in the halls of these institutions.

name: Great Awakening
description: A wave of religious revival sweeps the land, challenging old authorities and stirring the moral conscience of a rising people.

name: Declaration of Independence
description:
#italic We hold these truths to be self-evident, that all men are created equal.#!

With this bold declaration, we shall break the chains of subjugation, and embraced our shared destiny!

name: Bill of Rights
description: #italic ...or abridging the freedom of speech, or of the press; or the right of the people peaceably to assemble, and to petition the Government for a redress of grievances.#!

name: Recognized Sovereignty
description: Treaties and diplomacy affirmed what our struggles have earned. Our place on the stage of diplomacy is no longer questioned, but respected.

name: Era of Good Feelings
description: In the wake of hardship, peace and unity have brought a rare moment of national harmony. The people flourish with optimism and order.

name: City of Victory
description: $vijayanagar$ — the 'City of Victory' — is the heart of our state, and will one day become the heart of the entire $hindu_ADJ$. Let it shine as a beacon of culture and tradition even as it fends off the $muslim_ADJ$ invaders!

name: An Army for the City of Victory
description: For the City of Victory to be worthy of its name, we must have an army that can bring about these namesake triumphs. We will ensure our troops are well-trained and take great pride in their service.

name: Arabian Horses
description: Horses from $arabia_region$ are far superior to our local breeds. We will use our trade connections to ensure that we have a steady supply for our military.

name: First Indian Artillery
description: The military application of gunpowder is not yet widespread, but it has the potential to mold the future of warfare. We must explore the utility and benefits of gunpowder.

name: The Bunds
description: Our society is built on agriculture in the rather arid $karnakassala_area$ area. The #italic bunds#!, also called #italic anecut#!, provide our cities and fields alike with much-needed fresh water.

name: Adroit Diplomacy
description: The numerous invaders of our $hindu_ADJ$ people have shown time and time again the same weakness: the tendency to fight amongst themselves. We must be ready at all times to exploit this to our own ends.

name: Promotion of Trade
description: Our territory is situated on one of the key trade routes from East to West. We must ensure that our ports are safe and secure so that visiting captains will land there... giving us the opportunity to tax them.

name: Carnatic Music
description: We must resist the $muslim_ADJ$ invasion on all fronts. The musical traditions of the Northern States are already showing signs of foreign influence. This is blasphemy, because we all know that music is a divine art form that originated with the Devas and Devis themselves. We will show the $hindu_ADJ$ people that we are committed to defending this holy art form.

name: Cultural Integration
description: The cultural diversity of $india$ is one of our defining traits. By allowing our various settlements to rule by their own customs, we will assure their loyalty and integration into our society.

name: Rule According to Dharma
description: #Italic Dharma#! is a major pillar of our religious and social values. Our state can only be just and virtuous if our rulers themselves embody and live in accord with dharma.

name: Harsh Penal Code
description: Harsh punishments — including being put to death — are how we uphold law and order in this society. By establishing and strictly enforcing a harsh penal code, we ensure criminals fear the consequences of their actions, creating stability through the certainty of punishment.

name: Decentralized Rule
description: As our state grows, so do our administrative burdens on the government and the risk of revolt. To counteract this, we shall establish a system of decentralized rule, where settlements can manage their own minor issues, only seeking intervention from the central court for severe matters.

name: Indian Throne
description: $india$ has been subject to $muslim_ADJ$ threats for far too long. Heathen empires claim their rule from $delhi$ in the north, yet their beliefs and government are in direct opposition to what our people want. No, a new seat of power must be established — and $vijayanagar$ shall be the new Throne of $india$!

name: Arabia Felix
description: Ever since antiquity, $YEM$ has been known as 'Arabia Felix', the Fortunate Arabia. Blessed with a temperate highland climate and fertile soil in a sea of desert, it remains one of the most naturally prosperous regions of the peninsula. Let us nurture that prosperity and use it as the foundation of a thriving realm.

name: Coffea Arabica
description: Though others have attempted to transplant our beloved bean, the $coffee$ of $arabia_region$ remains unmatched in flavor and fame. From the bustling port of Mocha to the courts of faraway rulers, the world's desire for our drink is insatiable.

name: $zaidi_school$ Scholarly Traditions
description: The highlands of $YEM$ have long been home to the $zaidi_school$ imamate, a center of learning and piety. Rooted in Islamic jurisprudence, theology, and rationalism, our scholars have ensured the rule of law and the moral integrity of our governance for centuries.

name: $rasulid_dynasty$ Bureaucracy
description: The $rasulid_dynasty$ dynasty brought unprecedented administrative order to our lands. With census records, tax systems, and a robust cabinet structure, they transformed Yemen into one of the most efficiently governed realms in the region.

name: Red Sea Control
description: Any and all trade from $india$ and $africa$ must pass through the strait called Gate of Grief. Let us enforce our dominion over this maritime chokepoint and turn every passing ship into an opportunity.

name: Unite the $YEM_ADJ$ Tribes
description: From the Tihāmah coast to the Ḥarāz mountains, our realm is home to countless fiercely independent tribes. While they have long resisted centralized authority, they are also our strength. By uniting them under a single cause, we can better utilize them as a workforce.

name: Port of Aden
description: The port of Aden has been a nexus of trade for millennia — its natural harbor welcoming ships from $india$, $egypt_region$, and $east_africa$. If properly supported, it can once again become the cornerstone of our maritime economy and the pride of the Red Sea.

name: Palm Tree Masters
description: We may not have a very robust manufacturing industry, but one thing we do have in abundance are palm trees. Sturdy enough to support construction and shipwrighting, but flexible enough to be shaped by our artisans, mastering the use of this unique lumber will help us expand our seafaring activities, improve production, and ultimately line our pockets.

name: $bantu_language_family$ and Perso-Arabian
description: Ever since our descent from $arabia_region$ and $persia_region$, we have established communities across the $swahili_coast_region$ that integrate the local $bantu_language_family$ in an effort to maintain social order and make way for the rise of new architectural and cultural advances.

name: $ZAN_ADJ$ Trade Networks
description: Attracting merchants from as far away as $persia_region$ and $arabia_region$, our capital has become a bustling commercial hub, facilitating business from the horn of $africa$ all the way to the shores of $china$.

name: $n_kilwan_dhow$
description: $n_kilwan_dhow_desc$

name: $n_kilwan_zambuc$
description: $n_kilwan_zambuc_desc$

name: Zanj Taxation
description: Originally a term to describe the inhabitants of inner $africa$, particularly those of $bantu_language_family$ origin, these folk make up a substantial portion of our demographics. While they have many liberties and responsibilities, they are taxed accordingly in order to preserve these privileges. Their peaceful, relatively autonomous  place within our legal framework has led to the organic development of linguistic phenomena and new cultural traditions.

name: Food Imports
description: The dawn of a new age in seafaring has given us new opportunities to seek sustenance for our people. Whereas once we would only trade with the interior of $africa$ to procure crucial supplies of $millet$, $livestock$, and $rice$, we can now access new ports where food may be cheaper and more readily available.

name: Latitude Staves
description: Our superior ship technology allows us to sail further and for longer than any of our competitors, giving us a significant edge in any seafaring activity.

name: Shirazi's Legacy
description: Our ancestral founder came from $shiraz$, son of the 'Amīr of $persia_region$, which makes our right to rule undeniable.

name: $goods_gold$ Trade of $africa$
description: Our abundant reserve of $goods_gold$ from many sources across $east_africa$ is the cornerstone of our economy. We must take full advantage of our reserves, and use our wealth to support and disseminate a strong currency. This will help us develop as a trading hub.

name: Diplomacy Through Trade
description: We are uniquely positioned at the confluence of wealth coming from $china$, $india$, and $europe$. This not only benefits us financially, but it gives us great influence in the diplomatic game between Empires and foreign powers...

name: Prestigious Cavalry
description: Whether on horseback or atop an elephant, we can boast of an impressive cavalry, usually made up of descendants from the most prestigious families. Their contributions through supporting our infantry are invaluable.

name: White Elephant
description: The white elephant symbolizes sacred kingship in $buddhist$ tradition, and is also the emblem of our ruler. Possessing a white elephant legitimizes our authority, proving to our subjects that we rule with the blessing of the divine.

name: $AYU_ADJ$ Literature
description: Our country has a rich and complex literary tradition, from the epic #italic Lilit#! poems narrating famous military conflicts, to the #italic Nirat#! poetry of travels and lost lovers; from folk legend of local heroes to panegyrics praising the feats of our most glorious rulers.

name: Phrai Luang
description: All freemen subject to #italic phrai#! service not only serve in war — the #italic $ayu_phrai_thaan$#! — but also assist in the construction of public works, at the discretion of local governors.

name: Phrai Thaan
description: All males at the age of eighteen are to be registered with the military, and their information passed on to the government bureaucracy. Every male citizen is eligible to be conscripted and made to serve in the army in war, and we will make sure that they do so if needed.

name: Floating Rice
description: Rice has been grown in our country for centuries, but the constant flooding of our rivers has always been an issue for its proper cultivation. This new variety of rice, used to growing in flooded conditions, will provide us with a stable source of food even when the rivers overflow.

name: Sakdina
description: Our society is strictly organized along the $ayu_sakdina$ system. Each person knows their proper place in society and how much wealth and property they are entitled to have. This organization makes it much more efficient to extract taxes from them.

name: Cosmopolitan Trade
description: Our country is home to many people from afar, who came here hoping to profit from the richness of our land. Having so many people and goods flowing through our borders is something we derive numerous benefits from.

name: Stećci of $bosnia_area$
