description: Our people practice unique customs that transcend religious differences. The construction of #italic stećci#!, elaborately decorated tombstones, is a tradition shared by all of us, regardless of faith. These distinctive monuments mark our lands as uniquely Bosnian.

name: Many Churches of $BOS$
description: $BOS$ is home to several faiths. Not only is our land shared between the $orthodox_ADJ$ and $catholic_ADJ$ Churches, but it is also home to the $south_slavic_group$ $christian_ADJ$ faithful, the #italic Krstjani#!. Isolated from central supervision, we will have to foster a local understanding and harmony between these different groups to maintain our stability.

name: Vlach Katuns
description: Parts of our population are organized into self-governing, pastoralist communities. Instead of bending them to a central government's will, we should cooperate with them, and in doing so try to extract more resources from our more remote areas.

name: Stanak Meetings
description: Our nobility regularly gathers together to discuss the most pressing issues for our country. These meetings ensure our noble lords are aligned in their policies and show unity during our parliament sessions.

name: Defiant Terrain
description: $bosnia_area$ is a land of forested hills and mountains, cut through by river valleys. This terrain lends itself naturally to delaying and tiring invading armies, and we should use this to our advantage. Engaging our enemy only when it benefits us and letting the hostile terrain itself claim both their supplies and troops will preserve our strength.

name: Kingly Ambitions
description: The achievements and hard work of our people deserve recognition and protection. We will establish a prestigious title for ourselves and thereby secure that recognition from neighboring rulers, formalizing our status through diplomatic bonds.

name: Bosančica
description: The Bosnian people have unified around #italic Bosančica#!, a unique, cursive Cyrillic script used for everything from diplomatic treaties to private merchant ledgers. This national script serves as a powerful cultural gatekeeper; it is difficult for foreigners to read but universal among the Bosnian literate class, regardless of their specific confession. By maintaining this distinct script, the people ensure that their legal and historical records remain a 'closed book' to imperial administrators, preserving the secret nuances of Bosnian property law and lineage in a format that reinforces their unique Slavic heritage.

name: The Srebrenica Mint Office
description: As the mines of $srebrenica$ become the premier source of bullion in the Balkans, the realm has moved beyond the mere export of raw ore. We have established a Royal Mint and an Assay Office to regulate the purity of Bosnian silver, producing a coin which rivals those of Venice in reliability. By mandating that all silver extracted by Ragusan or Saxon miners be processed through state-controlled refineries, we capture a massive share of the value-added profit. This liquid wealth allows us to make Bosnia the most financially solvent power in the Dinaric Alps.

name: People from the Hills
description: The geography of the Bosnian heartland is a vertical maze of limestone ridges and valleys that defy conventional mapping. Our people have adapted to this logic, mastering the secrets of the subterranean cavern networks and the logistics of the mule-train.

name: Bosnian Ljekaruše
description: In the secluded valleys of our nation, monks of our monasteries have compiled the #italic Ljekaruše#! — extensive medicinal codices written in the native #italic Bosančica#! script. By synthesizing ancient Greco-Byzantine theory with the high-altitude herbalism of the Dinaric Alps, these manuals provide a sophisticated system of community healthcare in an era where professional physicians are a rarity. This mastery of folk-medicine and surgery ensures our population remains resilient against the plagues that devastate the lowlands, fostering a cultural identity defined by intellectual self-reliance and the preservation of Slavic scientific knowledge.

name: Susjedstvo of Bosnia
description: The ancient cultural concept of #italic Susjedstvo#! — the sacred social obligation to protect and honor one's neighbor — has evolved into a sophisticated civic philosophy that transcends religious divides. In the face of external pressures, this unwritten code mandates that a neighbor's safety and property are as sacred as one's own. This practice prevents the 'Divide and Rule' tactics often used by foreign powers to incite internal strife. By prioritizing local solidarity and the 'Law of the Neighborhood', we maintain a level of social harmony and internal stability that allows the nation to present a single, unbreakable front against any attempt to dismantle our shared homeland.

name: The Filigree Guilds
description: Drawing on the inexhaustible silver veins of the central mountains, our urban craftsmen have perfected the art of Filigran — intricate silver wire-work that has become the hallmark of Bosnian luxury. These guilds operate as a powerful economic estate, exporting ceremonial daggers and fine jewelry to the markets of Venice and Vienna. By turning our raw mineral wealth into high-value artistic exports, we have created a prosperous urban middle class that is fiercely loyal to the Crown. This industrial refinement elevates the prestige of our nation in every foreign court, proving that the 'Iron Heart' of the Balkans possesses a sophisticated cultural edge that rivals the great capitals of the West.

name: Expansive Policies
description: $brandenburg_area$'s infertile, sandy soil has earned it the unflattering nickname 'Sandbox of the $hre$.' Such poverty spurred the margraves to aggressively expand, pursuing claims to neighboring territories. These conquests have made our country much more culturally diverse than the rest of the Empire.

name: The Northern March
description: In the early days of the $hre$, the $brandenburg_area$ area was settled and governed by $slavic_group$ tribes, until the Emperor created the Northern March to subjugate and fortify the area. Over time, this Northern March evolved into $brandenburg_area$, becoming one of the most important regions in the $hre$.

name: Divide the Estates
description: United, the three estates form an effective block against the power of the ruler. To consolidate our control, we must systematically leverage the nobility against the other estates.

name: Soldiers of Fortune
description: Our lands are sparsely populated, for the most part, and surrounded by enemies. The necessity for more robust defenses has prompted us to hire soldiers from foreign lands, who will fight under our banner for a price.

name: Iron Tooth
description: Enhancing our court's control over the Margraviate's lands will earn our ruler the moniker #italic Iron Tooth#!, as if we bit it like an attack dog. Our rule will leave a mark on our nation, a mark which will instill a sense of pride and loyalty in even the lowliest peasant in $brandenburg_area$.

name: Found the Kammergericht
description: In order to regularize control of the Mark of Brandenburg, we will replace local common law with Roman law. We will further regulate justice by moving the Supreme Court from the court of the Elector, who is prone to moving around, to a fixed central location. This will simultaneously improve justice and curb the power of local magnates.

name: Dispositio Achillea
description: Dividing our lands between heirs has weakened dynasties across the Empire. We will establish a clear rule of succession, the eldest inherits all. Our nobles may grumble, but an undivided Mark is worth their discontent.

name: Geheimer Rat für die Kurmark
description: The authority of the Margrave is greatly threatened by the ever-increasing power of our Estates. The Estates are of great benefit to our nation, but the threat they represent to our base of power necessitates the creation of a new council, one which reduces the very real power that the estates hold over our nation into more of an advisory position for the Margrave. This way, we may continue to enjoy the benefits of our Estates while having fewer concerns about their needs.

name: Religious Toleration
description: Stability in our home regions is the key to our success elsewhere. Expanding outwards while fostering religious tolerance, we not only improve stability at home, but we also make our realm a haven for those fleeing persecution elsewhere.

name: Hohenzollern Privy Council
description: Our estates have long held sway over the governance of the Mark. By establishing a council of advisors answerable to the Elector alone, we bring our ablest men to the center of power, and quietly reduce the estates to a consultative role.

name: Edict of Potsdam
description: Our neighbors drive out their most industrious subjects for the sake of religious conformity. Their loss is our gain. We open our doors to the persecuted and the skilled alike, and our cities grow richer for it.

name: Hohenzollern Court Culture
description: A great court needs more than soldiers and clerks. By welcoming artists, philosophers, and men of science into our service, we turn the court of $BRA$ into a beacon of culture, and show the world that our ambitions reach beyond the battlefield.

name: Berliner Aufklärung
description: New ideas spread fast in our cities, and the minds of $BRA$ have never been idle. We will cultivate this spirit of inquiry, drawing scholars and thinkers to our court. A nation that thinks clearly governs itself well.

name: Báihuàwén
description: Our domain stretches well beyond the horizon. The emergence of a common written language among our subjects will surely bridge the gaps between us, elevate our culture, and reduce conflict based on misunderstanding and linguistic differences.

name: Zájù
description: Typically consisting of four acts, this brilliant display of dance and music is a colorful expression of the artistic heights that our society has achieved.

name: Successors of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$
description: From the days of total conquest to the vast expanses of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$'s great Empire, our people descend from generations of earthshakers. Our people are the ones destined to author history.

name: Confucian Influences
description: If we are to manage our realm properly, our advisors shall find great wisdom about administration in Confucian teachings, which emphasize meritocratic selection of officials, attention to administrative detail, and other foundational advice for creating a healthy and prosperous government.

name: Imperial Bureaucracy
description: Our realm rests upon a tradition of sophisticated administrative institutions, from the Central Secretariat that coordinates all civil governance to the Censorate that holds our officials to account. We shall make this legacy of imperial administration the foundation of our state.

name: Extensive Canal Works
description: The many rivers that cross our domain have tremendous economic potential. By constructing extensive canal networks, we can connect waterways to inland settlements, making transportation easier while also providing a reliable water supply to our people.

name: Tributary System
description: A system of subjugated local warlords and other rulers who send us regular gifts of allegiance in recognition of our overlordship. To refine and centralize this system would help us tighten our grip and squeeze more out of them.

name: Zhōngshū Shěng
description: One of the most vital branches of the #italic Three Departments and Six Ministries#!, the central secretariat is responsible for the drafting and codification of many Imperial reforms and decrees.

name: Lǐ Jiǎ System
description: Under the #italic Lǐ Jiǎ#! system, we are able to exercise control over our borderlands through the allocation of settled armies. By granting land and agricultural rights to our stationed troops, our borders will be safer and our authority shall be affirmed.

name: Yúlín Túcè
description: Tax evasion is a timeless problem that even plagued our ancestors, but we may have found a solution: By compiling registers for districts and provinces, we will keep better track of the taxes owed to the central government by every plot. This taxation is largely determined based on the grain yield of every plot that undergoes survey.

name: Wèi Suǒ
description: Many would-be conquerors eye our lands with covetous intent. If we are to defend our territory, we must set up a garrison system, aimed at rapidly responding to hostile invasions. Through the recruitment of local troops, our defensive prowess will be supplemented through supplies and more efficient logistics.

name: Grand Coordinators
description: Maintaining control over our territories, policymaking, and military operations is vital for the continuation of our dynasty. Through the creation of Grand Coordinators, a body of high-ranking officials who can coordinate governance across our vast empire, we will succeed in cementing our position through effective stabilization of internal and external matters.

name: The Censorate
description: Parallel to other institutes within our administration, this branch of our government is in charge of preventing corruption. The censors are tasked with keeping palatial intrigues and malfeasance in check, often seen as the eyes and ears of the Emperor.

name: The $tea$ Trade
description: A staple beverage of our society, $tea$ has come to dominate social gatherings, becoming the choice drink of many. This will undoubtedly lead to not only new varieties being cultivated, but a production boom as well.

name: Tǔ Bīng
description: In our quest to shore up our border defenses, it has become apparent that we must create a system of recruitment centered around local soldiers and stalwarts. These fighters will be a valuable addition to our military capabilities, and shall be kept separate from the #italic Wèi Suǒ#! system.

name: Tǔsī Titles
description: Titles granted to warlords and local strongmen, these administrative positions are used to quell unrest and keep the rural populace under central control.

name: Restore the $salt$ Monopoly
description: The $salt$ monopoly was once our most important revenue source, but previous Emperors abolished it to encourage free trade. It is time to return the $salt$ trade to state control.

name: Reform the Grand Secretariat
description: Considered the #italic de facto#! highest institution in our nation, the #italic [ShowBureaucracyTypeName('grand_secretariat_bureaucracy')]#! has served our rulers for centuries. Wielding immense influence over administrative affairs, this body of cabinet ministers must undergo a reform to further increase its effectiveness.

name: Grand Military Parades
description: Our illustrious military history of our people is a great source of inspiration and pride for our people. By conducting elaborate parades to showcase our armies, we will decisively demonstrate our martial experience and unparalleled strength.

name: Silver Standard
description: By turning most obligations towards the central government - from poll taxes to the labor obligations of the peasants or the tributes of local officials - into a single silver payment, the amount of which is based on the population and cultivated land in each prefecture, tax collection will become easier and our income will increase.

name: Nine Garrisons of the Great Wall
description: In order to defend against the vicious barbarian onslaught, we must do more than simply repair the Great Wall. The Nine Garrisons are militarized garrison towns along the Wall that will not only help to defend the most important passes, but also improve the overall logistical situation on our northern border.

name: The Red Cannon
description: The red-haired barbarians from $europe$ may be uncivilized and ill-mannered, but they do know how to make artillery and firearms of good quality. Importing and duplicating their weapons will give our army a significant advantage against all invaders.

name: Woodblock Printing
description: The production of elegant illustrations, artworks, and books using this printing method has captivated our people's attention, and our master printers constantly strive to perfect their techniques. Woodblock printing has become part of our culture and, with recent improvements to and expansion of our literary production, will further elevate our prestige.

name: Green Standard Army
description: The Green Standard Army, a military force mainly composed of ethnic Hàn soldiers, coexists with our Eight Banner armies. Originally formed by surrendered troops and recruited on a voluntary, long-term basis, they attract individuals from socially disadvantaged backgrounds. Used as a police force post-consolidation, they will play a crucial role in local military governance, while Bannermen will be reserved for emergencies and sustained resistance.

name: Great Tax Reform
description: Our wealthy nation has ample coin and bounteous, fertile fields, but all this abundance requires comprehensive taxation. The Great Tax Reform enables more efficient revenue management, which should guarantee a healthier budget for our realm.

name: Jūnjī Chù
description: Also known as the Grand Council, the #italic Jūnjī Chù#! is tasked with overseeing military affairs. As the most important privy council, it has come to overshadow the Grand Secretariat that held sway over previous dynasties. Despite its crucial role, this council will retain an informal nature within the inner court, with its members holding other official roles besides their councilorship.

name: Jǐngdézhèn $porcelain$
description: Our $porcelain$ industry is emblematic of the prosperity and tradition of artisanal excellence alive in our Empire. By perfecting the already-superior $porcelain$ production techniques of Jǐngdézhèn, we will spread our cultural influence far and wide.

name: Sānxītáng
description: The Hall of Three Rarities is our most splendid repository of rare, valuable objects and works of art. Through the generous patronage of our ruler, it has flowered into a venue for academic discussions, lectures, and even cultural events, promoting intellectual exchange and scholarly pursuits.

name: Monuments of Greatness
description: In our people's many millennia of existence on this planet, they have endured thousands of catastrophes through sheer tenacity. This innate steely strength has come to be recognized as a defining feature of our society. We showcase our resilience in the strength of our army and the divine beauty of our art.

name: Ten Grand Campaigns
description: The Ten Great Campaigns are aimed at expanding our influence both inside and outside our borders. To achieve that, we will draft a huge army to crush any resistance that we might find in our way. We shall choke the life out of any rebellion before it has the chance to raise its head, and our glory will be eternal.

name: Tribal Elections
description: We will elect a nominal leader of our people, who will act as our representative but will not meddle with the oversight of local lords.

name: $CIR_ADJ$ Mercenaries
description: Our lands have again and again been raided by foreign powers, and our people enslaved. Some of these slaves, used as soldiers, have advanced in their new lives, accumulating power and wealth of their own. With some convincing, we could convince them to return to our lands, and protect it from future invasions.

name: Skilled Horsemen
description: Our position at the edge of the steppes has resulted in multiple mounted invasions of our homelands. If we want to ensure our independence, we will need to raise a great host ourselves, and expand our influence over the steppes, securing our heartland.

name: Fortified Towns
description: Our settlements lie unprotected, and are easy prey to any invader. As these settlements grow, however, we can directly incorporate the hilly terrain into our defensive lines, enhancing their protection. If necessary, we can even create the elevated terrain required ourselves.

name: Grand Princedom
description: To unify our people, we shall elect the greatest of our lords as the Grand Prince, who will serve as an inspiring leader for our troops.

name: Religious Coexistence
description: Our lands are frequented by many $catholic_ADJ$, $muslim_ADJ$, and $orthodox_ADJ$ people, who frequently engage in trade with our population. We should foster a collective tolerance between all our subjects, to promote peace and stability.

name: The Glagolitic Lithurgy
description: Our culture is defined by the unique privilege of the Glagolitic liturgy — the only place in the Catholic world where the Mass is sung in the native Slavic tongue. This tradition bridges the gap between the Latin cities and the Slavic heartland, creating a unified cultural identity. By preserving this ancient script, our people maintain a secret cultural language that reinforces their distinctiveness, providing a sense of national pride that resists assimilation by both the Italian and Germanic cultural spheres.

name: The Pacta Conventa
description: This legal bedrock formalized the union between the Twelve Noble Tribes of Croatia and the Hungarian Crown. By preserving the right to elect the monarch and maintaining a separate coronation with the Zvonimir Crown, we ensure Croatia remains a distinct political entity in the case of falling in Union with other nations. This contractual sovereignty prevents total absorption into a foreign administration, allowing our nobility to manage internal justice and defense under their own ancient laws.

name: The Baška Tablet
description: The cultural soul of Croatia is anchored in the 'Zvonimir tradition', where our history is carved in stone. We have promoted the memory of our independent kings through epic poetry and historical chronicles, instilling a 'Royal Consciousness' in every peasant and noble. This historical pride ensures that even when ruled by foreign kings, the Croatians view themselves as part of an ancient and sovereign nation, fostering a resilience that ensures our culture remains vibrant and resistant to external cultural decay.

name: The Marturina Tax System
description: We have formalized the #italic Marturina#! (marten-pelt tax, also known as #italic Kunovina#!), a unique and ancient Slavonian tribute system that provides the Ban with a high-value, portable liquid asset. By standardizing the value of these pelts against the Royal Mark, we have created a stable currency for the region that is highly resistant to inflation. This fiscal reliability allows the Banate to maintain a professional guard and build extensive wooden and stone river-fortifications along the vulnerable Drava crossings without burdening the peasantry with excessive grain taxes.

name: Influx of Foreign Knowledge
description: The coastal cities have become vibrant centers of the Renaissance, where scholars and artists blend classical Italian influences with a distinct Slavic sensibility. This intellectual movement produces great thinkers who contribute to European science, poetry, and philosophy, proving that Croatian culture is at the forefront of the modern era. The patronage of wealthy merchant families allows for the construction of magnificent cathedrals and palaces, turning our coast into a beacon of high culture that attracts the finest minds of the age.

name: Legacy of the Trpimirović
description: We look back to the glorious age of our native kings, such as Tomislav and Zvonimir, to inspire a sense of independent destiny and national pride. By tracing our lineage and institutions back to these sovereign rulers, we bolster our diplomatic standing among the courts of Europe and assert our right to a crown that is older than many of our neighbors'. This historical prestige commands respect from the Holy See and serves as a powerful unifying mythos that rallies the disparate regions of the kingdom under a single, storied banner of Romanic-Slavic royalty.

name: The Banovac Silver Denar
description: We have asserted the right of #italic Monetaria#!, establishing a sovereign mint to produce the Banovac silver denar. By maintaining a higher silver content than neighboring currencies, our coin has become the primary medium of exchange in the northern Adriatic and the Drava basin. This fiscal independence allows us to fund its administration without relying on external subsidies, turning our court into a regional financial hub that attracts Ragusan and Venetian capital.

name: The Slavonian Sabor
description: Our people are governed under the scrutiny of the Slavonian #italic Sabor#!. This legislative independence allows the Slavonian nobility to address the specific needs of the inter-river plains, such as drainage projects and the regulation of grain markets. By having a dedicated assembly, the Banate can react quickly to regional crises and negotiate directly for tax exemptions, ensuring that Slavonia's agricultural wealth is used primarily for Slavonia's own defense and improvement.

name: The Marulić Epic Tradition
description: The cultural soul of Croatia has reached a literary peak with works like #italic Judita#! by Marko Marulić, the 'Father of Croatian Literature'. By using biblical allegory to describe the contemporary defense of our lands, Marulić has provided the nation with a high-culture blueprint for survival. This literature creates a bridge between the Renaissance urbanite and the frontier soldier, unifying all classes under a shared heroic mission and ensuring the preservation of the Croatian tongue as a language of high art and theological debate.

name: Antemurale Christianitatis
description: Our cultural identity has been forged in the fire of the 'Century of Martyrs'. We have embraced the role of the #italic Antemurale Christianitatis#! (Shield of Christendom), transforming our military struggle into a sacred religious mission. This mythos instills a deep, unshakable sense of historical duty in the population, viewing the defense of our nation as the defense of civilization itself. This 'Heroic Spirit' ensures that the national fire remains alive even in our darkest hours.

name: The Croatian Press
description: We have established one of the earliest and most daring printing houses in the Slavic world. By moving our technological heart to the 'impassable' valley of Kosinj, we ensure that the production of our sacred Glagolitic texts remains shielded from the maritime raids and border skirmishes that plague the littoral. This press is not merely a tool for literacy; it is a laboratory of cultural survival where we forge the first printed missals in our native tongue. By standardizing our ancient script through the modern press, we provide every parish in the Kingdom with a unified, incorruptible source of our laws and liturgy. This ensures that the Croatian identity remains intellectually fortified and spiritually independent, as it reaches the hands of every shepherd and noble, anchoring the soul of the nation in an unshakeable, home-grown tradition.

name: The Alluvial Land Grants
description: The fertile silt between the Sava and Drava is our greatest asset. By granting tax-free plots in exchange for clearing the heavy riverine brush, we are turning the flooded plains into the primary grain basin of the North. This agricultural intensification provides the logistics needed to support a massive standing army, ensuring the Kingdom can feed its defenders even during the most grueling winter blockades.

name: The Peasants' Revolts
description: The crushing weight of feudal obligations in the face of constant war caused peasant revolts in the past. The peasantry rose not against us, but against the 'unjust' nobility who failed to protect them while demanding excessive tithes. Though these revolts have been usually brutally suppressed, they have left a lasting legacy of social consciousness and have transformed the relationship between the classes, forcing the state to eventually moderate its tax demands to maintain internal stability.

name: The Lessons from the Uskoks
description: To counter the advance of our enemies, we have transformed our coastal fortresses into a sanctuary for the Uskoks — refugee warriors who wage a permanent war. These light-infantry units use small, fast boats to conduct lightning raids against enemy supply lines, surviving in the rugged karst where regular armies cannot follow. This policy turns our coast into a lethal 'no-man's-land' for our enemies, providing us with a cheap and fiercely motivated frontier guard that requires no support from the central treasury and keeps our enemies constantly on the defensive.

name: The Jesuit Academy
description: Founded by the invited Jesuit Order, this academy has evolved from a local gymnasium into the intellectual heart of our nation. By establishing a rigorous curriculum of Aristotelian philosophy, mathematics, and rhetoric, the academy has created a home-grown elite of 'Enlightened Croats' who are as comfortable in the salons of Vienna as they are in the Sabor. This institutional modernization ensures that our bureaucracy is led by a technocratic class capable of navigating the complex legal and scientific shifts of our century.

name: The Oak Staple Rights
description: Slavonian Oak is now the most sought-after timber in the Mediterranean for its iron-like resistance to water rot. By establishing a royal monopoly on the export of mature oak to the Venetian shipyards, we have secured a strategic economic lever over the maritime republics. This trade does not just fill our coffers; it ensures that the very foundations of Venice's palaces and the hulls of their galleys are physically composed of Croatian soil, giving us a unique diplomatic influence over the 'Queen of the Adriatic'.

name: The Cravats
description: During these convulsed years, the world has taken notice of the distinct, elite light-cavalry regiments from the Croatian Military. Beyond their legendary mobility and ferocity, these horsemen have introduced a unique sartorial innovation: a functional, knotted cloth worn around the neck to secure their shirt collars and provide protection from the chafing of breastplates. This #italic cravat#! — a name derived from the French mispronunciation of #italic Croate#! — has rapidly transcended the battlefield to become the height of Parisian and European fashion. By transforming a rugged military necessity into a hallmark of fashionable dressing, our culture has achieved a subtle but permanent victory. This sartorial dominance ensures that the image of the Croatian officer is one of both tactical lethality and unparalleled gallantry.

name: The Baroque Pietas
description: Our culture has embraced a dramatic and intense Baroque Catholicism, characterized by massive religious processions and the construction of grand, ornate churches. This 'Visual Piety' serves as a powerful unifying force, bridging the gap between the urban nobility and the rural peasantry through shared ritual and spectacle. This intense religious identity acts as a cultural shield against both Protestant and Eastern influences, ensuring that the Croatian soul remains firmly anchored in the Catholic-Mediterranean world, even while defending the central European plains.

name: The National Garrison System
description: To combat the sudden amphibious raids of enemy fleets or border transgressions, we will establish a sophisticated visual system using smoke and fire signals atop the highest Velebit crags. This 'Mountain Watch' will allow our forts to communicate across the jagged terrain in minutes, bypassing the slow mountain trails. By coordinating these signals with the inland garrisons, we will be able to mobilize our nation and reinforce our walls before any action happens. This high-altitude surveillance will turn the impassable peaks into a centralized command tower, ensuring that no enemy can approach without our immediate knowledge.

name: Swamp Drainage Projects
description: By investing in large-scale hydraulic engineering projects to drain the vast marshlands of the riverine areas, we unlock thousands of acres of new, fertile farmland. These reclaimed lands will be soon settled, increasing the population density and tax base of the province while eliminating the vectors for disease. This transformation of the landscape not only strengthens our economy but also creates a more navigable and defensible terrain, removing the natural barriers that once hindered our own internal communications.

name: The Illyrian Movement
description: Over the last few years, our nation has witnessed the explosion of the #italic Illyrian Movement#!, a cultural and political revolution that seeks to unify all Croats under a single banner. This movement effectively aims to unify the disparate regions of our nation into a single, cohesive political and cultural national body. By standardizing the grammar and orthography, we will transform our medieval nation into a modern one, ensuring that the Croatian name, language, and statehood will never again be forgotten or suppressed.

name: The Royal Council of Croatia
description: We have established the #italic Consilium Regium#! in our capital, creating a dedicated executive government for the Croatian Nation. This body will act as a proto-ministry, handling the economy, education, and internal security of the #italic Triune Kingdom#!. This era of 'Government by Council' will foster a professional class of Croatian civil servants who view the state as a rational, modern machine rather than a collection of feudal privileges. The experience gained in these halls of power will provide the administrative expertise necessary for the Croatian people to navigate the transition from a medieval kingdom to a modern European nation-state.

name: Uniting the Coast and the Inner Lands
description: To break the isolation of our coast, we will oversee the monumental construction of numerous roads, linking the inland to our ports. This engineered highway will be carved through the limestone heart of the Velebit mountains, featuring advanced stone bridges and serpentine curves to accommodate heavy wagons. The road will transform our littoral from a desolate frontier into a vital economic artery, allowing the timber and grain of the interior to reach international markets. By physically binding the mountain hinterland to the Adriatic, we will complete the territorial integration of the nation, fostering a new age of trans-Velebit commerce.

name: The Slavonian Grenadier Regiments
description: Our infantry units are reorganized into elite grenadier regiments that are renowned across the continent for their physical stature, rigorous discipline, and unwavering bravery under fire. These specialized shock troops are trained to lead the charge into the heaviest enemy fire, using their grenades and bayonets to break the lines of even the most formidable opponents. The presence of these 'Slavonian Giants' on the battlefield serves as a powerful psychological weapon, boosting the morale of our own troops while striking terror into the hearts of those who face them.

name: Legacy of Saint George
description: Our association with the legendary Saint George is well known through both the $christian_ADJ$ and $muslim_ADJ$ worlds. As he bravely faced and slew the fearsome dragon, so will our soldiers face our enemies in battle.

name: $Bagrationi$ Dynasty
description: A dynasty so old that its origins are shrouded in mystery, kings and queens of the $Bagrationi$ house have ruled $GEO$ ever since the 9th century, first as its princes and then as monarchs.

name: $GEO_ADJ$ Golden Age
description: $GEO$ enjoyed a cultural and religious Golden Age that was brought to a sudden stop, due to the $MGE_ADJ$ invasions. That period witnessed the peak of our cultural achievements, but we will now return to it, and achieve even greater heights.

name: Legacy of Tamar
description: Tamar was one of the greatest rulers our nation ever had. Her military and cultural successes are legendary, and the mere utterance of her name still stirs reverence in all $GEO_ADJ$ hearts.

name: Davit the Builder
description: Considered the greatest ruler in the history of our country, King Davit the Builder brought $GEO$ to its pinnacle. He built a powerful, culturally influential kingdom, and a beacon for $christian$ and the $GEO_ADJ$ people.

name: $GEO_ADJ$ Titles
description: 'King of Kings, strong and invincible, majestic and protector of the holy kingdom of the Abkhazians, Iberians, Ranis, Kakhetians, Armenians, Shahanshah and Shirvanshah, of the East and the West, of the South and the North, of both countries, of two thrones and crowns, the godlike Suzerain and the Sovereign of the Throne.' The titles of our ruler are numerous, and all at court shall respect them!

name: $GEO_ADJ$ Numismatics
description: Our country has a rich tradition of minting coins, inscribing them not only in $georgian_language$ but also in $arabic_language$ and $persian_language$, as they serve as currency for trade through our country and those that neighbor us.

name: Beacon of $christian$
description: $GEO$ has been a haven for $christian$ in the Caucasus for centuries, even after being surrounded and isolated by followers of $muslim$. The ardent faith of our people is a source of inspiration for all our religious brethren.

name: $GEO_ADJ$ Principalities
description: Our regional administration is divided into many different principalities and territories. Delegating authority this way allows us to exert our rule more effectively.

name: $GEO_ADJ$ Resilience
description: Our country has been torn apart, by external and internal influences, more than once in its long history. However, like the phoenix of legend, it has risen from the ashes and established itself as a presence to reckon with each time. The resilience of our people is commendable.

name: Professional Army Core
description: Our strategic position within the Empire makes us an attractive staging ground for other princes' armies whenever outside threats arise. However, hosting foreign troops hurts our finances. To prevent this costly burden, we must raise our own troops and put them into service of the Empire.

name: Hohlpfennig
description: Originally minted between the cities of $LUB$ and $HAM$, the #italic Hohlpfennig#! was a hollow currency developed as a countermeasure to rampant debasing, during an era where each mint had different standards regarding the concentration of silver on each coin. As a means of conducting transactions, the currency will smoothen our trade activities and bridge the gap between foreign markets and our merchants.

name: The $n_hanseatic_cog$
description: $n_hanseatic_cog_desc$

name: $HSA_ADJ$ Ties
description: Our League is home to a great many cities and merchant guilds, all with their own agendas and endeavors. In order to maintain our prosperity and expand our reach, we must take a keen interest in diplomatic efforts.

name: Seal of the $HSA$
description: In markets across $europe$, from $london$ to $novgorod$, our merchants are famed for their affluence. Our ability to mobilize great trade fleets and bring dozens of cities into a perfect symphony of profit and exchange of commodities is second to none.

name: $HSA_ADJ$ Shipwrights
description: At a time when $europe$ is enveloped in war, with rulers desperate for expansion pressing claims in all directions, they look to us to build grand fleets that will allow them to fulfill their ambitions. Armed with centuries of accumulated shipwrighting knowledge, and some of the best timber on the continent, our ship-building process is unparalleled!

name: $HSA_ADJ$ Fortifications
description: The $hsa_burgtor$ is more than a gate. It is a statement of power and permanence, raised at the entrance to our greatest cities to announce that the wealth of the $HSA$ is well protected. Where our merchants travel and prosper, the fortifications of the $HSA$ shall stand to safeguard them.

name: Draft Merchant Privileges
description: The merchants who conduct business under our seal carry with them tremendous influence and purses brimming with coin. As such, solidifying their privileges in foreign and domestic markets will only further increase our capacity for profitable business.

name: Mastery of the Sea
description: Our maritime traditions have linked our fortunes to the mighty sea. To reap all the benefits we possibly can from our marine resources, we must learn to harness the awesome power of the sea — and to treat it with the proper deference. This will have tremendous effects on our trade activities.

name: Exchange of Ideas
description: Our traveling merchants who carry our business abroad are excellent resources of foreign knowledge. Whenever they return to our shores, they bring innovation and inspiration in their wake.

name: Global Reach
description: The widespread adoption of trade on a global scale has shaken the mercantile world to its core. It is now customary to do regular business with foreign traders from all corners of the world, and our treasury has benefited as a result.

name: $HSA_ADJ$ Treasury
description: A strong economy is but one result of our prosperity. With ample coin and overflowing coffers, we have established ourselves as robust and dependable creditors.

name: Standardized Contributions
description: The many entities within our League must be brought under our firm control in a bid to standardize their monthly and annual contributions to our treasury.

name: The $HSA$ Bank
description: Following our new system of contributions, we can underwrite a bank for members to use. Backed by the resources of the League, a letter of credit from the bank will be as good as cash. This, as well as other financial instruments, will give our merchants an edge over those in other countries.

name: Reform the Hanstag
description: In times of troubles and evolving thought, our central institutions for assembly and deliberation must adapt to deal with emerging challenges and new paradigms.

name: Concept of Mercantilism
description: Over the past centuries, we have worked tirelessly to integrate our dealings into the global scale of trade. Now, more than ever, we must protect our own merchants, lest we fall victim to factionalism and external competition.

name: One Faith for $KHM$
description: Our country has lived through tumultuous times as royal patronage shifted between both $hindu$ and various branches of $buddhist$. We must promote the chosen faith throughout our country to breed stability, and trust that our ruler has chosen the true path for our people.

name: $KHM_ADJ$ Royal Processions
description: Our rulers excel at creating dazzling processions, events of glorious splendor that very few others can rival. These extravagant demonstrations of our national wealth confirm the power and brilliance of the ruler and the astonishing riches of our nation. The glittering procession of elephants, treasure, and the royal guard will strike awe and respect in the hearts of our people, winning their unbroken loyalty and admiration.

name: Ballista Elephants
description: Elephants are impressive creatures and tower over any other animal we have seen. It is time to utilize these qualities to strike fear into our enemies by using these majestic animals in warfare. Elephants are also able to carry great weight, allowing us to mount war machines on them. Constructing double-stringed crossbows and equipping our elephants with them will create a tool that will allow us to dominate the battlefields better than ever before.

name: Hydraulic Cities
description: Our great cities are home to many #italic barays#! and canals, primed to store and disperse water throughout the area. Constructing and maintaining this network of waterways with skill will ensure our population will thrive even during the unstable monsoon seasons.

name: Recruit the Peasantry
description: We will need to reinforce our army with new recruits, which are easily found among the peasant class. With some training, we will be able to ensure the ranks can be refilled at any time by capable soldiers.

name: Invite Foreign Experts
description: While our own people are not familiar with silk-weaving and prefer other fabrics, we are lucky that foreign artisans have settled in our cities and established their own weaving workshops. We should adopt this approach for other industries by directly inviting foreign artisans to bring their skills here, and thereby universally expand our production.

name: The Lifeblood of $KHM$
description: Our rivers provide an excellent way to transport goods harvested and produced in our inland territories to our harbors, which are connected to foreign trade routes. Utilizing this transport network will also connect our cities and make communication between them faster.

name: Mercenary Leaders of $CHA$
description: In the past, we both fought with and alongside the fierce warriors of $CHA$. If we can secure the service of their most capable leaders in times of conflict, we can ensure our own forces are trained and well-rested, ready to leap into battle as fresh reinforcements.

name: Restoration of $angkor$
description: The great city of $angkor$ was once a brilliant example of our architectural genius. Due to external pressures, we had to abandon our construction efforts, but we should connect to the roots of our society and start constructing new monuments to our splendor again.

name: A Modern Navy for $KHM$
description: We cannot allow others to dominate the seas and control the trade our state depends on. Let us create a new, modern naval force capable of taking on any pirate or rival navy in $south_east_asia$.

name: Expand the Barays
description: While our existing water reservoirs meet our current agricultural demands, we could easily support more people if we were to dig new #italic barays#! in other parts of our country, creating the foundations for new urban hubs.

name: Secure the Borders
description: Our lands are frequently threatened by invasion, and our precious $angkor$ lies especially vulnerable to siege. We must invest into a comprehensive system of fortifications, with sufficient garrisons to withstand any invading force, so that we can protect our people and national treasures from foreign conquest.

name: Guided by Rivalry
description: Our people were humiliated in the past by being forced to bow to foreign invaders. While not every defeat can be avoided, we use these old rivalries to spur our people to fight harder and longer on the battlefield, burning to erase the shame of these ancient humiliations.

name: Peace in the City
description: Not so long ago, our city was nearly torn apart in the struggle between our burghers and our clergy. We must ensure that this conflict cannot repeat itself, and that every member of both our court and the city council cooperate in preserving Cologne as a central hub on the Rhine.

name: Cologne School of Painting
description: Our city is home to many capable painters and craftsmen skilled in the art of bringing images to life through the media of wood, stone, and especially glass. With the support of a strongly established artists' guild, they will thrive under our sponsorship and illuminate our city to new glory.

name: Land of Many Religions
description: Our people coexist with fellow men and women of many faiths. This diverse social composition is embedded in our legal frameworks and beliefs. Together, we are stronger!

name: Migrant Opportunities
description: Mercantile opportunities and the promise of a better life are some of the reasons as to why our towns and settlements tend to receive constant waves of immigration. Many men and women relocate to our lands seeking their fortune, and their presence and contributions increase our fortune in turn.

name: Warlord Dukes
description: Over two remarkable centuries of warfare, $LIT_ADJ$ warlord dukes transformed a loose federation of tribes into a unified warrior state. They mounted fierce resistance against the aggression of $catholic_ADJ$ holy orders, while simultaneously conquering vast territories in the East. These legendary achievements continue to inspire our military leaders today.

name: Two Realms
description: Due to the size of our realm, our jurisdiction falls under two distinct frameworks: To the north lies the core of our territories, proudly embracing our cultural traditions and social mores. However, our southern and eastern regions often diverge to a certain degree from our central norms. To respect such diversity will strengthen our nation as well as our position on the geopolitical stage.

name: Chancery Slavonic
description: To help connect our people across our vast realm, we need a unified language, and require many literate members of the clergy to spread it. The development of such a language to record our history and maintain our administrative apparatus is not only a sign of national pride and prestige, but also a means of creating a distinct government, separating us linguistically and culturally from our neighbors to the east.

name: 'Supremus Dux Lithuaniae'
description: If we are to defend ourselves against our aggressive $polish$ and $russian_group$ foes, we must project strength! Establishing the title of #italic Supreme Duke of Lithuania#! will decisively assert our authority, especially against the growing power of our nobility and others who seek to violate our sovereignty.

name: Holy See Ties
description: Years of negotiations with the Holy Father have resulted in our embracing $catholic$, with the blessing of our $polish$ neighbors and the Pope himself, during a turbulent and unique Christianization process. After our struggle to seek our spiritual identity subsided, it is clear that we have become a beacon of $catholic$, a shield against the heathens and heretics that threaten our society.

name: Patriarchate of $LIT$
description: The abolition of $romuva$, a faith embraced by our ancestors, has shaken the very foundations of $LIT_ADJ$ society. Yet, in order to secure a brighter future, we have chosen the path of $orthodox$ and fully celebrate our new identity. But if we are to be successful in that, the religious authorities of our newfound $orthodox_ADJ$ faith must maintain autonomy from foreign patriarchates in order to avoid external interference.

name: Statutes of $LIT$
description: Statutes of $LIT$ are a set of three different legal reforms which aggregate, unify, and update the laws of the realm. Known for harsh punishments and the introduction of the death penalty, these statutes are in line with many contemporary Western penal codes. Each crime is supposed to be punished the same regardless of the class of the person committing it, but in practice, the peasants were often at a disadvantage compared to how members of other estates were treated.

name: $LIT_ADJ$ $renaissance$
description: $LIT$ experienced a $renaissance$ in the late 15th and early 16th centuries. Inspired by the ideas of the Reformation and influenced by the $ITA_ADJ$ $renaissance$, there was a prolific flourishing of education, arts, architecture, and literature during this era. This period will also see the creation of a written form of $lithuanian_dialect$ and, subsequently, the first works of $lithuanian_dialect$ literature.

name: Columns of $gediminid_dynasty$s
description: The coat of arms that hangs on our banners originates from one of our most celebrated dynasties, the $gediminid_dynasty$ family. Many of their brightest have led our nation through turbulent times into ample prosperity with careful statesmanship and capable guidance. The columns of such great leaders symbolize the strong foundation and tenacity of our country and our fellow men and women.

name: Mines of $LOR$
description: Our lands are rich in ore and coal. Extracting these resources could make us a rich country and lay the groundwork for our grand ambitions.

name: Land of Many Cultures
description: Our territory is home to many different peoples and cultures. Establishing a single state to govern this diverse population will not be easy, but we must. Only then will we be worthy successors to the $LOR_ADJ$ state from which we descend.

name: Land of Bishops
description: $LOR$ is home to many bishops with powerful supporters abroad and within the Church itself. Cooperating with them will be useful when making our voice heard within the broader Church. Having the support of the bishops will also help us to pacify the population more easily.

name: Legacy of Old Kings
description: Our lands were once an important part of Lotharingia, one of the Frankish kingdoms. If we do not want to fall into irrelevance, we will need to secure our diplomatic position and establish lasting alliances.

name: Fortified Cities of $LOR$
description: We occupy vital crossing points on several rivers, which we must defend at all costs if we want to secure our independence. To this effect, we must modernize the large bridge castles of our cities, and construct large citadels at strategic points.

name: Diadema Regni
description: Our beloved city has been described as 'Diadema Regni', the Crown of the Empire, a moniker we strive mightily to maintain. Maintaining this distinction will help us remain above other Imperial cities in terms of our prestige and political influence.

name: Rights of the City
description: The citizens of $MAI$ have prospered under the extensive rights granted to them by Adalbert of $MAI$ in the early 12th century. These rights, carved into the bronze door of the Cathedral, will serve as a reminder of cooperation between the separate powers within the city, both the clergy and the citizenry.

name: Rheinish League
description: When the Rheinish League was active, we naturally assumed a position of leadership and guidance for the other members. Although the League itself has disbanded, we must do everything we can to maintain our influence over our former associates.

name: Protect Our Faith
description: Our country's religious unity must be defended against any threat. If we provide our armies with moral guidance in the form of military chaplains, they will be much more motivated to defend our beliefs.

name: Governance of the Vicar
description: To ensure our lands are governed reliably, even in the absence of our ruler, we should instate a vicar. Empowered with extensive rights, the vicar can rule with our best intentions and remind the common folk of our presence at all times.

name: Mainzer Königreich
description: While celebrations on Ash Wednesday are a common occurrence, they hold especially deep roots in our country. While the public celebrates the #italic Fastnacht#!, or carnival, with masquerade and excessive feasts, our court will engage in a special event. During the carnival celebrations, we will redistribute the roles of our court per lottery, with even the ruler having to participate. This custom of swapping roles, called #italic Mainzer Königreich#!, will spread far beyond our borders and help expand our cultural legacy.

name: Printing Shops of $mainz$
description: By expanding our already-growing printing industry, we can become the leading producer of books in $europe$.

name: Garrison of the Rhine
description: Defending our borders can be a difficult task, especially considering the river splitting our land in two. We must build an extensive network of garrisons and fortifications that can withstand our enemies.

name: Barīd
description: A postal service that extends even to the farthest corners of our Empire, this institution is responsible for all communication between our capital and centers of local authority across the land.

name: Kārimī Merchants
description: Formidable traders that primarily deal in spices, these maritime giants have profited greatly from the flow of exotic goods that trail their origin as far as the shores of $india$ — and beyond.

name: $a_mamluk_unit_traditions$
description: $a_mamluk_unit_traditions_desc$

name: $a_halqah_unit$
description: $a_halqah_unit_desc$

name: $a_mamluk_unit_renaissance$
description: $a_mamluk_unit_renaissance_desc$

name: Kāshif
description: Our Sultanate is enormous, and therefore we must make wise, careful choices about its administration. To employ particularly learned individuals as local governors is a brilliant move, one that should eventually tip the geopolitical scales in our favor.

name: The Royal Mamluks
description: The Royal Mamluks are the elite core of the Mamluk army, serving as the Sultan's personal guard. Handpicked and rigorously trained, they are renowned for their loyalty, exceptional combat skills, and unwavering dedication.

name: Red Sea Trade
description: The spice trade flowing through the Red Sea is a key source of our wealth, and we must seize full control of it. By threatening to burn down any Red Sea ports outside our authority that accept spice traders, we can capture the lion's share of this lucrative commerce. We may not win many friendships with our aggression, but we shall have gold enough to comfort us.

name: Masters of the Nile
description: The heart-vein of our Sultanate is the river Nile. Traversing our nation, its touch creates our most fertile lands, and its life-bringing waters of the river channel prosperity and ample wealth throughout our domain.

name: Indian Networks
description: Our merchants deal in goods from the markets of $alexandria$, to the shores of Aden, and as far away as $india$ itself. These extensive networks of contacts, business, and capital have positioned us at the forefront of maritime commerce.

name: Foreign Gunpowder
description: The great empires of $europe$ and the East have made groundbreaking advances in the use of gunpowder and its military applications. To study their ways and make the according improvements to our own armaments would greatly strengthen our own military.

name: Port Customs
description: Designating our ports as official merchant zones for incoming cargo is a move that will certainly increase the mercantile significance of our territory, albeit at the expense of our neighbors and foes alike.

name: Secure Mediterranean Ports
description: Our ports across the Mediterranean Sea are some of the most affluent in the entire region. Merchants from every corner of the known world travel to $alexandria$ and Cairo to deal in spices, $silk$, and precious stones. The creation of a merchant navy to facilitate and protect our maritime avenues would therefore be a wise idea.

name: The Meißen Lion
description: The Meißen Lion, also known as the #italic Markmeißnische Löwe#!, holds a special place in heraldry. Representing the $wettin_dynasty$ dynasty's symbol of power, an armored black lion with a red tongue gazes to the left on a golden field. Its image appears in various forms, including on painted tombstones, ensigns, helmets, coins, and seals, symbolizing the affiliation of the city of $meissen$ to the #italic Mark Meißen#! and adorning the coats of arms of numerous towns and communities. Some link it to the recolored Thuringian lion.

name: A Mining Heritage
description: For centuries, mining has shaped our landscape, economy, and culture. Significant $silver$ discoveries in the region have attracted miners and traders from diverse regions, fostering the Ore Mountains' growth and expanding our realm's significance and development.

name: Meißner Groschen
description: The #italic Meißner groschen#! will serve as our national currency. This coin is based on the #italic Prague groschen#!, which we will replace. This new large groschen will mark the beginning of a new era in the history of our coinage and will let us better control its influxes.

name: A Resilient Soul
description: Our people are truly resilient, embodying unwavering determination in the face of challenges. They weather adversity with unwavering spirit, finding strength in unity and a steadfast commitment to their shared values. Their indomitable resilience propels us forward, enabling us to overcome any obstacle that comes our way. We will always emerge stronger and more determined than ever before.

name: The $SAX_ADJ$ Court
description: The $SAX_ADJ$ Court is a pillar of Electoral $SAX$'s government, alongside civil and military administration. Court regulations define the responsibilities and daily routines of officials, while the court itself is composed of both nobles and peasants serving the ruling family in governance and administration. Traditionally, each adult member of the ruling family maintained their own household court, but we will now create a single, permanent court in our capital, attracting the finest minds in the realm.

name: A Tolerant Society
description: Religious infighting and intolerance plagues other lands, but we stand firm against allowing such strife to fester in our realm. Regardless of the diverse faiths our subjects hold, this nation shall be built on the strong pillars of tolerance and brotherhood, fostering a harmonious coexistence among all communities. United by a common vision, we will be forging a nation where respect and understanding flourish, paving the way for a prosperous future.

name: Fürstenschule
description: As the Reformation takes hold and the state assumes control over religious administration, a new responsibility arises for the emerging state: education, which was previously the duty of the Church. We will found princely schools at Pforta, $grimma$, and $meissen$ using former monastic properties. Thus, the state will take on a significant role in shaping the educational landscape, fostering knowledge and intellectual growth for the future leaders of $SAX$.

name: Bonded by Loyalty
description: Our valiant armies never waver! They demonstrate exceptional morale and loyalty, standing firm whether defending our realm or supporting allies. With indomitable spirits, they will press forward even in desperate circumstances, refusing defeat until physically unable to continue.

name: Meissner $porcelain$
description: $SAX$ is the first country in $europe$ to produce $porcelain$, which will bring wealth and prestige to the $wettin_dynasty$ court.

name: $SAX_ADJ$ Baroque
description: $dresden$ and $leipzig$, among other locales, have gained international recognition for being centers of $SAX_ADJ$ Baroque culture. Magnificent architecture, like the Dresdner Hof, epitomize the grandeur of $SAX$, while Johann Sebastian Bach's work has transformed $leipzig$ into a city of music and thriving highbrow culture. The region boasts unique expressions of culture, including handicrafts from the Ore Mountains and culinary traditions like the #italic Dresdner Christstollen#!.

name: Rétablissement
description:
After tumultuous wars, a new era dawns upon $SAX$ — the remarkable $SAX_ADJ$ #italic Rétablissement#!. Amidst the ruins of our past, our nation will rise like a phoenix, rebuilding its shattered economy and charting a path toward prosperity. Driven by a blend of visionary state reforms and disciplined spending, our nation will emerge as a commercial hub.

With unparalleled administrative prowess and a strategic focus on economic growth, this resolute transformation will mark a pivotal moment in history, shaping the destiny of $SAX$ well into the future.

name: $SAX_ADJ$ Industrialization
description: $SAX$'s successful early industrialization is evident, with a highly developed industrial sector compared to other regions. The manufactory system, producing mainly for export, has flourished and will make $SAX$ a leading state in $GER$'s industrialization process. The emergence of smaller commercial landscapes and trade will be instrumental in promoting the region's economic growth and connections to other markets in $europe$.

name: Amazigh Slave Raids
description: Our coastal raiders provide our nation with a constant influx of captives from $europe$ through maritime raids and coastal incursions. This steady supply of enslaved labor is key to expanding our workforce and increasing our economic success.

name: Zenata Roots
description: Our people are descendants of the Zenata, a tribe best known for its vital wool production and skill at shepherding great herds of rams.

name: Strongholds of the Atlas
description: The mountain ranges that occupy most part of our country — the various parts of the Atlas and the Rif — are the reason no empire has ever truly conquered $MOR$. Our Amazigh mountain clans have been defendeding these passes since the times when Roman armies first marhced through them, and our knowledge of every track and refuge remains unmatched. The mountains do not slow us; they protect us.

name: Ṣūfī Marabouts
description: Several groups of Ṣūfī teachers have made Morocco their home. We must make sure that we accommodate these holy men, and take their teachings to heart.

name: Trans-Saharan Trade
description: The caravans of the great Saharan routes trade $salt$ and other goods from $north_africa$ for $slaves_goods$ and $goods_gold$ from the Sub-Saharan kingdoms. Through these valuable avenues of coin, we will build our great legacy.

name: First Fleet of the Mediterranean
description: The great al-Muwaḥḥidūn once prided themselves upon owning one of the most formidable navies in the entire Mediterranean Sea. Our people today still possess the traditions and expertise to reignite that passion and restore our greatness across the oceans.

name: Slave Soldiers
description: To ensure a loyal corps of well-trained standing troops, we will employ disciplined slave soldiers from within our society.

name: Desert Power
description: Our region is inhabited by many peasants and tribal groups, who represent the lower classes of our society. Despite their relative poverty, they command great influence over trade routes that cross the barren deserts between our cities. Bringing these people under our jurisdiction, and ensuring their allegiance, will help us establish ourselves as powerful scions of the desert.

name: Atlantic Trade Routes
description: Successfully navigated by sailors starting from $europe$, these new maritime routes have opened the floodgates to goods and coin from both the New World and the Far East.

name: Foreign Politics
description: To prevail over our foes, we must establish proper diplomatic channels and official cooperation with countries that share our animosity towards them.

name: Saharan $goods_gold$ Trade
description: The $goods_gold$ mined within our territory is of superior quality, and an excellent tool with which to further spread our influence over trade routes with foreign ports.

name: Jaysh Armies
description: A new era in warfare is dawning, and with it comes the need for a new regiment of loyal forces. Jaysh fighters, recruited from our tribal population, provide disciplined soldiers familiar with regional warfare and the local terrain.

name: $a_black_guard$
description: $a_black_guard_desc$

name: Shurfā' Status
description: The most revered and prestigious amongst all those who inhabit the $muslim_ADJ$ world, there are not many who can proclaim themselves descendants of the Great Prophet. We, of course, are among these blessed few.

name: Maghrebi Administration
description: Centuries of autonomy and our harsh environment have bred separatist tendencies among regional tribes within our borders. Maghrebi administration addresses this through creating a network of regional governors, who enforce central authority and the ruler's will while respecting local customs.

name: Bulwark of the $hindu$
description: The $muslim_ADJ$ faithful have invaded $india$ and subjugated many $hindu_ADJ$ residents under their gruesome rule. Yet, $ORI$ stands unflinching against the warriors of $muslim$. We are the bulwark of $hindu$, and we shall defend our traditions and culture against any foreign invader!

name: Anka Year System
description: The #italic Anka#! system is our method of documenting the regnal years of our rulers. Years ending in 6 or 0 are skipped, except for year 10, which is retained. The count begins at year 2, not year 1, and always starts on the #italic Sunia#!, our fiscal new year.

name: Gajapati
description: Horses are not native to $ORI$, and the lands here are unsuitable for raising them. Our jungles are, however, famously teeming with elephants. In the dense jungles of Eastern $india$, well-executed tactical cooperation between elephants and infantry can be just as deadly as a cavalry. Let us further increase the size of our elephant corps and refine their tactics, so that we will be known as a true #italic Gajapati#!, 'Lord of the Elephants'.

name: Servitor of Jagannath
description: Worship of Jagannath, the Lord of the Universe, is what unites our people. Previous rulers of $ORI$ were even considered to be the scions of Jagannath. Our current ruler might not be one of his descendants, but we must imprint on all that our leader is the servitor of Jagannath, and that any disobedience to them equals treason against Lord Jagannath himself.

name: Parikshas
description: $ORI$ has long been divided among many different princes, but their time is over! We will take control of these lands, and appoint regional governors — #italic parikshas#! — instead of allowing these petty princelings to dilute our imperial authority.

name: Odia Militarization
description: The $muslim_ADJ$ threat never ceases, nor does it ever rest. We must ensure our military is ready to face and combat invaders at any and all times.

name: Patronized Temple Construction
description: The glory of past dynasties is reflected by the grandeur of the temples they left behind. We should improve our many magnificent temple complexes, and construct new ones to further the development of Kalinga architecture.

name: Refined $cloth$ Production
description: $ORI$ has been famous for its high-quality textiles since ancient times. Let us further encourage the textile guilds of $ORI$ to refine their methods of producing their fine Kalinga $cloth$.

name: $salt$ Trade
description: The high-quality $salt$ of $ORI$ is in demand all over $india$. Let us do whatever we can to encourage the $salt$ trade so that we may grow rich from it.

name: Expansion of Infrastructure
description: As technology advances, so does the number of people in our realm. Industrialization has driven significant population growth, and as such, we must expand our infrastructure to accommodate these growing communities.

name: Palatine Lion
description: Originating from the dynastic coat of arms of the Wittelsbach family, the Palatine Lion is the centerpiece of our legitimacy. Displayed with a red crown, it signifies our role as the Imperial Vicar and Arch-Steward of the Holy Roman Empire. As long as the Palatine Lion is proudly displayed on our crest, our legitimacy will not come into question.

name: Castles on the Rhine
description: By erecting multiple castles in key positions along the Rhine, we will be able to exert and expand our control over both the river and the trade flowing through it.

name: Vineyards and Orchards of the Rhine
description: Although our territory is small, the sunny banks of the Rhine are perfectly suited to cultivate vineyards and orchards. With some effort, these could sustain our local economy by producing wine.

name: Local Fortification
description: By virtue of having our territories disperse, we are vunerable to attacks from several foreign powers. Constructing many fortified outposts within our lands will buy us time to raise an army and repel any attempt to take over one of our many disconnected territories.

name: Consolidate the Territories
description: Our administration is skilled in handling multiple disconnected territories without losing our grasp on them. With that, we can build a strong bureaucracy capable of handling even the most difficult tasks.

name: A Mild and Calm Ruler
description: The only effect of bloodshed is to cause further bloodshed. Therefore, we need to be a forgiving ruler, and reconcile with our enemies to establish a lasting peace in our territories.

name: Palatinate Tolerance
description: No matter their denominations, all $christian_ADJ$ people must be welcomed in the towns and cities of our lands. While others may decide to suppress their religious minorities, our tolerance will ensure a steady stream of immigrants into our territory, and we shall benefit from their presence.

name: Forgiveness for Peasants
description: When our peasantry rises up against our nobility, they unmistakably rise up against our own rule. However, we should not excessively punish those who revolt. With mild consequences, everyone will be more in alignment with our authority.

name: Humanist Education
description: To govern well, our rulers must receive a comprehensive education in humanist ideas. To this effect, we must hire renowned humanists for the education of our rulers and heirs, while also focusing our court on these principles.

name: Heidelberg Catechism
description: The Reformation has created many discussions around the nature of our faith. We should invest into a comprehensive catechism, to which our people will be able to adhere.

name: Protect the #italic Bibliotheca Palatina#!
description: Rich in theological scriptures of several $christian_ADJ$ denominations, the #italic Bibliotheca Palatina#! is one of our most prized possessions. Protection of the knowledge and the cultural value contained within must be a high priority, so that we are able to keep relying on its documents.

name: Support the Romantic Movement
description: A significant part of the Romantic movement is centered around $heidelberg$. We should capitalize on this phenomenon, and support these and other artists in order to bolster our global recognition.

name: Teutonic Legacy
description: The knights who carved this land from the wilderness left something behind, a tradition of service, discipline, and arms as a way of life. Our noble houses carry that tradition still. They do not merely own the land; they are sworn to defend it.

name: Double Electorate
description: Governing two territories separated by foreign lands demands more than ordinary administration. We will ensure our laws reach the far corners of our realm and that every magistrate answers to the same authority, however distant from the capital he may be.

name: Junker Officer Corps
description: In $PRU$, a commission is not purchased, it is owed. Our nobles are expected to lead, and to lead well. Men who grew up on the land know how to march across it, and how to keep their soldiers alive along the way.

name: Kriegskommisariat
description: Waging war cannot wait on the consent of our estates. We will establish a permanent organ of military finance, empowered to levy what the army requires. Our estates may not approve, but a well-funded army wins wars they cannot afford to lose.

name: Preußische Tugenden
description: Our court will not be a place of idle luxury. Every ducat saved is a ducat for the army; every hour wasted is a march not made. We ask nothing of our soldiers that we do not first demand of ourselves.

name: Army Professionalism
description: As we learned from the Persian invasion of Greece so long ago, a small army can defeat a larger one — as long as they have iron discipline and the proper training. We must elevate our own army to meet these extraordinary standards.

name: Standing Army
description: Other nations raise armies when war arrives and dismiss them when it ends. We cannot afford that luxury. Our army will be permanent, always trained, always ready, and the storehouses to sustain it will never run dry.

name: The Soldier-King of $PRU$
description: Most states are countries that have an army. $PRU$, on the other hand, is an army that has a country! The many Kings of $PRU$ were soldiers as much as monarchs; each concluded their reign not only by reforming the state but also leaving a lasting impact on the army.

name: $a_prussian_grenadiers$
description: $a_prussian_grenadiers_desc$

name: Cantonment System
description: Every boy born in $PRU$ is born into a regiment. Each province will supply its own soldiers to its own officers, who will know their men by name. When war comes, we will not scramble to fill the ranks, they will already be there.

name: The Goose Step
description: Although it looks rather odd, the 'goose step' is specifically designed to facilitate our men holding their line as they advance towards the enemy. This provides our armies with a tangible advantage on the battlefield.

name: Auftragstaktik
description: #italic Auftragstaktik#!, or 'Mission Tactics'. is a system by which our subordinate leaders are informed about the objectives of the battle or the war by their commanders, and then are allowed to act on their personal initiative. This system allows our battalions to develop a tighter relationship with their leaders, yielding better results.

name: Scharnhorst Reforms
description: Shortcomings due to overconfidence and arrogance can lead to great failures and defeats. Defeat is a teacher, if we are willing to learn. We will purge our army of its complacency, noble birth alone will no longer open the officer ranks, and every soldier must understand not just his orders, but the purpose behind them.

name: $SAV_ADJ$ Diplomacy
description: Due to our precarious location between greater powers, we must rely on our diplomatic skills for survival. By maintaining diplomatic relations even with our most dangerous foes, we will be able to shift our alliances to ensure the endurance of our country.

name: A Unified House
description: $SAV$ has been ruled by a stable line of dynastic counts ever since its creation. By ensuring the unity of our ruling family and maintaining a strong connection to local representatives, we keep our land from being fractured.

name: $SAV_ADJ$ Alpine Identity
description: Nestled in the high Alps, We are a mountain people before we anything. Their therrain and the passes crossing them are our inheritance, our livelihood, and the mountains themselves are our protectors. Generations of living inside the Alps have given our people an unmatched understanding of their heights and geography.

name: Holy Shroud Pilgrimage
description: Our realm is in the possession of a most holy artifact, a piece of cloth that bears the face of Jesus of Nazareth. Naturally, it has attracted numerous pilgrims, all clamoring to see and venerate this extraordinary relic. This constant stream of pilgrimage brings a great deal of wealth into our territory — which is all very much to our advantage.

name: Control Over the Passes
description: The passage over the Alps is troublesome at the best of times, and can be outright impossible with carriages or a larger entourage. By maintaining good pathways, shelters, and waystations, we will be able to dominate the difficult terrain and ensure a steady exchange of merchants throughout our territory.

name: Stand against Heresy
description: Our lands have long suffered under the heretical preaching of the Waldensians. By the force of our will and with the support of the divine, we have been able to contain their influence, and we shall continue to defend the one true faith from these dangerous ideas.

name: A Light in the Darkness
description: We have embraced the teachings of the Waldensian movement and are dedicated to protecting this faith from the vicious $catholic_ADJ$ Church, which seeks to eradicate its ideas.

name: Populate Alpine Valleys
