description: Many people in our realm leave the alpine valleys they were born into to settle in the urban areas on either side of the mountain range. This depopulation leaves the small villages of lesser valleys in a precarious, politically unstable position. We must ensure that the valley lands are sufficiently populated and can be adequately maintained.

name: Experienced Ambassadors
description: We have extensive political experience. The birth of our country was something achieved not only with the power of our military, after all. Surely our diplomatic reputation will prove to be a source of our influence on the world stage.

name: Rise to Equal Heights
description: There are many parts of our country with very low population. We should improve conditions in these regions to ensure that no part of our country is seen as lackluster, and all of it shines equally.

name: Advanced Elephant Warfare
description: It is not uncommon for our greatest poems to dedicate lines of text to list and honor our war elephants individually. Let us show our enemies why!

name: Consolidation of the State
description: A decentralized system may cause us to lose control over our more distant provinces. If we are to be the true unifying realm for the $thai_culture$ people, our provinces must be unified as well.

name: Education Reforms
description: As our Lord Buddha said, we shall not accept something because it is often said, but we need to experience it ourselves. Education is the basis of knowledge, and if we want to excel at technology, we need to excel at education first.

name: Royal Absolutism
description: Second only to Heaven — that is what a ruler should be. Honored and worshipped, our leaders rule over the Earth as the Gods rule over Heaven.

name: $thai_culture$ Unity
description: We are undoubtedly the leaders of all $thai_culture$ people. Our troops are proud to serve as defenders of our culture and identity itself, and they fight fiercely for the privilege.

name: $jaqeli_dynasty$ Dynasty
description: Despite its humble origins, the $jaqeli_dynasty$ dynasty has been able to establish many successful relationships, forging strong ties to the rulers of surrounding states. As such, we have a positive reputation in the diplomatic sphere.

name: Atabegs of $SME$
description: We are not just one part of the Kingdom of $GEO$, as a long time ago we received royal recognition and, with it, the title of Atabeg. This title had previously been granted only to the Armenian vassals, and therefore its conveyance is a sign of distinction and of the respect that the $GEO_ADJ$ monarch has for us.

name: Proactive Diplomacy
description: While still a part of $GEO$, $SME$ operates with substantial independence. This privileged position requires constant diplomatic awareness and a policy of active diplomacy, ensuring that we always have a direct channel to those in power. We do all this while actively engaging in our internal politics, meddling with the succession and forging dynastic alliances as best benefits us. The survival of our relatively small state depends on upholding these diplomatic traditions. Let it never be said that we have done too little or acted without sufficient wisdom!

name: Fortresses of $SME$
description: Our mountainous terrain has acted as a shield against foreign invaders many times. Because of this, we learned to build strong fortresses and to always be prepared for defensive warfare. This legacy of strength and readiness is one we must strive at all costs to uphold — the fortresses of $SME$ must be perpetually well maintained, manned, and supplied, as foreign invaders are not a possibility but a certainty.

name: Independent Ambitions
description: $SME$ has often been obligated to bow to foreign rulers, be they $muslim_ADJ$ or $christian_ADJ$; $georgian_culture$, $turkic_group$, or $iranian_group$. To build an enduring state that survives as an independent entity and can stand against covetous outsiders, we must establish independent institutions: issuing our own coinage, creating our own laws, and patronizing our own theologians and writers.

name: Protect the Trade Routes
description: Our position at the crossroads of $georgia_area$, $anatolia_region$, $armenia_area$, and $azerbaijan_area$ also means that a great number of traders seek to cross our lands. However, the constant threat of being raided by nomadic tribesmen means that some have come to doubt the safety of traveling on our roads. We must properly defend all roads and merchant inns in our nation so that trade revenue can flow into our state treasury unhindered.

name: Frontier Warriors
description: The Caucasus have been shaped by nomadic emperors since time immemorial, but the lush pastures of $SME$ have convinced many tribesmen to settle. We must not let this affect the stability of our kingdom, but instead make arrangements with these settling tribes so that they contribute to our military ambitions in exchange for the lands they claim.

name: A Sacred Land
description: The lands of $SME$ are home to places both sacred and revered among the $georgian_culture$ people. The cave monastery of Vardzia, the ancient church of Atskuri with its miraculous icon of the Virgin Mary, and the Monastery of Ancha with its Anchiskhati icon, are some of the most significant holy places in our realm. By protecting and curating the $SME$ church, setting it apart as distinct from that of $GEO$, we ensure that our people stand united even in the face of adversity.

name: Bridge Between Worlds
description: Our country has always served as a bridge between the $christian_ADJ$ and $muslim_ADJ$ worlds. As such, people of both faiths within our borders have become accustomed to interacting with each other.

name: Breaker of Chains
description: It was not so long ago that we saw ourselves under the $KHM_ADJ$ authority, but we have since gained our freedom, and have taken our rightful place as an independent power. We have earned the admiration of our peers, and their respect.

name: Akson $SUK$
description: Although the $thai_culture$ script is already common to all $thai_culture$ people, it should not be forgotten that it was in our country and under our guidance that it was developed. As such, $thai_culture$ script is not only a unifying force for our culture, but also proof of our individuality and distinctiveness.

name: Birthplace of a Culture
description: We are called the first independent $thai_culture$ kingdom, as we were the first ones to rebel against $KHM_ADJ$ authority and establish ourselves as free from their influence. As such, all $thai_culture$ people look at us in admiration.

name: $name_ram_khamhaeng$ Stele
description: Most of the history of the early $SUK_ADJ$ kingdom comes from inscriptions on the $suk_ram_khamhaeng_stele$, commissioned by the great king to give a record of his glorious reign. The $suk_ram_khamhaeng_stele$ is a sacred piece of heritage and one that surely proves our place in history.

name: Wat Si Sawai
description: We are known for our many gorgeous temples, such as the $suk_wat_si_sawai$, one of the oldest in $sukhothai$. Built under the $KHM_ADJ$ authority as a $hindu_ADJ$ temple, its ensuing repurposing has turned it into a symbol of our identity. The faith of our people is strong.

name: $SUK$ Ceramics
description: Ceramics have been created by the $thai_culture$ people since antiquity, influenced by $chinese_group$ ceramics but always retaining their own distinct style. However, the ceramics produced in our country are most valued, and they are often traded at great distances overseas.

name: Military History
description: Our armies have a long history of victory in combat. As a result, a position in our military is seen as a post of honor and prestige, and there are many willing to serve.

name: Unstoppable Army
description: Many have tried in the past to stop our progress and expansion, but all have failed in the face of our army. It has proved to be an unstoppable force, one that readily crushes any obstacles in our way.

name: Ancient Roots
description: Our ancestors ruled the lands of $tamil_land_area$ for centuries. In these times when we are dominated by foreign invaders, we should rely on our ancient connections to this land to justify our rule.

name: Expert Resistance
description: Our troubled history records both victories and crushing defeats. If we want to endure and dominate as a significant power once more, we must develop a thorough understanding of how to best utilize our native terrain to delay and stall hostile armies until we can mount a direct resistance.

name: Pearl-Diving Expertise
description: Our people have developed an outstanding skill for diving for and harvesting pearls along our coasts. While this has clear economic benefits, the natural affinity our people have for water makes them excellent and easily-trained sailors, granting us an edge against our seafaring foes.

name: Hardened by War
description: Throughout our turbulent history, we never wavered in the face of conflict and insurmountable odds. We need to weaponize this determination, and use it to instill a sense of fervor into our people that will inspire them to fight harder than ever.

name: Imperial Pandyan Legacy
description: The lands of southern $india$ have long endured the incursions of foreign invaders and upstart warlords looking to establish their own domains. We must use the grand history of our ancient dynasty to lay claim to this land, as only we can bring stability and peace back to our rightful territory.

name: $pontic_greek_culture$ Trail Mastery
description: Our land is like our home; its forests, our garden. We know every bit of it better than anyone. Every path and every trail that crosses it is known to us, and we will make use of that knowledge if any dare to invade us.

name: $komnenos_dynasty$ Legacy
description: Let nobody forget that we are the descendants of the $komnenos_dynasty$ that ruled over the $BYZ_ADJ$ Empire. Although we now rule a different state, the legacy and prestige of our dynasty remains undeniable.

name: Empire in Exile
description: We inherit some of the bureaucracy of our former empire, allowing us to maintain order and governance despite our reduced circumstances.

name: Princes of the $laz_culture$
description: The $laz_culture$ have inhabited these lands for centuries. While our Empire was forged by $greek_culture$ people, many $laz_culture$ nonetheless remain within our borders. This has led to some of our enemies calling us $tre_princes_of_the_lazes$ in mockery, regarding us as inferiors. However, no matter what they say, it does not diminish our heritage, and we shall wear the title proudly.

name: Strategic Marriages
description: Kingdoms are conquered not only by the sword. By forging marriage alliances with surrounding nations, we create opportunities to inherit their thrones — and, at the very least, extend stronger influence over them.

name: Grand Komnenoi
description: The $komnenos_dynasty$ dynasty may have been expelled from the $BYZ_ADJ$ throne long ago, but its glory never faded. Members of our lineage are still shown the appropriate deference, and this respect and admiration stretches far beyond our borders.

name: $pontic_greek_culture$ Mountains
description: Much as the Alps separate the $french_group$ and $italian_group$, the $pontic_greek_culture$ Mountains separate our last $greek_culture$ holdout in $anatolia_region$ from the $turkic_group$ invaders who have seized the Anatolian Plateau. Pontus has always been more $greek_culture$ than the rest of $anatolia_region$; perhaps the legacy of the great Mithridates will inspire our warriors and strike as much fear into the Turks as he did the Romans?

name: $BYZ_ADJ$ Birthright
description: The great $BYZ_ADJ$ Empire, under the rule of our forefathers, was truly something to behold. Deceit and treachery may have toppled their regime, but $BYZ$ has risen like the phoenix to reclaim its former glory, and now no one shall doubt our authority!

name: $TRE_ADJ$ Monasteries
description: It is our faith that saves the souls of our people, and our clergy are the ones who ensure their salvation. What,  then, are our monasteries, if not the source and origin of such salvation?

name: $greek_language$ Stronghold
description: Since ancient times, $greek_language$ has been the language of education and science. When our ancestors came here, they not only brought their determination, but also their culture and native tongue. As such, the $greek_language$ tradition of learning is very much alive in our country.

name: Komnenoi Princesses
description: Some remarkable women have emerged from along the $komnenos_dynasty$, and many among the rulers of $europe$ and even the infidels have sought their hands in matrimony. Our line is well-respected, and our princesses doubly so, for they are what allow foreign countries to claim legitimacy through our line, and us to maintain influence in foreign courts.

name: Terminus of the Silk Road
description: Even when it was called Trapezous in the mists of antiquity, our nation was the point where the land route across $asia$ meets the sea route leading to the Mediterranean. We grew famous as the terminal point for the great Silk Road, the wealth of $china$ and $india$ passing through our lands on its way to $europe$. Since our nation still lies in this crucial location, there is no reason for us not to continue and encourage this steady flow of intercontinental trade.

name: Lessons of the Fourth Crusade
description: Isaakios Angelos, who deposed our line centuries ago, was himself deposed and blinded. On the pretense of putting the blind old fool back on the throne, the $VEN_ADJ$ troops then sacked $constantinople$. If there is something to learn from this incident, it is that treason and deceit are ubiquitous in the struggle for power, but they can also safeguard victory.

name: $TRE_ADJ$ Endurance
description: Banished from our country, and yet our line survived. Forced to live in a mountainous wasteland surrounded by enemies, and yet our people thrived. We are a resourceful people, determined to make the most of what we have and to best whatever situation we encounter.

name: Balance the Landstände
description: Our territory is both home to many urban areas and castles of many imperial knights. Balancing them and their often opposing interests is no easy task. Only if they cooperate with us and the cathedral chapter, we can ensure the functionality of our government.

name: $BAV_ADJ$ Dukedom
description: We have been granted the rulership of $BAV$ directly by the Emperor! By embellishing ourselves as the divinely-appointed protectors of $BAV$, we will ensure our legitimacy cannot be questioned.

name: $BAV_ADJ$ Imperial Knights
description: Our nobles have distinguished themselves as formidable knights in the service of the $hre$. We should nurture and scrupulously maintain these troops to ensure the survival of our ducal integrity.

name: Trading Hubs of $BAV$
description: Our lands are frequently crossed by merchants wishing to trade $salt$, $silver$, and $livestock$ in the rich lands to our south. We would be foolish not to take advantage of their presence, and therefore will establish bustling trade hubs in our own lands to attract their business.

name: Skilled Brewers
description: Our lands are rich in the crops and fresh water required to brew beer, and our people readily enjoy this abundance. Many small breweries could grow into successful businesses, with the right support.

name: $BAV_ADJ$ Cultural Institutions
description: With our homeland at the feet of the beautiful Alps, we are a destination for artists from all over $europe$, who seek inspiration in our incredible landscape. If we were to construct and support the appropriate cultural institutions, we could refine our court into a center of refinement and elegance, one that could rival even the most prestigious powers of $europe$.

name: Dreams of Unification
description: We once were ruled by $BAV$, unified in culture and allied under a single banner. We must ensure that the new $BAV_ADJ$ state is equally mighty, a home worthy of its strong and proud people.

name: One Faith for $BAV$
description: We must ensure our people remain united in their faith, and that they will not be divided by heretical thoughts.

name: $BAV_ADJ$ Hofkriegsrat
description: Establishing a council with the sole duty of advising our ruler during times of conflict will help us develop a more capable fighting force.

name: Practical Diplomacy
description: No matter if we are answering to an Imperial overlord or cozying up to a potential foreign ally, our diplomats must be prepared for everything. But only if they keep $BAV_ADJ$ interests first and foremost in their efforts will we be able to claim true success in our diplomatic maneuverings.

name: An Army for $BAV$
description: Only with a formidable standing army will we have the military might necessary to match our ambitions. With careful focus, we can expand it without having a ruinous impact on our state's finances.

name: $BAV$ Coin
description: Our realm needs a new standardized coin to serve as our national unified currency. Establishing a state-owned mint in our capital would ensure our total control over this new coinage.

name: $BAV_ADJ$ Purity Law
description: The excellent quality of our beer has been celebrated for centuries, but for our brews to achieve legendary status, we must ensure their continued prestige and superiority for all time. Several rulers in the past have created regulations and standards for the brewing of this wonderful substance; and we could use this fact as a stamp of our breweries' quality.

name: Experienced Herders
description: Herding animals requires some skill, and is crucial for our survival. If we want to stabilize and expand our rule, we should expand our herding and grazing grounds as well.

name: Builders of $ZMW$
description: The astonishing stone buildings of $ZMW$ impress many visitors to our great country. Continuing our architectural traditions will allow us to expand our great cities of stone, which shall stand tall for centuries.

name: New Grounds for Resources
description: Beyond our borders lie vast expanses of land, studded with resources and herding grounds waiting eagerly to be claimed by our people. We must encourage settlement in these territories, and establish new towns.

name: Rekindling the Royal Fires
description: Our subordinate chiefs must prove their loyalty to us and the gods by traveling to the capital once a year, and using our flames to rekindle their own local fire. Once a year has passed, our army will extinguish their fire, and they will have to make a new journey.

name: $goods_gold$ Trade Restrictions
description: The land provides us with plenty of goods that foreign merchants have a keen interest in, but our abundant reserves of $goods_gold$ shine brighter than any other. While such riches are a blessing, the state must tightly regulate all trade and ownership of $goods_gold$ in order to help prevent the destructive effects of human greed and skullduggery from affecting  our bottom line.

name: Spokesman Before the Dead
description: Our ruler is not only our leader in the temporal sense, but is also expected to speak on our behalf before the spirits of the dead. Prior to any campaign or harvest, he will communicate our respect and needs to the spirits of our ancestors through ceremonies or dances. Without a diligent ruler to maintain the royal graves and keep in close contact with our dead, things might go awry very quickly.

name: Provincial Administrators
description: Traditionally, all of our administrators, even on the local level, have been direct relatives of our ruler. As our empire has grown and matured, however, it is time we show deference to the local knowledge of our subjects, and allow them to select their own administrators.

name: Regular Training
description: Discipline, preparation, and training are the factors that win battles. With this in mind, our commanders have successfully pioneered elaborate new tactics and organizational improvements. Let us make good use of these innovations by dividing our warriors into regiments and having them train regularly with their bows, assegais, daggers, and axes. Practice will also allow them to fight in formation without fear, defeating many more numerous enemies.

name: Mercantile Fees
description: With the arrival of new traders in the Zambezi area, the need has arisen to assert our authority. Anyone who wishes to trade here, and carry our precious $goods_gold$ and $ivory$ to other shores, must first be approved by our ruler and pay a tax in order to be granted access. Should payments lapse, all foreign merchandise will be confiscated by our state.

name: Controlling the Riches
description: Western travelers have named our land 'Ophir', and the riches of our gold mines and the Zambezi trade have made many visitors envious of us over the centuries. Let us leverage our control over these riches, and build permanent trade posts which can grow into sprawling cities.

name: Empowering the Rozwi
description: Our lands are home to many skilled warriors. Among them are the Rozwi, disciplined fighters who stand ready to defend our people against any who would dare try to take our rightful lands from us.

name: Cow-Horn Formations
description: Adapting to the ever-changing tactics of war is no easy task. Against potentially superior enemies, we should rely on our own mobility over everything else. If we are able to pin our foes into a melee fight and send a regiment to flank and encircle their troops, we will be able to inflict devastating casualties.

name: Scouting Parties
description: Through the use of mounted scouts, we can check the terrain lying ahead of armies, and plan how to maneuver around any difficulties. This allows us to travel at a faster rate than other armies could in that same location.

name: Pretexts
description: Our professional diplomats and spies excel at fabricating credible pretexts to justify almost any action we might take on the international stage.

name: Respect Local Government
description: Our people are fearsome warlords who wish to spread their legacy to every corner of the world. As a means of integrating and managing our ever-growing domain, we have decided to mostly respect the way conquered locals conduct themselves, and not to interfere excessively.

name: Raider Troops
description: Raiding and looting is fundamentally how our army sustains itself. Everywhere our troops go, they pillage as much as they can.

name: Armed Envoys
description: Our army is feared far and wide. Despite our reputation, we should still establish diplomatic relations with nations that have the same goal as ourselves: the destruction of our common enemies. By sending well-armed and escorted envoys to foreign courts, we can ensure our diplomatic reach will not suffer under outbreaks of violence.

name: Planned Trade Expeditions
description: Trade with foreign countries is the lifeblood of our nation. By meticulously planning out the trading routes and stockpiling supplies for each voyage, we can reach markets further from our bases.

name: Currency Ownership
description: There are many types of currency in circulation, but the one that bears our seal is the most widely accepted as trustworthy.

name: Emporiums
description: With clever techniques, we can easily make our controlled markets more attractive to foreign merchants, increasing the amount of money we earn in the process.

name: Expanded Trade Depots
description: The growing demands of international trade will need to be accounted for in the planning of our trading endeavors. With this expansion of our trade depots, we can reach new shores without risking our valuable cargo.

name: Agile Exportation
description: Costs to export valuable goods from our controlled markets can be quite high, making our products less attractive. By performing these export actions quicker, we can make our trade more dynamic.

name: Secret Codes
description: It is well known that our activities attract unwelcome attention. If we wish to keep our plans hidden from these curious gazes, we should encrypt our communications.

name: $renaissance$ Building Methods
description: The great edifices and grand statues erected in the past still stand proudly. It is undeniable that the construction techniques used to design and erect them were sophisticated and well-developed. There is still much we can learn from studying them.

name: The Kanun
description: In the absence of a central crown, our social order is maintained by the #italic Kanun#!, a sophisticated code of customary law. This legal framework governs everything from property rights to the sacred duty of #italic Besa#! (the sworn oath). The #italic Kanun#! provides a bedrock of stability and honor that foreign administrators can never fully dismantle.

name: Bjeshkët e Namuna
description: The Accursed Mountains that rise in the heart of our lands are as much a part of our people as the #italic Kanun#! itself. Even the humblest villager knows which passes are passable in winter, which ridges offer shelter from ambush, and which valleys lead nowhere. Invaders who march into these mountains find themselves trapped in a maze by the terrain long before they meet our warriors.

name: The Arbërian Principality
description: As the power of our foes wanes, our great houses have united to ensure the survival of our nation. By leveraging our position between the Catholic West and the Orthodox East, we have become masters of maritime diplomacy and coastal trade. This strategic autonomy allows us to navigate the rivalries of neighbors to our own benefit.

name: Angevin Legitimacy
description: Our latest crowned heads can be traced directly to the lineage of the Capetian House of Anjou, specifically established by Charles I of Naples to serve as his gateway into the Byzantine heartlands. This connection grants us a unique Western prestige among the fragmented Balkan lords, allowing us to claim a seat at the table of the great Catholic monarchs of Europe. By upholding the honors and heraldry of the Lily, we distinguish our sovereignty from that of mere tribal chieftains.

name: Born in the Highlands
description: Our ancestral home in the highlands of our nation is a natural citadel of jagged peaks and narrow ravines that is nearly impossible for a conventional army to navigate. We have further fortified every strategic pass and mountain peak, ensuring that any enemy invader must pay a staggering price in blood for every inch of our territory they attempt to occupy.

name: The Masters of the Karavasta
description: Our domain is protected by the labyrinthine Karavasta Lagoon, where our people have mastered navigation through mudflats and hidden channels. This watery landscape serves as a natural fortress that is nearly impossible for heavy foreign armies to map or conquer, providing a sanctuary that no cavalry charge can reach.

name: Agricultural Wealth of the Devoll
description: The fertile valleys of our heartland allow us to fund a lavish court and a highly trained cavalry force through advanced irrigation. This agricultural surplus provides the economic bedrock for our political ambitions, allowing us to sustain a larger professional retinue than our rivals.

name: French Blood Claims
description: We assert a prestigious, albeit disputed, descent from the French Royalty, granting our diplomats a unique standing in the courts of Europe. This perceived noble pedigree allows us to negotiate as peers with the Italian city-states and the Papacy, securing alliances that would be denied to common Balkan warlords.

name: The Stradioti Tradition
description: The poverty of our mountains has turned our men into the finest light cavalry in Christendom. These Stratioti are sought after by every major power from Venice to France for their unparalleled skills in skirmishing and reconnaissance. By exporting our martial prowess, we bring wealth back to our hills and ensure our soldiers are the most experienced in Europe.

name: Eastern and Western Heritage
description: Our urban centers continue to operate under both the sophisticated principles of Byzantine Law and the modern bureaucracies of the West. This legal continuity provides a stable framework for contracts, property rights, and inheritance that attracts foreign merchants and scholars to our courts. A predictable legal system is the foundation of our growing administrative strength.

name: The National Arsenal
description: As the primary port for Western intervention, we have modernized the shipyards of Durrës to maintain a permanent fleet of galleys. This infrastructure allows us to project power across the Adriatic, ensuring that the sea lanes between Naples and Albania remain open for reinforcements and trade. Our control of the harbor makes us the undisputed masters of the western Balkan coastline.

name: The Iron Mines of the Interior
description: The rugged mountains of central Albania under our control are rich in high-quality iron ore essential for the tools of war. We have established state-sponsored smelters to provide our clans with a constant supply of superior steel blades and armor plates, ensuring we are never dependent on foreign imports to equip our growing armies.

name: The Lagoon Fisheries
description: The biological wealth of our coastal waters provides a stable food supply that supports a larger standing militia even during regional famines. By monopolizing the harvest of the lagoons, we ensure that our population remains healthy and our granaries full, fueling our state's survival.

name: The Despots of Berat
description: Ruling from the Castle of Berat, the 'City of a Thousand Windows', we represent the peak of Albanian urban sophistication and Byzantine-style administration. Our court serves as a magnet for scholars and artisans, turning our capital into a beacon of culture that rivals the grand cities of the East.

name: The Lion of Thopia
description: Our house has risen to preeminence by masterfully navigating the clashes among the clans, positioning the Thopia family as the arbiters of Albanian sovereignty. By weaving together a complex web of alliances, we will secure the first true #italic Princeps Albaniae#! title recognized by both the East and the West. With the lion of our crest flying over the ramparts of the coast, we have established a professionalized administrative core that outpaces the primitive feudalism of our rivals, ensuring our house remains the apex predator of the Adriatic shore.

name: The Sacred Oath
description: The concept of #italic Besa#! has evolved into a national institution of trust and hospitality. An Albanian's word is his bond, and this reputation for unwavering loyalty makes us the most trusted guards and mercenaries in the Mediterranean. In a world of shifting alliances, our word is our most valuable currency.

name: The Champion of Christ
description: Despite our communities being divided by faith, our nation is devoted to Christ, earning us the title of #italic Athleta Christi#!. Our relentless faith has drawn the eyes of the Papacy and the Patriarchs, securing us financial subsidies and military volunteers. We fight not just for our land, but for the very survival of the 'Word of Christ'.

name: The Catholic Bulwark
description: Positioned as the easternmost outpost of the Roman Church, we have become the primary shield against both Orthodox schismatics and Turkish heathens. This sacred duty gives us an inner peace that infuses the entire realm, transforming our struggle into a crusade for our soul.

name: Arianiti's Defiance
description: Following the heroic example of our leaders, our house is known as the first to rise and the last to surrender against our foes. This legacy of unyielding resistance has forged our people into a nation of warriors who see struggle as a sacred duty rather than a burden.

name: Marshland Guerillas
description: We specifically train our levies to lure enemy units into the deep bogs where their armor becomes a liability. In these environments, our light, unarmored infantry reigns supreme through ambush tactics, turning the very earth into a weapon. Our ability to adapt to any terrain and move fast in the worst conditions makes us a dangerous foe.

name: The Muzaka Chronicle
description: Our family keeps meticulous and grand records of our history and territorial rights, ensuring our ancient claims are never forgotten. This literary tradition preserves our high Byzantine titles, overawing local rivals with our imperial dignity and historical depth.

name: A Centralized Levy System
description: We have moved away from loose clan associations toward a semi-professional core of infantry based in our central urban axis. This modernization allows us to respond to threats with a speed and discipline that traditional tribal levies cannot match.

name: The Transhumance Networks
description: The seasonal movement of livestock — Transhumance — allows our people to utilize the high summer pastures and the warm winter plains of the coast. This mobile lifestyle makes our population difficult to pin down and provides a resilient food supply that cannot be easily burned by a scorched-earth campaign. Our wealth walks on four legs, always ready to move to safer ground.

name: The Arbëreshë Diaspora
description: Over time, a good number of our people have emigrated abroad and formed #italic Arbëreshë#! communities. These 'Albanians across the sea' maintain our language and traditions while gaining influence in their new homes. They serve as permanent diplomatic envoys there, constantly lobbying for support for the homeland.

name: Diplomacy of the Two Shores
description: Our position allows us to act as the essential bridge between the Italian city-states and the rugged Balkan interior. Our diplomats are trained to navigate both the Venetian Senate and tribal councils, making our mediation indispensable for trade and war.

name: Patronage of the Faith
description: By providing significant land grants and funds to our monasteries, we maintain the spiritual loyalty of the nobility and the peasantry. These sacred sites serve as the cultural heart of our principality, where our victories are celebrated.

name: The Trade Monopolies
description: By controlling the river mouths and coasts, we can successfully dictate the flow of timber and grain from the interior to Venetian galleys. We have positioned ourselves as the indispensable middlemen of the Adriatic trade, ensuring no merchant can bypass our tolls.

name: Silk Road Waystations
description: Our land sits on the primary trade routes from the interior; by taxing the silk caravans, we maintain a full and prosperous treasury. This revenue allows us to patronize the finest calligraphers and icon painters, turning our domain into the cultural capital of southern Albania.

name: Mecenas of the Arts
description: We have funded the construction of grand cathedrals and fortifications, blending Gothic and Byzantine styles to showcase our wealth and piety. This architectural splendor serves to legitimize our rule in the eyes of the Church and our subjects, turning our cities into symbols of permanence.

name: The Fortified Kulla Houses
description: Throughout the countryside, the nobility and wealthy farmers have constructed #italic Kulla#! — fortified stone tower houses. These structures serve as miniature citadels, protecting families from both blood feuds and enemy raids. They represent a society that is permanently mobilized for defense.

name: The Albanian Merchant Class
description: The merchants of our coast have become the primary carriers of trade between the Balkans and the West. By utilizing the Greek language for commerce and Albanian for loyalty, they dominate the markets from Venice to Constantinople. These merchant marines are the lifeblood of our modernizing economy.

name: The Expansion of the Regnum
description: We will not rest until the borders of the ancient Kingdom are restored to their greatest extent and beyond, reclaiming our place as masters of the Balkans. This centralizing mission allows us to integrate newly conquered territories with minimal friction as we restore 'rightful' rule.

name: The Eternal Resistance
description: We have sworn an eternal oath that so long as we breathe, the heart of the rebellion will continue to beat. Our troops are drilled with a fanatical devotion to our ruling house, ensuring they maintain discipline even in the face of overwhelming imperial numbers.

name: Reclamation Engineering
description: We have begun the process of draining parts of the Myzeqe marshes to create even more fertile farmland. This engineering feat not only increases our tax base but allows us to construct permanent roads through what was once impassable bog.

name: Literary Patronage
description: We have turned our capital into a center of culture, preserving the wisdom of the East and the West for future generations. This intellectual prestige makes our court the destination for the finest minds of the Orthodox and Latin worlds alike.

name: Princeps Albaniae
description: Our name has become synonymous with the state itself, allowing us to integrate various ethnic groups under a single banner. By promoting the most talented individuals regardless of their origins, we have created a meritocratic bureaucracy that outshines our feudal rivals.

name: The Albanian Alphabet Commission
description: Scholars and patriots are working tirelessly to standardize the Albanian language using a unified Latin alphabet. By establishing national schools and printing newspapers in the vernacular, we are breaking the cultural hegemony of foreign tongues. Literacy in Albanian is the first step toward true independence.

name: The Spirit of the Rilindja
description: Our 'National Rebirth' or #italic Rilindja#! has ignited a fire in the hearts of Albanians everywhere, from the mountains of the north to the diaspora in Italy and Egypt. This cultural and political movement has unified all Albanians under the common banner of 'Albanianism'. We are a nation reborn, ready to take our place among the sovereign states of Europe.

name: Enlightened Albanian Absolutism
description: Following the European trend, our monarchs have centralized power, stripping the old clans of their feudal privileges in favor of a modern state. This move has allowed us to implement universal taxation and a national judicial system, turning the kingdom into a streamlined machine of war.

name: The Professional Highland Grenadiers
description: We have evolved our traditional skirmishers into elite mountain grenadier units, specialized in heavy assault and siege warfare. These troops combine their ancestral mountain agility with the devastating firepower of modern explosives, making them the terror of any fortress garrison.

name: The Mataranga Port Authority
description: We have unified all coastal harbors under a single administrative authority, streamlining the collection of dues and customs. This centralization has made us the most efficient trade administrators in the Adriatic, attracting foreign investment.

name: The Muzakan Industrialization
description: We have introduced the large-scale cultivation of cash crops in our most fertile valleys, fueling a new domestic industry. By processing our own raw materials into high-value products, we have created an industrial base that supports a wealthy and loyal urban population.

name: The Thopia Merchant Marine
description: We have expanded our commercial influence by offering state protection to all merchant vessels flying the Thopia banner. This naval security has turned our ports into the preferred hubs for Levant trade, siphoning wealth away from the decaying ports of our rivals.

name: $pukara_building$
description: $pukara_building_desc$

name: $terraces$
description: $terraces_desc$

name: $incamisana$
description: $incamisana_desc$

name: $a_bedouin_cavalry$
description: $a_bedouin_cavalry_desc$

name: Legacy of Hayk
description: Hayk, descendant of Noah, founded our kingdom at the base of Mount Ararat after defeating the Babylonians, and thus became the patriarch of our nation. All our people know this story, and all are proud to belong to such an ancient lineage.

name: Mount Ararat
description: Mount Ararat, where Noah's Ark came to rest after the Great Flood, is where our nation first formed. As a result, our people resist with a particularly holy fervor when the sanctity of our territory is threatened.

name: $ARM_ADJ$ Apostolic Church
description: $ARM$ was the first nation to declare $christian$ as its state religion. As such, our religious traditions, especially those of our clergy, are a major component of our identity.

name: Reclaimed Territory
description: $ARM$ has been ravaged by war for centuries. By reclaiming the lands lost in these struggles, making them suitable for inhabitation, and restoring ruined churches and fortresses, we can improve the lives of our people and take firmer control over our territory.

name: Border Nation
description: Since ancient times, $ARM$ has been the reluctant battleground between larger nations. Even after regaining our sovereignty, remaining neutral is extremely difficult — it is not impossible to appease everyone, but it is not easy, either.

name: Melikdom Organization
description: As one of the few bastions of an independent $ARM_ADJ$ state, $ARM$ is governed by feudal suzerains called #italic meliks#!, as the old system of $arm_nakharar_titles$ collapsed after the $MGE_ADJ$ invasions. The relationship between meliks and their subordinates is that of a military commanding officer and junior officer, and not of feudal lord and a serf.

name: Mountain Armies
description: $ARM$ is a mountainous land. Our people have adapted to this terrain over the centuries, and we have developed many ways to use those mountains to our advantage. Our armies will gather readily when called, confident in the additional protection our unique environment provides.

name: Nakharar Titles
description: The #italic Nakharar#! system of titles was in continuous use in $ARM$ from its inception until the times of the $MGE_ADJ$ invasions, when it collapsed. Although the titles themselves are no longer in use, certain characteristics of that system persist, enhancing the abilities of both our nobles and armies.

name: Greater $ARM$
description: In our long and illustrious history, $ARM_ADJ$ kingdoms spread over a large territory, and so did our $armenian_culture$ people. By emulating these bygone realms, we become a beacon of all $armenian_culture$ people, who will happily unite under our leadership.

name: Highland Fortresses
description: Our fortresses are a brilliant emblem of our resilience and fortitude, built to endure not only the difficult local climate, but also any foreign invader foolish enough to mount an attack into our unforgiving territory.

name: $BNG_ADJ$ Vassal System
description: During the reign of $DLH$, the $bengali$ people served their overlord as productive vassals. The $DLH_ADJ$ system shall serve as the foundation for our own vassal systems for the years of $bengali$ sovereignty to come.

name: $BNG_ADJ$ Paik
description: The #italic paiks#! are the backbone of our military. While other states have the Paik System active and use paiks as their general levies, our state maintains smaller, but very well-organized paiks, and provides them with sufficient military support.

name: $bengali$ Architecture
description: A mixture of ancient urban architecture, $muslim_ADJ$ engineering influences, and traditional $bengali$ roof-building techniques, the unique $bengali$ architectural style is used for religious and cultural buildings of all kinds. Due to our expertise in this style, constructing such buildings is significantly easier and more affordable for us than other nations.

name: Habshi Generals
description: Abyssinian slave-soldiers play a significant role in our military as elite infantry. Those who excel as leaders shall be given greater levels of command, while those who demonstrate exceptional loyalty shall make up the palace guard.

name: War Elephants
description: Although slow, the maneuverability of elephants in the riverine terrain of our country is crucial to quickly resupplying our military. Additionally, war elephants will aid our troops on the battlefield with their imposing stature and terrifying strength.

name: Minting of Rupees
description: The lack of a widely adopted standardized currency is stunting our commercial development. As one of the foremost economic powers on the subcontinent, we are in a good position to begin minting a new silver coinage with standard weights, which we shall call the #italic rupee#!.

name: $BNG_ADJ$ Traders
description: The $indian_ocean_region$ connects our local markets with those of $south_east_asia$ and $china$. We shall therefore greatly emphasize maximizing our presence in these markets via sea routes, and through this increase our trade profits.

name: $bengali$ Poetry
description: The written word is one of the most influential and enduring forms of art. $bengali$ poetry shall tell the tales of epic conquerors, relatable dramas, and engaging philosophical questions, all of which shall further the spread and reputation of $bengali$ culture.

name: Religious Pluralism
description: $india$ is home to many religions: $hindu$ for the majority, $muslim$ as the preferred faith of the ruling classes, and a few remarkable minor religions such as $buddhist$ and $jain$ amongst the working minorities. Promoting one religion over another will cause inevitable chaos and unrest. Thus, we should aim for religious pluralism, and neither favor nor discriminate against any religion in our state.

name: Artillery Corps
description: Cannons are an impactful asset to military campaigns. We must ensure an efficient artillery corps that specializes in dealing damage to the enemy's rows before they even start to clash with our soldiers on the field.

name: $BNG_ADJ$ Trade Fleet
description: The $bengali$ trade fleet brings exotic goods from foreign lands, as well as precious $goods_gold$ and $silver$, to the markets of the Ganges Delta. Our merchants are well renowned in far-flung parts of the world, thanks to our impressive trade fleet.

name: Shipbuilding Industry
description: Maritime trade is vital to our state. Our trade and our warships are some of the most important aspects of our economy, and therefore we focus heavily on supporting the shipbuilding industry.

name: Industrialized Muslin Production
description: $BNG$ is uniquely situated in $india$ to start a revolution unlike any seen before. Muslin — the special cotton fabric $bengali$ spinners are famous for — is a prime trade good for industrialization. We stand poised to exploit new developments in our already world-class textile industry. Let us begin an industrial revolution!

name: Matrilineal Heritage
description: Women in our society are given more reverence and appreciation than in many of our neighboring countries. The birthright of any child comes from their mother's side, and women have a wide array of liberties and social responsibilities.

name: Religious Tolerance
description: Our society is a melting pot of different religious influences. The $buddhist_ADJ$ ideas from $china$, the $hindu_ADJ$ practices from $india$, and the spread of $muslim$ in $south_east_asia$ create a unique environment where religious tolerance is paramount to keeping our society together.

name: $dharmic_ADJ$ Presence
description: The $dharmic_ADJ$ gods bless us with their presence. May their strength guide us through the most difficult of times.

name: Kṣatriya
description: The $cha_kshatriya$ is a term adopted from $hindu_ADJ$ societies, and describes the elite nobles of our state. Given the origin of this term, it follows that our nobility take  similar roles in military and court affairs as their counterparts in $india$.

name: Veteran Shipbuilders
description: Our state relies on maritime dominance to secure its political, military, and economical presence in $indochina_region$. As such, being able to build ships swiftly is of great importance to our survival.

name: Haluwbilau
description: The $cha_haluwbilau$ are elite warriors who occupy key positions in both our land and naval forces. Selected for their talents and bravery, these men lead armies and ships into battle against external threats, and also mediate disputes in local communities.

name: Commercial State
description: Much of our wealth comes from trade. We should concentrate on expanding and refining our exchange practices, with the ultimate goal of creating a commercial state in the process.

name: Boarding Tactics
description: Due to our challenging native terrain, would-be conquerors must rely on their naval capabilities when attempting to invade us. Decades of piracy in the surrounding seas have taught us valuable boarding tactics, which allow us to use an opponent's own ships against them.

name: Towers on Water
description: As a maritime power, much of our wealth and power comes from the sea and our dominance over it. In order to secure this supremacy, our shipwrights have designed special large warships which are known as #italic Towers on the Water#!, hybrid creations between a heavy ship and a galley.

name: $cham_culture$ Cultural Influence
description: Although some of our neighbors see our culture as inferior, they are just in denial, as many of our cultural aspects make their way into their self-proclaimed 'civilized' courts. $cham_culture$ drumming, songs, dances, poetry... all of these art forms have left a clear and lasting mark on what other nations consider artistic achievement!

name: The Machja
description: The Corsican interior, dominated by the dense, aromatic evergreen shrubland known as the #italic Machja#! (#italic Macchia#! in standard Italian: the Scrubland), has become the central pillar of the people's survival strategy. Rather than fighting superior maritime invaders on the vulnerable coasts, the population has developed a culture of 'Strategic Retreat' into the impenetrable granite mountains. This has created a society of highlanders who are masters of concealment and rapid movement through vertical terrain. This cultural adaptation has turned the island's geography into a living fortress for our culture, where the people can preserve their laws and customs indefinitely, safe from the naval reach of any invader.

name: The Pievi
description: The Kingdom has traditionally been divided into #italic Pievi#!, traditional districts centered around a mother church. These were not just religious units but the primary nodes of civil administration. The state has utilized the #italic Pievani#! (parish priests) as royal registrars and judges, creating a highly localized and efficient tax-collection network. This ensures that the Kingdom can mobilize resources from even the most remote mountain hamlets, turning the rugged geography into a structured administrative grid.

name: The Vindetta
description: As past occupiers of our island attempted to impose a rigid legal framework, the Corsican people responded by strengthening their own traditional justice system based on the Vendetta. While viewed as lawlessness by outsiders, this is a sophisticated social mechanism of honor and self-regulation. It creates a culture where the individual is responsible for his own protection and that of his kin, leading to a populace that is universally armed and tactically proficient. This 'Culture of the Long Memory' means that any offense is met with a generational blood-feud. In a national context, this means making the cost of occupation by foreign troops prohibitively expensive in both coin and lives.

name: The Milizia di u Riamu
description: Under our direction, the Corsican clans are formalizing their traditional levies into a structured 'Militia of the Kingdom' as a result of pressure coming from our enemy's maneuvers. This will require a cultural shift from clan-based skirmishing to a national military duty. Every parish will be required to maintain a standardized armory and conduct regular drills. This 'Nationalization of the Sword' will ensure that the island possesses a standing army of citizens who are personally invested in the defense of their homes. It will bridge the ancient gap between the north and south, creating a unified military identity that will be the precursor to modern national statehood.

name: The Castagniccia
description: Past Genoese occupation heavily promoted the cultivation of the chestnut tree, particularly in the central highlands. This has created a unique culture around the chestnut that provides the population with a reliable, low-labor food source that is immune to the grain-price fluctuations of the Mediterranean market. This gives the Corsicans incredible strategic autonomy; they can retreat into the mountains and subsist indefinitely on chestnut flour, making them immune to the standard naval blockades and 'siege by starvation' tactics employed in the past by the Genoese maritime fleets.

name: Capituli de Corsica
description: We will formalize the #italic Capituli#! — written agreements between the central Crown and the rugged mountain communes of the interior. These charters will grant the highlanders specific tax exemptions and the right to local self-governance in exchange for their perpetual military service and loyalty. This is a masterstroke of internal diplomacy that will trade royal authority for absolute loyalty, ensuring that the most difficult terrain on the island is held by a motivated, state-aligned citizenry rather than rebellious feudal lords.

name: Corsican Baroque
description: A wave of Baroque church construction has hit the island, funded by the wealth of returning mercenaries and merchants. These churches are characterized by an 'Austere Grandeur', reflecting the rugged and pious nature of the people. Culturally, this is a display of civilizational defiance — a statement to our neighbors that Corsica is a wealthy, cultured society capable of producing grand monuments. These churches will serve as the primary nodes of social cohesion, where the community gathers to celebrate their distinct identity through choral polyphony and theatrical religious ritual.

name: The Guardia Corsa
description: For decades, Corsicans have been seeking service as elite guards for the Papacy and the kings of France, among others, earning a reputation for unyielding loyalty and ferocity. We will leverage this by incentivizing these veterans to return and train the local militias. This will create a culture of the 'Professional Returnee', where the nation's defense is led by men who have mastered the latest European tactics. This influx of expertise will turn a nation of irregular mountain skirmishers into a disciplined, modern infantry force.

name: Lamentu and Voceru
description: The Corsican culture of oral poetry, specifically the #italic Lamentu#! (#italic Lamento#! in standard Italian: mourning songs) and #italic Voceru#! (#italic Vocero#! in standard Italian: songs of vengeance), has become the primary vehicle for preserving national memory. These songs act as a living archive of the people's struggles and the names of their martyrs. Culturally, this ensures that the spirit of resistance is ingrained in every child from birth, making it impossible for an occupier to 're-educate' or assimilate the population. This oral tradition functions as a powerful psychological weapon, maintaining a state of perpetual high morale and cultural defiance even during the darkest periods of foreign military occupation.

name: U Ginnasiu Corsu
description: To reduce dependency on foreign-educated officials, the Kingdom will establish its first secular gymnasiums and colleges. This will foster a home-grown class of state jurists who are experts in the specific geography and common law of our land. This intellectual boom will be the cradle of the Corsican Enlightenment, producing a generation of administrators who prioritize rational governance and the 'Rights of the People' over ancient clan traditions, preparing the state for modern constitutionalism.

name: Chjam'è Rispondi
description: During the long years of foreign military pressure, the Corsican oral tradition of #italic Chjam'è Rispondi#! (Call and Response) evolved into a sophisticated tool of social cohesion. This improvised poetic competition allowed the people to debate politics, honor their fallen heroes, and mock their occupiers through coded metaphors in the town squares. This all has ensured that the principles of the Enlightenment and the memories of the Revolution remain accessible to even the illiterate segments of society. By encouraging this we will create a unified cultural narrative that is immune to censorship, ensuring that the flame of Corsican identity remains burning bright through every situation.

name: The Corsican Constitution
description: Under our ruler, Corsica will adopt the world's first modern written constitution, which will grant universal suffrage to all property owners. This will foster a culture of 'Enlightened Citizenship', where the Corsican people view themselves as the vanguard of European liberty. This political maturity will allow the state to establish powerful national institutions. The Corsican Constitution will become a 'Beacon of Liberty', influencing revolutions to come and providing the people with a sense of immense pride and historical purpose that will transcend our geographical size.

name: The Maritime Commune Spirit
description: Our culture is defined by the Commune, where every citizen's honor is tied to the prestige of their city. This spirit of urban competition drives our people to build more beautiful cathedrals and faster ships than their neighbors, creating a culture of extreme local pride and innovation. This 'City-State' mentality ensures that our people are highly invested in their local governance and defense, fostering a population that is exceptionally resilient and self-reliant, capable of managing its own affairs even when the central crown is distant or weak.

name: Comune Privileges
description: To secure the loyalty of the coastal cities against Venetian encroachment, we will issue privileges that guarantee the internal autonomy and Latin laws of those comunes (a unit of government). By allowing these cities to elect their own priors and manage their own local taxes, we create a loyal urban class that views us as a protector rather than an oppressor. This decentralized urban defense ensures that the coast is a patchwork of loyal, fortified comunes that can hold out against maritime raids, bringing the coasts and inner lands together.

name: The Statute of 1272
description: To ensure a stable environment for international investment, Ragusa has codified its laws into a comprehensive legal framework that defines property rights and maritime codes. By limiting the power of any single noble and establishing the #italic Consilium Rogatorum#!, we create a predictable mercantile environment that attracts the wealthiest traders of the Mediterranean. This legal clarity allows a small city-state to punch far above its weight, turning a rocky outcrop into a sanctuary of #italic Libertas#! that no feudal lord can easily subvert or ignore.

name: The Cult of the Local Patron Saint
description: Every Dalmatian city is anchored by the intense veneration of its own unique patron — Saint Chrysogonus in Zadar, Saint Domnius in Split, Saint Tryphon in Kotor. These saints are not just religious figures; they are the 'Foundational Sovereigns' of the city. Their feast days are the primary social and political events of the year, uniting all classes in a shared ritual that reinforces the city's independent identity. This intense localism ensures that Dalmatian culture is a mosaic of fiercely independent urban identities, making it impossible for any foreign power to culturally dominate the entire coast at once.

name: The Union of the Two Souls
description: The Dalmatian culture has matured into a truly bilingual society where Latin is the language of the law and Slavic is the language of the heart. This linguistic flexibility allows our people to navigate the complex social strata of the Renaissance Adriatic with ease. By mastering both tongues, our merchants and sailors become the indispensable intermediaries for all trade between the Italian city-states and the Slavic interior. This bilingualism creates a 'Dalmatian Bridge' culture that is uniquely adapted to international trade and diplomacy, ensuring that our people are always at the center of Mediterranean commerce.

name: The Lazzaretto System
description: Facing the recurring devastation of the Black Death, Ragusa has pioneered the world's first mandatory maritime quarantine system on the islands of Mrkan and Bobara. By isolating incoming crews and goods for forty days (quaranta), we protect our urban population while maintaining the functionality of our port when other Mediterranean hubs are paralyzed by plague. This scientific approach to public health ensures that the Republic remains a reliable and clean port of call, preserving our manpower and mercantile networks during even the most lethal periods of European history.

name: The Guild of the Stone-Master
description: The abundant, bone-white limestone of the coast has birthed a culture of master stone-cutters who view the karst as a canvas. Our craftsmen have developed a 'Gothic-Renaissance' style that is world-renowned for its structural innovation and delicate carving. This is not merely art; it is a physical statement of our permanence. By building every church, palace, and city wall from local stone, our people create a landscape that is both beautiful and indestructible, fostering a national pride that views the Dalmatian town as a sacred, eternal monument to our skill that no sea-borne empire can truly erase.

name: The Soldato Dalmantine
description: As we consolidate our rule, we have turned our population into the 'Sword of the Nation'. Our men are recruited into elite #italic Schiavoni#! (Slavic) regiments, serving as the frontline heavy infantry for our wars. This military service provides our people with professional training and exposure to the latest European warfare techniques, creating a culture of career soldiers. While our cities may lose their mercantile edge, our people become the most respected warriors in the Mediterranean, ensuring that our military tradition remains unbroken even under foreign administration.

name: The Arsenal Expansion
description: Our shipyards have become famous for producing the #italic argosy#!, massive carracks capable of surviving the Atlantic and the Indian Oceans. By standardizing our shipbuilding techniques and securing high-quality oak from the Bosnian forests, we ensure that the Ragusan merchant marine is the most technologically advanced in the Adriatic. These vessels are designed for maximum cargo capacity and defensive firepower, allowing our merchants to dominate the spice and silk routes while flying the flag of Saint Blaise in every major port from London to Goa.

name: The High Chancery Style
description: The Dalmatian patriciate has adopted the 'High Dalmatian' literary standard for their private correspondence and diplomatic registries, emulating their Italian Peninsula counterparts. This cultural pivot away from the medieval Latin towards the refined vernacular aligns the coastal cities with the heart of the Italian Renaissance. This shared linguistic aesthetic creates a seamless intellectual bridge with the Venetian #italic Studio#!, allowing Dalmatian poets and lawyers to participate in the most exclusive humanist circles of Italy. This 'Linguistic Refinement' ensures that our diplomats are regarded as cultural peers in any Western court, providing a diplomatic shield based on shared civilization rather than raw military force.

name: Adriatic Oak Galleys
description: Recognizing that the Mediterranean is becoming a sea of fire, we have commissioned a new class of heavy, oak-reinforced oared vessels built in our best shipyards. By utilizing the iron-hard timber of the coastal mountains, these ships can withstand heavier broadsides and are designed to navigate the shallow, rocky karst inlets where large Venetian galleys founder. This superiority allows us to police our own waters and defend our coasts from any enemy.

name: The Collegium Ragusinum
description: To maintain our status as a center of refinement, we have established the #italic Collegium Ragusinum#!, a Jesuit-led institution of higher learning that attracts the sons of Balkan and Italian nobility. By producing a class of highly educated diplomats, scientists, and poets, we ensure that Ragusa's leadership is never outmatched in the courtrooms of Europe. This intellectual investment turns our small city into a center of culture, where the fusion of Latin logic and Slavic spirit produces the scholars who will define the cultural awakening of the entire Adriatic littoral.

name: The Accademia degli Oziosi
description: Modeled after the Italian literary academies, the intellectuals of our cities have founded societies like the #italic Accademia degli Oziosi#! to discuss physics, astronomy, and classical poetry. These 'Idle' scholars are anything but — they serve as the scientific advisors to the naval admiralties, applying the new Baroque rationalism to cartography and ballistics. This cultural institutionalization of curiosity ensures that the Dalmatian urban centers remain the 'Scientific Watchtowers' of the Adriatic, preserving the coast as a hub of European Enlightenment even as the interior of the Balkans remains locked in traditionalist cycles.

name: Morlach Frontier Levies
description: We have integrated the Morlachs — the fierce Vlach and Slavic shepherds of the interior — into a permanent military reserve. These irregulars are granted land rights in exchange for constant readiness, serving as the eyes and ears of the nation. Their intimate knowledge of the karst geography allows us to conduct deep-strike ambushes and night raids that paralyze the enemy's logistics. This creates a 'Nation in Arms' culture in the Dalmatian hinterland, where the boundary between civilian and soldier is entirely erased in the name of our defense.

name: The Ragusan Porto Franco
description: As the wars between our neighbors intensify, we have declared our city a strictly neutral #italic Porto Franco#! (Free Port). By refusing to host foreign warships while offering high-quality repairs and storage to all merchant vessels, we ensure that the conflict only serves to increase our profits. This 'Economic Non-Alignment' makes Ragusa the only safe harbor in a burning sea, allowing us to capture the trade routes that our rivals have abandoned in their pursuit of military glory.

name: Mediterranean Cosmopolitanism
description: Centuries of maritime trade and bilingualism have produced a culture of Cosmopolitanism, where our people are at home in any port from Venice to the Levant. This cultural openness allows us to absorb and adapt the best ideas from across the globe, creating a society that is uniquely flexible and resilient. Our people are the 'citizens of the sea', possessing a world-view that is far broader than that of the landlocked interior. This cosmopolitan spirit ensures that the Dalmatian culture remains vibrant and commercially successful, serving as the 'window to the world' for the entire Balkan Peninsula.

name: Dalmatian Olive Pacts
description: We have pivoted our economy toward intensive agriculture, taking advantage of the climate of the Dalmatian coast. By establishing state-monitored 'Agricultural Pacts', we have reclaimed the coastal hills for large-scale production, turning our rugged land into a green garden of exports. This economic diversification reduces our reliance on the maritime trade and provides a new source of wealth for the coastal nobility, funding the construction of grand summer villas and urban theaters that rival those of the Italian mainland.

name: The Ragusan Maritime Insurance Code
description: We have moved beyond mere shipping to the world of high finance by formalizing one of the first sophisticated systems of maritime insurance. By pooling the risks of our merchant families through the #italic Monte di Pietà#!, we allow our captains to undertake daring new voyages to the Americas and the Far East with minimal personal risk. This financial innovation ensures that Ragusan capital is always in motion, creating a self-sustaining cycle of wealth that keeps our city wealthy and relevant even as the traditional Mediterranean trade routes begin to fade in importance.

name: Al Pô Domâ
description: Living in a flood-prone plain, the Emilian people have mastered the art of river canalization. These are not just for drainage but serve as a renewable energy source for silk mills and grain grinders. This has not only allowed our landlocked cities like Modena and Bologna to function as industrial hubs, transporting goods via artificial waterways to the Po River and the Adriatic Sea, but also tamed the Po river and its destructive floods.

name: The Dòta
description: Bologna became the intellectual laboratory of Europe with the rise of its organized university, the oldest in the world, earning the nickname of #italic La Dòta#! (#italic La Dotta#! in standard Italian: the Learned). Culturally, this moved the society away from feudal trial-by-combat toward a civilian jurisprudence based on recovered Roman Law. This produced a class of professional lay-notaries and judges who could manage complex urban administrations, giving Bologna an unmatched bureaucratic efficiency.

name: The Curtesia
description: As the free communes transitioned into Signorie (Lordships), the Ferrarese court became a center of Late Medieval chivalry. This was a cultural synthesis of French Arthurian legends and Italian humanist wit. It created a sophisticated courtly etiquette that has become the gold standard for European nobility, turning our court into a diplomatic hub where the 'Art of the Possible' is practiced through refined conversation and artistic patronage.

name: The House of Gonzaga
description: For well over a century the #italic Casa Gonzaga#! has ruled Mantua not as conquerors but as lords whose claim rests on a compact of mutual benefit with their subjects — a legitimacy that no merely military power can purchase and that we have maintained by never treating the city as a resource to be extracted. We sustain this standing through three interlocking channels: the church patronage that binds our subjects through shared devotion, the formal dynastic titles that give our rule a legal foundation that rivals cannot challenge, and our deliberate respect for the commune traditions that Mantua's citizens still recognize as their inherited right. This triple foundation of faith, dynasty, and civic compact gives our state a legitimacy that is felt by every subject rather than merely proclaimed from above, and makes our rule more stable than any arrangement built on force alone.

name: The Ancient Commune
description: Before the great dynasties, the cities of the Po plain governed themselves through elected consuls and sworn associations of citizens, building habits of civic organization that no lord has fully displaced. We draw on this inheritance to formalize the relationship between the crown and our urban communities, offering recognized rights in exchange for the taxes and soldiers that sustain the state. This compact between crown and city roots our authority in consent as much as in force, making our subjects partners in government rather than merely subjects of it.

name: The Commune of Parma
description: Parma's tradition of self-governance runs deep, forged in the era of the Italian communes when the city fought alongside its neighbors to defend their liberties against imperial ambition. We draw on this inheritance to structure the relationship between the crown and our urban communities, offering protections and recognized rights in exchange for the taxes and soldiers that sustain the state. This compact roots our authority in consent as much as in force, making our government a more stable and cooperative partner for all who live under it.

name: The Commune of Piacenza
description: Piacenza governed itself as a commune long before any lord arrived to claim it, and the institutions of that self-governance, including the elected consuls, the municipal courts, and the tradition of written statutes enforceable by citizens, survived every change of regime by adapting rather than resisting. We draw on this deep civic tradition to rationalize the administration of our city, reducing the friction that unwritten custom creates and giving the urban population a structure of governance they recognize as legitimately their own. This revival of #italic Communal Institutions#! makes our state more stable and our subjects more willing to meet their obligations without expensive coercion.

name: The Via Emilia
description: Emilian cities shall leverage their position on the Via Emilia (the ancient Roman artery) to establish international trade fairs. We will provide the means for these activities to develop with total security and will standardize weights and measures. This will help us gain the trust of international traders, so that traders from the Alps and the Mediterranean can meet. This trade-centric mindset will allow Emilian states to thrive as essential middlemen in the luxury silk and spice trades.

name: La Grâsa
description: Through the fertile bounty of the Po Valley and the mastery of the Bolognese guilds, our capital will earn a reputation for unparalleled opulence and a second nickname: #italic La Grâsa#! (or #italic La Grassa#!, the Fat One, in standard Italian). By investing in the Quadrilatero markets and the production of refined meats and pastas, we will ensure that every traveler leaves with a full stomach and a lighter purse.

name: Lo Studio di Ferrara
description: The University of Ferrara, founded by the Este and among the first of its kind, has attracted humanists and jurists from across Italy to our court. Under the guidance of eminent scholars, our classrooms become workshops of the New Learning, training the lettered servants and diplomats our growing state requires. This institution ensures that knowledge and new institutions spread faster through our lands than in any realm that relies on war alone.

name: Gonzaga Patronage of the Arts
description: Our court has become one of the great magnets of artistic talent in the peninsula — painters, sculptors, and architects arrive already knowing that Mantua rewards ambition and that the work produced here will reach the eyes of every prince who sends an envoy to our door. We formalize this tradition of patronage into a deliberate policy, maintaining stipends and workshops that keep multiple artists resident at once and ensuring that the work they produce reflects the standing we intend to project. This culture of #italic Mecenatismo#! reduces the cost of maintaining artists and draws talent of the highest quality to settle permanently among us rather than passing through for a single commission.

name: Este Textile Craft
description: The workshops of Modena have long produced silk and wool cloth of a quality that commands premium prices at the great northern fairs. Under our patronage, we deepen this tradition by protecting the guild practices that concentrate weaving expertise within our walls and ensuring that the most skilled artisans train their successors. This investment in craft turns our merchants into trusted suppliers to the courts of Europe and brings steady returns to our treasury that do not depend on the fortunes of war.

name: The Bishop of Parma
description: The #italic Bishop of Parma#! has long wielded an authority that rivals the secular power in this city, guiding its spiritual life through some of the most remarkable religious buildings in northern Italy. We choose to align ourselves with this institution rather than resist it, channeling its influence toward the stability and devotion of our people. This partnership between crown and church strengthens the faith of our subjects and gives our government a source of moral authority that no military force can easily replace.

name: The Collegium Placentinum
description: The tradition of legal learning in Piacenza predates the great universities of the region — it was from our city that glossators and jurists spread across the peninsula, carrying a deep knowledge of Roman law that formed the intellectual foundation of Italian governance for centuries. We revive this tradition by establishing a formal collegium dedicated to law and civic administration, drawing students from the city's burgher families and producing a trained administrative class capable of managing the legal and fiscal apparatus of a modern state. This #italic Collegium Placentinum#! raises the literacy and competence of our governing class and gives our legislation a clarity and consistency that looser institutions cannot achieve.

name: Dispenza Emigliàna
description: The Emilian courts have developed a culture where each chef acts as an ambassador of the region. Our region's unique products (balsamic vinegars, cured hams, and aged cheeses) are used to woo foreign monarchs. This strategy of conquering through the palate will ensure that we are always influential in the courts of Europe, securing alliances through the sheer exclusivity and quality of our premium foods.

name: La Råssa
description: #italic La Råssa#! (the Red, or #italic La Rossa#! in standard Italian), as Bologna is also known, celebrates the crimson soul of our skyline; the ancient terracotta brickwork and the defensive sea of red rooftops seen from the Asinelli Tower inspire awe in our subjects and defiance against our foes. Red is becoming so associated with our city that we must start creating laws to make sure that anything not currently in our preferred palette is rebuilt in red terracotta as soon as possible.

name: L'Adizión Erculéa
description: Ferrara has originated the concept of the 'Ideal City'. Instead of organic medieval growth, the state will implement large-scale, planned urban expansions with wide boulevards and symmetrical plazas. This will be the first example of modern urban planning in Europe, designed to reflect the order and majesty of the state. It will improve public health, facilitate military movement, and make Ferrara the most modern and prestigious nation in the West.

name: The Studium Mantovano
description: We establish a formal studium in Mantua, drawing teachers of law, philosophy, and the arts from the great universities of the region and providing the sons of our burghers and minor nobility with an education that was previously available only to those wealthy enough to travel to Bologna or Padua. The institution links Mantua to the network of European learning that flows through the great schools, bringing the latest ideas in jurisprudence, theology, and natural philosophy into our city rather than letting them arrive years late through correspondence. This #italic Studium Mantovano#! raises the literacy of our governing class and ensures that new ideas take root among us as quickly as they spread anywhere in Italy.

name: The Estense Library
