This theatre gives $VEN$ a stage on which the Republic's taste, wealth, and ambition are on display every night, reaching an audience of nobles, travellers, and critics whose admiration travels further than any diplomatic dispatch.

name: The Grand Tour
description: Verona has become a destination that the educated aristocracy of Europe cannot complete their travels without visiting — English lords, French scholars, and German princes make their way to the Arena, the Roman theatre, and the Gothic tombs of the Scaligeri, spending freely and writing the city into the correspondence of every court on the continent. Their accounts turn Verona into a byword for Italy's layered heritage, a city where Roman, medieval, and Renaissance civilization can be read in a single afternoon's walk through streets that belong to no single century. This steady stream of wealthy and influential visitors enriches our treasury, opens diplomatic conversations that our size alone would never invite, and builds a reputation for civilization that travels far ahead of our armies.

name: The Paduan Commune
description: The oldest municipal institutions of our city — the elected councils, the written statutes, the tradition of citizen participation in public decisions — have never been fully extinguished, even through the decades of seignorial government that placed a single family above them. We revive and formalize these communal structures, giving our merchants and burghers a recognized role in civic governance and restoring the sense that the city belongs to all its citizens rather than its rulers alone. This #italic Comùn Padovàn#! (#italic Comune Padovano#! in standard Italian: Paduan Commune) channels the energy of our most active citizens into institutions that serve the state, increasing the tax revenue that flows from a population that believes in the legitimacy of what it pays into.

name: $vietnamese_culture$ Architecture
description: Though influenced by the $chinese_group$, our architecture remains distinct and unique to our state. While still following the concepts of Fēng Shuǐ, many typical $chinese_group$ elements have been left out or adapted to our unique environment.

name: $dai_tran_hung_dao$ Tactics
description: $dai_tran_hung_dao$ was an Imperial Prince of $DAI$ long ago. He served as officer during the first $MGE_ADJ$ invasion of $DAI$ in 1258, and as leading commander during the second war against the $MGE_ADJ$s in 1285 and their third attempt in 1287. During these bloody conflicts, $dai_tran_hung_dao$ managed to develop tactics which reliably repelled the oncoming onslaught of cavalry.

name: Nhã Nhạc
description: The $dai_nha_nhac$ is the traditional music played at our courts and performed at annual ceremonies. It is a prominent aspect of our culture, and a pillar of our traditions.

name: Confucian Administration
description: Our state bureaucracy is obviously of the utmost importance, and as such, we select only the most capable administrators to hold government office. Learned in the Confucian texts of $CHI$, these bureaucrats ensure smooth and stable bureaucratic operations.

name: Giao Chỉ Arquebus
description: The $dai_giao_chi_arquebus$ is a staple of our military. Self-produced and adapted to the specific needs of our troops, this type of arquebus gains praise from not only $chinese_group$ people, but also Western observers.

name: Ca Trù
description: The $dai_ca_tru$ is a $vietnamese_culture$ genre of musical storytelling which serves both entertainment and religious purposes.

name: Trading Contracts
description: Our existence has been shaped by $CHI$ for too long. To leave our own mark on the world, we must expand our reach beyond the $chinese_group$ sphere of influence.

name: Literary Reform
description: For centuries, we used $classical_chinese_language$ to write our documents. However, the script used to write our language is Chữ Nôm, a native script based on Chữ Hán, the script of $classical_chinese_language$. Chữ Nôm was non-standardized and not used often enough compared to $classical_chinese_language$, so there has been some pressure to reform the script and make it more suitable for our administrative purposes.

name: Đôn Điên
description: The $dai_don_dien$ is a system which utilizes military colonies, in which soldiers and landless peasants clear the area for the establishment of new villages. These villages are then incorporated into our administrative system after three years, and the people who cleared the land may then claim and work it.

name: Thuận Thiên
description: $dai_thuan_thien$, or Heaven's Will, is the name of the legendary sword wielded by our liberator, Lê Lợi. According to the tales, the sword gave him the strength of a thousand men, enough to finally throw off the yoke of $CHI_ADJ$ rule. Many in our country look upon Lê Lợi as the perfect embodiment of the ideal leader.

name: The Drailles
description: The ancient seasonal routes that shepherds use to move their flocks between highland summer pastures and lowland winter grazing — the #italic drailles#! — are among the most carefully maintained paths in the region, crossing passes and valleys in patterns refined over centuries. The communities along them have developed systems of collective grazing rights, waypoint shelters, and dispute arbitration that turn transhumance from a seasonal risk into a reliable cycle of production. This managed seasonality of the pastoral economy gives our highlands a food-producing capacity that purely sedentary agriculture cannot match.

name: The Alpine Passages
description: The mountain passes that cross through our lands connect the plains of Italy with the highlands beyond, and we have learned to profit from every traveler and merchant who must pass our gates. Control of the #italic Alpine Routes#! gives us a leverage that no army alone can provide, and we use it to sustain friendships on both sides of the mountains. This geography is our greatest inheritance.

name: Alpine Infantry
description: The mountain terrain has bred a tradition of light, mobile foot soldiers who could fight in conditions that make cavalry and heavy armor useless — men who need no road, no level ground, and no supply line longer than their own backs can carry. The valleys of our culture produce soldiers accustomed to cold, altitude, and sudden ambush, capable of holding narrow passes against forces many times their number. This tradition of alpine warfare gives our armies a quality in difficult terrain that opponents trained on the open lowland battlefield are consistently unprepared for.

name: The Mountain Routes
description: The trails and roads that thread through our mountains are known to us as no outsider can know them, and this knowledge shapes how we move and supply our armies. Our soldiers march along paths that would leave foreign troops exhausted and disoriented, arriving fresh where others would arrive worn. This intimate mastery of the #italic Alpine Terrain#! is a form of strength no fortress can replace.

name: The Alpine Passes
description: Mont Cenis, the Col de Montgenèvre, the Col de Larche — the great transalpine routes connecting the Mediterranean world to northern Europe all pass through our territory, making even modest lords the indispensable gatekeepers of international movement. Merchants, armies, papal legates, and pilgrims all pay to cross our ground, and the traffic that passes through our hands gives us information, contacts, and leverage that purely inland powers could never accumulate. This position as the crossroads of transalpine exchange makes our diplomacy unusually well-informed and our merchants unusually well-connected.

name: The Saluzzo Chronicles
description: Our court has fostered a distinctive literary tradition that weaves together the languages and voices of both sides of the mountains, producing chronicles and verse of surprising richness. The #italic Occitan and Italian tongues#! mingle in our writings as they do among our people, creating something that belongs to neither tradition entirely. This chronicle of who we are preserves our identity in letters that outlast stone.

name: Herbes des Alpes
description: The alpine flora of our region provides us with an extraordinary pharmacopoeia — gentian, arnica, valerian, and dozens of others — and the communities here have developed traditions of herbal preparation and botanical knowledge that keep these isolated valley populations healthier than their lowland counterparts. This is the result not of folk magic but systematic observation, transmitted from generation to generation in the form of practical recipes and the accumulated memory of what had worked and what had not. These #italic Herbes des Alpes#! give our healers tools that the physicians of great cities, dependent on imported remedies, cannot easily replicate.

name: The Alpine Strongholds
description: We have fortified the natural strongpoints of our mountains with walls and towers that make our land a nightmare for any invader who seeks to hold it by force. Every valley approach leads to a defended pass, and every pass to a #italic Hilltop Citadel#! that must be taken before any advance can continue. Any army that enters our lands uninvited will find the mountains themselves arrayed against them.

name: Valley Councils
description: The isolation of our mountain communities has forced them to develop functional self-governance long before larger states thought to organize them — village councils managing collective pastures, local courts arbitrating disputes, and elected officers coordinating the resources that kept valley communities alive through the winter. These institutions run on knowledge of local conditions that no governor sent from outside could replicate, and they have accumulated over generations a tradition of deliberation and record-keeping that gives our communities an administrative depth disproportionate to their size. This #italic Conseilh de Valat#! tradition makes our governance unusually competent and our subjects unusually engaged in the management of their own affairs.

name: The Alpine Regiments
description: Our soldiers have been forged in the hard school of mountain warfare, where endurance and discipline matter more than numbers and where every man knows the value of his comrades. The #italic Highland Regiments#! of our marquisate have built a reputation for steadiness that makes them sought after even when our state is not at war. This tradition of arms is the shield behind which our people have always stood.

name: Alpine Nature
description: Rousseau's idealization of mountain simplicity, followed by the poets and painters of the Romantic movement, transformed the Alps from a barrier to be crossed into a destination to be sought. Our valleys, peaks, and ancient communities became mirrors for everything that educated Europe felt it had lost, drawing visitors, naturalists, and artists in numbers that the passes had never seen for any other reason. This reputation for embodying a kind of unspoiled authenticity gives our culture an influence far beyond what our political weight could command — people come to us to understand themselves, and they carry home memories that outlast any treaty.

name: The Alpine Crafts
description: The highland villages of our marquisate have long sustained themselves through skilled craftsmanship, producing goods of quality that find their way into the markets of the plains below. The knowledge of our artisans is passed within families and guilds, ensuring that each generation inherits the #italic Alpine Craft Traditions#! intact. This industry sustains the prosperity of our communities and earns our highland towns a reputation for quality that outlasts any political upheaval.

name: Griots
description: The #italic griots#! are storytellers, historians, counselors, musicians, and poets all at once. They safeguard the stories and legends of past generations, mediate between warring parties, and serve both their rulers and local people as advisors.

name: Saharan $caravan_stop$
description: Trade between sub-Saharan $africa$ and $north_africa$ has been part of our identity for centuries. The journey across the vast desert, even with the many years of accumulated experience, is always taxing and dangerous. The key to securing trade in this region is the $caravan_stop$, a place where merchants and their caravans can rest and refresh themselves on their way through the desert.

name: Sudano-Sahelian Architecture
description: The grasslands, savannas, and deserts of $west_africa$ provide few resources suitable for construction projects, so we have made the best of what we can get. The usage of mudbricks and adobe plaster reduces the cost of buildings significantly while also giving them a distinct style that is pleasing to the eye.

name: Infiltrate Administration
description: Conflicts with other states are not only fought on the battlefield, but in the shadows as well. Knowing the enemy's next move is an invaluable asset when trying to win wars. Our spies shall specialize in infiltrating state administrations, and forward any relevant information they gather to us.

name: Cossack Raids
description: Our Cossacks live in a near-permanent state of war, and have adopted pillaging and raiding tactics similar to those of the $MGE_ADJ$ hordes. Although that will surely not earn us many friends, it will decidedly enrich our coffers.

name: Tamed Steppes
description: Although most people would qualify the steppes as inhospitable and even worthless land, our Cossacks have adapted to the harsh environment, and are able not only to survive but to thrive in the wilderness. Thanks to their expertise, we are able to exploit those lands and benefit from them.

name: Cossack Recruitment
description: The Cossacks are fearsome warriors, and their skill in surviving in the unforgiving wilderness of the steppes is almost unmatched. There is a place for them in our state as well as our military, as an elite force that will enforce our lordship over the steppes.

name: Escaped Serfs
description: Many Cossacks were born into serfdom. Tired of feudal oppression, they fled their masters, and sought lives of freedom on the steppes. We must continue to welcome these escaped serfs into our society.

name: Cossack Hetmanate
description: There are no kings or khans among the Cossacks. They are led by the #italic ataman#!, who is their highest military commander, but in matters of state and society simply the first among equals. Political power lies in the Rada, the legislative and military assembly, in which all Cossacks can have their say.

name: Cossack Administration
description: By granting our Cossack leaders dual roles as both generals and administrators, we will be able to streamline army recruitment, and ensure a high training standard.

name: Steppe Riders
description: The steppes are a peculiar and treacherous place to live. When you enter the Endless Sea of Grass, your horse stops being an animal or piece of property, and truly becomes a part of you. Just as your body cannot survive without a heart or a liver, in the steppes it certainly will not survive without a horse. But the good news is that those who find themselves in that situation will find countless interesting ways to perish...

name: Cossack Exploration
description: Our Cossacks live at the edges of our country, making them excellent candidates to serve as explorers and go beyond our borders to the final frontier, to explore strange new lands, to seek out new countries and new civilizations, to boldly go where no one has gone before...

name: Military Society
description: There is almost no division between civil and military society among the Cossacks. They are a host, defined by their people rather than by the land they control, and their people are warriors. We must ensure that military divisions properly meet our administrative needs as the host expands.

name: Cossack Serf Autonomy
description: No man should suffer tyranny among the Cossacks. When we conquer new territories, the serfs, peasants, and slaves there will be treated as equals to our own people.

name: Cossack Colonization
description: Our Cossacks are already used to roaming freely and going beyond our borders. We can use them to advance further settlement, and thus expand our influence to those unclaimed lands.

name: Cossack Registers
description: As the ranks of our Cossacks swell, we must keep account of the strength of each regiment, their numbers, and how well they are supplied. A centralized registry will allow us to support the needs of all Cossacks.

name: Fearsome Reputation
description: Our Cossacks have already built for themselves a reputation of fierce warriors. That in itself is enough to instill fear in the hearts of our enemies when they have to face them in battle.

name: Frankokratia
description: The original division of the Byzantine Empire in 1204 remains our legal foundation, granting us permanent, divinely sanctioned claims on the remnants of the Greek world. We do not view ourselves as conquerors, but as the rightful heirs to the fiefs assigned to our ancestors by the Latin Emperor and the Venetian Doge. This legal certainty allows us to pursue a relentless policy of expansion and reclamation against any local lords who refuse to acknowledge our feudal suzerainty.

name: Assizes of Romania
description: The feudal laws of the Frankish East are the most refined in the Catholic world, having been codified to manage a complex web of Greek serfs and French lords. These #italic Assizes#! provide a clear legal framework for land disputes, inheritance, and military obligations, ensuring that even in times of war, the social order remains unbreakable. Rigorous adherence to these laws prevents the internal fractures that destroyed the first Crusader states, providing a rock-solid foundation for governance.

name: The Peloponnesian Diplomatic Hub
description: Because Argos is the most neutral and secure port in the Peloponnese, it has become the preferred meeting ground for the ambassadors of the Latin states. We have established a permanent 'Diplomatic Quarter' where treaties are negotiated and alliances are forged between the Frankish lords and the Great Powers. This role as a regional mediator grants us an international influence that protects us from being annexed by our larger neighbors.

name: The Catalan Company
description: After being hired and then betrayed by the Byzantine emperor, the ferocious Catalan Grand Company turned against their former paymasters and, in 1311, annihilated the Frankish duke Walter V of Brienne at the Battle of the Cephissus, seizing control of the Duchy of Athens and establishing a period of Catalan rule. These battle-hardened Almogàvers introduced a more ruthless mercenary ethos to Greek affairs, fortifying key strongholds, extracting tribute from the countryside, and maintaining their grip through a combination of terror and disciplined infantry tactics until internal strife and Aragonese intervention eventually shifted power back toward a more conventional feudal regime.

name: Guardians of the Thermopylae
description: Our fief sits upon the most famous pass in history, and we have taken the lessons of Leonidas to heart by fortifying the mountain tracks with Frankish stone. Every narrow path is a deathtrap for the invader, and every cliffside is a vantage point for our archers and scouts. To pass through Bodonitsa is to run a gauntlet of steel, ensuring that the heart of Greece remains shielded from northern threats.

name: Cephalonian Raids
description: The rulers of Cephalonia and Zante have developed a long tradition of raiding any enemy vessel foolish enough to sail without adequate protection through the Ionian approaches. These island-based raids amass considerable wealth through plunder and ransom while simultaneously weakening our enemies' naval logistics in the western Aegean, thereby allowing the tiny county to punch far above its weight and preserve its independence.

name: The Trapete of Messara
description: We have expanded the cultivation of sugarcane in the fertile Messara plain, building advanced water-powered mills (Trapete) for refining. Cretan sugar is now a luxury sought after by the courts of Europe, competing directly with the products of the Levant. This industrial-scale agriculture provides the crown with the gold needed to fund its naval supremacy.

name: Emperor of the Latins
description: With the #italic Frankokratia#! united under our rule, our court now meticulously blends the rigid, martial feudal hierarchies of the French and Occitan tradition with the ancient, intricate ceremonies of the Greeks. By adopting the purple robes and the dignity of the East, we command the spiritual respect of our Greek subjects while maintaining the chivalric loyalty of our Western knights. This synthesis transforms the Emperor from a mere foreign conqueror into a legitimate successor of Constantine, recognized by the Pope and feared by our enemies.

name: Sanudo's Isles
description: Marco I Sanudo, a Venetian noble who participated in the Fourth Crusade, seized the Cyclades archipelago in 1207 and founded the Duchy of Naxos, creating a maritime feudal state whose lords ruled from fortified island citadels and drew income from trade, piracy suppression, and the fertile valleys of Naxos, Paros, and Santorini. By blending Venetian commercial instincts with Frankish feudal organization, the Sanudo dynasty has maintained a semi-independent duchy that serves as a vital link in the Latin trade network, protecting shipping lanes while extracting tolls and offering safe harbors to Crusader, Genoese, and Venetian vessels alike.

name: The Negropontine Navarchy
description: The triarchs of Negroponte divided the lordship of the long island among three families, yet managed to maintain a unified naval policy that dominates the narrow Euripos channel and extracts tolls from every vessel passing between the Aegean and the northern ports. Their galleys, crewed by a mixture of Frankish knights, Greek mariners, and Italian mercenaries, patrol the straits with ruthless efficiency, ensuring that Negroponte remains one of the wealthiest and most strategically vital outposts of the Frankokratia.

name: Neopatras Fortresses
description: In the mountainous frontier of southern Thessaly, the lords of Neopatras — first Brienne and later Aragonese — constructed and repeatedly strengthened one of the most formidable castle complexes in Frankish Greece, turning the ancient city into a virtually impregnable stronghold that withstood repeated sieges by their enemies. These towering walls, deep ditches, and cleverly situated outworks became a symbol of Latin tenacity, allowing a small but determined garrison to project influence deep into central Greece and delay the northward advance of hostile powers for generations.

name: Salona's Stance
description: The mountain lords of Salona, perched around the ancient site of Delphi and controlling the strategic passes into central Greece, maintain a fierce independence through a combination of rugged terrain, stout fortifications, and a martial tradition that draws fighting men from across the Frankokratia. Even as larger states collapse, the lords of Salona repeatedly defy their enemies, turning their highland fief into a safe refuge of Latin knighthood in Greece and a persistent irritant to every power that seeks to dominate the region between the Corinthian Gulf and the Spercheios valley.

name: The Church-State of Saint Andrew
description: As the spiritual heart of the Frankokratia, Patras has evolved into a sovereign ecclesiastical principality similar to the Prince-Bishoprics of the Holy Roman Empire. The Archbishop wields both the crozier and the sword, ruling his lands through a #italic Synod of Defense#! that merges religious law with feudal military obligation. This unique status allows us to mobilize the peasantry through religious fervor, viewing every border skirmish as a localized Holy War.

name: The Thessalonican Crown
description: Boniface of Montferrat, crowned King of Thessalonica in 1204, established a northern Latin kingdom that controlled the vital Via Egnatia and much of Macedonia, creating a wealthy and strategically important realm whose capital became a glittering center of Frankish court life, Italian commerce, and Orthodox–Catholic coexistence under Latin domination. Although repeatedly threatened by surrounding enemies, the kingdom's barons maintained a proud martial tradition and a flourishing economy based on grain, wine, and transit trade, ensuring that Thessalonica remained one of the brightest jewels in the Frankokratia.

name: Synthesized Levies
description: To maintain power against overwhelming odds, we have integrated the local Prónoia system — granting land in exchange for military service — with the Western tradition of knightly tenure. This creates a hybrid martial class of #italic Latinikon#! who are loyal to the Latin Crown, but intimately familiar with the rugged Greek terrain and Eastern tactics. These soldiers combine the heavy shock of the Frankish charge with the endurance and skirmishing capabilities required to hold the Balkan frontiers.

name: Morean Silk
description: The Peloponnese remains the heart of European silk production, a legacy of the Byzantine era that the Frankish Princes have expanded through state-sponsored mulberry groves. By controlling strategic ports, we can undercut the high prices of Persian and Chinese imports, making Achaea the primary supplier for the garment makers of Florence and Lyon. This monopoly provides a steady stream of #italic Soft Gold#! that funds our mercenaries and the fortification of our mountain passes.

name: The Heraldry of the Brienne
description: As the House of Brienne maintains claims to Jerusalem and Cyprus, Argos has become a center for 'Chivalric Genealogy'. Knights from across the West come here to prove their lineage or seek titles in the 'crusader fringe'. This constant influx of high-born adventurers provides a rotating pool of talented officers for our local levies.

name: Thebes' Textiles
description: The workshops of Thebes, already renowned in Byzantine times for their silk-weaving, have flourished anew under Frankish rule as the dukes of Athens encourage Italian merchants to invest in looms, dyeworks, and export networks that carry Theban samites and velvets to markets from Bruges to Alexandria. This revival of luxury textile production, combined with the fertile plains of Boeotia that supply raw materials, generate substantial wealth that funds castle-building, knightly retinues, and the lavish lifestyle of the Athenian court, ensuring that the duchy remains one of the richest and most economically sophisticated territories of the entire Frankokratia.

name: The Curia of the Three Keys
description: To manage the wealth generated by the resurgence of the northern trade routes, the Marquisate has established the #italic Curia of the Three Keys#!. The state treasury and the legal archives are locked in the citadel of Bodonitsa, requiring three separate keys held by the Marquis, the Latin Bishop, and a representative of the local Greek burgesses. This primitive but effective system of 'Checks and Balances' prevents the embezzlement that often plagues small feudal states, ensuring that the heavy tolls collected at Thermopylae are actually spent on the fortress walls.

name: Ionian Sea-Wall
description: As the lords of Cephalonia, Zante, and Ithaca, we sit at the crossroads of the Adriatic and the Mediterranean, acting as the first line of defense for Italy. Our naval strategy focuses on 'Anti-Access' warfare, using heavy fortifications and fast scouting vessels to deny the enemy the ability to harbor in the Ionian Isles. We are the gatekeepers of the West, and no fleet enters the Adriatic without our silent consent.

name: The Galley Assembly Line of Suda
description: By standardizing the parts used in the construction of light galleys at Suda Bay, we have pioneered an early form of modular shipbuilding. This allows us to replace lost vessels at a fraction of the time and cost of other Mediterranean powers. A ship built in Candia is recognized for its speed and its ability to navigate the treacherous currents of the Cretan Sea.

name: Hegemony over the Bosphorus
description: Dominating the narrow gates of the Black Sea allows us to levy heavy tolls on the Italian merchant republics that once dictated our fate through debt and naval blockade. The wealth of the Pontic grain trade and the Silk Road's northern terminus now flows directly into the Imperial coffers rather than Venice or Genoa, funding our restoration. We have turned the Golden Horn from a den of foreign merchants into the beating heart of a centralized, sovereign economic powerhouse.

name: Achipelagic Vigil
description: The scattered islands of the Aegean demand constant vigilance from their Latin rulers, who maintain fleets of light galleys to patrol against pirates, raiders, and rival Italian maritime powers. The dukes of Naxos and their vassals have developed a sophisticated system of island garrisons, signal fires, and swift courier vessels that allow them to respond rapidly to threats across the archipelago, while the wealth extracted from trade protection and harbor dues enables the construction of sturdy coastal fortresses that make the Cyclades one of the most secure regions of the Frankokratia, a maritime bulwark.

name: The Three Fold-Defense
description: The island of Euboea is divided among three #italic Terzieri#!, or Triarchs, creating a competitive yet unified defensive structure that prevents any single lord from becoming weak. This tripartite system ensures that if one fortress falls, the other two mobilize instantly, creating a redundant and resilient military administration. This internal rivalry keeps our garrisons at peak readiness, as no Triarch wishes to be outdone by his peers.

name: The Consulate of the Sea
description: Using our connections to the Crown of Aragon and the merchants of Barcelona, Neopatras has become the primary entry point for Iberian goods into the Levant. We operate a #italic Consulate of the Sea#! that provides legal protection and standardized weights for all Catalan and Spanish traders. This special relationship makes Neopatras the wealthiest outpost of the Western Mediterranean in the heart of Greece.

name: The Pilgrimage Tolls
description: The purported relics of Saint Andrew attract thousands of Catholic pilgrims who seek safety in the East, and we have established a network of fortified 'Hospices' to protect them. By charging a modest 'Protection Fee' for passage and lodging, the Archbishopric funds the maintenance of a standing army of Crusader-Monks. These funds are also used to beautify the city, making Patras the 'Rome of the East' and a beacon of Latin architecture.

name: The Parnassus Mines
description: Deep within the rugged mountains of our lordship lie veins of metals that have been forgotten since the days of the Delphic Oracle. By bringing in Saxon mining experts and applying Western smelting technology, we have turned the #italic Mount of the Muses#! into a center of heavy industry. The wealth extracted from these mines allows the Lords of Salona to maintain a court that rivals the Dukes of Athens in elegance and power.

name: The Fair of Saint Demetrios
description: We have expanded the ancient religious fair into a massive international trade expo that links the Balkan hinterland with the Mediterranean maritime routes. By granting safe passage to merchants, Thessalonica has become the premier marketplace for fur, grain, and Western textiles. This economic vitality allows the King to bypass the local nobility by funding his administration through sales taxes and customs duties.

name: Union of the Soul
description: By installing a Latin Patriarch who respects the ancient Greek liturgy and the Julian calendar while acknowledging Papal supremacy, we bridge the Great Schism within our borders. This #italic Uniate#! compromise stabilizes the realm by allowing the Greek peasantry to keep their ancestral rites while ensuring the urban elite remains tied to Rome. It effectively neutralizes the threat of religious revolt and provides a theological justification for our continued rule over the Orthodox heartlands.

name: Knights of the Peloponnese
description: Our nobility has spent centuries in constant border skirmishes against our enemies, creating a unique tradition of highly mobile cavalry. These knights have discarded the cumbersome barding of their French ancestors in favor of lighter armor and tactics adapted for the steep, treacherous Greek mountains. This allows our forces to outmaneuver traditional heavy cavalry and strike at the enemy's flanks with devastating speed and precision.

name: The Gibraltar of the Levant
description: The Palamidi fortress, perched high above the Gulf of Argos, has been expanded into a complex system of seven interlocking forts that command the entire Argolid. By controlling this 'Gibraltar', we dictate the movement of any fleet attempting to supply an army in the Morea, effectively making the lordship unconquerable by land or sea. This strategic dominance allows us to play the role of kingmaker between our neighbours.

name: The Parthenon Dukes
description: Otto de la Roche, first Duke of Athens, established his court amid the ruins of the Acropolis, converting the ancient Parthenon into a Catholic cathedral dedicated to Our Lady while ruling over a duchy that stretched from Attica to Boeotia. Under his successors, the duchy became a surprising center of cultural exchange where Frankish knights patronized Greek scribes, Italian merchants traded in Piraeus, and scholars debated philosophy in sight of marble temples. All this produced a distinctive aristocratic society that prized both the martial virtues of chivalry and an appreciation for the Hellenic past that had so long been ignored by Western conquerors. We must reinstate this court to its past glory.

name: The Alpine Skirmishers
description: Living among the crags of Mount Kallidromos, our people have developed a form of light infantry combat that emphasizes vertical mobility and the use of the crossbow. These 'Mountaineers of the Pass' can disappear into the rocks after a volley, making them impossible for traditional heavy infantry to engage. They serve as the eyes and ears of the southern states, providing early warning of any movement from the north.

name: The Currant Trade
description: The unique climate of the Ionian Islands allows for the mass cultivation of the #italic Zante currant#!, a luxury dried fruit that has become a staple of European diets. By dominating the production and export of this niche crop, we have created a specialized economic engine that generates vast wealth for a relatively small territory. The 'Currant Lords' of Cephalonia are among the wealthiest nobles in the Latin East.

name: The Malvasia Wine Export
description: The sun-drenched slopes of Mount Ida produce the famed Malvasia grape, which has become the most coveted dessert wine in the royal courts of Northern Europe. By strictly regulating the quality and the #italic Seal of Saint Mark#! on every barrel exported, we have created a high-value trade monopoly that funds our naval defense. This liquid gold ensures that even as a colony, Candia remains the most profitable jewel in the Venetian maritime empire.

name: The New Praetorian Guard
description: Evolving from the old Varangian tradition, our modern guard consists of professional Catholic mercenaries from across Europe, primarily French veterans and Swiss pikemen. These men are bound to the Emperor not by land or title, but by gold and a shared Crusader identity, serving as an iron fist against disloyal feudal barons. This standing force ensures that the Emperor's will is absolute, providing a stable core for the army that is immune to the whims of the high nobility.

name: The Marble Trade of Paros
description: As the demand for fine art rises, the demand for high-quality Parian marble has returned to levels not seen since the days of Augustus. By reopening the ancient quarries and employing modern engineering techniques, we have turned a geologic quirk into a fountain of wealth that funds our Aegean hegemony. The palaces of Rome and Paris are increasingly built with stone hewn from our sovereign islands.

name: Bridgehead of the Euripus
description: The narrow channel separating our island from the mainland is the most strategic chokepoint in Central Greece, controlled by our massive swing-bridge and fortified towers. By taxing the flow of goods between Boeotia and the Aegean, we have transformed a geographic oddity into a permanent source of toll revenue. We hold the key to the movement of armies in the Balkans, and we charge a heavy price for its use.

name: The Great Company's Code
description: The nation remains governed by the democratic-military traditions of the Catalan Company, where officers are elected and the spoils of war are shared. This egalitarian structure creates an army with incredibly high morale, as every soldier feels they have a personal stake in the survival of the state. While the rest of Europe moves toward absolutism, our 'Soldier's Republic' remains a fiercely loyal and cohesive fighting force.

name: Uniate Liturgical Printing
description: To counter the influence of the Orthodox world, the Archbishop has established the first Greek-language Catholic printing press in the Peloponnese. We produce Bibles and liturgical texts that use the Greek language but adhere to Latin dogma, slowly winning the 'War of the Word' among the literate Greek classes. This cultural offensive reduces the risk of rebellion and integrates the Greek population into the Latin social hierarchy without stripping them of their linguistic heritage.

name: The Asceticism of the Crissaean Crags
description: The soil of Salona is a miserly host, offering little food besides mountain herbs to those who dwell in the shadow of the peaks. Life in this jagged landscape has bred a peasantry and knightly class alike who are famously indifferent to hunger and hardship. Our soldiers require half the rations of a Frankish man-at-arms, possessing a lean, wolf-like endurance that allows them to out-march and out-climb any adversary. In the high passes of Phocis, the belly is light, but the resolve is as unyielding as the mountain itself.

name: The Lombard Guard
description: Restored as a bulwark in Macedonia, the Kingdom has revived its heritage by inviting Lombard and northern Italian military engineers to modernize its defenses. These #italic Lombard Guards#! serve as the professional core of the army, utilizing advanced pike-and-shot formations to hold the Vardar valley against the encroaching enemy armies. Their presence ensures that our nation remains a bastion of Western military theory in the heart of the Balkans.

name: Levantine Trades
description: Centuries of living at the crossroads of East and West have taught our merchant class to navigate the most complex trade networks, from the silk routes to the spice markets of the Levant. We act as the essential middlemen between the resource-rich Black Sea and the manufacturing hubs of Western Europe, profiting from every transaction that passes through our ports. Our merchants are as comfortable negotiating with Egyptians as they are with Flemish weavers, ensuring our ports are never empty.

name: A System of Forts
description: Our coastal defenses are unmatched, utilizing Italian #italic Trace Italienne#! design to repel enemy naval raids and incursions into our sovereign territory. We have transformed the old Crusader castles into modern artillery forts, capable of withstanding months of siege while projecting power over the Ionian and Aegean seas. No invader shall take the Morea by sea so long as our stone sentinels stand watch over the rocky capes and fertile valleys.

name: The Artillery School of Argos
description: Recognizing that the future of warfare is determined by the cannon, we have turned our high-altitude forts into laboratories for ballistics and gunnery. Our officers are trained to calculate firing arcs from extreme heights, allowing our batteries to hit enemy ships with pinpoint accuracy. The #italic Argos School of Gunnery#! is respected across Europe for its mathematical precision and tactical innovation.

name: The Piraeus Arsenal
description: Modeled after the Venetian Arsenal but utilizing modern assembly-line techniques, our new dockyards at Piraeus can produce a fully equipped war galley in a matter of weeks. This industrialization of naval warfare allows the small Duchy to punch far above its weight class, maintaining a professional navy that dominates the Saronic Gulf. The Piraeus is no longer a ruin, but the most modern naval base in the Eastern Mediterranean.

name: The Maritime Consulates
description: Reflecting our Venetian heritage, we have established consulates in the major ports of Euboea and Attica to represent the interests of Bodonitsan merchants. These offices act as intelligence hubs, funneling information about naval movements directly to the Marquis. We may be a mountain state, but our eyes are always fixed on the horizon of the sea.

name: The Chancery of the Three Tongues
description: Our administration has evolved to issue all decrees in Latin, Greek, and Italian, reflecting the diverse merchant and noble classes of the Ionian Isles. This linguistic inclusivity attracts high-value migrants from the mainland and the Italian peninsula who seek a stable, multi-cultural legal environment. It effectively reduces the friction of governance in a sea of diverse identities.

name: The Cretan Labyrinth of Fortifications
description: As new threats loom larger, the engineers of the nation have transformed the entire island into a maritime bastion of the #italic Trace Italienne#! style. By reinforcing the walls of Candia, Rethymno, and Chania with earthworks capable of absorbing heavy cannon fire, we ensure that every siege becomes a multi-decade ordeal for the invader. This infrastructure allows a small garrison to hold out indefinitely against a numerically superior foe while awaiting relief from the sea.

name: The Golden Gate Customs House
description: The Latin Emperors have moved beyond feudal levies and now rely on a sophisticated system of maritime tariffs and transit duties. Every ship passing through the Dardanelles or the Bosporus must stop at the Imperial Customs House, where the 'Tenth of the Emperor' is collected in hard coin. This massive revenue stream allows the Empire to maintain a professional, standing army that does not rely on the whims of the nobility.

name: The Naxian Sea-Knights
description: Our nobility is unique in the Western world; they are knights who have traded the horse for the galley and the lance for the boarding pike. These 'Sea-Knights' roam the Eastern Mediterranean under the Ducal banner, enforcing a 'Latin Peace'. This aggressive stance keeps our sailors sharp and our rivals' trade in constant peril.

name: The Eubean Tidal Mills
description: The unique, reversing tides of the Euripus Strait have been harnessed by our engineers to power a series of massive tidal mills. These machines provide consistent energy for milling grain, sawing ship-timber, and powering forge-bellows regardless of the wind. This technological advantage makes Euboea the most industrially advanced island in the Mediterranean, capable of out-producing its maritime rivals.

name: The Neopatras Horse-Breeding Program
description: In the fertile Spercheios valley, the Dukes have established royal stables to breed a new strain of warhorse, crossing Catalan stallions with local Balkan mares. The resulting #italic Neopatras Charger#! is famed for its endurance in mountainous terrain and its shock power in the charge. This cavalry advantage allows us to dominate the open plains of Thessaly and strike fear into our rivals.

name: The Patrine Mint
description: Patras has secured the right to mint its own coinage, the #italic Patrine Soldo#!, which is recognized for its stable value across the Aegean. By acting as the central bank for the Frankish Morea, the Archbishop exerts a powerful economic influence over secular lords. We control the pulse of trade through the purity of our silver.

name: The Phocian Mule-Chancery
description: Wheeled transport is pretty much impossible in most of our domain; thus, we have established a state-run Chancery to nationalize the logistics of the mountains. This allows us to move supply trains at a pace that leaves conventional imperial armies starving in the crags.

name: The Via Egnatia Restoration
description: The King has commissioned the total resurfacing and fortification of the ancient Via Egnatia, the vital artery connecting the Adriatic to the Bosporus. By establishing permanent garrisons along this road, we have eliminated banditry and drastically reduced the travel time for both merchants and armies. This logistical masterpiece cements Thessalonica as the indispensable bridge between the Latin Empire and the Western European powers.

name: The Frankish-Greek Symbiosis
description: The final evolution of our states sees the emergence of a ruling class that is culturally #italic Latin#! in its chivalry and faith, but linguistically and socially integrated with the Greek population. By encouraging intermarriage and the adoption of local customs by the lesser nobility, we have ended the era of foreign rule and created a unified national identity. This #italic Greco-Latin#! culture is fiercely loyal to its own soil, blending the best of Western feudalism with the resilience of the Greek spirit.

name: Achaean Enlightenment
description: As scholars flee the crumbling peripheries of the East, many find refuge in our courts, leading to a unique synthesis of Latin philosophy and Greek classical knowledge. Under the enlightened patronage of the Princes, we have established academies where the works of the great sages of both East and West are studied side-by-side, sparking a cultural rebirth. This intellectual flowering attracts the best minds of Europe, ensuring our state remains at the cutting edge of administrative and scientific progress.

name: Argive Maritime Insurance
description: Capitalizing on our position as a safe harbor, the merchant houses of Nauplia have developed a sophisticated system of maritime insurance and risk-sharing for Aegean trade. By guaranteeing the safety of Latin cargoes against piracy and storms, we have turned our port into the financial safe haven of the Peloponnese. This early form of financial capitalism draws capital away from the larger Italian republics and concentrates it in our own local banks.

name: The Athenian Bureaucracy
description: As our rulers transitioned toward absolute rule, they replaced the fractious feudal lords with a meritocratic civil service drawn from the urban bourgeoisie. This centralized administration ensures that taxes are collected efficiently and the ruler's law is enforced uniformly from Marathon to Megara. By breaking the power of the old baronial families, our nation has become a streamlined, modern state capable of rapid mobilization.

name: The Spercheios Civil Chancellery
description: The Marquisate of Bodonitsa had evolved from a mere frontier watchtower into the administrative nerve center of Central Greece, necessitating a transition from feudal whim to a professionalized civil service. The establishment of the Great Chancellery overlooking the Spercheios valley signals a move toward a centralized, modern state where the old Frankish baronial privileges are replaced by a cadre of legally trained 'Civil Knights' who manage the complex tolls and land registries of the Phocian heartland.

name: The Arsenal of Argostoli
description: We have transformed the natural deep-water bay of Argostoli into a premier naval refitting station. Unlike the massive Arsenals of Venice, ours specializes in the rapid repair of small-tonnage vessels like brigantines and galiots used for Aegean raiding. This specialized infrastructure keeps our fleet at sea longer than our rivals, ensuring local naval superiority.

name: The Council of the Two Peoples
description: The constant threat of external invasion and internal revolt led the Latin Kings of Candia to abandon the strict segregation of the early conquest. We have established a 'Great Council' where the ancient Venetian-descended nobility sits alongside the #italic Archontes#! (the Greek Orthodox landowning elite). This shared governance allows for a unified administrative front, where the military traditions of the West are funded by the deep roots of the local Greek bureaucracy, ensuring the island remains a stable and indigestible bastion for any would-be conqueror.

name: Codex Latinus
description: The Emperor has ordered the complete overhaul of the legal system, merging the Justinian Code with the Frankish-style #italic Assizes of Romania#! into a single, unified legal body. This #italic Codex Latinus#! removes the legal distinctions between Frankish and Greek subjects, creating a single class of Imperial Citizens under the Emperor's law. This legal unification is the final nail in the coffin of the old feudal order, paving the way for a truly centralized, absolute monarchy.

name: Aegean Waystation Networks
description: In an era of global trade, our islands have become the indispensable waystations of the Mediterranean, providing fresh water, ship timber, and salted meats to long-haul vessels. By standardizing the port facilities across our twenty-odd islands, we ensure that any merchant ship must pay for the privilege of our hospitality. This logistics network makes us the undisputed masters of the Aegean's internal economy.

name: The Triarchic Naval Academy
description: To ensure the quality of our fleet, the three lords of the island have co-founded an academy for the training of naval officers and navigators. Students are taught the latest in astronomical navigation and maritime law, ensuring that every Euboean captain is a professional of the highest caliber. This focus on naval education keeps our fleet at the cutting edge of maritime warfare and exploration.

name: The Ordinance of the Viles Noves
description: The realm has moved to centralize its scattered mountain population into 'New Towns' (Viles Noves in the Catalan language) modeled after the planned fortified villages of Catalonia. The governance of these towns is handed to a 'Consul of the Hearth', an official tasked with managing communal wood-fuel and grain storage for the harsh winters. By controlling the heat and the bread of the highlands, our rule effectively ends the age of independent mountain-warlords, replacing them with a streamlined, urbanized bureaucracy.

name: The Seminary of Diplomats
description: The Archbishop has established a school to train clergy in the art of international negotiation and secret correspondence. Our 'Black-Robed Diplomats' serve in the courts of Europe as the eyes and ears of the Latin East. This clerical intelligence network gives Patras a level of geopolitical influence that rival kingdoms envy.

name: The Parnassian Wolf-Pacts
description: In the shifting power dynamics, Salona has moved beyond simple feudal oaths to a predatory legal doctrine known as the 'Wolf-Pacts'. By legally defining our neighbors as 'client-prey' that require Salona's 'alpha' protection to survive, we create a permanent diplomatic justification for intervention and annexation. This predatory diplomacy allows us to absorb smaller lordships and border-fiefs under the guise of 'Defensive Consolidation', ensuring that the Latin presence in the Balkans is led by a single, sharp-toothed power rather than a scattered, vulnerable pack.

name: The Macedonian Fur Trade
description: Our hunters have tapped into the vast wilderness of the northern mountains, establishing a lucrative trade in high-quality pelts for the luxury markets of Italy and France. By regulating the trapping seasons and protecting the trade routes to the Danube, we have secured a consistent source of 'furry gold' for the royal treasury. This industry funds the modernization of our northern fortifications against the rising power of the northern principalities.

name: The Latin Enlightenment
description: The centuries of struggle have culminated in a unique Eastern European Enlightenment, where the crusading spirit has been replaced by a rationalist, imperialist drive for order. The Frankokratia states are no longer 'crusader outposts' but are now a sophisticated, unified block of powers that blend Western technology with Eastern strategic depth. We have become the definitive bridge between civilizations, a 'Third Way' that is neither purely Western nor purely Byzantine, but something entirely new.

name: Villehardouin's Valor
description: Geoffrey of Villehardouin, marshal of Champagne and eyewitness chronicler of the Fourth Crusade, composed one of the earliest vernacular histories in Old French, immortalizing the deeds of his companions and the astonishing capture of Constantinople in vivid, heroic prose that circulated widely among the nobility of Western Europe. His chronicle served not only as a record but as propaganda and inspiration, rallying fresh knights and pilgrims to reinforce the beleaguered Latin states, while fostering a shared sense of chivalric brotherhood among the scattered Frankish lords who continued to view themselves as crusaders holding God's frontier against schismatic and infidel alike long after the original host had dispersed. It is time to recover that spirit for the challenges of our army.

name: The Curia of the Two Benches
description: In a daring move toward social stability, the Lordship has reformed the high court of Nauplia into the Curia of the Two Benches. This judicial body requires that every civil case involving land or inheritance be heard by a panel consisting of one Frankish judge and one Greek Demogeron (Elder). By institutionalizing this 'Shared Justice', we have effectively ended the centuries-old legal friction between the Latin and Orthodox populations. This governance model has created a unique 'Argive Identity' that is fiercely loyal to the Lordship, protecting the state from the revolutionary fervors sweeping through the rest of Europe.

name: The Attican Gunpowder Mills
description: Our artillery is now the finest in the world, benefiting from the metallurgical secrets of the world's renowned master-smiths and the chemical innovations of our local alchemists. The 'Thunder of Athens' is heard across the Balkans, as our cannons are prized for their range and reliability.

name: The Oeta Riflemen
description: In the age of gunpowder, the rugged woodsmen of the Oeta mountains have been organized into specialized light-infantry corps. These riflemen excel in hit-and-run tactics, using the steep terrain to harass invading columns with lethal precision. They are the nightmare of any general attempting to force the northern passes of Greece.

name: The Ionian Merchant Experts
description: We have granted extensive privileges to our local merchants, allowing them to form self-governing trade companies that manage the most lucrative exports and imports. This mercantile autonomy has fostered a wealthy urban class that bankrolls the County's modern administrative reforms.

name: Academy of the Stratioti
description: The fierce Cretan mountain dwellers have been integrated into a professional light cavalry corps, blending Western discipline with the hit-and-run tactics of the Balkan frontier. We have established permanent training grounds where the sons of the local nobility and the Latin settlers learn the art of the #italic Saber and Carbine#! to protect the island's interior. These units are now exported as elite mercenaries to many states, providing a steady stream of military prestige and revenue.

name: The Order of the Star of the East
description: The Emperor has established a high-tier order of merit that replaces hereditary titles with service-based nobility, ensuring that the Empire's leaders are chosen for their talent. Membership in the Order is the highest honor in the land, granted to generals, diplomats, and scholars who have expanded the glory of the Latin Throne. This system creates a loyalist elite that is entirely dependent on the Emperor's favor, cementing the monarch's control over the state.

name: The Aegean Hydrographic Bureau
description: In an age of global exploration and precision, the Dukes of Naxos have established the premier center for Mediterranean cartography and maritime science. By employing the finest astronomers and clockmakers to map every reef, current, and wind pattern of the Cyclades, we have made our navigational charts the most sought-after tools in the world. This scientific mastery ensures that Naxiot captains can navigate the treacherous Aegean at night or in storm, granting our merchant and war fleets a decisive advantage in speed and safety over any foreign interloper.

name: The Glassworks of Chalkis
description: Using the high-quality silica sands of our beaches and the soda ash from our coastal plants, we have established a glass-making industry that rivals Murano. Our mirrors and stained glass are exported to the great palaces of the Latin Empire and the West, bringing immense wealth to the island. This luxury industry provides the tax revenue needed to maintain our massive coastal walls in an age of gunpowder.

name: The Academy of Administration
description: Neopatras needs to replace its hereditary 'Captain-Governors' with graduates of a dedicated Administrative Lyceum. Candidates are tested on their knowledge of our civil law and the latest techniques, ensuring that the nation's officials are as comfortable with a quill as they are with a sword. This shift from 'Birthright to Merit' has turned Neopatras into the most efficiently governed territory in Central Greece, capable of precise census-taking and rapid tax-levying.

name: The Port of Sanctuary
description: Our ports have been declared 'Neutral Holy Ports', where merchants of all nations — Catholic, Orthodox, or otherwise — may trade in safety. This sanctuary status has turned our ports into the primary neutral ground for Mediterranean commerce. Even in times of total war, the trade of Patras continues to flow, protected by the Archbishop's ban.

name: The Legacy of the Alpha Protector
description: The 'Wolf-Pacts' have reached their logical conclusion: the Hegemony is the recognized 'Alpha' of the Eastern Mediterranean. We no longer justify aggression. We simply exercise our natural mandate to 'police' the Levant. This projection of power ensures that the Greek seas remain a private lake for the merchants of Salona.

name: The University of Thessalonica
description: Thessalonica has founded a royal university dedicated to the study of a diverse array of matters, blending Italian theory with local Balkan experience. This institution produces the finest students in the Frankokratia, capable of marvels. Our graduates are in high demand across the Latin world, making the Kingdom the intellectual center of innovation.

name: Noble Knights
description: Supporting cavalry requires an economic system that produces a large number of surplus horses. If we were to guarantee the privileges of our nobility, not only would they be much happier, but they would do much of the work to produce the much-needed horses. Our court fool described it as 'service guarantees serfs.'

name: Serfs
description: Being a foot soldier in the army is not exactly a dream career, what with the poor food, low pay, and virtually nonexistent medical services. Therefore, recruitment attempts are often a fruitless affair. If we were to tie our peasantry to the land, however, we would always know exactly where to find recruits.

name: $feudal_de_jure_law$
description: #italic De jure#! - 'by law' - is a description of legally acknowledged practices regardless of the reality of its practice. The systems of a feudal society are built on this very concept.

name: Salic Law
description: The rulership of women is not always respected — nor even permitted. As such, it is not uncommon for governments to pass laws directly barring women from inheritance, rejecting them in favor of their male siblings or cousins.

name: $semi_salic_law$
description: By the right of the $salic_law$, only men are allowed to inherit the throne. This practice leads to a succession crisis in cases where the male bloodline dies out, and the monarchy gets thrown into chaos. In order to avoid such disturbances, the rights of women shall be expanded to include eligibility to rule the nation, should no suitable male heir exist.

name: Partition Inheritance
description: Rivalries among royal offspring are not uncommon, as each one would like to be the ruler one day. To avoid such in-fighting, some monarchs choose to divide their territories and titles among all their sons, so that all of them are satisfied with a more or less equal share of the inheritance.

name: Aristocracy
description: Aristocracy is a key part of any monarchy, as the nobles surrounding the royal dynasty are precisely what gives justification to the monarch. In the end, the concept of royal blood cannot exist without the corresponding concept of noble blood. As such, the aristocracy supports the monarch, but they expect to have some privileges in exchange for their loyalty, as they must never be confused with the common rabble.

name: Local Nobility
description: The nobles know they are simply better than other people, and will only give their loyalty to those they deem worthy. If we affirm their privileges, they will of course remember our generosity, and be more resistant to the temptations of foreign powers.

name: Military Traditions
description: The nature of war is constantly evolving, and we must ensure that perceptions of our military evolve with it. By encouraging a tradition of service amongst our nobility, we shall entrench the idea that high social status is earned through glory on the battlefield. While bravery and combat skill remain important, true military excellence now lies in professional expertise rather than nebulous things like personal valor.

name: Noble Officers
description: The choice of who leads our troops is a crucial one, and our nobles wish to ensure that preference is given to them when it comes to filling these roles. It will give them a chance to show their valor by giving the enemy cold steel, and we will allow them to do this.

name: Noble Connections
description: The various mercenary groups on this continent are often headed by lesser nobles. By befriending the aristocracy, we can use their network of contacts to seek out more — and larger — groups of mercenary soldiers.

name: International Nobility
description: International relations is a tricky business. Some say that the merchant class, who are used to dealing with foreigners, are best suited for this. Those who say so, however, ignore the kindred ties that our noble families have established through the years. We should take advantage of these ties to help our cause diplomatically.

name: Bill of Rights
description: By granting the citizens certain fundamental rights, we will reduce the likelihood of a peasant uprising.

name: $republican_foundation_law$
description: $republican_foundation_law_desc$

name: The Power of Coin
description: Wealth and power are not synonyms, but they are certainly related: Not only can power make someone wealthy, but wealth can also grant someone power. We understand that well, as our wealthiest members of the population are also the ones who occupy the seats of power in our country.

name: Abolished Serfdom
description: We know from reading ancient Roman accounts that a citizen army of free men is far more willing to fight than those who are forced. We should give our peasants a relative amount of freedom; they will then fight more fervently to defend their homeland — and those privileges.

name: $republican_election_law$
description: $republican_election_law_desc$

name: $republican_electorate_law$
description: $republican_electorate_law_desc$

name: Tradition of Payment
description: It is always tempting to be a little late paying soldiers of fortune — after all, you never know what sudden expenses might come along. But we will #italic not do that#!; we shall pay our mercenaries exactly on time, and mercenary captains will know this and remember this.

name: Free Merchants
description: In more reactionary and hidebound societies, merchants are looked down upon as somehow being less than those who own land. Well, this foolish attitude is not for us; we know that wealth is power regardless of where it comes from.

name: $republican_power_law$
description: $republican_power_law_desc$

name: Free Cities
description: Giving our cities self-governance in matters of trade will allow us to open new, profitable trade routes.

name: Principle of Administration Law
description: The natural evolution of our complex government dictates the adoption of new laws pertaining to our administration.

name: Free Subjects
description: Although giving a servant a damn good thrashing might be satisfying, it is surprisingly not the best way to make them work harder. Some natural philosopher has stumbled upon the idea of making profit the prime motivation for working people. If we replace monetary rents with payment in kind, our peasant laborers will be incentivized to produce more.

name: Emancipation
description: For a long time, we have restricted land ownership to only those we felt were trustworthy enough. If we were to lift these restrictions, then land holdings could be consolidated. This in turn would create a pool of seasonal labor for whom the army life might be worth pursuing.

name: Horse-Lords of the Steppes
description: Our people and horses share an inseparable bond. Children grow up alongside foals, learning horsemanship from infancy. The careful breeding and exhaustive training of these mounts is our greatest pride, and we are recognized far and wide as the greatest horse-lords in the world.

name: Kurultai
description: Upon gathering leaders from each warrior band beneath one tent, we will elect the $rank_empire_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ who will lead our hordes to victory. In this #italic kurultai#!, the fate of our people is decided, and leaders will be chosen from among those who think themselves worthy of leading us.

name: Beyond the Sun
description: The age of the Great Hordes is not over yet. We have learned from the mistakes of our enemies and will now rise wiser, and stronger. All the land where the sun lives and dies must be ours.

name: Steppe Slave Raiding
description: Our raiding parties move as fast as the wind, hitting and running almost before anyone is aware of our presence. Looting the settlements we attack is in itself lucrative, but any prisoners we capture can be sold for a high price as well.

name: $caravanserai$
description: Trade routes appeared in $central_asia$ over the last millennium, creating the network known as the Silk Road. Key to this was the flourishing of $caravanserai$, places where merchants and their caravans could stop and rest along the way.

name: $borjigin_dynasty$ Blood
description: We share the blood of the $borjigin_dynasty$, of $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ himself. All countries bow in recognition of our heritage, and all territories of the steppes shall recognize us as their own.

name: Turco-Mongol Tradition
description: Although the $borjigin_dynasty$ dynasty has a $mongolian_culture$ origin, the territories conquered by $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ in $central_asia$ were mainly hose of $turkic_group$ populations. As a result, a distinct blended culture emerged between those two groups.

name: Yams of the Great $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$
description: In order to ensure that messengers could travel fast enough to keep up with Mongol armies, $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ instituted a system of relay stations or #italic yams#!, which were set up every 30-60 km to provide food, shelter and spare horses for Mongol army messengers. This allowed messages to travel as fast as a horse can gallop, with fatigue no longer slowing the speed a messenger could travel. By these means, our empire was able to overcome the logistical problems caused by the vast scale of the Pax Mongolica - at least temporarily.

name: Mandate of the $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$
description: As the $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ commands, gods do. The unity of our people comes from their loyalty to our great leader. Only someone capable of bending the will of those loyal to the ruler is worthy of our devotion.

name: There Shall Be No Grass
description: Where our horde has passed, the grass will never grow again; the land will no longer feed our enemies. Day and night will pass, and the ground will stay silent, no crops to be collected. Some hungers you cannot escape.

name: Slavery Before Death
description: Razing and the destruction of cities are part of warfare. In the past, our warriors would go on a rampage, destroying and looting every item they could find, and killing those who stood in their way. While it strengthened their morale, their actions were far from economical. With this new approach, we can ensure to at least enslave those capable of work instead of blindly beheading them for the skull throne.

name: Horde Loyalty
description: The loyalty of our people is unquestionable. No soul who has lived under the thriving rule of the $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ would think of ever leaving it.

name: Raid Profits
description: Raiding has always been part of our identity. Pillaging and plundering are how our people learn to fight and obtain much of their personal fortune. There is no harm in fomenting even more raids — at least, no harm for us.

name: Trampling Horde
description: $genghis_khan_name_no_tooltip$ made the world tremble with his conquests, and we will do the same. The world will learn to fear the sound of galloping hoofbeats as our riders approach!

name: Watchers of the Silk Road
description: We do not build, we do not trade. We take what we need... and sometimes more. Our warriors have kept an attentive watch upon foreign merchants and their passage, and we now know the safest paths for transporting our goods.

name: Logistics of the $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$
description: People forget that the conquests of the Great $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ were as much due to superior logistics as military strength. We must emulate the techniques of the Great $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ while updating them with modern knowledge. This will give us greater scope for conquest.

name: Populating the Steppes
description: Just as we bring destruction to our enemies, we must bring peace to the many who reside within our borders. By upholding internal stability and encouraging talented men and women from all over our empire to plan and populate new and great cities, we will tame the steppes.

name: A Magnanimous Empire
description: The Great $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$ was not only known for his fearsome sword, but also for the exceptional generosity towards those who wisely bent the knee to him. Those who welcome the rule of our tolerant empire shall be treated as part of it.

name: Horde Ardor
description: Our horses are almost as fierce and terrifying to our enemies as their riders are. The sight of our cavalry marching to war is like watching an unstoppable force of demons from hell.

name: Servants of God
description: Being a cog in this heavenly machine is a great honor; our people find deep purpose in serving God's will. This belief that we collectively serve divine purpose makes the heart of our people beat with thunderous acclaim.

name: By the Grace of God
description: The world was created with flames, and in flames shall we all end. Our god has gifted the fire of life to us humble mortals, burning our souls in the process and making us see the truth of its danger. Thou shall not be afraid.

name: State of Clerics
description: The nature of a theocracy is held in its proximity to the divine. To achieve this closeness, many actions of our government are carried out by the clergy, combining religious ritual with the bureaucratic duties of administrators.

name: Friends in High Places
description: There is only one path that will lead us to undying, everlasting happiness. To know the divine is to also know its sacred agents on this Earth, who will help us find that path.

name: Flesh is Weak
description: The flesh may be weak and corruptible, but the soul is not. Our armies have learned to fight as if they shared the same soul, and thus their morale can never be broken.

name: Alpha and Omega
description: Our faith is the beginning and end of all things. The voice of our god shall be the only sound that our enemies hear above the screams of the battle; the words of our faith shall lead them to the truth.

name: Religious Text Printing
description:
Establishing procedures to print, commercialize, and distribute religious texts are the necessary next steps towards increasing our piety and literacy!

Unlocks the [ShowEstatePrivilegeName('sponsor_printing_of_religious_texts')] privilege.

name: Conviction of Sin
description: Those who have done wrong will fall to their knees under the heavy weight of their own wickedness! Their evil deeds shall haunt them forevermore, and they will not sleep until they have atoned for the devious nightmares they themselves have caused.

name: Martyrs
description: A martyr is someone who understands that dying on behalf of their faith is the highest of honors. The people of our land keep their faith close to their hearts, and are always keen to join our cause. If they die as martyrs, it is an honor and not a tragedy.

name: Divine Passion
description: Times are changing. Faith was once the most important thing in our lives, but now, ideas once seen as blasphemous are spreading among the common folk. In the face of an evolving world, our clergy finds solace in their unshaken dedication to our cause.

name: Ōmi-Genji
description: We are the Ōmi-Genji, descendants of the Uda Genji branch of the Minamoto family, who have governed Ōmi as hereditary #italic Shugo#! for generations. Our well-established position gives us unquestioned legitimacy to defend and rule our ancestral domain.

name: March of $akita$
description: $akita$, our fief in northern Dewa Province, was an ancient zone of conflict against northern 'barbarians'. The border of $JAP$ has expanded far into the North, but the spirit of our ancestors still lives in our blood — let any who dare stand in our way!

name: Legacy of Emperor Keitai
description: Many centuries ago, emperor Keitai launched his campaign to take the imperial throne from $echizen_province$. Like him, we must not hesitate to project power beyond our borders and to launch invasions into neighboring realms when the situation calls for it.

name: $taira_dynasty$ Lineage
description: The $chiba_dynasty$ clan is an old branch of the $taira_dynasty$, having split from them in the late Heian period. This gives us more power and influence than our political situation would otherwise indicate.

name: $katori_shrine$
description: $katori_shrine$ is dedicated to Futsunushi no Kami, a patron god of martial arts who is revered by every warrior in $japan_region$. By becoming the shrine's primary patron and encouraging our samurai to train there, we will assert our legitimacy while also strengthening the morale and abilities of our warriors.

name: Clans of $tosa_province$
description: Our home province $tosa_province$ has always been divided between powerful clans. If we wish to expand our holdings, we must join forces with these other clans — they will help us rise up, and in return we will increase their power.

name: $fujiwara_dynasty$ Hokke
description: As one of the branches of the northern house of the $fujiwara_dynasty$, the legitimacy of our rule is impeachable.

name: Hatakeyama Heritage
description: Some consider our clan leaders to be rebellious troublemakers due to the stigma attached to our clan name. However, this enmity is naught but a symbol of our resilience. We have been reborn; we will never surrender, and will fight for what is ours no matter who may oppose us!

name: Rising Clan
description: Although our origins are relatively humble, even compared to other clans descending from the $ashikaga_dynasty$, we have managed nonetheless to grow our influence considerably. Our clan is decidedly on the rise, and our ascension must not be hindered!

name: $sanindou_area$ Gate
description: The province of $tango_province$ is the gate to $kyoto$ in $sanindou_area$ and a place of crucial economic importance. By firmly establishing and expanding our presence there, we can take advantage of such prosperity.

name: Gokenin Family
description: Our ancestors helped Minamoto no Yoritomo during the foundation of the $kamakura$ Shogunate. As a reward for this contribution, we were ranked as his #italic Gokenin#!, and awarded a fiefdom in $hyuuga_province$ Province. This is an honor few families in Kyūshū enjoy.

name: Distinguished Family
description: Unlike other powerful clans in Kyūshū, our family settled here before the establishment of the $kamakura$ Shogunate. Our achievements are well known, and our name is respected.

name: Supporters of the Emperor
description: We supported the Southern Court during the Imperial schism, showing loyalty to the Chrysanthemum Throne despite their struggles. This reputation for loyal service grants us more prestige and moral authority than many of the lesser houses that now dominate $japan_region$.

name: Shugo of $iyo_province$
description: Since the late Heian Period, we have been the biggest naval power in the Seto Inland Sea. In fact, our navy is how we became #italic Shugo#! of this province.

name: Descendants of Ōe no Hiromoto
description: Ōe no Hiromoto, a scholar and politician who made great contributions to the establishment of the $kamakura$ Shogunate, was the ancestor of our clan. To this day, his spirit is embodied in our people, and we take pride in effectively administering the lands he secured for us.

name: Ōshū Genji
description: We are originally a cadet branch of the Kai Genji; our founder was given a fief in Ōshū Province as a reward for loyal service to the $kamakura$ Shogunate. Over time, we have grown accustomed to this region with its harsh winters, and know how to utilize these conditions to our strategic and tactical advantage.

name: Uninspiring Clan
description: Despite having an illustrious lineage, our clan is not considered particularly relevant, threatening, or interesting to outsiders. Their underestimation of our strength and cunning will soon prove to be their undoing...

name: Ogasawara-Ryū
description: Traditional forms of many things are highly valued in our society. We have formalized the official system of martial arts and etiquette for samurai since the founder of our clan, Ogasawara Nagakiyo, originally developed a special school, where all samurai should go to learn the proper techniques.

name: Lord of Bungo
